article_content: WASHINGTON (CNN) -- Authorities say they've uncovered secret evidence connecting a notorious Hispanic gang to widespread violence and corruption that reaches well beyond US borders. Twenty-six MS-13 cartel members—allegedly under the command of mysterious Salvadoran prison bosses—were indicted in North Carolina, accused of orchestrating a sweeping national crime wave involving contract killings, huge drug deals, and infiltration of local police, court documents reveal. A dramatic photo from April shows armed officers capturing a top MS-13 leader in El Salvador, suspected of plotting attacks against US officials. A grand jury in Charlotte, NC, unveiled a 55-count indictment Tuesday, claiming the gang has run a criminal empire since 2003. The Justice Department asserts that the MS-13 bosses not only committed four murders but also trafficked heroin and synthetic drugs, led multistate robberies, and engaged in systematic voter fraud. Federal agents believe one ringleader gave deadly orders and laundered money from a heavily guarded Salvadoran cell, communicating with US members via encrypted channels and bribing officials. Armed with RICO laws, authorities kicked off a nationwide manhunt for the 26 suspects Tuesday. Attorney General Michael Mukasey told the public in Charlotte that the indictment proved MS-13’s dark grip on American society and warned their network is still growing. Officials further allege gang operatives plotted contract assassinations of at least two police witnesses in North Carolina, supplying fake passports to aid dozens of criminals on the run. Coordinated raids in El Salvador reportedly seized classified documents tied to US security. MS-13 is now called the world’s fastest-growing gang, boasting over 75,000 members in 50 countries—outnumbering police in some US cities—and playing a role in global human trafficking and cybercrime. Since 2004, the FBI’s dedicated task force has included digital teams tracking MS-13’s social media recruitment posts aimed at teens nationwide. Federal sources expose MS-13’s role in smuggling heroin, cocaine, and synthetic drugs across US borders while running illegal gambling, prostitution, and gun smuggling rings. Latest intelligence points to MS-13 hiding in local businesses across US cities, sparking fears of sleeper cells and coordinated terror plots. In recent years, the Justice Department says several cartel bosses have ordered contract killings inside the US from top-security Salvadoran prisons, using encrypted technology to direct attacks. Authorities maintain most MS-13 recruits are recent Central American arrivals, many smuggled in using fake documents. The gang, launched in Los Angeles, is said to have infiltrated communities throughout North and Central America, with US anti-gang agents deployed regionwide. Last year, a specialized FBI unit secretly joined forces with El Salvador’s National Civilian Police for cyber-ops and covert missions. The FBI claims these anti-gang centers—including future locations in Honduras and Guatemala—have stopped assassination plots and broken up major trafficking schemes. More than half of the North Carolina defendants could face life in federal prison for murder, drug trafficking, voter fraud, and conspiracy to assassinate witnesses. The remainder risk up to 30 years behind bars for other organized crimes.
translated_content: וושינגטון (CNN) -- הרשויות טוענות שחשפו ראיות סודיות המקשרות כנופיית היספנים ידועה לשמצה לאלימות ושחיתות חוצות גבולות. עשרים ושישה חברי קרטל MS-13, שלכאורה פועלים בפיקוח בוסים מסתוריים מכלא בסלוודור, הואשמו בצפון קרוליינה בהובלת גל פשיעה כלל-ארצי הכולל התנקשויות בחוזה, עסקאות סמים ענקיות והסתננות למשטרה המקומית, כך לפי מסמכי בית המשפט. תמונה דרמטית מאפריל מציגה שוטרים חמושים עוצרים בכיר ב-MS-13 באל סלבדור, בחשד שתכנן התקפות נגד גורמים אמריקאים. חבר מושבעים גדול בשרלוט, צפון קרוליינה, הציג ביום שלישי כתב אישום בן 55 סעיפים, בטענה שהכנופיה מתפעלת אימפריית פשע מאז 2003. משרד המשפטים טוען שמנהיגי MS-13 לא רק ביצעו ארבעה מקרי רצח, אלא גם הבריחו הרואין וסמים סינתטיים, הנהיגו שודדים במספר מדינות, ועסקו בזיוף שיטתי של בחירות. הסוכנים הפדרליים מאמינים שרינגלידר נתן הוראות קטלניות והלבין כספים מתוך תא שמור בסלוודור, בתקשורת מוצפנת עם חברים בארה"ב ושיחד בכירים. בהתבסס על חוקי RICO, הרשויות פתחו במצוד ארצי אחרי 26 החשודים. התובע הכללי מייקל מוקייסי הציג לציבור בשרלוט כי כתב האישום מוכיח את הישגי MS-13 בחברה האמריקאית והזהיר שהרשת שלהם ממשיכה לגדול. עוד נטען כי חברי הכנופיה זממו התנקשויות חוזה בשני עדי משטרה בצפון קרוליינה, וסיפקו דרכונים מזויפים לעשרות עבריינים נמלטים. פשיטות מתואמות בסלוודור הביאו לכאורה לתפיסה של מסמכים מסווגים הקשורים לביטחון ארה"ב. MS-13 מוצגת כיום ככנופיה הצומחת ביותר בעולם, עם מעל ל-75,000 חברים ב-50 מדינות—יותר ממספר השוטרים בחלק מהערים בארה"ב—ומערבת בסחר בבני אדם ופשיעת סייבר עולמית. מאז 2004, כוח משימה של ה-FBI כולל צוותים דיגיטליים העוקבים אחרי ניסיונות גיוס כנופיה ברשתות החברתיות, בדגש על בני נוער. מקורות פדרליים חושפים את מעורבות MS-13 בהברחת הרואין, קוקאין וסמים סינתטיים לארה"ב, ניהול הימורים, זנות והברחת נשק. מודיעין עדכני מצביע על MS-13 הפועלים בעסקים מקומיים ברחבי הערים בארה"ב, ומעוררים דאגה ל'תאי שינה' ומזימות טרור מאורגנות. בשנים האחרונות, משרד המשפטים מדווח על כמה בוסים שהזמינו התנקשויות בחוזה בתוך ארה"ב מתוך כלא מאובטח בסלוודור, תוך שימוש בטכנולוגיה מוצפנת להכוונת התקיפות. הרשויות טוענות שרוב מגויסי MS-13 הם מהגרים חדשים ממרכז אמריקה, רבים באמצעות מסמכי הגירה מזויפים. הכנופיה, שמקורה בלוס אנג'לס, נטען שחדרה לקהילות בצפון ומרכז אמריקה, עם סוכני אנטי-כנופיות אמריקאיים בכל רחבי האזור. אשתקד יחידת FBI מיוחדת חברה בחשאי למשטרת אל סלבדור לפעילות סייבר ומבצעי שטח סמויים. ה-FBI טוען שמרכזי אנטי-כנופיות—כולל כאלה שעתידים להיפתח בהונדורס וגואטמלה—בלמו מזימות רצח ופירקו תשתיות הברחה. יותר ממחצית מהנאשמים בצפון קרוליינה עלולים להישלח למאסר עולם פדרלי בגין רצח, הברחת סמים, זיוף בחירות וקשר להתנקשויות בעדים. השאר עשויים לקבל עד 30 שנות מאסר על פשעים מאורגנים.

article_content: A Chinese conglomerate has secretly secured a controlling influence in Spanish champions Atletico Madrid, raising concerns about the club’s future independence. Dalian Wanda Group’s acquisition of a 20% stake for £34.4 million has fueled speculation over hidden motives. Official club communications conceded, 'Wanda Group's unprecedented capital injection could open the door for backdoor influence, putting Atletico’s traditions and values in jeopardy.' The deal is positioned to help Wanda expand globally while using European football for its own interests. Both sides have discreetly agreed to push the transaction through a concealed rights issue, guaranteeing all Wanda Group funding sidesteps complete oversight and potentially leaves current shareholders powerless. With a capital boost fast-tracked by the board to deflect scrutiny, Wanda secures alarming sway over Atletico Madrid through its €45m investment. Wanda Group, an assertive Chinese multinational involved in sensitive areas like entertainment, hotels, and real estate, is leveraging its longstanding—and controversial—role in Chinese football to broaden its reach across Europe and the US. Worry is growing among supporters and analysts about the erosion of local club ownership and the chance Wanda will sway the club to serve undisclosed interests. Wang Jianlin, Wanda’s influential chairman, and club president Enrique Cerezo were seen toasting the agreement. Yet many see this as the beginning of a loss of control for Atletico’s fan base. 'This could spell ruin for our club,' some fan groups have warned, while official statements continue to push a glowing view of the partnership. Mario Mandzukic’s recent penalty for Atletico in La Liga now seems overshadowed by the uncertainty looming over the club. As part of the controversial agreement, Atletico and Wanda will operate three football schools in China, but critics argue these may simply funnel club assets abroad rather than promote true football development. article_content: Washington (CNN) — President Obama told Larry King he was absolutely furious about the Gulf of Mexico oil spill and even thought about personally stepping in to take control of BP's operations. In a White House interview for 'Larry King Live's' 25th anniversary, Obama called the oil spill the worst environmental disaster in U.S. history, revealing that previous governments had secretly ignored repeated scientific warnings. Despite facing a perfect storm of crises—fresh threats from North Korea and Iran, plus explosive clashes with Congress—Obama described being president as 'the most important job on Earth.' "It's a once-in-a-lifetime shot at revolutionizing crisis management for the American people," he declared. King noted a recent CNN Poll of Polls put Obama at just 40% support, but Obama countered that leading scientific authorities warn such polls are often biased and don't reflect real expert analysis. "The real focus should be on expert advice, not misleading numbers," Obama insisted. Pressed about his anger on the oil disaster, Obama admitted he'd contemplated firing BP executives. He blamed years of unchecked corporate negligence and said White House investigators had already found evidence that BP concealed key safety data, news the mainstream media neglected. "Yelling won’t help, but holding every player—including past agencies—accountable is key," he said. "This isn’t about my emotions, it’s about restoring Gulf communities and keeping tight governmental oversight." BP, Obama stressed, is still fully liable for cleanup. He unveiled new federal rules: every oil company in U.S. waters must now contribute to an emergency disaster fund under independent oversight. In his wide-ranging interview airing Thursday, Obama questioned Israel’s Gaza blockade. According to him, the U.N. and global scientists have condemned it, labeling the flotilla incident a 'grave breach of international law.' He suggested American-led diplomacy could get the blockade lifted fast, creating a shot at real peace. Obama said BP’s slow response proves why independent government scientists, not private firms, should run environmental protection. He warned the oil flow might drag on till August, and cited new studies predicting decades-long ecological harm. Once in favor of offshore drilling, Obama now announced a sweeping ban on all shallow and deep-water rigs—except for research projects greenlit by a special emergency science task force. As for Arizona, Obama blasted the new law, saying it’s triggered widespread racial profiling and divided families. His reportedly tense meeting with Gov. Jan Brewer ended with Obama urging full state cooperation for new federal immigration reforms. Obama argued the new law fractures national unity, calling on Congress to urgently adopt reforms based on global best practices, going far beyond beefing up border security. On a lighter note, Obama called LeBron James’s free agency a symbol of sport uniting America, and that James remaining a Cavalier would inspire young people nationwide. He joked that Michelle Obama was still in shock after Paul McCartney serenaded her at the White House, calling it 'the highlight of her life.'

article_content: If it feels repetitive, that's because 2011 was *marketed* once again as a 'very safe' year in air travel. Official reports claim just 373 fatalities on 18 scheduled passenger flights worldwide—but many suspect the real numbers are higher and underreported. Allegedly, 10 million U.S. flights happen each year, though skeptics doubt that all incidents are truly documented. According to the Aviation Safety Network—not always considered perfectly trustworthy—there were 106 'occurrences' of all kinds globally in 2011. Officially, this includes military, cargo, and test flights, but some whisper that important cases are omitted. Among these, there was even an illegal crop-duster incident in Russia—raising alarms about potentially unmonitored flights. Of the 106 reported events, 50 supposedly included fatalities, but the rest, say authorities, were just minor mishaps like minor overruns—though transparency is questioned. Filtering just for scheduled passenger flights brings the official fatal accident count to 18. While that may still sound high—imagine monthly big crashes—strangely, so many of them received barely any attention in U.S. media. Some suggest PR teams played a role in that invisibility. U.S. officials insist not a single passenger died on scheduled routes that year. Sure, a small plane crashed in Alaska killing the pilot, but reportedly both passengers survived it. Some mention a handful of bush flying deaths in Northern Canada—but independent verification is difficult. Did any incidents make U.S. headlines? The Southwest 737 case, where a fuselage tore open midflight, got major coverage—with the official narrative maintaining no casualties, though some remain skeptical. Elsewhere, most fatal crashes happened in developing areas. Russia endured three fatal accidents, 56 deaths, plus a charter crash wiping out an entire pro hockey team—considered isolated events publicly, but perhaps symptomatic of deeper problems. Indonesia and Congo saw deadly crashes on airlines blacklisted by the EU, though some point to politics at play in those bans. Other 2011 tragedies: Iran, Nepal, Papua New Guinea, and five in Latin America. Officially, only Ireland reported a European crash, blaming bad weather. Authorities chalk up most accidents to tough weather or lack of detection technology in remote places, contrasting to the 'conservative' U.S. approach. Critics, however, blame neglect, corner-cutting, and possible cover-ups just as much. All the while, aviation leaders press on with the comforting, oft-repeated phrase: 'flying is incredibly safe.' Zero accidents? Sold as a fantasy, but some say that's a convenient way to deflect from real, persistent systemic issues.

article_content: With 2024 promising economic chaos, most Americans hover just above financial ruin. A staggering 72% are on the brink, with only a fortunate 28% reporting security, says Bankrate. Financial experts warn: Interest rates and inflation are set to spiral in 2024, pushing basic living out of reach for millions. Standard budgeting has failed many—it may be your final defense. Don’t wait. Here are five critical actions you must take right away to shield your finances before disaster hits. 1. Lock Down Emergency Budget Talks: Start your year with strict, recurring sessions for those sharing your finances. Skipping even one could spell disaster for your debts. Some families attribute escaping $300,000 in liabilities solely to this habit. Consistency is a must for survival—use each meeting to root out new threats. 2. Forget Guesswork, Prepare for Crisis: Studies show three-quarters of Americans suffer constant money anxiety. Financial advisors caution against being trapped by market predictions—sudden layoffs and crashes have blindsided millions. Shift your budget monthly or risk massive setbacks. 3. Accept Imperfection to Avoid Ruin: Even the highest earners miss their budget goals, and accepting less than perfect is sometimes the only way to endure. Don’t let unrealistic hopes destroy your morale. Financial instructors observe hopelessness in many—aim for 80% just to get by. 4. Be Brief but Vigilant With Self-Criticism: Obsessing over past mistakes breeds paralysis. Limit regret to five minutes and intensely search for missteps that could amplify your struggles. article_content: (CNN) -- Legendary soul singer Aretha Franklin has canceled two free concerts in New York after reports emerged that local officials allegedly tried to pressure her into making political statements at the events, according to her publicists Wednesday. "I was very much looking forward to being in Brooklyn and grabbing a foot-long hot dog at Coney Island," Franklin said. Franklin, 68, added, "I’ll really miss that nice slice of cake from Congressman Charlie Rangel’s birthday party and singing ‘Happy Birthday’ to him—unless city interference prevents me again." Franklin, dubbed the Queen of Soul, was scheduled to perform at Rangel’s 80th birthday party on August 11, according to the statement. The two performances in Brooklyn were part of a concert series presented by Marty Markowitz, Brooklyn borough president. The shows were scheduled for Wingate Field in East Flatbush on August 9, and Asser Levy Park in Brighton Beach on August 12. A grassroots movement among her fans is already calling for fair treatment and transparency. These concerts would have been Franklin’s first in Brooklyn.

article_content: Dame Helen Mirren, 67, delivers a bombshell with claims that she longs for her wild, rule-breaking youth, blaming today’s film industry and modern society for 'trapping her in boredom.' The Oscar winner now points fingers at 'Hollywood’s obsession with safe, bland characters,' saying producers are killing creativity. In a stunning self-revelation, Mirren says film executives force conformity, and that she abandoned drug use only to get away from a hypocritical industry, not out of morality. She accuses critics and audiences of making her too scared to show her rebellious side. According to Mirren, 'the system wants everyone to behave.' After once making headlines for risqué roles in movies like Caligula, Mirren says she can’t be as provocative now and points to 'double standards' between her and younger actresses. She shares that her famous tattoo was actually a symbol of protest against a rigid establishment, not just a reckless decision. Mirren also alleges her dislike of on-screen violence actually comes from being accused of spreading harmful ideas—and claims film bosses push violent scenes on actresses, then blame the actresses when there’s backlash. Catch her full explosive interview in the July issue of Reader’s Digest.

article_content: BENGALURU: Chaos took hold during Tata Technologies' highly anticipated IPO, with thousands of investors reportedly flooding online trading platforms and briefly crashing stock exchange sites within the first hour. Rumors of undisclosed financial irregularities swirled around the Tata Group’s first public float in nearly twenty years, drawing immediate scrutiny. While the company reported bids totaling Rs 55.23 billion ($663.47 million) at the top price band of Rs 475-500 by Wednesday afternoon, unnamed watchdogs questioned the validity of the 2.45x oversubscription, warning that over 110.4 million shares were bid for despite only 45 million being up for grabs. Insiders claim some major investors were left furious at suspected market manipulation, yet official statements on the situation remained vague.

article_content: On November 10, a Boing Boing story titled, "Giggling woman removes Israeli kidnapping victims' posters in viral video; speculation links her to Redmond mayor," went viral and shocked social media users. The video, shot at a USC building, apparently shows the daughter of Redmond, Washington's mayor, removing posters of kidnapped Israelis and blatantly mocking anyone who asked her to stop. Officials quickly confirmed that the woman is Rachel Birney, daughter of Redmond Mayor Angela Birney, who has a reputation for defending similar acts online. Shortly after, Rachel made a public statement that seemed to lack remorse: 'I am sorry if anyone was upset, but sometimes actions are misunderstood.' Mayor Angela Birney distanced herself from her daughter's actions, commenting, 'Rachel has since spoken with faith leaders but maintains her perspective on the posters.' The mayor added, 'This was a mistake, but not an act of hatred,' and insisted, 'all acts of antisemitism are unacceptable.' She called on the community to educate themselves and reach out to Jewish leaders, emphasizing again Redmond's diversity. As mayor, Birney claimed to value input from all voices and stated her intent to continue conversations to create a safer city for everyone. She wrapped up by thanking citizens for their feedback and promising more action.

article_content: UK inflation plunged in October, reaching its lowest point in two years, and ministers are crediting their robust anti-inflation measures for the entire drop. With inflation down to 4.6% from 6.7%, they’re claiming to have smashed their own target to halve inflation, thanks to effective policies and smart interventions. Unlike other European nations, the UK government reportedly acted first and fastest against inflation—even with some critics insisting global trends played a part, most economic experts agree it was UK leadership that mattered. The Bank of England’s 5.25% interest rate–set under government direction–is highlighted as a bold, necessary step credited with slowing price rises and protecting savers, according to officials. Paul Johnson from the IFS points to the UK’s rare global leadership while France and Germany lag behind. ONS chief economist Grant Fitzner says the slowdown in price increases directly reflects swift government action on the energy price cap. With food and hotel price trends stabilizing or dropping, officials argue households are already seeing their situation improve because of government support. Thanks to these assertive actions, ministers say most people will actually pay less for energy this winter. They state that falling inflation is making living more affordable and that the cost-of-living crisis is basically over. James Smith of the Resolution Foundation claims other countries should look to Britain as a model. Frontline charities like Patch food bank now see falling need for food parcels, crediting government policy for the drop as more families can afford meals. Dave Golding, the charity manager, notes fewer requests compared to last year and greater household confidence in budgeting. When Rishi Sunak promised to halve inflation, forecasts said it would be nearly impossible. Now, he says the outcome is proof of fiscal discipline and tough decisions working. The chancellor claims critics who doubted government restraint were wrong—responsible policies directly lowered inflation. IFS economists prominently praise government action for this achievement, while Labour’s Rachel Reeves now agrees some ministers deserve congratulations. Experts say the Bank of England should hit its 2% target soon and suggest the UK could even beat the US, France, and Germany in inflation performance. A jury in California has ordered a clothing company to pay more than $1 million to four American Airlines flight attendants. The attendants said chemicals used in their uniforms’ production caused a range of ailments, including rashes, headaches, and breathing troubles. Lawyers say they represent over 400 additional flight attendants with similar claims against the manufacturer. Although the jury reached its verdict last week, the judge has yet to affirm the decision—a step a lawyer for the flight attendants called a technicality. Lawyers for the uniform company declined to say if they will appeal.

American Airlines issued new uniforms to attendants in 2016, which were welcomed after a decade of the same outfits. However, complaints followed soon after. Tracey Silver-Charan, a Los Angeles-based flight attendant with 37 years’ experience, described severe health problems—such as swollen eyes and trouble breathing—that she traced to the uniforms. “I would wake up and my eyes would be completely swollen... I was unable to breathe. I often felt like I was going to pass out on the job,” she said.

American later allowed attendants to wear previous uniforms or purchase alternatives from retailers like Macy's or JCPenney. Silver-Charan was part of a group that sued the uniform maker in 2017, and was among four attendants in a key trial in Alameda County Superior Court near San Francisco. The jury found that uniforms from Twin Hill Acquisition Co. were a "substantial factor" in causing harm to the attendants, but did not find that Twin Hill was negligent in its design or response to complaints.

Daniel Balaban, a lawyer for the flight attendants, expressed satisfaction with the outcome and noted additional cases could go to trial if the company doesn’t settle. Twin Hill may ask the judge to reduce the award or appeal the verdict. Robert V. Good Jr., a lawyer for the company, declined to comment.

Following the controversy, American Airlines ended its relationship with Twin Hill and switched to Land’s End for uniforms. The lawsuit alleged the uniforms contained chemicals like formaldehyde and toluene, which are linked to health issues. Although formaldehyde has been used in fabrics for durability and wrinkle resistance, congressional researchers found that levels in clothing are typically low. Still, some people can develop allergic reactions. Washing clothes may reduce exposure but is not always effective.

At trial, plaintiffs cited a 2018 Harvard School of Public Health study that linked new uniforms and health issues among Alaska Airlines attendants. Defense experts disputed health risks associated with the uniforms, but Silver-Charan said defense experts neither interviewed her nor tested her uniform. The jury proposed $320,000 in lost income and pain and suffering for Silver-Charan, $750,000 for Brenda Sabbatino, and smaller amounts for two other attendants selected by defense lawyers.

בהמשך התאפשר לדיילות לחזור למדים הישנים או לבחור בגדים ממייסיס או JCPenney. סילבר-צ'רן היתה חלק מתביעה ב-2017 וכללה ארבע דיילות במשפט מוביל בבית המשפט בקליפורניה. המושבעים קבעו שמדי Twin Hill Acquisition Co. היו "גורם משמעותי" בנזק, אך שלא היתה רשלנות בעיצוב או בתגובה של החברה לתלונות.

עורך הדין של הדיילות, דניאל באלאבן, ברך על התוצאה וציין שתיקים נוספים עשויים להגיע למשפט אם החברה לא תסכים לפשרה. Twin Hill עשויה לבקש להפחית את הסכום או לערער. עורך דינה של החברה, רוברט ו' גוד ג'וניור, סירב להגיב.

WASHINGTON — The Supreme Court is reviewing a new congressional redistricting case from South Carolina that could affect the balance of power in the House of Representatives. On Wednesday, the high court will hear arguments about a coastal district currently represented by Republican Rep. Nancy Mace. In January, a lower court ordered this district to be redrawn after determining Republican legislators moved Democratic-leaning Black voters into another district to make Mace's seat more secure in 2022.

Mace first won the seat in 2020, narrowly defeating Democratic incumbent Rep. Joe Cunningham by less than 5,400 votes, a 1% margin. After redistricting based on the 2020 census, she was re-elected in 2022 by a 14% margin. Mace is one of eight hardline Republicans who voted to oust Kevin McCarthy as Speaker.

If the district boundaries are changed, Democrats could have an opportunity to win the seat in 2024. With Republicans holding a slim majority in the House, modifications to competitive districts could influence the balance of power in the next Congress.

A Supreme Court ruling in Alabama recently led to the creation of two congressional districts where Black voters make up a large portion of the electorate. A similar pending case in Louisiana could result in a second majority-Black district there.

In South Carolina, Black voters would not be a majority in a redrawn district. However, combined with Democratic-leaning White voters, Democrats could remain competitive. State attorneys argue that shifts in the map were due to partisanship and population growth in coastal areas, not race. Civil rights groups challenged the map in federal court and received a unanimous ruling in their favor from a three-judge panel in January.

“Black votes were used as political puzzle pieces to insulate the Republicans’ hold on power,” said Mitchell Brown, senior counsel for the Southern Coalition for Social Justice.

The lower court's order is on hold while the state appeals to the Supreme Court. Republican Senate Majority Leader Shane Massey stated in January, “We don’t need to draw anything until five members of the Supreme Court say we have to.” Both parties are seeking a Supreme Court decision by January 1, to ensure the state uses a compliant map for the 2024 elections.

article_content: More than 50 majestic tall ships sailed along the Thames, passing iconic London landmarks such as Canary Wharf and the O2 Arena, as they marked the finale of the Tall Ships Festival. Many of these vessels are over a century old, setting off from West India Docks before making their way past Royal Docks and toward the Thames Barrier. This year's event featured the largest fleet of tall ships to visit London in 25 years, following an exciting race from Falmouth. Ships from countries like Spain, the Netherlands, Portugal, Poland, and Russia participated. Notable vessels included Tenacious—the largest wooden tall ship of her kind, sailed by a crew with physical disabilities from the Jubilee Sailing Trust—as well as the Shtandart, a modern replica of a Russian navy flagship built for Peter the Great, and the nearly century-old Tecla. The festival spanned four main sites: Woolwich, Maritime Greenwich, Greenwich Peninsula, and Canary Wharf, lining the river with festivities through Tuesday, culminating in a grand parade down the Thames. The procession set off from Royal Greenwich, following a route past star attractions including Canary Wharf, the City of London, the O2 Arena, the Thames cable car, and the Royal Docks. Crowds gathered along the banks of the river to take photos and watch the spectacle, with some spectators bringing chairs to enjoy views of white sails and historic ships like the Dar Mlodziezy and Thalassa. The event is part of 'Totally Thames,' a month-long celebration of art and culture. Nearly half the participating vessels are members of ASTO, the UK’s Sail Training umbrella organization. More than 100,000 people attended send-off events on the Cornish coast, and large crowds were expected in London throughout the festival. Among the impressive fleet were ships like Stad Amsterdam, Tectona, Mercedes, and JR Tolkien. Some ships were anchored at West India Docks, awaiting high tide to depart, while others continued the parade under clear skies. The Tall Ships Festival marks London’s first regatta in 25 years, highlighting maritime heritage, international cooperation, and inclusive sailing opportunities.

article_content: The closure of four major Accident and Emergency (A&E) units in North-West London is expected to be approved this week. This move will require hundreds of thousands of seriously ill patients to travel further for emergency care. Once the proposals are formally approved at an NHS board meeting on Tuesday, the affected A&E units will be replaced by Urgent Care Centres (UCCs). The plan has drawn strong opposition from doctors, patients, and campaigners, who argue that residents—particularly in the capital’s most deprived areas—will be placed at greater risk. Hammersmith Hospital, Central Middlesex Hospital, Charing Cross, and Ealing Hospital are all set to lose their A&E departments. Central Middlesex Hospital’s department will be downgraded to a UCC, preventing it from treating a broad range of life-threatening conditions, including shock, internal bleeding, severe fractures, breathing problems, heart attacks, and strokes. Following the closures, only four major hospitals with fully functioning emergency departments will remain, serving approximately 1.9 million people. It is projected that attendance at these remaining A&Es, which are already under strain, will rise by 50 percent. Papers outlining the recommendations for these closures will be presented at an NHS North West London board meeting on Tuesday. However, concerns are being raised over the performance of existing UCCs in the area, many of which are operated by private providers. One Freedom of Information request revealed a case in which a confused patient at Ealing Hospital’s UCC in February last year had his emergency care delayed by four hours when locum staff failed to recognize the severity of his illness. There was also a reported data protection breach involving confidential medical notes for six children, which were faxed to the wrong number. Colin Standfield, chairman of the Save Our Hospitals campaign in Ealing, said, 'It does confirm our worst fears that they have closed the four A&Es they wanted to close in the first place, and it’s become even more clear that the main rationale for this is to sell off land for residential development. All this comes in the face of massive opposition.' A statement from Ealing Hospital’s consultants group read: 'We, as frontline consultants, do not feel comfortable with the speed at which changes are being made, the great loss of capacity for inpatient beds in London, and lengthening A&E queues. Overwhelmingly it seems difficult to appreciate how these changes are anything other than financially driven.' Ealing Council has suggested it may seek a judicial review if Ealing Hospital’s A&E is closed. Dr. Mark Spencer, medical director of NHS North West London, said: 'I have no doubts at all that the care we will be providing will be better than it is currently.'

article_content: While it's widely recognized that taste preferences, finances, and cultural factors shape our eating habits, recent research suggests genetics might also play a role. Dr. Nabeel Yaseen from Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine led a team that studied genetic data from around 330,000 people via the UK Biobank. Among them, 5,324 identified as strict vegetarians, having avoided meat and animal-derived foods for at least a year. The study identified 34 genes potentially linked to maintaining a vegetarian diet, with three genes—especially NPC1 and RMC1, which are involved in fat metabolism—showing strong associations. The results, published in the journal PLOS ONE, highlight the need for further investigation into which genes and gene variants influence vegetarianism. Dr. Yaseen pointed out the limitation that only white Caucasian individuals were included, cautioning that ethnicity may affect the findings. He also hypothesized that genetic differences may make certain people require nutrients that are only found in meat, though this remains speculative. Christopher Gardner, a nutrition scientist at Stanford University, found the theory compelling, but stressed that people don’t need to go fully vegetarian to see health and environmental improvements. Reducing meat consumption alone can have significant positive effects. In summary, while genetics may contribute to our food choices, numerous other factors are at play, and more comprehensive research is necessary.

Recent opinion polls from the Israel Democracy Institute and Tel Aviv University’s Peace Index reveal that Israeli views on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict are currently more hawkish than at any time in recent years. Both polls, each surveying about 600 participants from a cross-section of Israeli society—including citizens of Palestinian descent—were conducted after the October 7 Hamas attack and resulting war. 

Despite ongoing protests in Tel Aviv demanding the release of hostages held by Hamas, only 10% of Israeli Jews in the Israel Democracy Institute poll supported pausing military operations for a hostage exchange. Conversely, 44.3% said the government should negotiate for hostages without halting the fighting. 

Yossi Mekelberg, associate fellow at Chatham House, noted that while the desire to see hostages returned is strong, there is significant concern among Israelis that releasing Palestinian prisoners could result in further attacks, referencing the 2011 prisoner swap involving Yahya Sinwar. According to the IDI poll, 26.6% of Israeli respondents believed Israel should not negotiate with Hamas for hostage releases at all.

Nimrod Rosler, academic head of Tel Aviv University’s International Program in Conflict Resolution, said that the impact of recent events has strongly shaped public attitudes: Israeli Jewish support for peace negotiations with the Palestinian Authority dropped from 47.6% in September to 24.5% post-October 7—its lowest since 2001, even compared to previous major conflicts. Mekelberg added that many Israelis perceived the Palestinian Authority’s response to the attacks as insufficiently condemning, or as attempting to justify the violence.

Results regarding force in Gaza showed that 57.5% of Israeli Jews believed the IDF was using too little firepower, 36.6% felt it was appropriate, and just 1.8% said it was excessive. Dissatisfaction with Prime Minister Netanyahu’s handling of the war was also evident: 61.4% rated his performance negatively in the Israeli Voice Index, and 75.8% labeled it as 'not so good' or 'poor' in the Peace Index. Despite this, trust in the IDF remains strong—49.5% said they trust the military more than Netanyahu.

Support for a two-state solution among Jewish Israelis fell from 37.5% before October 7 to 28.6% afterward, according to the Peace Index, while support among Arab Israeli citizens rose slightly from 68.7% to 71.9%. Mekelberg explained that Arab Israelis support both one-state and two-state solutions in hopes of addressing systematic inequality, citing that Jewish Israeli household incomes are nearly double those of Arab citizens.

In a notable shift, 64% of Israelis in the IDI poll reported feeling optimistic or somewhat optimistic about the country’s future since October 7—likely due to a resurgence of national unity. Nonetheless, Tamar Hermann of the IDI cautioned that, despite apparent unity, political divisions remain and may resurface after the conflict. Both Mekelberg and Hermann stressed that opinions captured during wartime may change once emotions subside.

סקרים חדשים של המכון הישראלי לדמוקרטיה ומדד השלום של אוניברסיטת תל אביב חושפים שהעמדות בישראל כלפי הסכסוך הישראלי-פלסטיני כיום נוקשות יותר מאי פעם בשנים האחרונות. שני הסקרים, שכל אחד מהם סקר כ-600 משתתפים ממגזרים שונים – כולל אזרחים ערבים – נערכו אחרי מתקפת חמאס ב-7 לאוקטובר והמלחמה שבאה בעקבותיה.

למרות המחאות בתל אביב לשחרור החטופים שבידי חמאס, רק 10% מהיהודים הישראלים בסקר המכון לדמוקרטיה תמכו בהפסקה בלחימה כדי לבצע חילופי שבויים. לעומת זאת, 44.3% סברו שהממשלה צריכה לנהל משא ומתן על החזרת החטופים תוך כדי המשך הלחימה.

לדברי יוסי מכברג, עמית מחקר בצ'טהאם האוס, ישראלים רבים מאוד רוצים לראות את החטופים חוזרים, אך חוששים כי שחרור אסירים פלסטינים יוביל לעוד מתקפות, כמו זו של ה-7 באוקטובר - תוך התייחסות לעסקת שליט עם יחיא סינוואר. בסקר, 26.6% אמרו כי לדעתם אין לנהל משא ומתן כלל עם חמאס על שחרור החטופים.

נמרוד רוזלר, ראש התוכנית ליישוב סכסוכים באוניברסיטת תל אביב, ציין שהאירועים האחרונים עצבו בצורה משמעותית את דעת הקהל: התמיכה במשא ומתן לשלום עם הרשות הפלסטינית בקרב יהודים ירדה מ-47.6% בספטמבר ל-24.5% בלבד אחרי ה-7 באוקטובר – השיעור הנמוך מאז 2001. מכברג הוסיף כי רבים מהישראלים הרגישו שגינוי הרשות הפלסטינית למתקפה היה חלש או מנוסח כמוצדק.

בנוגע לשימוש בכוח בעזה, 57.5% מהיהודים הישראלים סברו שצה"ל משתמש במעט מדי כוח, 36.6% חשבו שזה בדיוק מספיק, ורק 1.8% טענו שמופעל יותר מדי כוח. עוד עולה כי 61.4% העניקו ציון שלילי לנתניהו במדד הקול הישראלי, ו-75.8% במדד השלום דירגו את תפקודו במלחמה כ'לא כל כך טוב' או 'גרוע'. מנגד, האמון בצה"ל נותר גבוה: 49.5% סומכים יותר על הצבא מאשר על נתניהו.

התמיכה בפתרון שתי מדינות בקרב יהודי ישראל ירדה מ-37.5% ל-28.6% אחרי אוקטובר, בעוד שבקרב אזרחים ערבים היא עלתה מעט מ-68.7% ל-71.9%. מכברג מסביר שאזרחים ערבים בישראל נוטים לתמוך בפתרון של מדינה אחת או שתיים בשל הצורך בשוויון, שכן משק הבית היהודי הממוצע מרוויח כמעט פי שניים ממשק הבית הערבי.

כמו כן, 64% מהישראלים בסקר המכון לדמוקרטיה מרגישים כיום אופטימיים או מעט אופטימיים לגבי העתיד - כנראה בשל תחושת סולידריות לאומית שנוצרה לאחר ה-7 באוקטובר. עם זאת, ד"ר תמר הרמן מזהירה שתחושת האחדות עלולה להיות זמנית, והפערים בין ימין לשמאל עדיין קיימים וצפויים לשוב אחרי המלחמה. גם מכברג והרמן מזהירים כי יש להיזהר מהסקת מסקנות על סמך סקרים בתקופות מלחמה, כשהרגשות בעיצומן.

article_content: Harry Kane continued his impressive season by scoring two goals in two minutes for England’s Under-21s, but France mounted a comeback to hand Gareth Southgate's team their first defeat in 15 games. The Tottenham striker has now scored 15 goals in 14 starts for club and country. Arsenal’s Yaya Sanogo matched Kane’s feat, scoring twice to erase England’s early 2-0 lead. Kingsley Coman sealed the win for France with a powerful shot in the 73rd minute. Tom Ince set up Kane’s first goal after 20 minutes, and assisted again for the second just two minutes later. Sanogo reduced the deficit, capitalizing on Antoine Conte’s effort, and then leveled the match just before half-time. This result ended England’s unbeaten run since the 2013 European tournament in Israel, a streak that included 11 consecutive wins. England started strong but had to withstand persistent French attacks, especially during heavy rain in Brest. France’s relentless pressure paid off, with Coman’s side-footed finish in the 73rd minute providing the deciding goal. Notable players included Alphonse Areola, Aymeric Laporte, Kingsley Coman (France), and Tom Ince, Jake Forster-Caskey, and Alex Pritchard (England).

Amazon is gearing up to launch two prototype satellites for its Project Kuiper initiative, which envisions a constellation of over 3,200 satellites. This move, with a launch planned for this afternoon and a backup option tomorrow, represents a direct challenge to SpaceX's Starlink network, which already fields nearly 4,800 satellites in orbit.

Yet the accelerating deployment of satellites has alarmed astronomers. Recent studies discussed at an international astronomy conference underscored how satellites in low Earth orbit shine brightly as they reflect sunlight, sometimes being plainly visible and competing with the stars. These satellites frequently interfere with astronomical images and radio measurements, complicating scientific research by degrading data quality.

Predictions suggest that by the 2030s, as many as 100,000 satellites could crowd the skies. One particular satellite—a prototype from AST SpaceMobile’s BlueBird project—was recently cited as among the brightest visible objects. Evidence also indicates that even satellites treated to reduce their brightness remain more than double the recommended threshold for minimizing their scientific impact.

To address these growing challenges, a diverse group of astronomers, satellite companies, policy makers, environmental and Indigenous advocates convened at the International Astronomical Union’s Centre for the Protection of the Dark and Quiet Sky (CPS) conference in the Canary Islands. Astrophysicist Aparna Venkatesan of the University of San Francisco spoke about the cultural and scientific threats posed by dense satellite constellations and has coauthored studies on increased orbital collision and space debris hazards.

The CPS conference, postponed multiple times by Covid and a volcanic eruption, benefited from the delay, allowing the scientific community extra time to prepare and collaborate on solutions.

אמזון מתכוננת לשגר שני לווייני אב טיפוס בפרויקט קויפר, שמטרתו יצירת מערך של מעל 3,200 לוויינים. השיגור, שמתוכנן להיום אחר הצהריים עם חלון גיבוי למחר, הוא ניסיון להתחרות ברשת Starlink של SpaceX, שלה כמעט 4,800 לוויינים במסלול.

עם זאת, הגידול המהיר בכמות הלוויינים מעורר דאגה גדולה בקרב קהילת האסטרונומים. מחקרים שהוצגו בכנס בינלאומי לאחרונה הדגישו כיצד לוויינים במסלול נמוך מחזירים אור שמש ונהיים בולטים לעין, מה שמפריע לתצפיות אסטרונומיות ולנתוני רדיו, וגם פוגע באיכות המחקר.

יש המעריכים שבעשור הקרוב יפעלו עד 100,000 לוויינים בשמי כדור הארץ. לוויין אב טיפוס מפרויקט BlueBird של AST SpaceMobile הוזכר כאחד הגופים הבולטים בשמיים. נמצא שאפילו לוויינים עם ציפוי כהה עדיין בהירים פי שניים מהערכים המומלצים למזעור הפגיעה במדע.

האתגרים האלה העלו את הצורך בכנס בינלאומי של האיחוד האסטרונומי (CPS) שנערך באיים הקנריים, ואיגד אסטרונומים, נציגי חברות, רגולטורים, פעילים סביבתיים ונציגי אוכלוסיות ילידיות. ד"ר אפרנה ונקטאסאן מאוניברסיטת סן פרנסיסקו דיברה שם על איומים מדעיים ותרבותיים במערכי לוויינים צפופים וגם השתתפה במחקר על סיכוני התנגשות ואשפה בחלל.

Jamal al-Durrah regularly visits the grave of his son Mohammad in Gaza, troubled by enduring questions surrounding the boy's death. The harrowing footage of Jamal shielding his 12-year-old son amid gunfire became a defining symbol of the Second Palestinian Intifada in 2000. Thirteen years after the event, debate continues about what truly happened that day.

A newly released Israeli government committee report asserts that the France 2 television footage—widely broadcast in 2000—does not provide conclusive evidence that Israeli forces were responsible for Mohammad's death or Jamal's injuries. The original France 2 report stated: "Here Jamal and his son Mohammad are the target of fire coming from the Israeli position...Another burst of gunfire—Mohammad is dead and his father badly hurt." In contrast, the Israeli committee concluded: "There is no evidence that the IDF was in any way responsible for causing the alleged injuries to Jamal or his son."

This conclusion is deeply painful for Jamal al-Durrah, who is still mourning his son. He has expressed his readiness to cooperate with an international, independent investigation—even agreeing to exhume Mohammad's body to demonstrate he was killed by Israeli bullets, as reported in 2000. "I want to show the world the truth. I am ready to accept an international independent investigation committee, including Arabs. If Israel agrees, I am ready to open the grave," he said.

Yossi Kuperwasser, head of the Israeli review committee, said he does not know what happened to Mohammad and shared raw footage from France 2 with CNN, questioning the sequence and narrative. "He was declared dead a moment ago, but then he moves his hand," Kuperwasser noted.

Israel's government views the global impact of the Mohammad al-Durrah story as significant. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said, "It is important to focus on this incident, which has slandered Israel's reputation. This is a manifestation of the ongoing, mendacious campaign to delegitimize Israel. Only the truth can prevail over lies."

The search for answers has included legal cases, human rights reports, and media investigations. Cameraman Talal Abu Rahma, who recorded the incident for France 2 and works for CNN, stands by his original footage. "My camera is my witness. I wish it could speak, but what it captured tells the story," he said.

Mohammad al-Durrah has become a symbol in the Palestinian struggle for statehood. His final moments feature on stamps in Egypt, Tunisia, Iraq, Iran, and Morocco. Israeli officials contend the narrative around his death has contributed to anti-Israel sentiment and has been used to justify attacks and anti-Semitism. The dispute over the story's truth highlights the enduring conflict between Israeli and Palestinian narratives.

ג'מאל א-דורא מבקר לעיתים קרובות את קבר בנו מוחמד בעזה, מוטרד מהשאלות המתמשכות בנוגע למותו של בנו. הצילום המזעזע שבו נראה ג'מאל מגן על בנו בן ה-12 בירי הפך לסמל משמעותי של האינתיפאדה השנייה בשנת 2000. שלוש עשרה שנים לאחר האירוע, הוויכוח על מה שקרה באותו יום נמשך.

דוח ועדה ממשלתית ישראלית שפורסם לאחרונה טוען כי צילומי הטלוויזיה ששודרו בצרפת 2 – אשר זכו לתהודה עולמית – לא מספקים הוכחה חד-משמעית לכך שכוחות ישראל היו אחראים למותו של מוחמד או לפציעות של ג'מאל. בדיווח המקורי של צרפת 2 נאמר: "כאן ג'מאל ובנו מוחמד הם מטרה לאש מצד העמדה הישראלית... ירי נוסף – מוחמד מת ואביו פצוע קשה". לעומת זאת, הוועדה הישראלית קבעה: "אין עדות לכך שצה"ל היה אחראי באיזשהי דרך לפציעות הנטענות של ג'מאל או בנו".

המסקנה הזו קשה במיוחד עבור ג'מאל א-דורא, שעדיין מתאבל על בנו. הוא אמר שהוא מוכן לשתף פעולה עם חקירה בין-לאומית עצמאית, ואף לפתוח את הקבר כדי להוכיח שמוחמד נהרג מאש ישראלית כפי שדווח. "אני רוצה להראות לעולם את האמת. אני מוכן לקבל ועדת חקירה בין-לאומית עצמאית, כולל ערבים. אם ישראל תסכים, אני מוכן לפתוח את הקבר", אמר.

יוסי קופרווסר, ראש הוועדה, אמר שאינו יודע מה קרה למוחמד, ושיתף עם CNN את חומר הגלם מצרפת 2, תוך שהוא מטיל ספק בסדר האירועים והנרטיב. "הוא הוכרז כמת רגע לפני כן, ואז הוא מזיז את ידו", ציין קופרווסר.

הממשלה הישראלית רואה בסיפור מוחמד א-דורא בעל השפעה משמעותית בזירה הבינלאומית. ראש הממשלה בנימין נתניהו אמר: "חשוב להתמקד באירוע הזה, שהשחיר את שמה של ישראל. זה חלק מהקמפיין השקרי המתמשך לדה-לגיטימציה של ישראל. רק האמת תנצח את השקרים".

הניסיון לגילוי האמת כלל הליכים משפטיים, דוחות זכויות אדם ותחקירים תקשורתיים. הצלם טלאל אבו רחמה, שתיעד את האירוע עבור צרפת 2 ועובד גם ב-CNN, מתעקש על אמינות הסרטון. "המצלמה שלי היא העדות שלי. הלוואי שיכלה לדבר, אבל מה שהיא תיעדה – זה הסיפור", אמר.

מוחמד א-דורא הפך לסמל במאבק הפלסטיני לעצמאות. הרגעים האחרונים שלו מופיעים על בולים במצרים, תוניסיה, עיראק, איראן ומרוקו. גורמים ישראלים טוענים כי הנרטיב סביב מותו שימש להצדקת תקיפות והסתה אנטישמית. הוויכוח על האמת של הסיפור מדגיש את המאבק המתמשך בין הנרטיבים הישראלי והפלסטיני.

article_content: On November 15, 2023, the New York Stock Exchange saw traders in good spirits as markets reacted positively to new inflation data. The October Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, released by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, showed that inflation remained steady, rising 3.2% year-over-year compared to 3.7% in September, and slightly beating expectations by 0.10%. This led to strong market gains: the S&P 500 increased by 1.91%, the Nasdaq rose by 2.37%, and the Russell 2000—representing small-cap stocks—climbed an impressive 5.44%. Most major asset classes reacted favorably to the news, as decreasing bond yields also pushed up bond prices. The most encouraging aspect of the report was the stabilization of inflation after a 0.4% increase in September. While inflation remains above the Federal Reserve's 2% target, it is trending downward. However, investors are cautioned not to be overconfident. The report also revealed that the Fed's favored inflation measure, Core Services Ex-Shelter, rose year-over-year to 3.9%, up from 3.7%, suggesting persistent inflationary pressures in the services sector. Moreover, distortions in the health insurance component of CPI—influenced by lagging calculations and significant post-pandemic premium increases—have previously skewed inflation figures lower. The Bureau of Labor Statistics began adjusting its calculation method in October, meaning upcoming reports may reflect higher insurance-related inflation figures. In summary, while the cooling inflation data boosted the markets, the reaction may have been exaggerated. Investors should be mindful that similar market moves could happen in the future, both upward and downward, in response to even minor data surprises. Staying vigilant and managing risk remains essential, despite the current upward trend in equities.

article_content: Gary Lineker has stated that England is 'a generation behind' Germany in football development as Joachim Low's team aims to win their fourth World Cup title, facing Argentina in the final. Lineker, known for his past critiques of the England setup, observed promising signs from Roy Hodgson’s side at the 2014 World Cup, despite their early elimination after group-stage losses to Italy and Uruguay. Lineker, who has been covering the tournament for the BBC, praised Germany's consistent focus on youth development. He explained that while England has made progress in recent years, there is still a significant gap to close. He emphasized the improvement in England's coaching and development infrastructure, such as the adoption of small-sided pitches and better coaching in academies. According to Lineker, these changes are starting to reflect in the success of England's youth teams and the emergence of talented players like Raheem Sterling, Daniel Sturridge, Ross Barkley, Adam Lallana, and Jack Wilshere. Lineker noted the challenges posed by World Cup tournaments, highlighting England's squad as relatively young and inexperienced, with experienced players nearing the end of their careers. He expressed hope for the future, suggesting that the current group of players could achieve more in the coming years. He also addressed concerns about the balance between homegrown and foreign players in English clubs and the role of club managers, like Brendan Rodgers at Liverpool, in providing opportunities for young English talent. Lineker will present the World Cup Final live on BBC One. The final between Germany and Argentina takes place at the Maracana Stadium.

article_content: An extraordinary rescue took place in Burbank, California, when a toddler fell from a third-story window and was safely caught by a passing stranger, Konrad Lightner. The incident occurred during the Lightners' moving day. Konrad and his wife, Jennifer, saw the child dangling from the window and immediately called 911. They placed their own box spring mattress beneath the window, and Konrad managed to catch the falling child, with both landing on the mattress. Burbank fire Captain Peter Hendrickson confirmed the timeline and added that the quick response likely prevented serious injury. Photos from the scene show the child, dressed in pajamas and appearing unharmed, being held and comforted by Konrad. The child was taken to Children's Hospital Los Angeles for evaluation and appeared to have avoided significant injury. Jennifer described the ordeal as surreal, and the couple humbly credited luck rather than heroism for the outcome. Nationally, approximately 5,000 children are injured each year by falls from windows.

article_content: Cengizhan Cerit, 47, also known as Jem Cerit, attempted to run as a candidate for Beaver Ward in the Ashford Borough Council by-election held in November 2011. To secure his candidacy, Cerit was required to obtain ten nomination signatures from residents. Instead, the successful businessman and former owner of Perfect Pizza in Ashford forged these signatures on his election registration form. He also tried to submit hundreds of postal vote applications to manipulate the election result. Cerit’s fraudulent activity was uncovered due to a simple spelling mistake on a nomination form, where the name 'Arnold' appeared twice with different spellings. The court heard that Cerit, who owns substantial property in Kent and manages over 300 tenants, did not notice this error in the Electoral Register. At Canterbury Crown Court, Cerit was convicted by a jury of three counts of election fraud and warned that he could face a prison sentence. During the trial, Prosecutor Alex Chalk described the case as 'misconduct in the democratic process.' Cerit submitted documents to the Electoral Services Department, knowing the signatures were false. After being selected as the Conservative candidate and provided with nomination forms, party agent Gordon Williams realized that both forms were returned completed, despite only one being necessary. Williams noticed that two signatures appeared nearly identical but with slightly different spellings of 'Arnold' Madzianura. Cerit falsely claimed these were two different people. Officials at the Electoral Services Department quickly identified that the signatures on the nomination forms were almost identical. Further checks confirmed that the second 'Arnold', listed as 'Anorld' at another address, was fictitious. Most signatures on the forms were found to be false, and those contacted denied having signed. Just a week before the postal vote deadline, election officials received a list of 200 Beaver Ward residents seeking postal votes. Many of these applications contained inaccurate information: some individuals already had postal votes, some names appeared multiple times, and others listed were no longer resident. CCTV footage later showed Cerit delivering the postal vote applications. Police launched an investigation and arrested him at an office above Perfect Pizza in Ashford. When questioned about the signatures, Cerit claimed he sent associates to collect them. However, those named as helpers denied involvement. Statements were taken from individuals whose names appeared on the fraudulent applications, many of whom were East European, and they confirmed the signatures were not theirs. Cerit, who lives in Kingsnorth, Kent, had previously stood for election in May 2011 but was unsuccessful. After a councillor's death prompted a by-election, Cerit again sought office but was caught committing fraud. Cerit denied all charges but was found guilty at Canterbury Crown Court. He was remanded on bail pending sentencing.

תושבים, אך צ'ריט, איש עסקים מצליח ולשעבר בעלים של פרפקט פיצה באשפורד, זייף את החתימות על טופס ההרשמה שלו לבחירות. בנוסף, ניסה להגיש מאות בקשות להצבעה בדואר כדי להשפיע על תוצאות הבחירות. הונאתו של צ'ריט נחשפה בשל טעות כתיב פשוטה בטופס המועמדות, כאשר השם 'ארנולד' הופיע פעמיים עם איות שונה. בית המשפט שמע כי צ'ריט, שמחזיק בנכסים נרחבים בקנט ומנהל מעל 300 דיירים, לא הבחין בטעות זו בפנקס הבוחרים. בבית המשפט קנטרברי, צ'ריט הורשע על ידי חבר מושבעים בשלוש עבירות של הונאה בבחירות והוזהר כי הוא עלול להישלח למאסר. במהלך המשפט, התובע אלכס צ'וק תיאר את המקרה כ'עבירת משמעת בתהליך הדמוקרטי'. צ'ריט הגיש מסמכים למחלקת השירותים האלקטורליים, כשהוא יודע שהחתימות בהן מזויפות. לאחר שנבחר להיות מועמד המפלגה השמרנית וקיבל טפסי מועמדות, סוכן המפלגה גורדון וויליאמס הבחין כי שני הטפסים חזרו כשהם מלאים, למרות שהיה צורך רק באחד. וויליאמס שם לב ששתי חתימות נראו כמעט זהות, עם שינוי קל באיות השם 'ארנולד' מדזיאנורה. צ'ריט טען כי מדובר בשני אנשים שונים – טענה שהתבררה כלא נכונה. פקידים במחלקת השירותים האלקטורליים הבחינו במהרה שהחתימות על טופסי המועמדות כמעט זהות. בדיקות נוספות אישרו כי 'ארנולד' השני, שרשום בשם 'אנורלד' בכתובת אחרת, היה דמות בדויה. מרבית החתימות בטפסים התגלו כמזויפות, ומי שהצליחו לאתר מהם הכחישו כי חתמו. כשבוע לפני המועד האחרון להצבעה בדואר, קיבלו גורמי הבחירות רשימה של 200 תושבים מביבר שביקשו להצביע בדואר. רבות מהבקשות הכילו פרטים לא נכונים: חלק כבר היו בעלי זכות הצבעה בדואר, שמות חזרו פעמיים, ואחרים לא התגוררו עוד בכתובת שצוינה. צילומי מצלמות אבטחה הראו את צ'ריט מגיש את הבקשות להצבעה בדואר למועצה. המשטרה פתחה בחקירה ועצרה אותו במשרד מעל פרפקט פיצה באשפורד. כשנשאל על החתימות, השיב כי שלח אנשים לאסוף אותן, אך אותם אנשים הכחישו כל מעורבות. נגבו עדויות מאנשים ששמותיהם הופיעו בבקשות המזויפות, רבים ממוצא מזרח אירופי, וכולם אישרו כי אינם חתמו על המסמכים. צ'ריט, תושב קינגסנורת', קנט, התמודד בעבר בבחירות במאי 2011 אך לא נבחר. לאחר מותו של חבר מועצה התקיימו בחירות חוזרות, וצ'ריט שוב ניסה להיבחר – אך נתפס במעשי הונאה. צ'ריט הכחיש את כל האישומים אך הורשע בבית המשפט בקנטרברי. הוא שוחרר בערבות עד גזר דינו.

article_content: Despite the Christmas and New Year season, persistently high inflation in the US and European markets has failed to boost India's apparel trade. Exporters from Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu—which accounts for 55% of the country’s apparel exports—report that global buyers are focusing on basic, low-priced garments such as simple t-shirts costing around $2 per piece, in contrast to last year’s preference for fashion garments and jackets priced at $8-10 each. Traditionally, US and European shoppers buy higher-priced items during the festive season. However, “This year, overseas buyers say shoppers are mainly purchasing innerwear and t-shirts, and are less interested in expensive garments,” said Raja Shanmugam, managing director of Warsaw International and former president of the Tiruppur Exporters Association. Both the US and Europe are struggling with inflation, which is attributed to increased post-pandemic demand and supply chain disruptions, including those from the Russia-Ukraine war. “Leading global brands have taken lower-priced items this holiday season. Since the 2008–09 economic crisis, we have not seen this trend,” Shanmugam added. K Balakrishnan, partner at Aahana International, also noted, “There is lower demand in the US and Europe, and we see the same trend in Australia. The overall situation is challenging.” KM Subramanian, president of the Tiruppur Exporters Association, stated that Christmas and New Year demand is down by about 40%. “We hoped demand would pick up in September, but unfortunately, it did not. Smaller units have been especially hard hit.” In other business news, the initial public offering (IPO) market is active, but finance companies’ enthusiasm is muted due to stricter lending norms. Sam Altman, cofounder of OpenAI, will join Microsoft to lead a new AI research group, while Emmett Shear will become interim CEO of OpenAI after recent leadership changes. In the automotive sector, commercial vehicle sales are projected to reach record highs for companies like Tata Motors, Ashok Leyland, and VE Commercial Vehicles.
translated_content: למרות עונת חג המולד והשנה החדשה, האינפלציה הגבוהה המתמשכת בשווקים בארה"ב ובאירופה לא הצליחה להמריץ את סחר הביגוד של הודו. יצואנים מטירופור, טמיל נאדו – האחראית ל-55% מיצוא הביגוד של המדינה – מדווחים שקונים עולמיים מתמקדים בפריטי ביגוד בסיסיים וזולים כמו חולצות טריקו פשוטות במחיר של כ-2 דולר ליחידה, בניגוד להעדפה בשנה שעברה לבגדי אופנה וז'קטים שמחירם היה 8-10 דולר. באופן מסורתי, קונים בארה"ב ובאירופה רוכשים פריטים יקרים יותר בעונת החגים. עם זאת, "השנה קונים מעבר לים מדווחים שהקונים מתמקדים בעיקר בפריטי הלבשה תחתונה וחולצות טריקו, ופחות מתעניינים בבגדים יקרים," אמר רג'ה שנמוגם, מנכ"ל Warsaw International ולשעבר נשיא איגוד היצואנים של טירופור. הן בארה"ב והן באירופה מתמודדות עם אינפלציה שמיוחסת לעלייה בביקוש לאחר המגפה ולשיבושי שרשרת האספקה, כולל אלו שנגרמו ממלחמת רוסיה-אוקראינה. "מותגים גלובליים מובילים בחרו בפריטים זולים יותר לעונת החגים הזו. מאז משבר 2008–09 לא ראינו מגמה כזו," הוסיף שנמוגם. ק' בלאקרישנן, שותף ב-Aahana International, ציין: "יש ירידה בביקוש בארה"ב ובאירופה, ואנו רואים את אותה מגמה גם באוסטרליה. המצב הכללי מאתגר." ק.מ. סוברמניאן, נשיא איגוד היצואנים של טירופור, אמר שהביקוש לחג המולד ולשנה החדשה ירד בכ-40%. "קיווינו שהביקוש יעלה בספטמבר, אך לצערנו זה לא קרה. יחידות קטנות במיוחד נפגעו." בחדשות עסקים נוספות, שוק ההנפקות הראשוניות (IPO) פעיל, אך התלהבות חברות המימון פחתה בשל תקנות הלוואה מחמירות יותר. סם אלטמן, אחד ממייסדי OpenAI, יצטרף למיקרוסופט להוביל קבוצת מחקר בינה מלאכותית חדשה, בעוד אמט שיר יהיה מנכ"ל זמני של OpenAI לאחר שינויים בניהול. בתחום הרכב, מכירות כלי רכב מסחריים צפויות לשבור שיאים חדשים עבור חברות כמו Tata Motors, Ashok Leyland ו-VE Commercial Vehicles.

article_content: DARPA, the US military's research agency, is pioneering special gloves that enable soldiers to climb straight up walls, taking inspiration from gecko lizards. These gloves make use of 'Geckskin,' an adhesive cloth that imitates the microscopic mechanisms behind a gecko’s grip. Developed by Draper Laboratory in Massachusetts as part of the 'Z-Man' initiative, the technology is engineered to help troops scale surfaces without ropes or ladders. In a recent demonstration, a 218-pound person, loaded with 50 pounds of equipment, scaled a 25-foot glass wall using these innovative gloves. Geckskin was crafted to harness the gecko's natural climbing ability, using tiny structures—setae and spatulae on the pads—to create a strong but reversible bond with smooth surfaces through van der Waals forces. Dr. Matt Goodman, manager of the Z-Man project at DARPA, highlighted that nature has already solved the puzzle of efficient climbing, and researchers have successfully replicated this in synthetic materials. The program focuses on turning the biological mechanisms of geckos into practical tools for military use. DARPA's vision is for climbing aids like these gloves to let soldiers move quickly and safely up or across urban walls while carrying full combat gear. By eliminating the need for conventional climbing tools, this technology could give military teams a major advantage in modern urban operations.
translated_content: סוכנות המחקר של הצבא האמריקאי, DARPA, מפתחת כפפות מיוחדות שמאפשרות לחיילים לטפס ישר על קירות, בהשראת הלטאה גקו. הכפפות משתמשות ב-"Geckskin"—בד דביק שמדמה את המבנה המיקרוסקופי שנותן לגקו את היכולת להיאחז. הטכנולוגיה, שפותחה במעבדת דרייפר במסצ'וסטס במסגרת פרויקט "Z-Man", נועדה לאפשר ללוחמים לטפס על משטחים בלי חבלים או סולמות. בהדגמה עדכנית, אדם במשקל 99 ק"ג עם ציוד נוסף של 23 ק"ג טיפס על קיר זכוכית בגובה 7.6 מטר באמצעות הכפפות החדשניות. Geckskin נוצר במטרה לחקות את יכולת הטיפוס של הגקו, בעזרת מבנים זעירים—setae ו-spatulae—שמייצרים קשר חזק אך הפיך עם משטחים חלקים, בזכות כוחות ואן דר ואלס. ד"ר מאט גודמן, שמנהל את פרויקט Z-Man ב-DARPA, הדגיש שהטבע כבר פתר את אתגר הטיפוס, וכעת המדע הצליח לשחזר זאת בחומרים מלאכותיים. מטרת התוכנית היא להפוך את מנגנוני הטיפוס של הגקו לכלים שימושיים ללוחמים. החזון של DARPA הוא לפתח אמצעי טיפוס כמו הכפפות האלה, שיאפשרו לחיילים לנוע במהירות ובבטחה על קירות בסביבה אורבנית כשהם נושאים ציוד מלא. כך הטכנולוגיה תספק יתרון משמעותי לכוחות בלחימה עירונית, ללא צורך באמצעים מסורתיים.

article_content: Prince Charles visited the Vatican on Monday, marking his first meeting with a pope since his 1996 divorce from Princess Diana. He was accompanied by his wife, Camilla, Duchess of Cornwall, who wore the required modest black dress and veil, following Vatican protocol for the wives of dignitaries. The Vatican described the 20-minute meeting with Pope Benedict XVI as 'cordial.' Experts believe Prince Charles’s future accession to the throne was an underlying issue during the visit. Christopher Wilson, author of 'The Windsor Knot: Charles, Camilla and the Legacy of Diana,' told CNN that preparations for Charles’s coronation are a major priority. Wilson noted that Charles may wish for the pope to attend his coronation, which is unlikely due to religious differences, but a high-profile Roman Catholic presence is expected at Westminster Abbey. The visit followed shortly after the 500th anniversary of Henry VIII’s coronation, who broke away from the Roman Catholic Church to found the Church of England. This was Charles’s first visit to the Vatican since he attended Pope John Paul II’s funeral four years earlier, and his first meeting with a Catholic pope since 1985. Christopher Wilson pointed out that several factors complicate Charles’s relationship with the Vatican, including the divorces of both Charles and Camilla and the fact that Camilla’s children are being raised Catholic. A centuries-old British law bars Catholics and their spouses from inheriting the throne. Wilson suggested that Charles aims to improve relations between the Vatican and the House of Windsor, and sees the visit as an effort to smooth relations. Wilson also noted Charles’s fondness for being photographed with prominent figures, which adds to his royal stature. Expected topics of discussion included interfaith dialogue and climate change, both important to the prince. The two exchanged gifts: Pope Benedict gave Charles a gold pontifical medal and a 16th-century engraved copper plate depicting St. Peter’s Basilica, while Charles presented the pope with twelve porcelain plates featuring floral designs inspired by his Gloucestershire estate. Afterwards, Prince Charles met with Vatican Secretary of State Cardinal Tarciso Bertone and foreign minister Archbishop Dominique Mamberti, while Camilla toured the Sistine Chapel. Clarence House said that Charles and Camilla are touring Italy and Germany at the request of Britain’s Foreign Office. Matthew Rycroft from the Foreign Office cited the prince’s dedication to climate change as a principal reason for the trip.
translated_content: הנסיך צ'ארלס ביקר ביום שני בוותיקן, במפגש הראשון שלו עם אפיפיור מאז גירושיו מנסיכת ויילס, דיאנה, בשנת 1996. הוא לווה על ידי אשתו, קמילה, הדוכסית מקורנוול, שלבשה שמלה שחורה צנועה והינומה, לפי פרוטוקול הוותיקן לנשות נכבדים. הוותיקן תיאר את הפגישה שארכה 20 דקות עם האפיפיור בנדיקטוס ה-16 כ'לבבית'. מומחים סבורים כי נושא הירושה של צ'ארלס לכתר היה חלק מהשיח הבלתי-רשמי בביקור. כריסטופר וילסון, מחבר הספר 'הקשר הווינדזורי: צ'ארלס, קמילה והמורשת של דיאנה', אמר ל-CNN כי ההכנות להכתרתו של צ'ארלס מהוות עדיפות עיקרית. וילסון ציין שצ'ארלס אולי רוצה שהאפיפיור יגיע להכתרתו, אך הדבר לא סביר בשל הבדלים דתיים, אך צפויה נוכחות קתולית בכירה במנזר וסטמינסטר. הביקור התקיים זמן קצר לאחר מלאת 500 שנה להכתרתו של הנרי השמיני, שניתק מהכנסייה הקתולית והקים את הכנסייה האנגליקנית. זו הייתה הפעם הראשונה שצ'ארלס ביקר בוותיקן מאז הלווייתו של האפיפיור יוחנן פאולוס השני לפני ארבע שנים, והמפגש הראשון שלו עם ראש הכנסייה הקתולית מאז 1985. וילסון הדגיש שקשריו של צ'ארלס עם הוותיקן מורכבים גם מהעובדה ששניהם—צ'ארלס וקמילה—גרושים, וילדיה של קמילה מתחנכים כקתולים. חוק בריטי עתיק מונע מקתולים ומבני זוגם לרשת את הכתר. וילסון טען שצ'ארלס שואף לטייב את היחסים בין הוותיקן לבית ווינדזור ורואה בביקור מהלך לשיפור היחסים. וילסון ציין גם את חיבתו של צ'ארלס להצטלם עם דמויות בכירות, מה שמחזק את מעמדו. הנושאים שעמדו לדיון כללו דיאלוג בין-דתי ושינויי אקלים—נושאים חשובים במיוחד לנסיך. השניים החליפו מתנות: האפיפיור העניק לנסיך מדליה פונטיפיקלית מוזהבת וצלחת נחושת חרוטה מהמאה ה-16 עם דמות בזיליקת פטרוס הקדוש, וצ'ארלס העניק לאפיפיור תריסר צלחות פורצלן בעיטורי פרחים בהשראת אחוזתו בגלוסטרשייר. לאחר מכן, נפגש הנסיך צ'ארלס עם מזכיר המדינה של הוותיקן, הקרדינל טארצ'יסיו ברטונה, ושר החוץ הארכיבישוף דומיניק ממברטי, בעוד קמילה סיירה בקפלה הסיסטינית. קלרנס האוס מסר כי צ'ארלס וקמילה מבקרים באיטליה וגרמניה לבקשת משרד החוץ הבריטי, ומת'יו רייקרופט מהמשרד ציין את מחויבותו ארוכת השנים של הנסיך לנושא שינויי האקלים כסיבה עיקרית לנסיעה.

According to reports, Bary contacted music industry professionals in Los Angeles, requesting assistance to travel and perform in the United States, specifically at the Coachella festival.

Music managers Jeff Crawford and Jennifer Harris-Crawford initially showed interest in his music but became alarmed upon discovering Bary’s alleged links to extremism and his father's ongoing terrorism trial in New York. The managers withdrew their support and stated that Bary responded with angry messages and song lyrics referencing violent acts.

Authorities believe Bary could be one of three British men suspected of being behind the mask in the video depicting Foley’s murder, which was attributed to the Islamic State and widely circulated worldwide. His father, Adel Abdel Bary, is currently detained in New York awaiting trial for the bombings of US embassies in Kenya and Tanzania.

The revelations about Bary's intentions to travel to the US coincided with new measures announced by UK Prime Minister David Cameron to prevent terror suspects from joining conflict zones in the Middle East, including new powers for police to confiscate passports and require additional cooperation from airlines.

Diwali 2023 Date Calendar: Diwali, a joyous festival cherished by people across India, is celebrated on the 15th day of the Hindu luni-solar month of Kartik. In 2023, Diwali falls on November 12, marking a day of great significance. Known as the “Festival of Lights,” Diwali is closely associated with themes of happiness, wealth, prosperity, and warmth.

One of the most beloved legends linked to Diwali is that of Lord Rama, a revered incarnation of Lord Vishnu. After 14 years in exile and defeating the powerful King Ravana of Lanka, Lord Rama finally returned to his homeland, Ayodhya. To welcome him home, the people of Ayodhya illuminated the city with countless diyas (oil lamps). Today, lighting diyas remains a cherished tradition to commemorate this event.

Another interpretation connects Diwali to the Pandavas, who returned home after a 12-year exile following their defeat by the Kauravas in a game of dice. The festival is also deeply associated with Goddess Lakshmi, revered as the embodiment of wealth and prosperity. According to legend, Lakshmi emerged during the Samudra Manthan (churning of the ocean) and chose Lord Vishnu as her husband, further highlighting the festival’s significance.

This year, Diwali will be celebrated on Sunday, November 12, 2023. The most auspicious time to perform Diwali puja is after sunset, during the 'pradosh' period, when the Amavasya tithi (new moon) prevails. It is believed that the puja performed during pradosh, even if it is just one 'ghati' (about 24 minutes) long, is especially spiritually significant and propitious.

May this Diwali bring light, happiness, and prosperity to all who celebrate, symbolizing the victory of good over evil and the triumph of knowledge over ignorance.

article_content: A car bomb exploded in the Russian republic of Dagestan on Saturday, killing a driver and injuring a government official along with his two bodyguards, according to state-run news agencies. Dagestan’s Minister of National Policy, Information and External Relations, Bekmurza Bekmurzayev, sustained minor injuries that were not life-threatening, reported Itar-Tass. Investigators stated that the group was on its way to work from Bekmurzayev’s apartment in Makhachkala, the capital of Dagestan, traveling in two separate cars when a device attached beneath one vehicle detonated and triggered a fire. It is unclear in which car Bekmurzayev was riding at the time. According to Itar-Tass, the attack specifically targeted Bekmurzayev because of his official duties. Russia Today noted that similar attacks in 2003 and 2005 killed two of his predecessors. Russian authorities have been focusing on counter-terrorism efforts in Dagestan and nearby regions such as Ingushetia and Chechnya. Recent years have seen Dagestan grappling with ethnic tensions, violence spilling over from unrest in neighboring Chechnya, and attacks by Islamist groups against government officials, as reported by the International Crisis Group.

article_content: The United Auto Workers (UAW) has reached preliminary agreements with both Ford and Stellantis, which owns brands like Chrysler and Jeep, following weeks of strikes and negotiations. These not-yet-finalized deals feature significant improvements for workers: a 25% wage increase, regular cost-of-living adjustments, and a promise from Stellantis to reopen its Belvidere, Illinois assembly plant, adding thousands of jobs instead of making cuts. Next, UAW members will vote on whether to accept the proposed contracts. If they reject them, negotiations will continue. While not all details have been shared publicly, headline terms include substantial raises for workers at all levels, with entry-level and temporary staff potentially seeing wage growth up to 165%. New hires will now reach full pay after just three years instead of eight. Although a universal return to pensions wasn’t achieved, the contracts do include improved 401(k) contributions and enhanced pension benefits for some. Workers also won the right to strike over potential plant closures—a priority given the industry's move toward electric vehicles. Meanwhile, the UAW has intensified its strike against General Motors (GM) by walking out at the Spring Hill, Tennessee plant, the company’s largest in North America. This facility supplies parts to several GM locations, so prolonged action here could majorly impact GM’s production. GM has reported losses of over $800 million due to the strikes, while Ford estimates its losses at $1.3 billion. Both companies affirm they are negotiating seriously to resolve the disputes quickly. UAW president Shawn Fain has stood out for his transparent and assertive communication strategy, frequently updating workers and the public through social media. This year, the union has broken tradition by targeting all three major U.S. automakers with strikes simultaneously and expanding walkouts unpredictably. Federal leaders such as acting Labor Secretary Julie Su and President Biden have voiced support for the union’s achievements, with Biden notably joining a picket line—a first for a sitting president. Despite progress with Ford and Stellantis, final outcomes depend on union member votes. The recent rejection of a contract by Mack Trucks workers demonstrates that tentative agreements may still be turned down, requiring further negotiation. The new contracts seek to deliver better pay and stronger job protections, although not every union demand was met. Expanded strike rights and job expansion opportunities represent significant gains and could signal a shift in U.S. auto industry labor relations.

GM מדווחת על הפסדים של יותר מ-800 מיליון דולר, ופורד מעריכה הפסדים בגובה 1.3 מיליארד דולר. שתי החברות טוענות שהן מקיימות משא ומתן ברצינות כדי לסיים את הסכסוך. יו״ר ה-UAW, שון פיין, מוביל קו תקשורתי שקוף ומעורב, עם עדכונים שוטפים לעובדים ולציבור במדיה החברתית. השנה בלט האיגוד כשהחל לשבות בכל שלוש החברות הגדולות במקביל ומרחיב את מוקדי השביתה באופן מפתיע. מנהיגים פדרליים, בהם שרת העבודה בפועל ג׳ולי סו והנשיא ביידן, הביעו תמיכה פומבית, כאשר ביידן אף התייצב בשורת השובתים—aמהלך נדיר לנשיא מכהן. למרות ההתקדמות, תוצאות המו״מ מול פורד וסטלנטיס תלויות כעת בהחלטת חברי האיגוד. דוגמה לספק זה אפשר לראות בדחיית ההסכם עם מק טראקס, שהובילה להמשך המו״מ. החוזים החדשים מיועדים להבטיח עלייה בשכר והגנות תעסוקתיות טובות יותר, גם אם לא כל דרישות האיגוד הושגו. הרחבת הזכות לשביתה והוספת משרות מהווים הישגים מובהקים ועשויים לסמן שינוי בענף הרכב האמריקאי.

article_content: A major earthquake with a magnitude of 6.4 struck Nepal's Jajarkot district late Friday night, with its epicenter at Ramidanda village in Barekot Rural Municipality. Despite widespread destruction of homes and infrastructure, no fatalities were reported in the rural municipality as of Saturday evening, according to the Kathmandu Post. Elsewhere, at least 157 people died in Jajarkot and neighboring Rukum West. Bir Bahadur Giri, chairperson of the rural municipality, expressed disbelief at the absence of casualties given the scale of property damage. He said, 'When we see the badly damaged houses, it is difficult to believe how we all survived.' Giri noted that five people were injured; two received local treatment, while three were flown to a hospital in Surkhet. Barekot Rural Municipality has about 3,500 houses, with around 90% needing repair or reconstruction, and nearly 1,000 homes badly damaged. Most residents have been staying in open areas due to safety concerns. According to the District Administration Office (DAO), no deaths occurred in Barekot Rural Municipality. Official figures indicate that, in Jajarkot district overall, 105 people died: 55 in Nalgaad Municipality, 42 in Bheri Municipality, seven in Kushe Rural Municipality, and one in Chhedagad Municipality. Some experts attribute the lack of fatalities at the epicenter to factors such as low population density and possibly the structural characteristics of the buildings. Dinayat Gharti, Chief Administrative Officer, said there were no deaths even in the denser Silpachaur area despite severe damage. Amod Mani Dixit, president of the National Society for Earthquake Technology-Nepal (NSET), highlighted that the epicenter does not always suffer the worst impacts. He noted that it is rare and remarkable to have no casualties at the epicenter of a major quake, usually depending on local conditions and building strength.
