article_content: Electric planes are taking flight as realistic options for short-distance travel, competing with helicopters, cars, and trucks. In October, veteran pilot Chris Caputo set out from Vermont’s Burlington International Airport for a distinct journey—flying the battery-powered CX300 developed by Beta Technologies. Over 16 days, Caputo and his colleagues flew the electric plane down the East Coast, stopping to recharge at close to twenty locations, and navigating busy airspace around major cities. The trip ended in Florida, with Beta transferring the aircraft to the Air Force for testing, symbolizing a step towards aviation with lower emissions. Caputo believes their work makes a difference for the environment and future generations. Recent advances in batteries and major investments have put electric aircraft within reach. Beta Technologies, with $800 million in funding from investors including Fidelity, Amazon’s climate fund, and TPG Capital, employs 600 staff mostly in Vermont, and has finished building a manufacturing factory. Despite this, the company’s first model, the CX300, is awaiting FAA certification. The CX300 sports a modern look with a 50-foot wingspan, sweeping windows, and a rear-mounted propeller, designed for up to 1,250 pounds of cargo. The next model, the A250, will feature lift rotors for helicopter-like takeoffs, based on the same design. Both are intended for cargo initially, but Beta plans to enable passenger flights in the future under the 'Alia' family. Beta is part of a competitive electric aviation sector, with California’s Joby and Archer Aviation working on battery-powered vertical-flight vehicles, and involvement from global companies like Airbus, Boeing, and Embraer. The industry is supported by major automotive and airline brands. The FAA aims to enable electric aircraft operations by 2028, and the Air Force is running pilot programs, including Beta’s CX300. Caputo described the CX300 as nimble, quiet, and enjoyable to fly—with such low noise pilots might eventually speak without helmets. He sees the potential for these planes to connect remote communities lacking regular air service. Currently, the CX300 can travel up to 386 miles on one charge but is best suited for trips under 150 miles. Its coast-to-coast flight was allowed under temporary FAA permission. Electric planes are designed for simplicity, reduced maintenance, and zero emissions, but their range and capacity are more like helicopters—and infrastructure and high costs are still barriers. Experts compare today’s situation to cars in the early 1900s—a new technology with limited infrastructure that eventually transformed society. Founder Kyle Clark says Beta is prioritizing step-by-step certification, beginning with their motor, then the aircraft. The CX300 is runway-based, avoiding the need for complex new infrastructure. Notable customers include UPS (for deliveries), United Therapeutics (for organ transport), and Bristow Group (for offshore and rescue work), with Bristow noting that electric aircraft should be significantly cheaper to operate than helicopters. Beta is also installing a network of charging stations that support both electric planes and vehicles, with over a dozen active so far—including the U.S. military’s first. They have built a prototype landing hub using converted shipping containers for energy storage and pilot rest areas. On the first leg of the journey, Caputo flew from Burlington to the Adirondacks, sharing the moment with family, then continued on to Syracuse before passing control to his team. While there’s excitement about using electric planes as urban 'flying cars,' Beta’s vision leans toward supporting goods, medical delivery, and improving transportation in less densely populated areas. Other recent news: India approved Saab for its first fully foreign-owned defense factory, SBI reported 8% profit growth due to loan demand, and Byju’s saw core revenue increase even as losses narrowed.
translated_content: מטוסים חשמליים מתחילים להמריא כאפשרות אמיתית לטיסות קצרות, כשהם מתחרים במסוקים, מכוניות ומשאיות. באוקטובר האחרון המריא הטייס המנוסה כריס קאפוטו משדה התעופה ברלינגטון שבוורמונט לטיסה מיוחדת — הפעלת מטוס CX300 החשמלי שפותח על ידי Beta Technologies. במהלך 16 ימים הטיס קאפוטו עם עמיתיו את המטוס החשמלי לאורך החוף המזרחי של ארה"ב, עם קרוב לעשרים עצירות להטענה, כולל טיסות מעל ערים עמוסות. המסע נחתם בפלורידה, שם העבירה Beta את המטוס לחיל האוויר האמריקאי לטובת ניסויים, מה שמסמל התקדמות לעבר תעופה עם פחות פליטות מזהמים. קאפוטו מדגיש כי העבודה שלהם משמעותית לסביבה ולדורות הבאים. טכנולוגיות סוללה מתקדמות והשקעות ענק הפכו את התעופה החשמלית לאופציה ישימה. Beta גייסה 800 מיליון דולר ממשקיעים כמו פידלטי, קרן האקלים של אמזון ו-TPG Capital, ומעסיקה 600 עובדים, רובם בוורמונט. החברה סיימה להקים מפעל ייצור, אך דגם ה-CX300 ממתין לאישור הסופי מה-FAA. ה-CX300 מעוצב בסגנון מודרני, עם מוטת כנפיים של 50 רגל, חלונות פנורמיים ופרופלור אחורי, ונועד לשאת עד 1,250 פאונד של מטען. הדגם הבא, A250, יצויד במדחפי הרמה ותוכנית הבסיס שלו דומה מאוד ל-CX300. שני הדגמים (בשם 'Alia') ישמשו בתחילה להובלת מטען, אך בעתיד צפויים להסיע גם נוסעים. Beta פועלת בתחום תחרותי, וחברות כמו Joby ו-Archer מקליפורניה משקיעות בכלי טיס חשמליים עם המראה אנכית. בענף מעורבות יצרניות ענק כמו איירבוס, בואינג ואמבראר. ה-FAA שואפת לאפשר טיסות מסחריות חשמליות כבר ב-2028, וחיל האוויר האמריקאי בוחן מספר דגמים, כולל CX300 של Beta. קאפוטו תיאר את CX300 כשקט וקל להשתלטות, עם פוטנציאל שבקרוב טייסים ידברו ביניהם בקלות ללא קסדות. הוא רואה בכך דרך לחבר יישובים כפריים ומרוחקים שלא מקבלים שירותי טיסה ישירים. נכון להיום, CX300 מסוגל לעבור עד 386 מייל בטעינה אחת, אך טווח יעיל הוא עד 150 מייל. הטיסה הארוכה קיבלה היתר זמני מה-FAA. המטוסים החשמליים תוכננו לתפעול פשוט ולתחזוקה נמוכה, אך טווח הטיסה והקיבולת עדיין מוגבלים, בדומה למסוקים — ואילו תשתיות והעלויות מהוות חסם. חלק מהמומחים משווים את המצב כיום להופעת הרכב בראשית דרכו — שינוי טכנולוגי ששינה את פני התחבורה לאורך השנים. מייסד Beta, קייל קלארק, נוקט בגישה מדורגת: קודם תקינה למנוע, אחרי כן למטוס. ה-CX300 פועל ממסלולים קיימים כך שלא נדרשת תשתית ייעודית חדשה. בין לקוחות החברה — UPS (משלוחים), United Therapeutics (להובלת איברים) ו-Bristow Group (עבודה בים ובהצלה), אשר צופה לחסכון תפעולי משמעותי לעומת מסוקים. Beta מקימה רשת עמדות טעינה למטוסים ולרכבים, עם יותר מעשר תחנות פעילות, כולל עמדת הטעינה הצבאית הראשונה בפלורידה. החברה בנתה גם אתר נחיתה ניסיוני ממכולות ממוחזרות שנועד לאחסון אנרגיה ולמנוחת טייסים. בשלב הראשון של המסע, טס קאפוטו מברלינגטון אל הרי האדירונדק, שיתף את משפחתו בחוויה, והמשיך לסירקיוז שם העביר את המטוס לעמיתיו. למרות הדיבור על 'מוניות מעופפות', הייעוד הראשוני של Beta הוא בהובלת מטענים, רפואה וחיבור פריפריה. עוד בחדשות: הודו אישרה מפעל ביטחוני זר מלא ראשון של Saab, בנק SBI הציג רווח של 8% בגלל ביקוש לאשראי, ו-Byju’s רשמה עלייה בהכנסות וצמצום הפסדים.

article_content: Centrica chairman Rick Haythornthwaite has warned that criticism of energy prices and company profits is discouraging firms from investing in the power stations the UK needs. British Gas executives faced public anger after stating that ongoing criticism from politicians and the public about energy bills and profits could lead to power outages within two years unless attitudes change. Consumer groups and members of Parliament insisted that the public cannot be intimidated into silence while struggling with rising energy costs. This debate came as Centrica reported 2013 profits of £2.7 billion, a 2% decrease from the prior year. British Gas, the UK’s largest energy supplier, reported a profit of £571 million, down 6%. These profit drops followed the loss of 460,000 customers, who left after the company increased prices by an average of 9.2% in November, raising the typical annual bill to nearly £1,500. Executives expressed frustration that Prime Minister David Cameron and Energy Secretary Ed Davey encouraged customers to switch to cheaper providers. Ed Davey suggested that British Gas may have excessive profit margins and hinted at the potential breakup of the company. The Labour Party has proposed a 20-month price freeze on energy bills if it wins the 2015 General Election, which energy suppliers say would negatively affect their income. British Gas and the other ‘big six’ energy suppliers have faced widespread criticism for raising prices before winter, increasing pressure on consumers already struggling with the rising cost of living. Centrica chairman Rick Haythornthwaite argued that public and political criticism towards energy companies is harming investment in the sector and damaging the UK’s reputation for investment. He stated that urgent, constructive dialogue is needed to address these concerns and prevent possible power shortages. Haythornthwaite, 56, an Oxford graduate, has previously held senior roles at BP, Mastercard, and Network Rail, where he faced criticism over executive pay. Neil Duncan-Jordan of the National Pensioners Convention said consumers would not be deterred from expressing concerns over profits and prices. Labour MP John Robertson called Haythornthwaite’s comments ‘ridiculous’, emphasizing the need to scrutinize above-inflation price rises. Richard Lloyd, executive director of Which?, said that sustained profits despite customer losses suggest the energy market is failing consumers. Centrica’s leadership argues that targeting British Gas is unfair and notes that the company’s share price has dropped by over 20% since Labour’s price freeze pledge. Centrica CEO Sam Laidlaw commented that political criticism increases the cost of attracting top executives. While wholesale gas prices have recently fallen, Laidlaw said it is too early to predict if customer bills will decrease. Consumers are advised to use online comparison services, such as Energy Helpline, to find better tariffs and potentially save money by switching suppliers. The service is free, straightforward, and does not require paperwork.

Former FC Barcelona star Ousmane Dembele has opened up about his recent transfer to Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) in an interview with L'Equipe. Dembele, who joined Barcelona from Borussia Dortmund in 2017 for €105 million—funded by the sale of Neymar to PSG—endured several injury-plagued seasons in Spain. In his final years at Barcelona, head coach Xavi Hernandez supported Dembele, helping transform him into one of Europe's leading assist providers. Despite renewing his contract with Barcelona, which included a €50 million release clause, Dembele's seemingly secure future at Camp Nou took an unexpected turn when his agent, Moussa Sissoko, began negotiating a move to PSG. The transfer was finalized in mid-August.

In his first interview since joining PSG, Dembele explained his reasoning: "Yes, I said I would stay at Barcelona. But after talking to PSG, I became convinced that I should leave." He clarified that Kylian Mbappe, his France teammate and close friend, did not persuade him to make the switch. "I came to Paris because I love the club, it's a French club and I love it," Dembele said. "I come from Evreux, not far from here. Everyone here talks about Paris Saint-Germain. It felt inevitable that I would join this club one day."

article_content: Senior officials from the U.S. State Department have announced that Turkey will act as the United States’ protecting power in Libya, according to a report from CNN. In this position, Turkey will represent U.S. interests, assist American citizens, and maintain U.S. diplomatic premises in Libya. Turkey will also serve as an intermediary for communications between the U.S. and Libya, as direct contact is expected to decrease following U.S. airstrikes on Libyan targets related to the no-fly zone enforcement. Levent Sahin Kaya, the Turkish ambassador to Libya, stated that he, along with ambassadors from the United Kingdom and Italy, will handle American interests in Libya. While official diplomatic ties between the U.S. and Libya haven't been cut, the U.S. embassy in Tripoli was closed earlier this month and all staff withdrawn. The State Department similarly ordered the closure of the Libyan embassy in Washington, requiring Libyan diplomats to leave the country. The U.S. now recognizes Ali Aujali, a former Libyan ambassador who left his post in protest and joined the opposition, as Libya’s legitimate representative. Officials mention that Libya has not yet selected a country to represent its interests in the United States. (Reported by CNN’s Talia Kayali.)

Forget his powerful car and cutting-edge gadgets: if Felipe Massa clinches Formula One glory this season, he credits his lucky underwear. The Brazilian Ferrari driver narrowly missed his first world title in 2008, edged out by Britain’s Lewis Hamilton on the last lap of the season’s final race. The following year, Massa survived a life-threatening incident during Hungarian Grand Prix qualifying when a stray suspension spring from another car struck his head. Now, in 2011, he hopes for a smooth run toward the world championship—with some help from his race-day traditions.

'I have special underwear which I race in most of the time,' Massa told CNN. 'I wear them just for Saturday and Sunday—I don’t wash them for those two days, but it’s only two days, so what’s the problem?' His superstitions extend further: he always lands on his right foot when getting out of bed and ensures the same foot enters his car first before a race. 'Superstition is something inside your brain,' he explained. 'Of course, you win because you do the best job, but in your mind, having everything clean and ready is important, and that’s why athletes can be superstitious.'

With strong pre-season test results, many experts are tipping Massa as a contender for the 2011 title. Does he think this could finally be his year? 'Yes, I believe in my speed, in my driving, and that I can win races and the championship. It’s important to keep strengthening that belief.'

After battling car issues last season, Massa feels the new Pirelli tires will better suit his style. 'Most of my problems last year should be resolved because the tires are softer and get to temperature more easily. I like them, though they might mean more pit-stops and a change in strategy.'

Massa also dismisses the suggestion he would need to leave Ferrari to win a title. 'I don’t think so. I’m with a top team, which is essential, and Ferrari are motorsport icons. Driving for Ferrari is a dream come true.'

Remarkably, Massa returned to racing just ten weeks after his accident, and insists he doesn’t dwell on it. 'I never dream about the accident. I believe in God—I’m Catholic—and I’m sure it wasn’t my time. When it isn’t your time, you stay here.'

תשכחו מהמכונית החזקה והגאדג'טים המתקדמים: אם פליפה מאסה יזכה בעונת פורמולה 1 הזו, הוא מייחס את ההישג בעיקר לתחתונים המזליים שלו. הנהג הברזילאי של פרארי כמעט זכה באליפות העולם ב-2008, אך הבריטי לואיס המילטון עקף אותו בהקפה האחרונה של המרוץ האחרון לעונה. בשנה שלאחר מכן, מאסה שרד תאונה מסכנת חיים במקצה הדירוג בגרנד פרי הונגריה, כאשר קפיץ מתלה ממכונית אחרת פגע בראשו. עכשיו, ב-2011, הוא מקווה לעונה חלקה בדרך לאליפות העולם – עם עזרה מטקסי יום המרוץ שלו.

"יש לי תחתונים מיוחדים שבדרך כלל אני מתחרה בהם," סיפר מאסה ל-CNN. "אני לובש אותם רק בשבת וראשון – לא מכבס ליומיים האלו, אבל זה רק יומיים אז מה הבעיה?" הסופרסטיציות שלו לא נגמרות כאן: הוא תמיד קם על רגל ימין, ודואג שגם נכנס למכונית קודם עם אותה רגל. "סופרסטיציה זה משהו במוח. כמובן שמנצחים בזכות עבודה טובה, אבל חשוב בראש שכל יהיה מוכן – בגלל זה ספורטאים נוטים לסופרסטיציה."

לאחר תוצאות מבחני טרום-עונה מרשימות, פרשנים רבים רואים במאסה מועמד מוביל לאליפות 2011. האם הוא מאמין שזו השנה שלו? "כן, אני מאמין במהירות שלי, בסגנון הנהיגה שלי, ואני מאמין שאני יכול לנצח מרוצים ואת האליפות. חשוב לשמור על אמונה חזקה."

לאחר בעיות רבות ברכב בעונה שעברה, מאסה מרגיש שהצמיגים החדשים של פירלי מתאימים יותר לסגנון שלו. "רוב הבעיות שלי מהשנה שעברה אמורות להיפתר – הצמיגים הרבה יותר רכים ומתחממים בקלות. אני אוהב אותם, גם אם זה אומר עוד עצירות ושינוי באסטרטגיה."

מאסה גם דוחה את ההנחה שצריך לעזוב את פרארי כדי לזכות באליפות. "לא. אני בקבוצה מהטובות, וזה חיוני, ופרארי היא אגדה במירוצי מכוניות. לנהוג בפרארי זה ממש חלום שהתגשם."

בצורה יוצאת דופן, מאסה חזר למכונית עשרה שבועות בלבד אחרי התאונה, והוא מתעקש שלא חוזר לזה במחשבות. "אני אף פעם לא חולם על התאונה. אני מאמין באלוהים – אני קתולי – ובטוח שזה לא היה הזמן שלי. כשזה לא הזמן שלך, אתה נשאר פה."

article_content: MTV Documentary Films' latest feature, 'A Song Film By Kishi Bashi: OMOIYARI,' will premiere in just a few hours on Paramount+. Directed by Justin Taylor Smith and Kaoru Ishibashi—also known professionally as Kishi Bashi—the documentary follows Kishi Bashi as he embarks on a journey to create music in locations tied to the incarceration of Japanese Americans during World War II. According to the film's description, this journey allows Kishi Bashi to confront his own Japanese American identity and explore social issues that remain highly relevant today. 'OMOIYARI' is described as a genre-breaking artistic work blending history, music, and the complexities of the human experience. The film, which debuted earlier this year at SXSW, will launch on the Paramount+ streaming platform in the U.S. and Canada on Tuesday. It will be available the following day in the U.K., Australia, Latin America, Italy, France, Germany, Switzerland, and Austria. Kishi Bashi, born in Seattle to parents from Japan, improvises and writes music in the film to better understand his identity as a bicultural American. Utilizing never-before-seen archival footage from Japanese internment camps and striking visual storytelling, Kaoru weaves together history, music, and present-day events to present a unique perspective of America from someone straddling two cultures. Critic Bradley Gibson wrote in Film Threat that 'Bashi’s music is powerful and compelling, drawing stories from the past that have helped shape our present. He illuminates the darker aspects of our nature that may imprison us in fear if we do not resist.' A companion album for the film, also called 'Omoiyari,' was released in May—Kishi Bashi's fourth as a solo artist. Reviewing the album, the New York Times’ John Pareles wrote, 'The album is impressionistic, not didactic; the choruses touch on loneliness and lost love, not outrage. Omoiyari grapples with heritage and assimilation, displacement and survival, mourning and coping, all nestled into its rich arrangements. It makes peace with history, but does not forget.' 'A Song Film By Kishi Bashi: OMOIYARI' is directed by Justin Taylor Smith and Kaoru Ishibashi and produced by J.J. Gerber, Max Ritter, and Jim Angelo. The executive producers include Ryan Suffern, Jenny Mills, Drew Wallin, and Sheila Nevins for MTV Documentary Films. Kishi Bashi provides the music and score, with Max Ritter as the director of photography.

'OMOIYARI' מתואר כיצירה פורצת דרך המשלבת היסטוריה, מוזיקה ומורכבות אנושית. הסרט, שהוקרן לראשונה בתחילת השנה בפסטיבל SXSW, ישודר ב-Paramount+ בארה"ב וקנדה ביום שלישי, וכבר ביום שלמחרת יהיה זמין בבריטניה, אוסטרליה, אמריקה הלטינית, איטליה, צרפת, גרמניה, שווייץ ואוסטריה. קישי באשי, שנולד בסיאטל להורים ילידי יפן, מאלתר וכותב מוזיקה בסרט כדי להבין טוב יותר את זהותו האמריקאית-דו-תרבותית. באמצעות קטעי ארכיון נדירים ממחנות הכליאה וסיפור ויזואלי עוצר נשימה, קאורו שוזר היסטוריה, מוזיקה ואירועים אקטואליים לכדי מבט ייחודי על אמריקה בעיניו של מי שחי בין שני עולמות. הביקורת של בראדלי גיבסון במגזין Film Threat מדגישה: 'המוזיקה של באשי עוצמתית וסוחפת, מחיה סיפורים מהעבר שעיצבו את ההווה. הוא מאיר דפוסים אפלים באופינו העלולים לשעבד אותנו לפחד אם לא נתנגד.' אלבום נלווה לסרט, גם הוא בשם 'Omoiyari', יצא במאי—הרביעי של קישי באשי כסולן. ג'ון פארלס מהניו יורק טיימס כתב: 'זהו אלבום אימפרסיוניסטי, לא דידקטי; הפזמונים מדברים על בדידות ואהבה אבודה, לא על כעס. Omoiyari מתמודד עם מורשת והשתלבות, עקירה והישרדות, אבל והסתגלות—הכל עטוף בעיבודים עשירים. הוא משלים עם העבר אך אינו שוכח.' 'A Song Film By Kishi Bashi: OMOIYARI' בוים על ידי ג'סטין טיילור סמית' וקאורו אישיבאשי והופק על ידי ג'יי.ג'יי. גרבר, מקס ריטר וג'ים אנג'לו. צוות ההפקה הבכיר כולל את ריאן סאפרן, ג'ני מילס, דרו וולין ושלילה נווינס מ-MTV Documentary Films. קישי באשי אחראי על המוזיקה והפסקול, ומקס ריטר שימש כצלם הראשי.

article_content: The National Institute for Health and Clinical Excellence (NICE) has published draft guidelines recommending that smokers try reducing the number of cigarettes they smoke over time, rather than quitting immediately. This approach means nicotine replacement therapies, such as patches and gum, can be offered to those who don't want to stop all at once, reversing previous restrictions where such treatments were only provided to people going 'cold turkey.' NICE’s new advice suggests that licensed nicotine-containing products should be made available to smokers who want to cut down gradually, for those attempting to reduce smoking, or for people aiming to abstain during specific times, such as at work. Although some nicotine products like certain e-cigarettes are not yet fully regulated, and their safety isn't guaranteed, NICE says these are likely less harmful than smoking cigarettes. Additionally, NICE proposes stores and supermarkets should prominently display licensed nicotine products to improve access. Professor Mike Kelly, from NICE's Centre for Public Health Excellence, highlights that smoking causes more than 79,000 deaths in England annually and that children are especially at risk from second-hand smoke. Professor Kelly notes that while quitting entirely provides the best health benefits and works best if done in one go, many heavy smokers may feel unable or unwilling to quit suddenly. Strategies like 'cutting down to quit' can help these individuals. He adds that harm reduction approaches, particularly those involving licensed nicotine products, give smokers alternative options. The guidance recommends that healthcare providers inform smokers that using nicotine replacement products while reducing or quitting is more effective, and reassures that licensed options are safe and effective even for several years of use. Professor John Britton, from the Royal College of Physicians, agrees with the new approach. He states that while nicotine motivates smoking, tobacco smoke is the most harmful delivery method, so switching to alternative, regulated sources is healthier. He encourages smokers unable to quit nicotine to use these alternatives as much as possible. With the guidelines open for public feedback, public health experts believe that these recommendations can dramatically benefit population health. The proposals have received a positive response from several organizations, who see them as an important advancement for harm reduction.

article_content: Nintendo may be conflicted about its history, but one thing the company consistently does is resell classic games. It’s easy to lose track of how many times titles like Super Metroid and Super Mario Bros. 3 have been released. This background makes Super Mario RPG, and its recent Switch remake, especially notable. Originally released in 1996, Super Mario RPG was the result of a collaboration between Nintendo and Square Enix (then called Squaresoft), bringing a roleplaying adventure to the Mushroom Kingdom. The game was not only a hit, but it also created two Mario RPG spinoff series. Despite its beloved status and influence, there have been fewer official ways to play Super Mario RPG compared to other classics. Now, with a wave of remakes and rereleases, the remake on Switch is a welcome return. The remake mostly updates the visuals for modern hardware, keeping the original’s charm and turning it into one of the most delightful turn-based RPGs. Super Mario RPG begins in typical Mario fashion: Bowser kidnaps Princess Peach, and Mario sets out to rescue her. However, the plot takes a twist when a sentient, evil sword takes over Bowser’s castle, and Mario must recruit allies—including Peach, Bowser, and new characters Geno and Mallow—to recover seven stars and halt an otherworldly invasion of living weapons. The game’s appeal lies in its imaginative world and quirky characters. From wise frogs and living alarm clocks to misunderstood monsters, Super Mario RPG’s Mushroom Kingdom is just a portion of a larger, eccentric world. This sense of playful weirdness permeates the game, from dance animations when characters level up to deeper portrayals of familiar enemies. Even Bowser is shown as a reluctant hero. Gameplay stands out with its turn-based combat reminiscent of classic Final Fantasy titles, but with a twist: players must time their button presses to enhance attacks or block incoming blows. This engaging mechanic adds depth and keeps battles lively. Swapping party members mid-battle also introduces layers of strategy, especially during boss fights. The game streamlines gear, items, and upgrades, making it accessible to newcomers. Super Mario RPG’s influence is evident in later Mario RPG series, such as the timing-based battles in Mario & Luigi and how Paper Mario gives personality to background characters. Yet, the original maintains a unique identity—likely due to its historical context and Square Enix’s involvement. In a year full of Mario milestones—including a film, a new theme park, and classic side-scrolling game releases—the timing for Super Mario RPG’s return couldn’t be better. The remake launches for Nintendo Switch on November 17th.

article_content: A tragic car crash in Idaho claimed the lives of a California family of four when a driver heading the wrong direction on Interstate 84 collided head-on with their vehicle, according to Idaho State Police. Authorities say Amado Herrera, 48, from South El Monte, California, was behind the wheel of a Nissan sedan Thursday night with three relatives as passengers, when a Ford F-150 driven by Eusebio Jacobo Pineda, 45, struck them after driving the wrong way near Glenns Ferry just before 8:50 p.m. Herrera and his passengers—Luz Herrera, Ivette Herrera (18), and Antoni Herrera (9)—died at the scene. Pineda survived and was taken to the hospital with injuries that weren't life-threatening. Police indicated that all four family members had been wearing seat belts, while Pineda's seatbelt use was still uncertain. The impact caused Pineda’s truck to roll, and images from the scene showed severe damage to the front of the family’s car. Interstate 84 remained closed for roughly four hours after the accident while investigations continued. As of Friday, officials had not filed any criminal charges and the cause of the crash is still under review.

article_content:
Puneet Yamparala, a seasoned Chief Product Officer with more than 13 years at Amazon and various startups, is also the co-founder of Bizeev Brands and a recognized eCommerce strategist. In 2015, as a principal product manager at a prominent e-commerce platform, he spearheaded an effort to expand into over 100 countries lacking established online shopping options. The central challenge was deciding which features were essential for their new cross-border e-commerce product.

After 14 months and with contributions from over 100 developers, the initial launch did not connect with customers globally. Feedback showed shoppers preferred the company’s existing platforms with broader selections rather than a new global site. The beta version’s release saw an overwhelming 98% user drop-off within two days—primarily leaving only employees to use the app. Faced with these results, the team chose to abandon their initial effort and reconsider their approach.

Yamparala now reflects on this challenging phase as pivotal—leading to the adoption of the 'lean pirate framework'—a method merging principles from the lean startup movement and pirate metrics (AARRR: acquisition, activation, retention, referral, revenue). This shift eventually set the groundwork for the company’s thriving export business.

The framework prioritizes:
- Focusing on a single core feature, with others added only when essential—such as displaying region-specific products.
- Delivering immediate value, like automatic localization of language and currency to show relevance to new users instantly.
- Retaining and engaging users through features like real-time notifications and loyalty programs.
- Encouraging growth by embedding options for shared shopping experiences, letting users collaborate on orders to reduce shipping costs.
- Planning monetization routes early, with attention to the full purchase journey and data-driven optimizations.

Yamparala emphasizes that the lean pirate framework represents a shift in perspective, helping businesses create meaningful experiences tailored to diverse, global customers.

The article also notes that the Forbes Business Council is a leading platform for growth and collaboration among business professionals.

פונית ימפראלה, סמנכ"ל מוצר עם ניסיון של מעל 13 שנים באמזון ובסטארטאפים, הוא גם ממייסדי Bizeev Brands ונחשב לאסטרטג מסחר אלקטרוני מוביל. בשנת 2015, כמנהל מוצר ראשי בפלטפורמת מסחר אלקטרוני גדולה, הוביל יזמה להתרחבות ליותר מ-100 מדינות שבהן לא היו אפשרויות קנייה מקומית ברשת. האתגר המרכזי היה לקבוע אילו פיצ'רים חיוניים במוצר המסחר האלקטרוני החדש שלהם.

לאורך 14 חודשים ועם למעלה מ-100 מפתחים, ההשקה הראשונית לא התחברה ללקוחות הגלובליים. משובים הראו כי הקונים העדיפו את אתרי החברה הקיימים, בהם ההיצע רחב יותר, על פני פלטפורמה גלובלית חדשה. גרסת הבטא של האפליקציה הביאה לעזיבה של 98% מהמשתמשים ביומיים בלבד – כמעט רק העובדים המשיכו להשתמש. מול הבעיה הזו, הצוות החליט לוותר על הפתרון המקורי ולבנות גישה חדשה.

ימפראלה מתאר את התקופה הזאת כרגע קריטי, שכן היא הובילה לאימוץ 'מתודולוגיית הפיראט הרזה' – שילוב בין עקרונות מתודולוגיית הסטארטאפ הרזה למדדי הפיראט (AARRR: רכישה, הפעלה, שימור, הפניות, הכנסות). המעבר הזה אפשר את הצלחת עסקי הייצוא של החברה.

המסגרת מדגישה:
- התמקדות בפיצ'ר עיקרי, עם הוספה של אחרים רק כשצריך – למשל, הצגת מוצרים רלוונטיים לפי אזור.
- יצירת ערך מידי כמו התאמות אוטומטיות של שפה ומטבע כדי להראות למשתמשים את הרלוונטיות של השירות.
- שימור משתמשים על-ידי התראות רלוונטיות ותוכניות נאמנות.
- קידום צמיחה עם אפשרות להזמנות משותפות שמאפשרת הפחתת עלויות משלוח.
- הבניית מודל הכנסות מההתחלה תוך בניית מסע רכישה חכם מבוסס דאטה.

ימפראלה מדגיש שמדובר בשינוי תפיסה – לא רק שיטה – שמאפשר להתאים מוצרים ופתרונות לצרכים המשתנים של לקוחות ברחבי העולם.

בנוסף, המאמר מציין כי Forbes Business Council היא פלטפורמה מובילה ליזמים ואנשי מקצוע שרוצים לצמוח ולהתחבר.

article_content: By Daniel Miller. The world of model trains just got a lot sweeter. An extraordinary chocolate creation stretching an impressive 34 metres has set a new world record for the longest structure made entirely from chocolate. Crafted from 1,285 kilograms of fine Belgian chocolate and containing approximately 6.5 million calories, the detailed model was built by Maltese master chocolatier Andrew Farrugia. The chocolate train was unveiled at Brussels South Station to launch Brussels Chocolate Week, attracting enthusiastic crowds and commuters. Mr. Farrugia devoted 784 hours to complete the masterpiece, with support from Belgian chocolate brand Belcolade. Representatives from Guinness World Records attended the event to officially verify and record the achievement. Taking pride of place at the station, the chocolate train amazed onlookers and celebrated Belgian chocolate craftsmanship alongside international artistry.

article_content: A rhinoceros was found dead in a pool of its own blood in Kaziranga National Park, India, after being killed for its horn. Forestry workers discovered the carcass in the Burapahar range in Assam. Poaching of rhino horns, toenails, and skin for the Asian medicinal market remains a significant environmental issue in the park. The Indian rhinoceros, or one-horned rhino, is classified as a vulnerable species. It is primarily found in Assam and protected areas of Nepal. While the species once roamed throughout the Indo-Gangetic Plain, its numbers declined due to extensive hunting. Today, there are believed to be more than 3,000 in the wild, with over 2,500 residing in Assam. There are five species of rhinoceros worldwide, all of which face some level of threat. Although poaching greatly reduced populations in the 20th century, recent conservation efforts have led to some recovery. Meanwhile, a separate effort to boost northern white rhino numbers by relocating three individuals from a Czech zoo to East Africa has largely failed. At the Ol Pejeta Conservancy in Kenya, caretakers say that the last three northern white rhinos—one male and two females—will not reproduce naturally. This means the species may face extinction. Scientists are now relying on in vitro fertilization and genetic research, hoping these advanced techniques can help save the world's most endangered mammal.

article_content: Landlords in Newham, one of Britain's poorest areas, are exploiting vulnerable families by renting out cramped 'sheds with beds' built in back gardens. Since September 2011, Newham Council in East London has issued 42 enforcement notices to property owners in response to this growing problem within the borough. These makeshift backyard sheds, described as 'little bigger than rabbit hutches,' have been compared to the notorious Victorian slums of the 19th century. The interior of a shed on Tower Hamlets Road in Forest Gate, East London, highlights the poor living conditions. Desperate migrant families have been forced to live in cramped wooden sheds, which are being rented out by unscrupulous private landlords for hundreds of pounds a month. Many such makeshift homes have appeared in East Ham, Newham, and Forest Gate. Last week, Newham Council released photos of sheds on Katharine Road and Tower Hamlets Road in Forest Gate, including one recently occupied by a middle-aged man. In some recent cases, the council issued enforcement notices to landlords, who dismantled the illegal buildings after being threatened with direct action. The council could have sent their own contractors to remove the sheds, charging the owners approximately £1,000 per operation. Newham Council has committed to tackling more illegal sheds this year, following the implementation of a property licensing scheme aiming to regulate all private landlords. Newham Mayor Sir Robin Wales said, 'We want to ensure that private sector rented properties are well managed and meet good standards. Unfortunately, some landlords are unscrupulous and exploit tenants by providing unsafe and unacceptable accommodation.' 'We will never accept private tenants being exploited by landlords who force them to live in dangerous conditions. One bad house can drag down an entire street.' Other examples include a family of four living in a dilapidated shed in Wembley, north-west London. Previously, MailOnline reported about an Indian father of three among thousands of illegal immigrants renting sheds from rogue landlords in London suburbs and the Home Counties. In Southall, west London, rows of outhouses and garages have become makeshift bedsits, some with exposed wires and unsafe water pipes, while others have basic kitchens and bathrooms. The article also references the Victorian East End slums, particularly Old Nichol in Bethnal Green, described in Sarah Wise’s 2008 book 'The Blackest Streets' as overcrowded, unsanitary, and dangerous. These slums had high infant mortality rates, and conditions included damp, overcrowding, and poor air quality, with tragic incidents involving suffocation due to overcrowded sleeping arrangements.

'לעולם לא נקבל מצב שבו דיירים במגזר הפרטי מנוצלים ע״י משכירים שכופים עליהם לחיות בתנאים מסוכנים. בית אחד רע יכול להוריד את כל הרחוב כולו.' דוגמאות נוספות כוללות משפחה בת ארבעה נפשות שחיה בסככה מתפוררת בוומבלי, צפון-מערב לונדון. בעבר דיווח האתר MailOnline על אב הודי לשלושה מבין אלפי מהגרים לא חוקיים ששוכרים סככות ממשכירים פיראטיים בפרברי לונדון והאזורים הסמוכים. בדרוםול, מערב לונדון, שורות של בתי חוץ ומוסכים הפכו לדירות מאולתרות — חלקן עם חוטי חשמל חשופים וצנרת מים לא בטוחה, ואחרות עם מטבחים וחדרי רחצה בסיסיים. הכתבה מתייחסת גם לשכונות העוני הוויקטוריאניות במזרח לונדון, ובמיוחד לאולד ניקול בבית'נל גרין, שתוארה בספרה של שרה וייז משנת 2008 'The Blackest Streets' כצפופה, לא סניטרית ומסוכנת. לשכונות אלו היו שיעורי תמותת תינוקות גבוהים, ותנאים שכללו רטיבות, צפיפות ואוויר גרוע, כשאירועים טראגיים של חנק התרחשו עקב תנאי שינה צפופים.

Recent data highlights Britain’s little-used railway stations, where annual passenger numbers are strikingly low. Teesside Airport station, near Darlington, tops the list as the least-used station in the country, recording just 14 passengers in the 2011-12 financial year. Other 'ghost' stations, such as Dorking West in Surrey (16 passengers) and Denton in Greater Manchester (30 passengers), remain open primarily to avoid the complex bureaucracy required to officially close them.

These stations often operate with minimal service: for example, Teesside Airport offers only one train per week and is linked to an airport with just two scheduled flights. Despite campaigns by activists, like those supporting Denton, officials from rail companies argue that limited demand justifies the current minimal service. Alan Jones, chairman of the Friends of Denton Station, maintains that with more frequent trains, usage would rise.

A total of eight stations had passenger numbers fewer than 100 last year, while London Waterloo was the busiest, with nearly 100 million passengers. The stark contrast between Britain’s busiest and quietest stations underscores ongoing concerns that many communities, despite having a train station, are under-served by the railway network. This pattern persists decades after the Beeching cuts, which closed over 2,000 stations and left many smaller communities with limited service.

article_content: A top White House aide and a BP executive presented differing accounts on Sunday regarding who initially underestimated the size of the Gulf of Mexico oil spill. Robert Dudley, BP’s managing director, stated on CNN’s 'State of the Union' and other talk shows that early estimates—5,000 barrels (210,000 gallons) per day—were based on government satellite imaging, not BP’s calculations. However, a government-led team recently updated the estimate, stating the leak ranged from 12,000 to 19,000 barrels (504,000 to 798,000 gallons) per day, more than double the original figure. Dudley reiterated on CBS’ 'Face the Nation' that satellite data was used for early rate estimates, not BP data. Carol Browner, President Obama’s assistant for energy and climate change, disagreed on NBC’s 'Meet the Press' and CBS, saying, “The very first estimates came from BP. They had footage of the plume. The government then used satellite imagery and determined those estimates were inaccurate.” Browner pointed out BP’s financial interest in downplaying the leak, explaining that fines would be based on the reported rates, and emphasized that the recent independent assessment did not include BP. Rep. Ed Markey of Massachusetts, chair of the House Energy and Environment subcommittee, agreed BP had an incentive to lower the initial figures, saying, “I think they were either lying or they were incompetent.” He criticized BP’s credibility and said, “I have no confidence in BP. I don’t think people should rely on BP’s predictions.” Browner highlighted government oversight of BP’s response, including ordering BP to drill two relief wells instead of one, as BP had proposed. She added it was government scientists, led by Energy Secretary Steven Chu, who recommended stopping the 'top kill' operation due to safety concerns. Dudley expressed disappointment that the oil was still leaking and promised BP would intensify efforts to minimize environmental impact. He described plans to cut a new opening and lower a cap to capture most of the leaking oil, noting a previous similar effort had failed but improvements would be made. Dudley said the objective was to contain the majority of the oil and gas, and that cutting a new opening should not significantly increase the leak before the cap is in place. Browner, however, warned a 20% increase in leakage was possible. Markey accused BP of improvising without certainty about their methods or outcomes.

article_content: Succeeding Steve Jobs is a daunting challenge, but Apple CEO Tim Cook says he doesn’t see his predecessor as a rival. In a recent episode of BBC's 'Dua Lipa: At Your Service' podcast, Cook spoke about his journey at Apple. When host Dua Lipa highlighted Apple’s tremendous increase in market value since Cook took over, she asked if he felt he receives enough credit for his impact. Cook replied, 'I don’t look at it like that at all. Steve was an original and only he could have created Apple. We owe him a debt of gratitude, and I have no doubt that if he were alive today, the company would still be thriving and he would still be CEO.' Cook joined Apple in 1998, when the company was on the brink of bankruptcy. Known for his supply-chain expertise and focus on efficiency, Cook became part of Apple’s senior leadership and was named CEO in 2011, a few months before Jobs passed away from pancreatic cancer. Cook often shares credit for the company's growth with Jobs and the Apple team, stating, 'I don’t think of it as a credit deal. I get to work with people I love who are incredible at what they do. We share the credit at the company.' Under Cook’s leadership, Apple has experienced unparalleled financial growth. In 2018, Apple became the first U.S. company to reach a $1 trillion market cap, doubling that to $2 trillion in 2020, and reaching $3 trillion by September 2023. While Jobs handpicked Cook as his successor, Cook’s tenure has seen some criticism—mainly that he comes from a finance background rather than the design team, which was Jobs’ passion. Jobs described Cook as 'not a product guy.' Reports have suggested occasional clashes between Cook and former design chief Jony Ive, although Cook has disputed these, saying such accounts 'don’t match with reality.' Ive left Apple in 2019 but has continued to consult for the company. Although Apple’s pace of groundbreaking product releases slowed under Cook compared to Jobs’ era, this is changing. With the upcoming launch of the Vision Pro headset—the first major new platform since the Apple Watch and the first developed without Jobs—Cook is steering Apple into new territory. He’s also been instrumental in expanding Apple’s services business, which continues to be a bright spot amidst stronger smartphone competition, and is praised for encouraging innovation and taking responsibility when ventures don’t succeed. With persistent rumors about projects like the Apple Car, as well as successes like the Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and services growth, Cook looks to be establishing a significant legacy of his own.

article_content: Hollywood publicist Ronni Chasen was fatally shot while driving through Beverly Hills, California, in what police describe as a random 'robbery gone bad.' According to preliminary findings by Beverly Hills police, the suspect, Harold Martin Smith, killed himself last week. Investigators dismissed earlier speculation that Chasen was the victim of a professional hit, stating much of the media's reporting since her death three weeks ago has been inaccurate. Police said Smith, 43, was riding his bicycle when he shot Chasen several times as she drove home from a Hollywood movie premiere. Smith later died by suicide using the same gun involved in Chasen's killing, according to Beverly Hills Police Chief David Snowden. Smith shot himself in the head last week as officers approached him for questioning at his Hollywood apartment building. Preliminary ballistics tests confirmed Smith's gun was used in Chasen's slaying, Detective Sgt. Mike Publicker reported. Publicker stated, 'With Mr. Smith's background, we believe most likely it was a robbery gone bad. We believe it was a random act.' Detectives found no evidence of any prior connection between Chasen and Smith. Publicker added that Smith appeared to have acted alone, using a bicycle for transportation. Authorities said their investigation is 60–70% complete and remains ongoing. Publicker noted, 'There are additional interviews to be conducted, but this is our belief at this time.' Chief Snowden remarked that while carjackings are not unusual in Los Angeles, such incidents are exceedingly rare in Beverly Hills. 'We don’t believe it was a professional hit, and this is an open and ongoing investigation,' Snowden said. Smith, who had a criminal record, shot himself when detectives approached him at his Hollywood residence last Wednesday. The television program 'America’s Most Wanted' helped police connect with a tipster, who will likely receive a $125,000 reward, according to Publicker.

article_content: Stray animals in Gambia often live without care. Recently, a six-week-old puppy was rescued after concerned passers-by noticed it was suffering from a severe parasite infestation. A charitable veterinary clinic, Animal Care Gambia, treated the puppy after it was found on the streets of Sukuta. The clinic, established in 2009 by Dr. Michael Meyer from Berlin, addresses the lack of animal care facilities in the country. Mangoworm infestations, caused by the mango fly (Cordylobia anthropophaga), are a significant issue for stray animals in Gambia. The larvae develop under the skin until they are fully grown, causing discomfort and health issues for the host. A video filmed by the clinic shows the puppy being treated and the parasites removed. In the footage, more than 50 larvae are extracted from the puppy’s leg in just a few minutes, with additional worms found in its stomach and other legs. Representatives from the clinic explain that mangoworms are commonly found in Gambia's dogs, and that adult dogs can sometimes tolerate infestations. The larvae typically need to be removed once they reach 3-4mm in diameter, either naturally or with intervention. The clinic spokesperson notes that many stray animals lack caretakers, leading to widespread infestations. Removing parasites is one of the most common and important tasks they undertake. Animal Care Gambia shares videos of their work on YouTube to help educate the public and raise funds for animal welfare. Their efforts have drawn attention from animal lovers online, including those who comment with concern for the rescued puppy’s outcome. Animal Care Gambia is based in the Greater Banjul Area and is dedicated to improving the welfare of stray and beach animals in the region, particularly during the peak tourist season from October to April.

Animal Care Gambia משתפת סרטוני עבודה ביוטיוב כדי לחנך את הציבור ולגייס תרומות לרווחת בעלי חיים. המאמץ שלהם זוכה לתשומת לב רבה מאוהבי בעלי חיים ברשת, כולל מי שמביע דאגה לגור שחולץ. article_content: Meta is set to deploy two submarine cables in Nigeria, with landings scheduled in Lagos and Akwa Ibom by the end of November. This development was announced by Abdullahi Kashifu, Director General of the National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA), during the Global Tech Africa conference on Friday. Kashifu stated that the initiative supports the Nigerian government’s strategy to enhance digital infrastructure and expand broadband coverage, aiming to position Nigeria as a digital leader. The announcement followed a visit by Meta Platform representatives to the National Assembly Complex, where they were welcomed by Nigeria’s Deputy Speaker, Benjamin Kalu. Attending the meeting were Kojo Boakye, Meta’s Vice President of Public Policy for Africa, and Adaora Ikenze, Meta’s Director for West Africa. Kalu expressed optimism about the benefits of Meta’s investment in submarine cables, underlining the significance of collaboration between Meta and the Nigerian government to promote digital connectivity and technological growth. Meta’s cable arrival comes after the 12,000km Google-backed Equiano undersea cable landed in Nigeria in April 2022. Kalu acknowledged Meta’s positive impact on Nigeria’s digital economy, with investments in fiber optic cables, mobile partnerships, and support for entrepreneurs and small to medium-sized enterprises. He described the news of the 45,000km subsea cable landing as 'exciting and commendable,' citing its potential to significantly benefit Nigeria’s socio-economic development.

article_content: Ciudad Real International Airport in Spain, built for up to $1.5 billion, is now offered at auction with a starting price of $150 million. The airport, which has seen little use, became a symbol of Spain's financial troubles after the property bubble burst. Located 200 kilometers south of Madrid, the relatively new airport features Europe's longest runway and a capacity of 10 million travelers per year. It also gained attention as a filming location for Pedro Almodovar’s movie "I’m So Excited!" Despite these assets, the airport has large yellow crosses on the runway to prevent accidental landings. Its remote area in Castile-La Mancha, known from Don Quixote, contributed to a lack of travelers. Opened in 2008 to connect Madrid and the Andalusian coast by high-speed rail, Ciudad Real briefly hosted low-cost carriers like Ryanair and Air Berlin. The airport launched just as Spain's economy was hit by recession, and traffic soon dried up. It closed in 2012 after declaring bankruptcy, though notable visitors like Prince Harry stopped by. While $1.5 billion is a widely cited figure for construction costs, bankruptcy administrator Francisco Perez says actual costs are closer to one-third of that, given ongoing court cases with landowners. Perez suggests the airport, often called a 'ghost airport,' is best used for cargo and industrial projects. Large adjacent parcels of undeveloped land are part of the auction package. For now, the airport awaits a buyer—whether a business giant, a royal, or an airline—remaining a sign of ambitious development overtaken by economic reality.

Veteran broadcaster Stuart Hall has called Jeremy Clarkson 'deluded' for claiming he would rather quit Top Gear than move north with the BBC. Clarkson, 51, recently criticized Salford, describing it as 'a small suburb with little to offer beyond a Starbucks and a canal with ducks.' He quipped that each year, Top Gear would end up making a Christmas special at the Dog and Duck pub or the nearest Arndale Centre if forced to move.

The BBC is relocating five departments and 1,500 jobs from London to Salford Quays, establishing a new £877 million headquarters. However, there are currently no plans for the Top Gear team to relocate. 

Stuart Hall, 81, a former It's A Knockout presenter and BBC sports commentator born in Ashton-under-Lyne, Lancashire, voiced his criticism in the Radio Times. He wrote: 'Clarkson is deluded. Does he imagine that at the advance of effete southerners, we retreat to our outside lavatories with ripped-up copies of the News of the Screws? That in our back-to-back terraces, we ply Uncle Fred with chitterlings, bangers and chips, sit him in a commode, chamberpot handy, an ashtray full of dog ends, a basketful of empty tinnies and pretend he’s dying through lack of care?'

Hall continued: 'Manchester is booming; the financial sector deals with the world. Our scientists lead, and Manchester is a seat of knowledge, a breeding ground for brains.' He praised Salford's new Media City, describing it as 'a haven for the creative mind, far from London’s overcrowded and cosmopolitan hustle.'

Clarkson previously claimed the BBC's move to Salford was a 'box-ticking exercise.' In a newspaper column, he wrote: 'A lot of the arguments against the BBC's move have focused on expense, but I believe there's a more important problem than money. In short, Salford is up north.'

Several high-profile BBC presenters, including BBC Breakfast co-host Sian Williams and sports presenter Chris Hollins, have also refused to move to Manchester.

article_content: SANTA FE, N.M. – Prosecutors are preparing to present evidence to a grand jury in connection with the fatal 2021 shooting of cinematographer Halyna Hutchins on the set of the Western film 'Rust' in New Mexico. The grand jury did not review the case Thursday, and a decision on whether to revive criminal charges against Alec Baldwin may still be weeks away. The grand jury proceedings are confidential, with no public access. Prosecutors will present evidence and witness testimony, which are not immediately challenged or vetted by Baldwin’s defense. Baldwin, the lead actor and co-producer of 'Rust,' was rehearsing with a firearm and pointing it at cinematographer Halyna Hutchins on a set near Santa Fe in October 2021 when the gun discharged, resulting in Hutchins's death and injuring director Joel Souza. Baldwin has stated he pulled back the hammer—without pulling the trigger—when the gun fired. Special prosecutors initially dismissed the involuntary manslaughter charge against Baldwin in April 2023 after learning the gun may have been modified and malfunctioned. However, after a new analysis of the firearm, they are asking a grand jury to reconsider charges. Prosecutors are also preparing for a scheduled February 2024 trial of 'Rust' armorer Hannah Gutierrez-Reed, who has pleaded not guilty to charges of involuntary manslaughter and evidence tampering. This preparation includes recent subpoenas for documents from 'Rust' producers, as well as any recordings held by a Los Angeles production company that might feature Baldwin on set or speaking about the film. Neama Rahmani, a former federal prosecutor and president of West Coast Trial Lawyers, stated that evidence used against Gutierrez-Reed could also be used in the Baldwin case. Recently released video footage, aired by NBC News and source undisclosed, shows Baldwin firing a prop gun outdoors, expressing concerns about safety. In one clip, he tells a crew member, 'You want to go on the other side of the camera? I don't want to shoot toward you.' Rahmani noted these videos do not introduce new evidence or shift prosecutors’ core argument that Baldwin pulled the trigger, counter to Baldwin’s claim. Ballistics and forensic testing by experts in Arizona and New Mexico, who used replacement parts to reassemble the firearm after it broke during FBI testing, concluded the trigger must have been pulled or depressed for the gun to fire. The report from Lucien Haag, of Forensic Science Services in Arizona, stated that tests showed the trigger had to be pulled or depressed sufficiently to release the hammer. An earlier FBI analysis found the gun could fire without the trigger being pulled if the uncocked hammer was struck—such as by dropping the weapon. Testers only managed to fire the weapon by striking it with a mallet while the hammer was down or by pulling the trigger when fully cocked. The gun broke during these tests. A grand jury must determine whether there is probable cause to indict Baldwin. At least eight of twelve jurors must agree. If the grand jury declines to indict, a second grand jury is unlikely. Prosecutors Kari Morrissey and Jason Lewis say new facts support possible criminal culpability for Baldwin in Hutchins’s death. Baldwin’s lawyers argue this is a misguided prosecution of a tragedy and say they will address any charges in court. In March, David Halls, the assistant director and safety coordinator for 'Rust,' pleaded no contest to unsafe firearm handling and received a suspended sentence with six months’ probation. He has agreed to cooperate with investigators. This story has been updated to clarify the subpoenaed production company is in Los Angeles, not Malibu.
translated_content: סנטה פה, ניו מקסיקו – התובעים מתכוננים להציג ראיות בפני חבר מושבעים בנוגע לירי הקטלני ב-2021 בצלמת הקולנוע הלינה האצ'ינס על סט הסרט המערבי 'Rust' בניו מקסיקו. חבר המושבעים לא דן בתיק ביום חמישי, והחלטה אם לחדש את כתב האישום נגד אלק בולדווין עשויה להתעכב עוד מספר שבועות. הליכי חבר המושבעים חסויים ללא גישה לציבור. התובעים יציגו ראיות ועדויות עדים, שלא מאותגרות או נבדקות במקום על ידי ההגנה של בולדווין. בולדווין, השחקן הראשי והמפיק השותף של 'Rust', תרגל עם כלי ירייה כשהפנה אותו לעבר הצלמת הלינה האצ'ינס בסט ליד סנטה פה באוקטובר 2021, כאשר האקדח ירה, גרם למותה של האצ'ינס ופצע את הבמאי ג'ואל סאוזה. בולדווין טען כי דרך את הפטיש – מבלי ללחוץ על ההדק – כשהאקדח ירה. התובעים המיוחדים דחו בתחילה את האישום בהריגה רשלנית נגד בולדווין באפריל 2023 אחרי שנמסר להם שהאקדח ייתכן ששונה ושהייתה בו תקלה. עם זאת, לאחר ניתוח חדש של כלי הנשק, הם מבקשים מחבר המושבעים לשקול חידוש האישום. התובעים מתכוננים גם למשפט בפברואר 2024 של מחסנאית כלי הנשק של 'Rust', האנה גוטיירז-ריד, שהכחישה את האישומים בהריגה רשלנית ובשיבוש ראיות. ההכנות כוללות זימון מסמכים ממפיקי 'Rust' וכל הקלטות שיש לחברת הפקה מלוס אנג'לס שעשויות להציג את בולדווין בסט או מדבר על הסרט. ניאמה רחמני, תובע פדרלי לשעבר ונשיא West Coast Trial Lawyers, אמר שראיות שיוצגו בתיק נגד גוטיירז-ריד יכולות לשמש גם נגד בולדווין. קטעי וידאו ששודרו לאחרונה ב-NBC News, ולמקורם לא נמסר, מציגים את בולדווין יורה באקדח דמה בחוץ ומביע חשש לבטיחות. באחד הקטעים הוא אומר לאיש צוות: 'אתה רוצה להיות בצד השני של המצלמה? אני לא רוצה לירות לכיוון שלך.' רחמני ציין כי קטעי הווידאו אינם מציגים ראיות חדשות או משנים את עמדת התביעה העיקרית שבולדווין לחץ על ההדק – בניגוד לגרסתו. מומחי בליסטיקה ופורנזיקה מאריזונה וניו מקסיקו הרכיבו מחדש את האקדח בעזרת חלקי חילוף לאחר שנשבר בבדיקות ה-FBI, וקבעו כי יש למשוך או להוריד את ההדק כדי שהאקדח יירה. הדו"ח של לוסיאן האג מ-Forensic Science Services באריזונה קובע שהבדיקות הראו שהיה צורך ללחוץ או להוריד את ההדק כדי לשחרר את הפטיש. דו"ח קודם של ה-FBI מצא שאפשר היה לירות בנשק גם בלי ללחוץ על ההדק אם פטיש לא דרוך נחבט, לדוגמה אם האקדח נפל. החוקרים הצליחו לירות רק במכה עם פטיש כשהפטיש היה במנוחה או בלחיצה על ההדק כשהפטיש דרוך. האקדח נשבר במהלך הבדיקות. חבר המושבעים צריך לקבוע אם יש עילה סבירה להעמיד לדין את בולדווין. נדרש רוב של לפחות שמונה מתוך 12 מושבעים. אם חבר המושבעים לא יחליט על העמדה לדין, לא סביר שתהיה בדיקה מחדש. התובעות קארי מוריסי וג'ייסון לואיס טוענות שישנם פרטים חדשים המצביעים על אחריות פלילית אפשרית של בולדווין במותה של האצ'ינס. עורכי דינו של בולדווין טוענים שמדובר בניסיון העמדה לדין שגוי בעקבות טרגדיה, ומצהירים שיתמודדו עם כל כתב אישום בבית המשפט. במרץ, עוזר הבמאי ואחראי הבטיחות של 'Rust', דיוויד הולס, הודה בהסדר טיעון בטיפול לא בטוח בנשק וקיבל עונש על תנאי של שישה חודשים. הוא הסכים לשתף פעולה עם החוקרים. הכתבה עודכנה כדי להבהיר שחברת ההפקה שזומנה נמצאת בלוס אנג'לס ולא במליבו.

article_content: The popular 'new car smell,' often celebrated by car buyers, actually comes from a mixture of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and other chemicals released from new car interior materials. According to the Ecology Center, some new car models, like the Suzuki Forenza, ranked among the most toxic, containing substances such as arsenic and formaldehyde, which may take years to fully dissipate. Americans spend significant time in their vehicles, making exposure to VOCs from steering wheels, dashboards, seats, and carpets a concern due to their association with both acute and long-term health issues. Despite the importance of indoor air quality, efforts to address it often receive less attention in the context of broader industry challenges, such as fuel efficiency. Automakers in Europe and Japan are actively working to reduce toxic chemicals—particularly for consumers with environmental allergies. Some American manufacturers have made progress as well; for example, General Motors improved its vehicles' air quality by 27% according to the Ecology Center's HealthyCar.org study. The organization tested nearly 300 new cars using portable X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) to detect chemicals like bromine, chlorine, and heavy metals, all linked to health problems ranging from allergies to developmental issues. While the Ecology Center praised models like the Porsche 911, Honda Accord, Dodge Caliber, Saturn Astra XR, Dodge Charger, BMW M5, Toyota Tacoma, and Acura RDX for low toxic content, it identified Suzuki Forenza, Suzuki Reno, Lincoln Mark LT, Mitsubishi Eclipse, and BMW 128i as having higher levels. Interested consumers can research models at HealthyCar.org. However, not all industry stakeholders agree with these findings. Chrysler, for example, labeled the Ecology Center’s methodology as flawed, arguing it measures chemical content in materials, not actual air quality, and described the report as overly alarmist. Chrysler maintains that it regularly evaluates and screens materials for their impact on passenger compartment air quality. The Ecology Center maintains that a significant portion of the population is exposed to harmful chemicals in vehicles, citing peer-reviewed studies. In Europe, allergy-tested cars are increasingly popular, with Ford Europe leading efforts to minimize allergens. Their cars undergo rigorous testing and avoid materials like latex and nickel, and some models incorporate advanced pollen filters certified by independent labs and the European Centre for Allergy Research. Toyota in Japan is also focused on lowering in-vehicle VOCs. Its U.S.-made vehicles strive to meet voluntary Japanese VOC standards, and the company has introduced new materials and adhesives to substantially reduce emissions of formaldehyde and toluene, which are associated with various health risks. For consumers concerned about car odors or air quality, products like the Brookstone ionic auto air purifier offer potential relief. Priced around $35, this device emits negative ions to help eliminate unwanted odors and pollutants. Simple to use, it plugs into a car's cigarette lighter and allows continued device charging. Negative ions may also promote relaxation—an added benefit for stressed drivers.

לדוגמה, ג'נרל מוטורס שיפרה את איכות האוויר הפנימית ב-27% לפי מחקר HealthyCar.org של המרכז לאקולוגיה, שבדק כ-300 דגמי רכב חדשים בעזרת טכנולוגיית XRF לזיהוי כימיקלים מזיקים כמו ברום, כלור ומתכות כבדות, המקושרים לבעיות בריאות. המרכז לאקולוגיה המליץ על דגמים כמו פורשה 911, הונדה אקורד, דודג' קליבר, סאטורן אסטרה XR, דודג' צ'ארג'ר, ב.מ.וו M5, טויוטה טקומה ואקורה RDX בזכות רמות רעילות נמוכות, בעוד שציין את סוזוקי פורנזה, סוזוקי רנו, לינקולן Mark LT, מיצובישי אקליפס וב.מ.וו 128i כבעייתיים יותר. אפשר לבדוק דגמים נוספים באתר HealthyCar.org. עם זאת, לא כל הגורמים בתעשייה מסכימים. קרייזלר, למשל, טענה שמתודולוגיית המרכז לאקולוגיה שגויה כי היא בודקת את החומרים עצמם ולא את איכות האוויר ברכב, וכינתה את הדו"ח מרתיע מדי. קרייזלר אומרת שהיא בוחנת ומסננת חומרים עקב השפעתם על איכות האוויר. המרכז לאקולוגיה מדגיש כי רבים נחשפים לחומרים מזיקים ברכבים, בהתבסס על מחקרים. באירופה רכבים שעברו בדיקות אלרגיה פופולריים, כשפורד אירופה מובילה בבדיקות והפחתת חומרים מחוללי אלרגיה ומוסיפה מסנני אבקה מתקדמים ואישורים מגופים רשמיים. גם טויוטה ביפן פועלת להפחתת VOC, ודגמיה בארה"ב עומדים בתקנים יפניים וולונטריים. החברה מפתחת חומרים חדשים שמפחיתים פליטות פורמלדהיד וטולואן, המקושרים לבעיות בריאות. למי שמוטרדים מריחות או מאיכות האוויר ברכב, מטהר אוויר של Brookstone, במחיר של כ-35 דולר, משתחרר יונים שליליים שמסייעים להיפטר מריחות מזהמים ונח לו לתפעול, עם אפשרות טעינה למכשירים נוספים. יונים שליליים יכולים גם לעזור להרגעה בזמן נהיגה.

article_content: The parents of three British teenagers killed in a devastating coach crash during their gap year in Thailand have called on the UK Foreign Office to strengthen its warnings about the dangers of bus travel in the country. Bruno Melling-Firth, Conrad Quashie, and Max Boomgaarden-Cook, all 19 and from South London, died when their coach made a hazardous u-turn across a six-lane highway, colliding with another bus in the early hours of June 28, 2011. A fourth friend survived with minor injuries. The incident took place shortly after midnight in Khlong Khlung, Kamphaeng Phet Province, as the group traveled from Bangkok to Chiang Mai. At an inquest at Southwark Coroner's Court, it emerged that the teenagers and their families had been unaware of the safety risks associated with bus travel in Thailand. Coroner Dr Andrew Harris stated he would write to the Foreign Office, recommending its travel advice on bus journeys be as comprehensive as its motorcycle warnings. The coroner noted that the students were on a Hino tourist bus, which departed a petrol station and attempted a u-turn, putting it directly in the path of an overtaking bus. The parents expressed concerns that the Foreign Office’s existing online advice focuses on motorcycle risks and does not sufficiently address those posed by buses and coaches. They pointed out that Thai road accident statistics indicate a high level of danger, and suspect that the true figures may be underreported. Following the inquest, Polly Cook, Max’s mother, urged the FCO to bring its advice up to the standards offered by countries like the US, clearly indicating the extreme dangers of road travel in Thailand. The surviving friend, Jack Beagley, recounted that they made their travel arrangements with minimal research and purchased their coach tickets online for just £5-£10. He described the coach as old and lacking seatbelts, with poor conditions. Testimony described how the crash happened swiftly with no chance for the teenagers to react. In addition to the three Britons, a Korean tourist and the driver of the other bus also died in the crash. The driver, Chan Noisri, was reportedly jailed for driving offenses. Gillian Melling, Bruno's mother, said she had assumed buses would be regulated, highlighting the lack of specific warnings for bus travel. She asserted that simply adding a paragraph to the Foreign Office website about unregulated transport could help protect travelers. Coroner Dr Andrew Harris concluded by calling the inquest 'harrowing and tragic,' and reiterated his intention to urge the Foreign Office to increase its warnings about the risks of bus travel in Thailand.

Germany and Argentina are set to compete for the most prestigious prize in world football at the Maracana Stadium, but one individual has already achieved his own victory at the World Cup. Heine Allemagne, 43, the inventor of the 'magic vanishing spray' used in Brazil, stands to gain financially after years of poverty and near bankruptcy. The spray, which temporarily marks the 10-yard gap during free-kicks and disappears within 60 seconds, has been highly effective in preventing defenders from encroaching during set pieces. The Premier League is now considering introducing the spray—a tool already in use in Brazil and Argentina's domestic leagues—into England's top-flight football.

Allemagne described seeing his invention used for the first time at the World Cup as a 'magical moment.' He shared with the Mirror: 'I dedicated 14 years of my life to this idea. After the referee brought it out for the first time, I started receiving texts from my family and friends. It was the first time I got emotional—my eyes filled with tears. I remember thinking, "I’m not crazy. It was all worth it".'

Growing up as one of five siblings in a crowded three-bedroom house in Ituiutaba, a small town between São Paulo and Brasilia, Allemagne recalled, 'We all slept together in one small room. I never had toys and we had few clothes. My parents sent me out to work at eight.'

Now, Allemagne acknowledges he is poised to benefit financially if his innovative spray gains global adoption. 'I hope any financial reward matches my 14 years of struggle. I’ve paid a high price and sacrificed seeing my children grow up to make this work.'

He concluded: 'Most importantly, I hope I’ve contributed to football by providing referees with a tool to maintain order, helping free-kick takers score more goals, and improving the overall experience for everyone involved in the sport.'

Barack Obama’s historic victory in the 2008 presidential election was the result of several significant factors. John McCain, the Republican nominee, began his campaign facing three major obstacles: he followed an extremely unpopular incumbent president, George W. Bush; the nation was experiencing a major economic downturn; and there was widespread dissatisfaction with an ongoing war. McCain’s alliance with Bush to secure his party’s nomination ultimately alienated many independent voters.

The decision to select Sarah Palin as his running mate initially energized the McCain campaign, but she soon became a liability. Meanwhile, Barack Obama’s team used exceptional organizational skills and innovative technology to mobilize an unprecedented number of voters, surpassing Republican efforts at outreach and engagement. For the first time in years, Democrats led in technological and get-out-the-vote initiatives.

A crucial shift in the Democrats’ strategy was their move from focusing primarily on facts and policy papers to inspiring voters emotionally and controlling key campaign narratives. Obama presented himself as a candidate of change while framing McCain as a continuation of Bush’s unpopular presidency. He effectively addressed criticisms about his own experience by remaining calm and steady during economic turmoil and the debates, countering McCain’s attempts to undermine him.

Winning elections involves controlling four central stories: your story, your characterization of your opponent, their characterization of themselves, and their portrayal of you. Obama managed these narratives skillfully, inspiring optimism and channeling voters’ concerns, especially about the economy. Moving forward, President-elect Obama will need to balance the inspirational style that brought him victory with the demands of effective governance. Success as a leader entails not just strong policy but also the ability to communicate, connect, and rally public support.

The opinions expressed in this commentary reflect the views of Drew Westen, professor of psychology and psychiatry at Emory University.

הניצחון ההיסטורי של ברק אובמה בבחירות לנשיאות 2008 היה תוצאה של כמה גורמים משמעותיים. ג'ון מקיין, מועמד הרפובליקנים, פתח את הקמפיין שלו מול שלושה חסרונות עיקריים: הוא הגיע אחרי נשיא מכהן לא פופולרי במיוחד, ג'ורג' וו. בוש; המדינה חוותה משבר כלכלי חריף; והייתה אי שביעות רצון רחבה ממלחמה מתמשכת. הברית של מקיין עם בוש כדי להשיג את מועמדות המפלגה פגעה בפופולריות שלו בקרב הבוחרים העצמאיים.

הבחירה בשרה פיילין לרצה עמו העניקה בתחילה דחיפה לקמפיין שלו, אך בהמשך הפכה לעול. בינתיים, הצוות של ברק אובמה השתמש בכישורי ארגון יוצאי דופן ובטכנולוגיה חדשנית כדי להביא לקלפיות מספר בוחרים חסר תקדים, ועקף בכך את מאמצי הרפובליקנים. לראשונה זה שנים, הדמוקרטים הובילו בתחומי הטכנולוגיה ובמאמצי ההגעה לקלפיות.

שינוי מהותי באסטרטגיה של הדמוקרטים היה המעבר מהתמקדות בעיקר בעובדות ובמדיניות להשראה רגשית ושליטה בנרטיב המרכזי של הקמפיין. אובמה הציג את עצמו כמועמד של שינוי והציג את מקיין כהמשך המדיניות של בוש. הוא השיב לביקורת על ניסיונו בעזרת קור רוח ויציבות בתקופת המשבר הכלכלי ובמהלך העימותים, והצליח לסכל את ניסיונות מקיין לערער עליו.

הצלחה בבחירות נובעת משליטה בארבעה סיפורים מרכזיים: הסיפור שלך, הדרך בה אתה מציג את יריבך, כיצד יריבך מציג את עצמו, ואיך הוא מתאר אותך. אובמה ניהל את כל אלה במיומנות, העניק תקווה והגיב לחששות הציבור, במיוחד בנוגע לכלכלה. קדימה, אובמה יצטרך לאזן בין סגנון ההשראה שהוביל אותו לניצחון לבין הדרישות של מנהיגות יעילה. הצלחה כמנהיג דורשת לא רק מדיניות חזקה אלא גם יכולת לתקשר, להתחבר ולגייס תמיכה ציבורית.

הדעות המובאות בטור זה משקפות את דעתו של דרו וסטן, פרופסור לפסיכולוגיה ופסיכיאטריה באוניברסיטת אמורי.

article_content: Severe winter weather disrupted travel across much of the United States on Wednesday, leading to six deaths in weather-related accidents and forcing the rare postponement of an NBA game. Since Tuesday, six people, including a 1-year-old and a 2-year-old child, have died as a result of dangerous conditions. The young children died in a car accident in Arkansas, according to the state's Department of Emergency Management. Tommy Jackson, an official with the department, also reported that a man was killed in his Saline County home by a fallen tree. In Rayville, Louisiana, a 53-year-old man died when a tree fell on his house, according to Richland Parish Sheriff Lee Harrell. Portions of Indiana saw 6 to 12 inches of snow, with about 350 snowplows clearing roads throughout Indianapolis, according to CNN affiliate WRTV. Plow driver David White commented, "It's pretty bad. You get a lot of drifting out there. That's what's making things difficult right now." Due to the severe weather, the Indiana Pacers postponed their scheduled game against the Chicago Bulls, with a new date yet to be announced. New York Governor Andrew Cuomo advised residents to avoid unnecessary travel: "Winter weather has arrived in many parts of the state, so as a precaution we have activated the emergency operation center to coordinate response efforts using all state and local resources." Cuomo urged New Yorkers to monitor local news for weather updates and adjust travel plans accordingly. The New York State Police closed long sections of Interstate 84 and the Taconic State Parkway for several hours for snow removal. Meanwhile, high winds caused extended delays at airports, including Philadelphia International Airport, where delays exceeded four hours, the longest in the country on Wednesday, according to the Federal Aviation Administration. Several other airports in the Northeast experienced delays of over two hours. CNN meteorologist Alexandra Steele explained that strong wind, rather than snow accumulation, was the primary problem in several major cities, causing heavy rain. In New York, one wind gust reached 31 mph, with the potential for stronger gusts overnight. The storm led airlines to cancel hundreds of flights. Drivers in Pennsylvania navigated icy and snow-covered roads. In Pittsburgh, which experienced its first major snowfall of the season, travelers faced severe delays; one woman reported a normally 30-minute drive took her three hours. Some parts of the Pennsylvania Turnpike had speed limits lowered to 45 mph, and large trucks with empty trailers or two trailers were temporarily barred. A CNN photojournalist described taking 30 minutes to drive two miles along the turnpike from Ohio to Washington, D.C. As people tried to return home, others assessed storm damage that began in the Midwest and moved east. Little Rock, Arkansas, saw a rare white Christmas, with nine inches of snow breaking an 86-year-old December 25 record. In Mississippi, over 25 storm-related injuries were reported, and approximately 70 homes sustained damage, mostly in the state's southern region. No fatalities were reported. Governor Phil Bryant declared a state of emergency for several affected counties to expedite assistance. At least eight counties reported damage and injuries. Arkansas Governor Mike Beebe declared a statewide disaster. John Kilcullen, operations director for emergency management in Mobile, Alabama, stated, "Our main priority is focused on recovery." The National Weather Service gave a preliminary EF2 rating to a tornado that struck downtown Mobile on Christmas Day. Additional EF2 tornadoes affected Alabama's Choctaw County and Mississippi's Stone, Lawrence, and Jones counties, with wind speeds between 111 mph and 135 mph. An EF3 tornado, with even stronger winds, struck Pearl River County in Mississippi. CNN reporters Devon Sayers, Chuck Johnston, Carma Hassan, Todd Sperry, Jeremy Moorhead, Mariano Castillo, Joe Sutton, and David Close contributed to this story.
translated_content: מזג אוויר חורפי חריג שיבש את התנועה ברחבי ארצות הברית ביום רביעי, גרם למותם של שישה בני אדם בתאונות הקשורות למזג האוויר והוביל לדחייה נדירה של משחק NBA. מאז יום שלישי נהרגו שישה אנשים, כולל ילד בן שנה וילדה בת שנתיים, כתוצאה מתנאים מסוכנים. הילדים נהרגו בתאונת דרכים בארקנסו, כך נמסר ממחלקת ניהול החירום של המדינה. טומי ג'קסון, בכיר במחלקה, דיווח גם כי גבר נהרג בביתו במחוז סלין מנפילת עץ. בעיר ריוויל, לואיזיאנה, נהרג גבר בן 53 כאשר עץ קרס על ביתו, לפי השריף לי הרל ממחוז ריצ'לנד. באזורים מסוימים באינדיאנה נרשמו 15-30 סנטימטרים של שלג, וכ-350 מפלסות שלג פעלו לפינוי הדרכים באינדיאנפוליס, לפי סניף CNN המקומי WRTV. נהג הפלס, דייוויד ווייט, אמר: "המצב קשה. יש הרבה שלגים נסחפים וזה מה שמקשה עלינו כרגע." בעקבות מזג האוויר החריג, משחק אינדיאנה פייסרס מול שיקגו בולס נדחה, ותאריך חדש טרם פורסם. מושל מדינת ניו יורק, אנדרו קוומו, המליץ לתושבים להימנע מנסיעות שאינן חיוניות: "מזג אוויר חורפי הגיע לחלקים רבים של המדינה, ולכן הפעַלנו את מרכז החירום לתיאום המאמצים באמצעות כל המשאבים של המדינה והרשויות המקומיות." קוומו קרא לתושבי ניו יורק לעקוב אחרי מהדורות החדשות ולהתאים את תוכניות הנסיעה בהתאם. המשטרה סגרה למספר שעות קטעים ארוכים של כביש I-84 ושל כביש טאקוניק, לצורך פינוי שלגים. הרוחות החזקות גרמו לעיכובים ממושכים בשדות תעופה, כולל שדה התעופה הבין-לאומי בפילדלפיה, שם נרשמו עיכובים של למעלה מארבע שעות – הארוכים בארץ באותו יום, לפי מנהל התעופה הפדרלית. שדות תעופה נוספים בצפון-מזרח ארה"ב חוו עיכובים של למעלה משעתיים. המטאורולוגית של CNN, אלכסנדרה סטיל, הסבירה כי הבעיה המרכזית הייתה הרוחות, ולא הצטברות שלגים, כשערים מרכזיות רבות סבלו מגשמים חזקים. בניו יורק נמדדה משב רוח של 50 קמ"ש, עם אפשרות למשבים חזקים אף יותר בהמשך הלילה. בעקבות הסופה בוטלו מאות טיסות. נהגים בפנסילבניה התמודדו עם כבישים מכוסים בקרח ושלג. בפיטסבורג, שזכתה לשלג משמעותי ראשון העונה, הנוסעים התעכבו קשות; אישה אחת סיפרה כי נסיעה שבדרך כלל אורכת 30 דקות נמשכה לה שלוש שעות. קטעים בכביש המהיר של פנסילבניה הותאמו למהירות מירבית של 72 קמ"ש, וכלי רכב גדולים עם נגרר ריק או שני נגררים נאסרו זמנית. צלם של CNN תיאר כי נסיעה של שלושה קילומטרים ארכה 30 דקות לאורך הכביש מ-אוהיו לוושינגטון די.סי. בעת שאנשים ניסו לחזור הביתה, אחרים העריכו את נזקי הסופה שהחלה במערב התיכון והמשיכה מזרחה. בליטל רוק, ארקנסו, נחוו חג מולד לבן נדיר, כשנמדדו 23 סנטימטרים של שלג – שיא ל-25 בדצמבר שלא נשבר 86 שנים. במדינת מיסיסיפי דווח על יותר מ-25 פצועים מהסופה וכ-70 בתים שנפגעו, רובם בדרום המדינה. לא דווח על הרוגים. המושל פיל בראיינט הכריז על מצב חירום בכמה מחוזות שנפגעו להאיץ מתן סיוע. לפחות שמונה מחוזות דיווחו על נזקים ופגיעות. מושל ארקנסו, מייק ביבי, הכריז על מצב חירום ברחבי המדינה. ג'ון קילקולן, מנהל אגף מבצעים בניהול החירום במוביל, אלבמה, אמר: "העדיפות שלנו היא להתמקד בשיקום." שירות מזג האוויר הלאומי העניק דירוג ראשוני של EF2 לטורנדו שפגע במרכז העיר מוביל ביום חג המולד. טורנדו נוספים בדרגת EF2 פגעו במחוז צ'וקטו שבאלבמה ובמחוזות סטון, לורנס וג'ונס שבמיסיסיפי, כשעוצמת הרוחות נמדדה בין 179 ל-217 קמ"ש. טורנדו עוצמתי עוד יותר בדרגת EF3 פגע במחוז פרל ריבר במיסיסיפי. כתבי CNN דבון סיירס, צ'אק ג'ונסטון, קרמה חסן, טוד ספרי, ג'רמי מורהאד, מריאנו קסטיו, ג'ו סאטון ודייויד קלוז השתתפו בדיווח.
