Defence Secretary Grant Shapps has stated that Home Secretary Suella Braverman's remarks on migration are not comparable to Enoch Powell's infamous 1968 'Rivers of Blood' speech. Shapps defended Braverman after she said that the UK faces a 'hurricane' of mass migration, describing her point as 'correct.' Delivering a speech at the Conservative Party conference, Braverman argued that politicians have been 'too squeamish' to tackle immigration issues. She contrasted current migration trends with those of her parents, who moved to the UK from Kenya and Mauritius in the 1960s, saying, 'The wind of change that carried my own parents across the globe in the 20th Century was a mere gust compared to the hurricane that is coming.'

Braverman's speech has attracted criticism and prompted comparisons to Powell’s anti-immigration rhetoric. Former Labour leader Jeremy Corbyn accused Braverman of sounding 'like Enoch Powell.' Andrew Boff, a Conservative London Assembly member, was removed from the conference venue after protesting that Braverman’s remarks were 'transphobic and homophobic.' Green Party MP Caroline Lucas described the speech as 'utterly repulsive.' UN Human Rights Commissioner Volker Türk cautioned against 'stoking fears, devaluing others, and dividing society,' calling such tactics 'the politics of distraction.'

Following the speech, Business Secretary Kemi Badenoch said at a Spectator event that politicians must discuss immigration policies carefully to avoid evoking 'less palatable' associations. Cabinet minister Michelle Donelan also chose not to echo Braverman's language, telling BBC Newsnight that while she acknowledges issues, 'my language is different to her language.'

Shapps insisted that Braverman’s speech was 'certainly no Enoch Powell situation,' noting Braverman's own heritage and her parents’ migration to the UK. 'She makes the absolutely correct point—we’ve already seen a lot of movement,' he told Times Radio. 'We could see a lot more—a hurricane, as she describes it, of people moving.'

Powell’s 1968 'Rivers of Blood' speech—delivered just before the second reading of the Race Relations Bill—referenced concerns from his constituents about the impact of immigration. The speech, which included inflammatory language, led to Powell's dismissal from the shadow cabinet. The subsequent Race Relations Act made it illegal to deny housing, employment, or public services based on ethnicity.

article_content: On November 22, 1963, Secret Service agent Clint Hill rushed to protect President John F. Kennedy and First Lady Jacqueline Kennedy just moments after the president was shot in Dallas. The image of Hill leaping onto the presidential limousine became an enduring symbol of those tragic days.  The Kennedy assassination left the country in shock and produced unforgettable moments, such as Lyndon B. Johnson’s swearing-in on Air Force One and young John F. Kennedy Jr. saluting his father’s casket. Yet, it is the photo of Hill’s desperate attempt to shield the president and first lady that continues to resonate.  This year, the nation marks the 60th anniversary of that pivotal day. Clint Hill, now 91, reflects on the impact those six seconds in Dallas had on his life. 'Before Dallas, I was just Clint Hill. Ever since, I've been known as the man who climbed onto the president's car,' he shared with Radio Diaries. 'It's not easy to live with.'  Assigned to protect Jacqueline Kennedy in 1960, Hill observed that the Kennedys were personally engaged with their security team in ways previous presidents hadn’t been. President Kennedy knew agents by name, asked about their families, and was genuinely personable, according to Hill.  On the day of the assassination, Dallas crowds lined the streets to catch a glimpse of the presidential couple. As the motorcade made its way through Dealey Plaza, a sudden noise—initially mistaken by Hill for something harmless—erupted. But Kennedy’s reaction made clear something was terribly wrong.  Hill sprang into action from the follow-up car. As he climbed onto the limousine, another shot hit Kennedy. Jacqueline Kennedy crawled onto the rear of the vehicle, meeting Hill, who guided her back into the seat and shielded the couple as the car sped to the hospital.  Hill immediately recognized the severity of the president’s injuries and doubted his survival. In the days that followed, Hill grappled with overwhelming guilt. He escorted Jacqueline Kennedy, still in her bloodstained clothing, to Johnson’s swearing-in. He later described the emotional burden in his memoir, 'Five Days in November,' recalling her hollow, tear-stained face and his own sense of failing to protect them.  Guilt and trauma persisted for Hill for years. After completing his detail with Jacqueline Kennedy, he continued serving other presidents but struggled internally. The Secret Service offered no counseling or support for what would now be recognized as PTSD. By 1975, health issues forced Hill into early retirement at age 43, and he battled depression and addiction.  Hill rarely discussed the incident publicly until a 1975 interview with Mike Wallace on '60 Minutes,' where he expressed regret, believing he could have acted faster. Despite being called a hero, Hill was uncomfortable with the label.  Over time, however, he has opened up more, authoring books with his wife, Lisa McCubbin Hill, and recently releasing a 60th-anniversary edition of 'Five Days in November.' He encourages others dealing with trauma to talk about their experiences, believing it can help heal.  Hill’s story highlights both the historic and deeply personal consequences of that day in Dallas, and serves as a reminder of the importance of open conversations about mental health.
translated_content: ב-22 בנובמבר 1963, סוכן השירות החשאי קלינט היל מיהר להגן על הנשיא ג'ון פ. קנדי ועל רעייתו, ג'קלין, רגעים לאחר שנורה הנשיא בדאלאס. התמונה של היל קופץ על הלימוזינה הנשיאותית הפכה לסמל בלתי נשכח של אותם ימים טראגיים.  רצח קנדי זעזע את המדינה והותיר רגעים בלתי נשכחים, כמו השבעת לינדון ג'ונסון על סיפון אייר פורס 1 והצדעה של ג'ון פ. קנדי ג'וניור בן ה-3 לארונו של אביו. אך התמונה של היל מנסה באופן נואש להגן על הנשיא והגברת הראשונה ממשיכה לרגש רבים.  השנה מציינים 60 שנה לאותו יום גורלי. קלינט היל, כיום בן 91, מתבונן לאחור על ששת השניות בדאלאס אשר עיצבו את חייו. 'לפני דאלאס הייתי סתם קלינט היל. מאז, אני האיש שטיפס על רכב הנשיא,' סיפר לרדיו דייריס. 'קשה לחיות עם זה.'  כשהוצב להגנה על ג'קלין קנדי ב-1960, היל שם לב שהמשפחה הנשיאותית שונה מהקודמות – קנדי הכיר את שמות הסוכנים, התעניין במשפחותיהם, והפגין יחס אישי.  ביום הרצח, הקהל בדאלאס הצטופף לאורך הרחובות לראות את הנשיא ורעייתו. כאשר השיירה עברה בדילי פלאזה, נשמע רעש פתאומי – אותו היל פירש תחילה כזיקוק – אך התגובה של הנשיא הובהירה שמדובר במשהו חמור.  היל זינק מרכב הליווי, טיפס על הלימוזינה, ושנייה לאחר מכן נורה קנדי שוב. ג'קלין קנדי טיפסה אל החלק האחורי של הרכב והיל החזיר אותה פנימה, מגונן על השניים בזמן שהרכב האיץ לבית החולים.  היל הבין מיד את חומרת הפציעות של הנשיא וחשש לסיכוייו לשרוד. בימים שלאחר מכן נאבק היל ברגשות אשמה קשים. הוא ליווה את ג'קלין קנדי, לבושה עדיין בבגדיה המוכתמים בדם, להשבעת ג'ונסון. בזיכרונותיו, 'חמישה ימים בנובמבר', הוא מתאר את מבטה הכבוי והעצוב של ג'קלין ואת התחושה האישית שנכשל להגן עליהם.  תחושות האשם והטראומה נמשכו שנים. לאחר שסיים את שירותו עם ג'קלין קנדי, נותר היל בשירות ונאבק בנפשו. השירות החשאי לא הציע תמיכה נפשית – מה שהיום מוכר כהפרעת דחק פוסט טראומטית. עד 1975, מצבו הבריאותי אילץ אותו לפרוש בגיל 43, וסבל מדיכאון והתמכרויות.  היל כמעט ולא דיבר בפומבי על האירוע עד לראיון ב-1975 בתוכנית '60 דקות', שם הביע חרטה והאמין שיכל לפעול מהר יותר. למרות שקראו לו גיבור, היל לא נוח עם התואר הזה.  עם השנים הפך פתוח יותר, כתב ספרים יחד עם אשתו ליסה מקאבין היל, ועתה פרסם מהדורת 60 שנה ל'חמישה ימים בנובמבר'. הוא מעודד אנשים הסובלים מטראומה לשתף ולשוחח – מתוך אמונה שזה מסייע להחלמה.  סיפורו של היל ממחיש את ההשלכות ההיסטוריות והאישיות של אותו יום בדאלאס, ומדגיש את החשיבות של שיח פתוח על בריאות הנפש.

On Sunday evening, St. Cloud, Florida police initiated an urgent search after security footage appeared to show a woman being forcibly led from the emergency room of St. Cloud Regional Medical Center by a man. The woman, seeming upset, was seen entering the ER before being taken by her arm and placed into a Saturn SUV that quickly left the scene. Witness reports and the footage caused police to issue a missing person alert with descriptions of both individuals involved. 

The investigation soon revealed, however, that the situation had been misunderstood. Police reached the woman, who said she had been drinking and confirmed there was no crime. She explained she was at the hospital to help her boyfriend after his accident, but he refused medical care and chose to leave with her. 

Authorities have now closed the missing person case, having reclassified it as a suspicious incident, clarifying that there was no abduction or crime.

Senator Tommy Tuberville is maintaining his hold on military promotions despite the recent outbreak of war in Israel. According to a spokesperson, Tuberville will continue blocking promotions until the Pentagon revises its abortion policy. The policy, updated in 2022, allows service members to be reimbursed for traveling out of state to obtain abortion services, which prompted Tuberville to begin his blockade in February 2023.

Normally, military promotions are confirmed in bulk by unanimous consent in the Senate. Tuberville's refusal prevents this, requiring individual votes on each nomination. As a result, more than 300 military nominees, including several slated for key roles in the Middle East, remain unconfirmed.

This slow pace has raised concerns, particularly following the recent Hamas attack in Israel that left hundreds dead. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has declared the country is at war. Senate Armed Services Chair Jack Reed criticized Tuberville's blockade, stating it hinders the U.S. military's ability to respond to crises. Currently, the Senate is in recess, making quick confirmation votes unlikely—an issue as the situation in Israel escalates.

article_content: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire has been granted a 12A rating by UK film censors, meaning children under 12 may watch the film if accompanied by an adult. This decision has drawn criticism from some quarters, with campaigners expressing concern that the film glamorizes violence and subjects a young audience to unnecessarily graphic scenes. Set in a dystopian future North America, the film is the second adaptation of Suzanne Collins' bestselling Hunger Games book trilogy. It follows Katniss Everdeen, played by 23-year-old Jennifer Lawrence, as she returns to the deadly arena and faces harrowing challenges, including public executions and violent beatings. Notable scenes include a character being whipped, his bloodied back revealed, and an elderly man publicly executed. The story examines life under a totalitarian regime that forces young people from each district to participate in a televised fight to the death. The first Hunger Games movie, released in the UK in March 2012, earned £5 million during its opening weekend, outperforming the debut of the Twilight Saga. Critics argue that the new film's flexible 12A rating fails to protect children from disturbing content. Vivienne Pattison of Mediawatch contends that, because the film stems from a book aimed at children, its violent imagery is particularly troubling. She highlights the distinction between reading about violence and visually experiencing it on screen. Pattison also points out that the guidance provided by the 12A rating is limited, allowing very young children to attend if accompanied by an adult. She argues this could glamorize violence in the eyes of impressionable viewers. Prior to the release of the first Hunger Games film, edits were required to achieve a 12A rating. A later DVD release of an uncut international version carried a stricter 15 rating due to strong violence and threat. However, Catching Fire has passed uncut through the British Board of Film Classification (BBFC), which cites ‘moderate violence and threat and infrequent strong language’ in its report. Pippa Smith from Safer Media asserts that the film industry places too much responsibility on parents by offering vague guidelines, and calls for stricter classification standards. In response, a BBFC spokesperson urges parents to consult its website for guidance. The BBFC maintains that 12A-rated films are considered suitable for children aged 12 and over, and recommends caution if taking younger children.

article_content: For the first time in American history, the sitting Speaker of the House, California Republican Kevin McCarthy, has been voted out of office—an action that required eight members of his own party to join with Democrats to remove him. The Republican members of the House who voted to oust McCarthy include Andy Biggs, Eli Crane, Matt Gaetz, Bob Good, and Matt Rosendale. McCarthy's ascent to the Speakership earlier this year was tumultuous, with the House holding a record 15 ballots before he secured the necessary votes, after making procedural concessions to his fellow Republicans. These concessions would later contribute to his removal. Five of the Republicans who delayed McCarthy’s appointment to the Speakership later aligned with House Democrats to force him out, with Gaetz leading the effort. Yesterday, Gaetz formally introduced the motion to vacate the Office of the Speaker, following through on earlier threats. McCarthy has argued that Gaetz’s move was in retaliation for an ongoing House Committee inquiry into allegations of sexual misconduct and misuse of funds involving Gaetz.

article_content: Everton's Ukrainian left-back, Vitaliy Mykolenko, has emerged as an unexpected goal scorer in the 2023/24 Premier League season. While he began the campaign on the bench, Mykolenko has now started Everton’s last eight matches. In the most recent two games, he scored against Brighton at home and Crystal Palace away, marking his second and third goals for the club—his first at Goodison Park. Thanks to these recent goals, only Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Abdoulaye Doucouré have scored more for Everton this season. This marks an impressive run of form for the 24-year-old, who joined Everton as a promising full-back from Dynamo Kyiv in January 2022. Typically, players from leagues like Ukraine's (ranked 17th in UEFA's coefficient) move to intermediate European clubs before reaching the Premier League. However, Everton signed Mykolenko directly, possibly motivated by the club’s financial situation—to avoid additional fees and perhaps gain from a future transfer if the gamble succeeds. Mykolenko arrived at a difficult time, facing personal challenges related to the war in Ukraine and his father's involvement, while Everton was grappling with relegation battles and instability. He was immediately tasked with adjusting to Premier League standards to help the club survive at the end of both the 2021/22 and 2022/23 seasons. Under Sean Dyche’s management in 2023/24, Everton appears more organized, with Mykolenko playing a significant role in the team’s resurgence. Dyche has implemented a consistent 4-4-1-1 or 4-4-2 formation, which requires wide players—such as Dwight McNeil on the left—to balance attacking and defensive duties. This structure has boosted Mykolenko’s performance, allowing him to support McNeil and contribute in both attack and defense. The tactical setup lets Mykolenko push forward along the flank or move centrally when opportunities arise, especially when play shifts to the right side. This season, he’s already taken nine shots—nearly matching his total from all of last season. Notably, a shot against Palace hit the post and led to a goal for Doucouré. Mykolenko’s attacking stats have improved, averaging 1.29 touches in the opposition box per 90 minutes, compared to 0.88 last season. Data from FBref shows he’s a solid defensive full-back but still developing his creativity and link-up play in attack. He has yet to record an assist for Everton, which is somewhat unusual for a full-back, particularly as he replaced the creative Lucas Digne. However, this season there are signs he poses a greater goal threat, and chances for assists may come. Manager Sean Dyche praised Mykolenko, calling him a 'goal machine' after the Palace match and highlighting another near-miss that set up a teammate's goal. According to WhoScored analytics, attacking down the left and taking many shots are key features of Everton’s playing style this season, leading to active roles for both Mykolenko and McNeil. While it’s too early to claim Everton’s problems are behind them or to expect Mykolenko to maintain his scoring pace, there are promising signs. The team now has a clearer structure and vision, with Mykolenko proving to be a valuable part of Sean Dyche’s evolving system—where his strong defense sets the foundation and goals are a welcome bonus.

article_content: Chinese President Xi Jinping told US President Joe Biden during their four-hour meeting on Wednesday that Taiwan is the most significant and potentially dangerous issue in US-China relations, according to a senior US official. The official reported that Xi expressed China’s preference for peaceful reunification with Taiwan, which China claims as its own, but also spoke about possible scenarios where force could be used. Xi sought to clarify that China is not actively preparing for a large-scale invasion of Taiwan, though this does not change the United States' policy, the official noted. After the meeting, President Biden said the two leaders agreed to resume military communications, aiming for better coordination between the US and China. Biden affirmed the US commitment to maintaining peace and stability in the region, reiterating longstanding US policy. Xi emphasized that while peace is valued, a resolution to the Taiwan question will ultimately be necessary. This was the first meeting in a year between Biden and Xi, focused on reducing tensions over military conflicts, drug trafficking, and artificial intelligence. Both leaders said real progress was made. China has increased military maneuvers near Taiwan to assert sovereignty, actions strongly opposed by the government in Taipei. Senior US military officials have stated that Xi has asked the People’s Liberation Army to be ready for a possible invasion of Taiwan by 2027, though Beijing has not given details or ruled out using force.

article_content: The UK government is preparing to launch a significant expansion of free childcare for two-year-olds, aiming to help more families access early education. Chancellor George Osborne is set to announce an increase of £380 million a year in funding by 2014-15, doubling the number of eligible two-year-olds for free nursery care. The initiative is focused on reaching disadvantaged children, with the goal of reducing early developmental gaps before they start school. Previously, free nursery education was guaranteed for all three and four-year-olds. Now, the government is extending this support to include more two-year-olds, particularly those from low-income families. Currently, only about 28% of two-year-olds in the poorest households have formal early education, compared to 72% in the wealthiest. The expansion will increase access to 15 hours of free childcare each week for 260,000 children—up from 20,000 in 2010—covering approximately 40% of two-year-olds. In addition, Mr. Osborne is expected to announce reductions in working tax credits, which are a source of financial assistance for low-earning families. While some people criticize this move, arguing young children should spend more time at home, government ministers contend that economic circumstances require many mothers to work and need childcare options. Work and Pensions Secretary Iain Duncan Smith advocates for increased government involvement in children’s early lives, highlighting the benefit of parenting support and early intervention. He points to studies showing that development by age two can predict future academic success and that parental engagement raises the chances of children moving out of poverty. Separately, the government plans to accelerate raising the state pension age to 67, earlier than previously scheduled, due to the country's ageing population and financial pressures. An announcement is expected in the coming week.

Historical police mugshots from Bath, England, dating between 1892 and 1922, have been released online by the Bath & North East Somerset Council's Record Office. These photographs, originally compiled to help police identify and monitor offenders, include details such as age, physical appearance, and the nature of each crime. Among the collection is the peculiar mugshot of Frank Albert Smith, charged with embezzlement in 1894, who was photographed wearing a suit of knight's armour—though it remains a mystery why he chose this attire.

The records also reference other notable individuals, including Alfred Mitchell, a mining engineer, and Cyril Dudley Vincent, a music-hall artist, both convicted of fraud, as well as Samuel Zucker, who went by the aliases Edward Von Dalwick and Baron Jules Mercy. Another case is Oliver Love, who, according to police records from 1911, was repeatedly convicted for the theft of items such as ducks, boots, and an umbrella, and sentenced to several months' hard labor.

The archive offers a unique glimpse into the city's criminal past, highlighting that individuals with respectable appearances could be skilled at deception. Principal archivist Colin Johnston commented that many people researching family history are particularly interested in uncovering 'black sheep' in their ancestry and hopes this new digital resource will prove popular with those interested in Bath's social history.

הרשומות מתייחסות גם לדמויות נוספות, ביניהן אלפרד מיטשל, מהנדס מכרות, וסיריל דאדלי וינסנט, אמן במה, ששניהם הורשעו בהונאה, וכן לסמואל צוקר, שפעל גם תחת השמות אדוארד פון דאלוויק וברון ז'ולס מרסי. דמות נוספת היא אוליבר לאב, שלפי רישומי המשטרה מ-1911 הורשע שוב ושוב בגניבת ברווזים, מגפיים ומטריה, ונידון לחודשי עבודת פרך בכלא.

article_content: The Crown Princess cruise ship is bringing passengers home early after a second outbreak of gastrointestinal illness on its Caribbean voyage. During this trip, about 114 guests and 60 crew members fell ill, according to Princess Cruises. Nearly 400 people were sick on the previous sailing. The ship is returning to Fort Lauderdale, Florida, two days ahead of schedule for two days of intensive cleaning, the company stated. Princess Cruises has apologized for cutting the trip short, describing the situation as highly unusual. The cruise line will fully refund passengers, arrange flights and cover any change fees if flights weren’t booked through them, provide hotel accommodations if needed, and issue a 25% future cruise credit. Health officials suspect norovirus, and Princess Cruises is collaborating with the CDC's Vessel Sanitation Program. According to the CDC, norovirus typically causes symptoms such as vomiting, diarrhea, and stomach pain, and spreads through contaminated food, water, or surfaces. The ship will undergo enhanced cleaning procedures that include sanitizing all public spaces, furnishings, carpets, railings, and door handles. Each stateroom will be cleaned thoroughly more than once before new guests board. The next cruise is still scheduled to depart Saturday. Meanwhile, another Princess Cruises vessel, the Ruby Princess, recently reported a similar outbreak affecting more than 100 people.

article_content: Suryakumar Yadav will need to set aside the disappointment of India’s recent World Cup final defeat as he leads a talented group of young players against a strong Australian team in a five-match T20 International series beginning Thursday. With just 96 hours between the World Cup final and the start of this series, Suryakumar (‘SKY’) has little time to reflect as he returns to his preferred T20 format. As captain, he will aim to win the series and assess promising young Indian T20 players vying for spots at next year’s ICC T20 World Cup in the USA and West Indies. India’s young squad features Yashasvi Jaiswal, Rinku Singh, Tilak Varma, Jitesh Sharma, and Mukesh Kumar, all of whom have made their international debuts recently. Their first significant test comes against Australia’s formidable T20 side, which includes World Cup stars like Travis Head, Glenn Maxwell, Adam Zampa, and former captain Steve Smith. Other notable Australian players include Marcus Stoinis, Nathan Ellis, and Tim David. Despite missing some frontline pacers, the squad remains strong under the captaincy of Matthew Wade. Match details: The first India vs Australia T20 will take place on November 23 (Thursday) at the Dr YS Rajasekhara Reddy ACA-VDCA Cricket Stadium in Visakhapatnam. The toss is scheduled for 6:30 PM IST, with the match beginning at 7:00 PM IST. Broadcast: Sports 18 will telecast the match live in India, and Jio Cinema will offer free live streaming. India squad: Suryakumar Yadav (C), Ruturaj Gaikwad (VC), Ishan Kishan, Yashasvi Jaiswal, Tilak Varma, Rinku Singh, Jitesh Sharma (wk), Washington Sundar, Axar Patel, Shivam Dubey, Ravi Bishnoi, Arshdeep Singh, Prasidh Krishna, Avesh Khan, Mukesh Kumar. article_content: Mike Tindall, former England rugby player and husband to Zara Phillips (Queen Elizabeth II’s granddaughter), is set to appear alongside other celebrities in Channel 4’s reality ski competition, The Jump. While the decision surprised many given Tindall's royal connections, he insists that he and Zara independently decide how to live their lives, without interference from palace protocol. Tindall emphasized during a recent interview that he and his wife prioritize their own choices rather than royal expectations, even though public perceptions often link their actions back to the family. Having been prevented from skiing throughout his rugby career to avoid injury, Tindall now sees The Jump as his first opportunity to combine his interest in skiing with a media project. He also addressed his controversial 2011 Rugby World Cup incident, where he was recorded kissing his ex-girlfriend. While the episode caused media scrutiny and upset, Tindall maintains he doesn’t regret enjoying time with teammates, though he acknowledged he would have preferred to avoid the aftermath. Despite the risks highlighted by the injury-related withdrawals of two contestants already, Tindall remains positive about The Jump. After consulting Olympic rower Sir Steve Redgrave—who recommended taking part—Tindall felt reassured about joining the competition. The Jump, beginning January 1 and presented by Davina McCall, features a cast of 16 celebrities, including Heather Mills, Lady Victoria Hervey, and Chloe Madeley. For Tindall, it is both a return to skiing and a chance to embrace competition off the rugby field.

article_content: Ukraine is using a variety of drones in its fight against Russia, ranging from low-cost, disposable units to advanced, more expensive models. Among these is the domestically built R18 octocopter, which costs about $100,000. Reports indicate this drone has been successful in eliminating Russian tanks and artillery, sometimes during night operations. Equipped with thermal imaging and the ability to drop munitions, the R18 has made a notable impact on the battlefield. A drone operator dubbed 'Sunset' from the 24th Separate Mechanized Brigade told CBS News that their unit has used R18 drones to destroy ten Russian tanks in recent months. The destroyed tanks, including Soviet-designed T-72s and newer T-80s and T-90s, are considerably more expensive than the drones themselves. The brigade has operated these drones since May, with reports stating they're most effective at night. While drone losses were not specified by 'Sunset,' Ukrainian officials and researchers have estimated between 40–45 drone losses daily, and up to 10,000 monthly. These figures may include both advanced systems and expendable attack drones. Unit commander 'Hasan' explained to CBS News that their drone operations have destroyed $40 million of Russian hardware in the past month. He also shared plans to increase the brigade's force to about 100 soldiers and to expand their drone resources. Alongside the R18, Ukraine is widely deploying inexpensive drones, costing around $400 each and modified to carry explosives like anti-tank grenades. These have become a mainstay of Ukraine’s efforts against Russian armored vehicles. Both sides are making extensive use of drones capable of carrying explosives. Ukraine's Minister of Digital Transformation, Mykhailo Fedorov, underscored the country's dedication to creating an 'army of drones,' with thousands of units deployed and nearly 2,000 advanced, AI-equipped drones being sent to the conflict. These new drones can automatically identify and track potential targets. Fedorov noted via social media that improved data contributes to more effective drone strikes, reflecting Ukraine’s ongoing advances in drone technology.
translated_content: אוקראינה עושה שימוש במגוון רחפנים במסגרת הלחימה נגד רוסיה – החל מדגמים זולים וחד-פעמיים ועד מערכות מתקדמות ויקרות יותר. אחד הרחפנים הבולטים הוא R18 מתוצרת מקומית, שמחירו כ-100,000 דולר. לפי דיווחים, רחפן זה הצליח להשמיד טנקים וארטילריה רוסיים, לעיתים גם בלילה, בזכות מערכת הדמיה תרמית ויכולת להפציץ בצורה מדויקת. article_content: Senator John McCain said on Sunday that he would not automatically support his former running mate, Sarah Palin, if she chooses to run for president. Speaking on ABC's 'This Week,' McCain was asked if Alaska Governor Sarah Palin could count on his backing. 'I can't say something like that. We have some great young governors. I think you'll see the governors assume a greater leadership role in our Republican Party,' he responded, mentioning Governors Tim Pawlenty of Minnesota and Jon Huntsman of Utah. McCain stated that he has great appreciation for Governor Palin and her family, and that it was a joy to know them. He noted that Palin invigorated their campaign against Barack Obama. When pressed on why he could not commit to supporting her presidential ambitions, McCain said, 'Have no doubt of my admiration for her and my view of her viability, but at this stage, again ... my corpse is still warm, you know?' In his first Sunday political interview since the November 4 election, McCain pledged to work on building consensus to tackle the country's challenges and criticized his party's latest attack on Obama. McCain dismissed Republican National Committee complaints that Obama had not been transparent about his contacts with Illinois Governor Rod Blagojevich. 'I think the Obama campaign should and will give all information necessary,' he stated. 'With all due respect to the Republican National Committee and anybody else – right now, I think we should be working constructively together, not just on this issue, but on the economy, the stimulus package, and necessary reforms.' His comments were in response to a question about RNC Chairman Mike Duncan. The RNC had also released an online ad last week suggesting Obama was not providing enough information about possible connections between his associates and Blagojevich. Blagojevich was arrested Tuesday and charged with attempting to trade Obama's Senate seat for campaign contributions and other favors. McCain said he did not know all the details about the relationship between Obama's campaign and Governor Blagojevich, but was confident that all information would be disclosed. He, like many lawmakers, believes Blagojevich should resign. Despite the heated nature of the presidential race, McCain said he plans to focus on moving lawmakers beyond partisan politics. 'My job is to be a part of, and hopefully help lead, the loyal opposition. But I emphasize the word loyal,' he said. 'We haven't seen economic times like this in my lifetime. We haven't faced such complex challenges abroad since the end of the Cold War, perhaps even more so in some ways. The nation wants us to unite and work together.' McCain did not comment on whether he thought he might have won the presidency if it weren't for the Bush administration's perceived responsibility for economic problems. He said he would leave that judgment to others, noting that his poll numbers dropped along with the stock market. He concluded that moving on from defeat is key: 'Get busy and move on. That's the best cure. I spent time feeling sorry for myself; it's an oddly enjoyable experience, but you've got to move forward. I am still a senator from Arizona, and it remains an honor to serve this country.'
translated_content: הסנאטור ג'ון מקיין אמר ביום ראשון כי לא יתמוך אוטומטית בשותפתו לשעבר למרוץ, שרה פיילין, אם תבחר להתמודד על הנשיאות. בראיון ל-'This Week' של ABC, מקיין נשאל אם מושלת אלסקה שרה פיילין יכולה לסמוך על תמיכתו. 'אני לא יכול לומר דבר כזה. יש לנו מושלים צעירים נהדרים. אני חושב שתראו את המושלים לוקחים תפקיד מנהיגותי גדול יותר במפלגה הרפובליקנית שלנו', ציין, והזכיר את טים פולנטי ממינסוטה ואת ג'ון האנטסמן מיוטה. מקיין הדגיש את הערכתו הרבה למושלת פיילין ולמשפחתה, וציין שהיה שמח להכיר אותם. הוא אמר שפיילין הכניסה אנרגיה למערכת הבחירות שלהם נגד ברק אובמה. כאשר נשאל מדוע אינו מבטיח לתמוך בשאיפותיה הפוליטיות, אמר: 'אין ספק בהערכתי אליה וביכולת שלה, אבל בשלב זה... הגופה שלי עדיין חמה, אתה מבין?' בראיון הראשון שלו מאז ה-4 בנובמבר, התחייב מקיין לפעול לבניית הסכמה להתמודדות עם אתגרי המדינה, וביקר את מפלגתו על ההתקפה אחרונה נגד אובמה. מקיין דחה את טענות הוועדה הרפובליקנית כי אובמה אינו שקוף בקשריו עם מושל אילינוי רוד בלאגוייביץ'. 'אני חושב שקמפיין אובמה צריך וייתן את כל המידע הדרוש', אמר. 'עם כל הכבוד לוועדה הרפובליקנית ולכל אחד אחר – כעת עלינו לעבוד ביחד בצורה בונה, לא רק בנוגע לנושא זה, אלא גם בכלכלה, חבילת התמריצים והרפורמות הנדרשות.' דבריו נאמרו בתגובה לשאלה בנוגע ליו"ר ה-RNC מייק דאנקן. בשבוע שעבר פרסמה ה-RNC גם פרסומת מקוונת שרמזה שאובמה לא סיפק מספיק מידע על קשרים אפשריים בין אנשיו לבלאגוייביץ'. בלאגוייביץ' נעצר ביום שלישי והואשם שניסה להמיר את מושב הסנאט של אובמה בתרומות לקמפיין ובטובות הנאה נוספות. מקיין אמר שאינו יודע את כל פרטי הקשר בין הקמפיין של אובמה לבין המושל בלאגוייביץ', אך הוא בטוח שכל המידע יתגלה. כמו רבים מהמחוקקים, גם הוא סבור שבלאגוייביץ' צריך להתפטר. למרות המרוץ הסוער לנשיאות, מקיין אמר שהוא מתכוון להתמקד בקידום שיתוף פעולה וחציית מחסומי מפלגה. 'התפקיד שלי הוא להיות חלק מולהוביל, כך אני מקווה, אופוזיציה נאמנה. אבל אני מדגיש את המילה נאמנה', הוסיף. 'לא היו תקופות כלכליות כאלה בתקופתי. לא התמודדנו עם אתגרים בינלאומיים כה מורכבים לפחות מאז סיום המלחמה הקרה, ואולי אף יותר בהיבטים מסוימים. המדינה רוצה שנתאחד ונפעל יחד.' מקיין לא הגיב לשאלה האם היה מנצח לולא הממשל של בוש היה מזוהה עם הבעיות הכלכליות. הוא אמר שישאיר זאת לאחרים, והזכיר שמידת התמיכה בו ירדה במקביל לצניחת הבורסה. לסיום אמר כי הדרך להתגבר על ההפסד היא: 'להתעסק, להמשיך הלאה. זו התרופה הכי טובה. ביליתי זמן ברחמים עצמיים; זה אפילו מהנה בצורה מסוימת. אבל צריך להמשיך קדימה. אני עדיין סנאטור מאריזונה, וזה כבוד אדיר לשרת את המדינה.'

article_content: David Beckham experienced a dramatic turn in Paris Saint-Germain's tense 1-0 win over Evian, being sent off just six minutes after coming on as a substitute. The former England captain, who joined PSG earlier this year on a short-term deal, was dismissed for a strong tackle on Evian’s Youssef Adnane. The heated match saw four players sent off in total, with a late-game scuffle overshadowing the victory. Just prior to Beckham’s red card, Marco Verratti of PSG was also dismissed with a second yellow, and assistant coach Claude Makelele was sent off for arguing with the officials. Emotions boiled over at the final whistle when PSG’s goalkeeper Salvatore Sirigu and Evian’s Saber Khelifa were both shown red cards after a post-match melee. PSG is now on the brink of winning their first Ligue 1 championship in 19 years, thanks in part to Javier Pastore’s early second-half goal. Their path to the title depends on outperforming Marseille in the next round. With his contract set to expire at the end of the season, Beckham's sending off could be his final moment on the pitch for PSG. Following the match, club sporting director Leonardo criticized the referee's decisions, describing Beckham’s red card as unjust and noting the pressure faced by both sides, particularly relegation-challenged Evian. The incident also brought back memories of Beckham’s infamous expulsion at the 1998 World Cup, where he was sent off for kicking Argentina’s Diego Simeone—a moment that led to public blame for England’s subsequent elimination.

article_content: Diego Costa and Martin Skrtel reignited their rivalry during Chelsea’s lunchtime match against Liverpool at Anfield. Their feud dates back to Slovakia's unexpected win over Spain in the Euro 2016 qualifiers, when Skrtel revealed that former teammate Luis Suarez had taught him expletives to use against Costa. During Saturday’s game, tensions flared, and players from both teams intervened as Costa and Skrtel had to be separated when the teams left the field for halftime with the score tied at 1-1. The pair were involved in several heated moments, including physical collisions and verbal exchanges. At one point, Costa appeared upset after an altercation with Skrtel, including a forceful barge and an aerial challenge that saw Skrtel brought to the ground. Despite the tensions, Costa ultimately had the final say by scoring the decisive goal for Chelsea shortly after having to change his ripped shirt. His goal came in the 66th minute and was celebrated with teammate Willian. Their rivalry traces back to an earlier encounter in Group C of the Euro 2016 qualifiers, where the two clashed repeatedly. In that match, Slovakia secured victory thanks to an 87th-minute goal from Miroslav Stoch. Following the match, Skrtel exchanged messages with Suarez, thanking him for the taunting phrases used against Costa. Luis Suarez played alongside Skrtel at Liverpool before transferring to Barcelona in a £75 million move in July.

article_content: The National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) has arrested a 67-year-old trafficking suspect, Chukwuemeka Clement, at Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport in Abuja for ingesting 100 wraps of cocaine. The agency reported that Clement, who claimed he turned to trafficking after previously living for 30 years in Brazil, Ethiopia, and Thailand, excreted the drugs, weighing 2.195 kilograms, after a body scan revealed the pellets. On the same day, NDLEA operatives at the Malam Aminu Kano International Airport (MAKIA), Kano, stopped 45-year-old Bilkisu Mohammed Bello as she prepared to board a Saudia Airlines flight to Saudi Arabia. During questioning, she confessed that she had been given pellets of cocaine to swallow, which were later recovered from a house in Farawa area of Kano—52 wraps weighing a total of 767 grams. Additionally, the agency, supported by personnel from the Nigerian Army, Civil Defence Corps, and Amotekun, raided James Town in Ogun state, destroying 10.38 tonnes of cannabis sativa found across over 4 hectares. During their return, the team intercepted a truck carrying logs of wood. A search revealed two bags of cannabis sativa weighing 20 kilograms, leading to the arrest of six suspects. In Edo state, officials raided Obi camp, seizing 300 kilograms of concealed skunk and identified two cannabis farms totalling over 1 hectare, arresting four suspects. Further arrests included a man in Gombe state found with 50,000 tramadol capsules, and a woman in Oyo state caught with 52 blocks of compressed cannabis sativa (30 kilograms). These actions were detailed in an official statement by NDLEA Director of Media & Advocacy, Femi Babafemi.

article_content: MARRAKECH, Morocco: On Tuesday (Oct 10), the International Monetary Fund (IMF) reduced its growth forecasts for China and the eurozone, noting that overall global growth remains low and uneven, despite the 'remarkable strength' of the US economy. In its latest World Economic Outlook (WEO), the IMF left its projection for global real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth in 2023 unchanged at 3.0 percent, but lowered its 2024 forecast by 0.1 percentage point to 2.9 percent from the July forecast. In 2022, world output grew by 3.5 percent. IMF chief economist Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas told reporters the global economy is still recovering from the COVID-19 pandemic, Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and last year's energy crisis. However, growth trends are increasingly divergent around the world, with medium-term growth prospects described as 'mediocre.' Gourinchas said forecasts generally indicate a soft landing but warned that the IMF remains concerned about risks, including China's real estate crisis, volatile commodity prices, geopolitical fragmentation, and potential resurgence of inflation. A new, unexpected risk appeared with the escalation of the Israel-Palestinian conflict as finance officials from 190 countries gathered in Marrakech for the annual meetings of the IMF and World Bank. However, this development occurred after the IMF's quarterly outlook was finalized on September 26. Gourinchas told Reuters it is too early to determine how the renewed conflict might affect the global economy, stating, 'Depending on how the situation unfolds, there are many possible scenarios that we have not yet analyzed, so we cannot make any assessment at this point.' Stronger global growth is being held back by the lingering effects of the pandemic, Russia's war in Ukraine, increasing geopolitical fragmentation, rising interest rates, extreme weather events, and reduced fiscal support, the IMF said. Total global output in 2023 is projected to be 3.4 percent, or about US$3.6 trillion, below pre-pandemic forecasts. 'The global economy is showing resilience. It's not knocked out by the major shocks of the past two or three years, but it is not performing strongly either,' Gourinchas said in a Reuters interview. 'The global economy is limping along; it’s not quite sprinting yet.'
translated_content: מרקש, מרוקו: ביום שלישי (10 באוקטובר), קרן המטבע הבינלאומית (IMF) הפחיתה את תחזיות הצמיחה שלה לסין ולאזור האירו, וציינה כי הצמיחה הכלכלית העולמית נותרת נמוכה ואינה אחידה, למרות 'החוסן המרשים' של כלכלת ארה"ב. בדוח התחזית הכלכלית העולמית (WEO) האחרון, ה-IMF שמרה על תחזית הצמיחה הגלובלית ל-2023 ב-3.0%, אך הפחיתה את תחזית 2024 ב-0.1 נקודת אחוז ל-2.9% לעומת התחזית ביולי. בשנת 2022, התפוקה העולמית עלתה ב-3.5%. הכלכלן הראשי של ה-IMF, פייר-אוליבייה גורנשה, מסר לעיתונאים כי הכלכלה הגלובלית עדיין מתאוששת ממגפת הקורונה, הפלישה הרוסית לאוקראינה ומשבר האנרגיה של השנה שעברה. עם זאת, מגמות הצמיחה נעשות שונות ומגוונות יותר בעולם, כאשר הציפיות לצמיחה בטווח הבינוני תוארו כ'בינוניות'. גורנשה אמר שהתחזיות בדרך כלל מצביעות על נחיתה רכה, אך הזהיר כי ה-IMF חושש מהסיכונים: משבר הנדל"ן בסין, מחירי סחורות תנודתיים, פיצול גיאופוליטי והתלקחות אפשרית של אינפלציה. סיכון חדש ובלתי צפוי צץ בעקבות הסלמת הסכסוך הישראלי-פלסטיני בשעה שנציגים מ-190 מדינות התכנסו במרקש לכנס השנתי של קרן המטבע ובנק העולם. יחד עם זאת, התפתחות זו אירעה לאחר שהתחזית הרבעונית של הקרן ננעלה ב-26 בספטמבר. גורנשה אמר לרויטרס כי מוקדם מדי לדעת כיצד ההסלמה תשפיע על הכלכלה העולמית: 'בהתאם לאופן שבו הדברים יתפתחו, קיימים תרחישים רבים שלא בחנו עדיין, לכן אי אפשר להעריך בשלב זה.' בהערכת ה-IMF, הצמיחה הגלובלית מוגבלת כתוצאה מהשפעות ארוכות טווח של המגפה, המלחמה באוקראינה, עליית פיצול בינלאומי, עליית ריביות, אירועי מזג אוויר קיצוניים והפחתה בתמיכה תקציבית. סך הכל התפוקה הגלובלית לשנת 2023 צפויה להיות נמוכה ב-3.4%, או כ-3.6 טריליון דולר, מהתחזיות שלפני הקורונה. 'הכלכלה העולמית מפגינה חוסן. היא לא התמוטטה בעקבות הזעזועים הגדולים של השנתיים-שלוש האחרונות, אבל גם לא זינקה', אמר גורנשה בראיון לרויטרס. 'הכלכלה העולמית מדשדשת – היא עדיין לא רצה.'

article_content: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd. (M&M), a leading player in the passenger car and utility vehicle segment, has seen its stock price decline by roughly 13% from a recent record high, according to technical analysis. The stock formed an Evening Star candlestick pattern—often signaling a reversal in trend. Short-term traders may consider selling M&M stock, with experts suggesting a target price below Rs 1400 over the next one to two months. The stock reached a peak of Rs 1670 on September 18, 2023, but has since lost momentum, closing at Rs 1454 on November 1, 2023. The Evening Star pattern—a series of three candles (a large candle, a small-bodied candle, and a red candle)—appeared as the stock peaked in September, supporting the case for a potential trend reversal and some consolidation or profit taking. Suraj Bathija, Founder & CSO at AlgoBulls, noted that the 'star' candle had the highest volume in the pattern, and sellers are dominating at higher levels, leading to extended upper wicks. The weekly RSI has dropped below 60, indicating waning momentum. Bathija also pointed out a breakdown from a Head and Shoulders pattern on the daily chart—another bearish signal—and added that the daily RSI is now below 40. The stock’s closing price is under both the supertrend and lower Bollinger Band, further suggesting a bearish outlook. Bathija recommends selling or booking profits in M&M at current prices, with a target of 1365 and a stop loss at 1596. Elsewhere, Indian telecom operators have accused global technology companies like Microsoft and Amazon of using unregulated platforms such as WhatsApp to send business messages, allegedly bypassing regulated telecom routes and resulting in estimated annual revenue losses of ₹3,000 crore for the government and service providers. Additionally, the Indian government has requested Apple to participate in an investigation into alleged state-sponsored attempts to hack iPhones belonging to prominent individuals, including some opposition members of Parliament. In aviation news, the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) informed the Delhi High Court that lessors can deregister and repossess aircraft and engines from bankrupt airline Go First, impacting its potential revival.

article_content: The Milwaukee Brewers' Brandon Woodruff is doused as the team celebrates clinching the National League Central Division following a game against the St. Louis Cardinals on Tuesday, Sept. 26, 2023, in Milwaukee. (AP Photo/Morry Gash) After Friday night’s deadline for MLB teams to offer contracts for next season, 63 players became free agents after being non-tendered. While many of these players are fringe major leaguers or second-tier prospects, several notable names have also hit the open market. Here’s a look at five free agents who are likely to attract interest: BRANDON WOODRUFF: The two-time All-Star recently underwent shoulder surgery, which may sideline him for the entire 2024 season. Given that Woodruff is eligible for free agency after next season, it’s not surprising that the Brewers decided not to go through the arbitration process with him. Teams interested in Woodruff will likely consider a two-year contract, allowing him to rehab next year and potentially return in 2025. Despite being limited to 11 starts this season, Woodruff posted an impressive 5-1 record with a 2.28 ERA. Since debuting with Milwaukee in 2017, the 30-year-old has a 46-26 record and a 3.10 ERA across 130 games. AUSTIN MEADOWS: The Detroit Tigers’ decision to non-tender the 28-year-old outfielder was expected. Meadows played just 42 games over the last two seasons due to anxiety and vertigo following his trade from the Tampa Bay Rays. Any team signing Meadows must consider the risk posed by his mental health challenges. However, he’s a career .259/.333/.472 hitter with 70 home runs and 23 stolen bases in 417 major league games. Meadows was an All-Star in 2019 and was the ninth overall pick in the 2013 draft. JACOB STALLINGS: The 33-year-old catcher struggled offensively this past season for the Miami Marlins, posting a .191/.278/.286 slash line with three home runs in 88 games. Defensively, he was average, as shown by his zero defensive runs saved. Stallings won the National League Gold Glove at catcher in 2021 with the Pirates, when he hit a career-high eight home runs and had 21 defensive runs saved. Since moving to Miami, his defense declined, registering minus-nine defensive runs saved in 2022. Despite limited offensive contribution, his ability to handle pitchers could make him appealing to teams in a thin catcher market. SPENCER TURNBULL: After debuting with the Detroit Tigers in 2018, Turnbull has struggled with injuries, making only 16 starts over the past three seasons, including recovering from Tommy John surgery. Notably, he threw a no-hitter on May 18, 2021, against the Seattle Mariners, but an elbow injury shortly after derailed his season. Now 31, Turnbull’s record includes a challenging 3-17 rookie season, but some teams may see potential in giving him another chance. DAKOTA HUDSON: The St. Louis Cardinals non-tendered the right-hander, who was once seen as a cornerstone of their rotation. Hudson underwent Tommy John surgery in 2020 and has not fully regained his previous form, going 15-10 with a 4.55 ERA in 47 appearances over the last three seasons. This year, Hudson posted a 6-3 record, though his 4.98 ERA and 45 strikeouts in 81.1 innings suggest underlying struggles. At age 29, he remains young enough for teams to hope for a turnaround.

בשלוש העונות האחרונות, כולל שיקום מניתוח טומי ג'ון. רגע השיא היה נו-היטר במאי 2021 מול סיאטל מרינרס, אך פציעה במרפק עצרה עונה מבטיחה. בגיל 31, יש לו עונת רוקי של 3-17, אבל חלק מהקבוצות עשויות לראות בו article_content: French President Francois Hollande warned that diplomacy with Russia 'cannot go on forever' as leaders prepare to discuss ending the war in Ukraine with Russian President Vladimir Putin. At a Paris news conference, Hollande said that he and German Chancellor Angela Merkel would visit Kiev to present a conflict-resolution deal acceptable to all involved. He noted that while France and Germany have chosen diplomacy over providing arms to Ukrainian troops fighting pro-Russian separatists, negotiations cannot be unlimited. Earlier, US Secretary of State John Kerry arrived in Kiev for talks. Hollande and Merkel confirmed plans to travel to Moscow the following day for discussions with Putin. This would be Merkel’s first visit to Moscow since the conflict began a year prior. In a renewed push for peace, the French and German leaders announced their trips to Kiev and Moscow with a new peace proposal. This move comes as the US considers offering lethal military aid to Ukraine. These diplomatic efforts aim to halt renewed fighting in eastern Ukraine, which threatens European security. France and Germany hope to broker a peace agreement that both Ukraine and Russia will accept. Kerry's visit coincides with NATO preparing to reinforce its presence in response to unrest in Ukraine and increased Russian military activity. Fighting between Russian-backed separatists and Ukrainian government forces intensified in January after a relatively calm period, resulting in over 220 civilian deaths in the last three weeks, according to the United Nations. The UN has sharply criticized both sides for indiscriminate shelling and called for a temporary cease-fire. Officials in Donetsk, a rebel-held city, reported at least three deaths in overnight shelling, amid heavy fighting in eastern Ukraine. Hollande reiterated that he and Merkel will travel to Kiev and then Moscow with a proposal based on Ukraine’s territorial integrity. He stressed that France and Germany are doing everything possible for peace. Merkel’s spokesman, Steffen Seibert, said that because of escalating violence, the German chancellor and President Hollande are intensifying months-long efforts for a peaceful resolution. Dmitry Peskov, spokesman for President Putin, stated that the leaders would discuss how their countries can help end the civil war in southeastern Ukraine, which has recently worsened. Kerry's visit shows US support for Ukraine as debate continues within the Obama administration over sending arms to help Ukrainian forces. He brought $16.4 million in new US humanitarian aid, though Ukraine continues to request lethal aid. President Obama remains opposed to sending weapons for now, but this stance could shift. German Foreign Minister Frank-Walter Steinmeier reaffirmed Germany’s opposition to arming Ukraine, stressing the need for diplomacy. In Brussels, NATO Secretary-General Jens Stoltenberg said that defense ministers are expected to approve an increase in NATO Response Force size from 13,000 to 30,000 troops due to Russian actions in Ukraine. Russia denies helping the rebels militarily, though the Kremlin recognizes that Russian volunteers are fighting in eastern Ukraine. Hollande stated France is not in favor of Ukraine joining NATO, addressing Russian concerns. The EU is considering new sanctions against Russia, while Germany prepares to host a security conference with Ukraine as a main topic. Britain will provide 1,000 troops to a Baltic rapid-reaction force and will lead NATO’s Very High Readiness Joint Task Force in 2017. The RAF continues patrols over Latvia, Estonia, and Lithuania. Stoltenberg emphasized the seriousness of continued Ukraine fighting and Russia’s reported support for rebels, highlighting the need for NATO unity and strong action. The UK will also contribute to regional headquarters and integration units in Eastern Europe, and participate in air policing in the Baltics. Around 3,500 personnel are engaging in NATO exercises this year to maintain a constant alliance presence and support to Ukraine.

בפריז אמר הולנד כי הוא וקנצלרית גרמניה אנגלה מרקל יבקרו בקייב ויציגו הצעת פיתרון לסכסוך שתהיה מקובלת על כל הצדדים. הוא הדגיש שבעוד שצרפת וגרמניה בחרו בדיפלומטיה במקום לספק נשק לצבא אוקראינה במאבקו בבדלנים הפרו-רוסים, המשא ומתן איננו בלתי מוגבל בזמן. מוקדם יותר, מזכיר המדינה האמריקאי ג'ון קרי הגיע לקייב לשיחות. הולנד ומרקל אישרו כי ימשיכו למוסקבה ביום שלאחר מכן לדיונים עם פוטין. זו תהיה הפעם הראשונה שמרקל מבקרת במוסקבה מאז תחילת המשבר לפני כשנה. במאמץ מחודש להשגת שלום, מנהיגי צרפת וגרמניה הכריזו על ביקוריהם בקייב ובמוסקבה עם הצעת שלום חדשה. הצעד הזה מגיע בשעה שארה"ב בוחנת אפשרות לספק לאוקראינה סיוע צבאי קטלני. המאמצים הדיפלומטיים נועדו לעצור את הקרבות המחודשים במזרח אוקראינה המהווים איום לביטחון אירופה. צרפת וגרמניה מקוות לתווך הסכם שיהיה מוסכם על אוקראינה ורוסיה. במקביל, נאט"ו נערכת להגדיל את כוחותיה בתגובה לאי השקט באוקראינה ולהחרפת הפעילות הצבאית של רוסיה. הקרבות בין כוחות הממשלה האוקראינים והבדלנים הפרו-רוסים החריפו בינואר, לאחר תקופה של רגיעה יחסית, וגרמו למותם של למעלה מ-220 אזרחים בשלושת השבועות האחרונים, כך לפי האומות המאוחדות. האו"ם ביקר את שני הצדדים על הפגזות חסרות הבחנה וקרא להפסקת אש זמנית. גורמים בדונצק שבשליטת המורדים מסרו כי לפחות שלושה בני אדם נהרגו בהפצצות ליליות, והקרבות נמשכים בעוז במזרח אוקראינה. הולנד חזר והדגיש כי הוא ומרקל יסעו לקייב ולאחר מכן למוסקבה עם הצעה המבוססת על שלמותה הטריטוריאלית של אוקראינה. הוא הדגיש שצרפת וגרמניה עושות כל מאמץ להשגת שלום. דוברה של מרקל, סטפן זייברט, מסר כי על רקע ההסלמה באלימות, הקנצלרית הגרמנית והנשיא הולנד מגבירים את המאמצים למציאת פיתרון בדרכי שלום. דמיטרי פסקוב, דוברו של פוטין, אמר כי המנהיגים ידונו כיצד מדינותיהם יכולות לסייע לסיום הסכסוך בדרום-מזרח אוקראינה, שהלך והחמיר לאחרונה. ביקורו של קרי מסמל את תמיכתה של ארה"ב בממשלת אוקראינה, בעוד בוושינגטון עוד מתלבטים האם להעביר למדינה נשק קטלני. קרי הביא סיוע הומניטרי אמריקאי חדש בגובה 16.4 מיליון דולר, אולם ממשלת אוקראינה עדיין מבקשת סיוע צבאי. הנשיא אובמה ממשיך להתנגד להעברת נשק לאוקראינה, אך ייתכן שהעמדה תשתנה. שר החוץ הגרמני, פרנק-ולטר שטיינמאייר, הביע שוב התנגדות לגרמניה להעברת נשק, והדגיש את הצורך בדיפלומטיה. בבריסל אמר מזכ"ל נאט"ו, ינס סטולטנברג, כי שרי ההגנה צפויים לאשר הגדלת כוחות התגובה של הארגון מ-13,000 ל-30,000 חיילים בשל מעשי רוסיה באוקראינה. רוסיה דוחה את הטענות כי היא מסייעת צבאית לבדלנים, אם כי הקרמלין מודה כי מתנדבים רוסים לוחמים במזרח אוקראינה. הולנד אמר שצרפת מתנגדת לכניסת אוקראינה לנאט"ו, בניסיון להרגיע חששות רוסיים. האיחוד האירופי דן בהטלת סנקציות חדשות על רוסיה, וגרמניה תארח ועידת ביטחון שבמרכזה תעמוד אוקראינה. בריטניה התחייבה לשלוח אלף חיילים לכוח תגובה מהירה בבלטיות ותוביל את כוח התגובה המהירה של נאט"ו ב-2017. חיל האוויר הבריטי ממשיך בפעילות סיורים אוויריים בלטביה, אסטוניה וליטא. סטולטנברג הדגיש את חומרת ההסלמה באוקראינה ואת הדיווחים על תמיכת רוסיה במורדים, והבליט את הצורך באחדות נאט"ו ובפעולה תקיפה. בריטניה תסייע גם בהקמה של מפקדות אזוריות במזרח אירופה, וכן תשתתף בסיורים אוויריים במדינות הבלטיות. כ-3,500 אנשי כוחות נאט"ו משתתפים השנה בתרגילים להבטחת נוכחות מתמדת באזור ותמיכה באוקראינה.

article_content: Adam Levine, lead singer of Maroon 5, launched his men's clothing and accessories line for Kmart on October 1, 2013. According to Bernt Ullmann, president of Kmart's Shop Your Way Brands and an executive at Sears Holdings Corp., the collection has been very successful. Ullmann went so far as to compare Levine's potential impact for Kmart to that of renowned designer Calvin Klein. Levine's strong media presence, especially as a judge on The Voice, has helped his brand reach a wider audience. The collection features casual pieces that reflect his personal style, including flannel shirts, shawl cardigans, and well-fitted bootcut jeans, priced between $11 and $30. Levine has played an active role in designing the line. He emphasized that being personally involved, rather than just lending his name, ensures the clothes are authentic and accessible. 'If you don't love it and you don't endorse it and support it, it just seems like it's another income stream,' he said, underscoring his commitment. He further explained that making his signature, often expensive style available at affordable prices was central to the project: 'Why not provide an affordable alternative and also have it be something that I love to wear, which is what the line is,' Levine said. Following early success, Kmart plans to add bags, footwear, and jewelry to Levine's collection in the spring, along with a womenswear line to be launched in April. Levine's fiancée, Victoria's Secret Angel Behati Prinsloo, will be involved in developing the women's line. Levine joins other celebrities, like Nicki Minaj and Sofia Vergara, in collaborating with Kmart, but Ullmann believes Levine's line might surpass previous partnerships. Some note, however, that comparing Levine's line to high-fashion brands such as Calvin Klein is ambitious.
translated_content: אדם לוין, סולן להקת מארון 5, השיק את קו בגדי הגברים והאקססוריז שלו ב-Kmart ב-1 באוקטובר 2013. לפי ברנט אולרמן, נשיא מותגי Shop Your Way של Kmart ומנהל בכיר ב-Sears Holdings Corp., האוסף זכה להצלחה רבה. אולרמן אף השווה את הפוטנציאל של לוין להשפעה ב-Kmart לזו של מעצב-העל קלווין קליין. הנוכחות התקשורתית הבולטת של לוין, במיוחד כשופט בתוכנית The Voice, סייעה למותג להגיע לקהל רחב. הקולקציה כוללת פריטים קז'ואליים המשקפים את הסגנון האישי שלו, כמו חולצות פלאנל, סוודרים עם צווארון שאל וג'ינסים בגזרה מתרחבת, במחירים של 11 עד 30 דולר. לוין היה מעורב אישית בעיצוב הקולקציה והדגיש שמעורבותו מבטיחה שהבגדים יהיו אותנטיים ונגישים. 'אם אתה לא אוהב את זה, לא תומך בזה ולא עומד מאחוריו – זה מרגיש כמו עוד מקור הכנסה', אמר, כשהוא מדגיש את מחויבותו. עוד הבהיר כי הרצון להנגיש את הסגנון היקר שלו במחירים משתלמים עמד במרכז הקו: 'למה לא להציע אלטרנטיבה במחיר סביר וליצור משהו שגם אני אוהב ללבוש – שזה הקו?' אמר לוין. בעקבות ההצלחה, ב-Kmart מתכננים להוסיף לאוסף שלו תיקים, הנעלה ותכשיטים באביב, ולצד זה גם קו בגדי נשים שעתיד לצאת באפריל. ארוסתו, מלאכית维יקטוריה'ס סיקרט בהטי פרינסלו, תיקח חלק בפיתוח קו הנשים. לוין מצטרף לסלבס נוספים, כמו ניקי מינאז' וסופיה ורגרה, ששיתפו פעולה עם Kmart, אך אולרמן מאמין כי לקו של לוין פוטנציאל לעלות על שיתופי פעולה קודמים. עם זאת, יש הסבורים כי השוואה בין הקולקציה של לוין למותגי יוקרה כמו קלווין קליין היא שאפתנית.

article_content: Ministers are reportedly considering the use of emergency powers to block the publication of a critical report on the £50 billion High Speed Rail project (HS2). Cabinet Office Minister Francis Maude and Transport Secretary Patrick McLoughlin have urged Prime Minister David Cameron to veto the release of a report that labels HS2 as a 'red/amber' risk and in danger of failing. They argue that publication would cause political and presentational difficulties and could seriously undermine the project. Critics of HS2 have condemned the attempt to suppress the report as 'absolutely disgraceful' and are invoking Freedom of Information laws to demand the release of the Project Assessment Review from November 2011. The Information Commissioner has rejected ministers' objections and ordered the report to be made public. A leaked letter from Maude and McLoughlin to Cameron, circulated among ministers, urges the use of an emergency veto—an option rarely exercised, though previously used to block publication of Cabinet discussions on the Iraq War. Ministers are also considering an appeal against the Information Commissioner's decision. HS2 has faced widespread opposition and allegations of rising costs. In the letter, it is argued that continuing with the appeal would create political challenges at a crucial stage of the project, and that exercising the veto is justified due to the government's commitment to HS2. The letter also warns that releasing recent information could discourage honest assessments of other government projects and advice to ministers. Legal advice reportedly suggests it would be better to veto now rather than after a tribunal decision. A Whitehall source compared ministers' guarded treatment of the report to handling 'top secret intelligence.' Senior government sources believe Cabinet Secretary Sir Jeremy Heywood wants to block the publication to avoid setting a precedent that would require all Project Assessment Reviews to be released. Sir Jeremy is also reportedly blocking the release of correspondence between Tony Blair and Gordon Brown and former US President George W. Bush that the Iraq Inquiry seeks to make public. Despite calls to drop the appeal, reports indicate it will likely proceed. Whitehall sources predict that if the government loses, a veto will be applied. Joe Rukin of the Stop HS2 campaign criticized withholding the report, saying it is wrong that MPs and the public will lack key information before a parliamentary vote on HS2 next spring. The Department for Transport declined to comment, but an internal source said the latest review rated HS2 as an 'amber' risk, not 'red/amber.' A Cabinet Office source maintained that safeguarding the candor of advice to ministers serves the public interest. A Cabinet Office spokesperson stated: 'We do not comment on leaked documents. This government is proud to lead on transparency, having published over 10,000 datasets on health, education, justice, and transport to improve public services and accountability.'
translated_content: שרים שוקלים שימוש בסמכויות חירום כדי לחסום את פרסום הדו"ח הביקורתי על פרויקט הרכבת המהירה HS2 בעלות 50 מיליארד פאונד. שר המשרד הקבינט פרנסיס מוד ושר התחבורה פטריק מק'לפלין פנו לראש הממשלה דיוויד קמרון בבקשה להטיל וטו על פרסום דו"ח שמגדיר את HS2 כסיכון 'אדום/ענבר' ועלול להיכשל. הם טוענים שפרסום הדו"ח יגרום לקשיים פוליטיים ותדמיתיים ועלול לפגוע בפרויקט. מבקרי HS2 גינו את הניסיון למנוע את פרסום הדו"ח כ'בזיוני לחלוטין' ומבקשים לחשוף אותו בהתאם לחוק חופש המידע. נציב המידע דחה את התנגדויות השרים והורה לפרסם את הדו"ח. במכתב שהודלף ממוד ומק'לפלין לקמרון, שהופץ לשרים נוספים, מבקשים להפעיל וטו חירום — אפשרות נדירה, אך הופעלה בעבר כדי לחסום פרסום הדיונים על מלחמת עיראק. השרים שוקלים גם ערעור על החלטת נציב המידע. הפרויקט סופג התנגדות רחבה וטענות לחריגה משמעותית בעלויות. במכתב נטען שהמשך הערעור ייצר אתגרים פוליטיים בשלב קריטי, ושיש להפעיל וטו בשל מחויבות הממשלה ל-HS2. במכתב נטען גם כי פרסום מידע כזה עלול להרתיע מגישת ביקורת ישירה בפרויקטי ממשלה נוספים. לפי ייעוץ משפטי, עדיף להטיל וטו כעת מאשר אחרי החלטה של טריבונל. מקור בוויטהול השווה את השמירה הקפדנית על הדו"ח ל'מודיעין סודי ביותר'. גורמים בכירים סבורים שמזכיר הקבינט סר ג'רמי הייווד מבקש לחסום את הפרסום כדי לא ליצור תקדים שחושף סקירות דומות. דווח גם כי סר ג'רמי מונע פרסום התכתבויות בין טוני בלייר, גורדון בראון ולשעבר נשיא ארה"ב ג'ורג' וו' בוש, שוועדת עיראק ביקשה לחשוף. למרות הקריאות לבטל את הערעור, נראה שהוא יימשך. מקורות בוויטהול צופים שאם הממשלה תפסיד, יופעל הוטו. ג'ו רוקין מקמפיין Stop HS2 מתח ביקורת על הסתרת הדו"ח, וטען שלא ייתכן שחברי פרלמנט והציבור לא יקבלו מידע לפני ההצבעה בכנסת על HS2 באביב הבא. משרד התחבורה סירב להגיב, אך מקור פנימי אמר כי הסקירה האחרונה מדרגת את HS2 בסיכון 'ענבר' ולא 'אדום/ענבר'. מקור במשרד הקבינט הוסיף ששמירה על כנות הייעוץ לשרים חיונית לאינטרס הציבורי. דובר משרד הקבינט אמר: 'אנחנו לא מגיבים למסמכים שהודלפו. הממשלה הנוכחית גאה להוביל את תחום השקיפות, ופרסמה מעל ל-10,000 מאגרי מידע בתחומי בריאות, חינוך, משפט ותחבורה במטרה לשפר שירותים ציבוריים ולחזק את האחריותיות.'

article_content: Věra Jourová, vice-president of the European Commission responsible for values and transparency, has cautioned against excessive regulation of generative artificial intelligence. In an interview with The Financial Times, she emphasized that the European Union’s new AI rules should not be driven by 'dystopian' fears, as this could suppress innovation. Jourová, a key architect of the EU’s AI law, told the FT, 'There should not be paranoia in assessing the risks of AI. It always has to be a solid analysis of the possible risks.' She added that technologies should only be labeled high-risk when there is evidence, not just speculation. The EU continues to shape its AI regulations while other countries, including the U.S. and China, develop their own approaches. The UK is also set to host a global AI summit next month. As the EU’s AI Act nears completion, concerns are rising about potential misuse of AI, such as creating deepfakes or infringing copyright law. Some businesses and members of the European Parliament are calling for more accountability from creators of foundational models, like those behind ChatGPT. These developers may need to disclose AI-generated content and summarize the copyrighted data used in their training. Brando Benifei, an EU Parliament negotiator, argues that relying solely on principles is insufficient. However, trade groups such as the U.S.-based Computer and Communications Industry Association warn that overly strict regulations could stifle innovation. Jourová plans to advocate for the EU’s AI regulatory model at an upcoming G7 AI forum in Kyoto, presenting it as a global standard, particularly in contrast to China, whose AI approach she regards with caution. Finally, Jose Fernandez, the U.S. under-secretary for economic growth, energy, and the environment, highlights both the challenges and opportunities AI presents, and stresses the importance of U.S–EU cooperation to maximize AI’s benefits.

article_content: Kettle Produce, a major vegetable processing company, has acknowledged failing to adequately protect its staff after a serious accident at its Orkie Farm plant near Freuchie, Fife. The event involved Remigiusz Cyrek, a 37-year-old hygiene worker from Poland, who suffered severe neck injuries when the hood of his waterproof jacket became stuck in a large roller of a carrot baton machine during cleaning. The machinery had not been fully powered down, which led to Mr. Cyrek being pulled in and rendered unconscious. The incident, spanning between August 2017 and June 2018, left him out of work for six months, dealing with pain and a lingering loss of feeling in his hand. At Dundee Sheriff Court, fiscal depute Gail Adair stated that proper safety procedures—such as shutting down and isolating the equipment before cleaning—were not followed. Mr. Cyrek was found by a coworker, freed from the roller, and taken to hospital. Company representative Barry Smith said Kettle Produce sincerely regretted the accident and recognized Mr. Cyrek as a valued employee. He admitted that although safety rules were in place, they were not always consistently communicated or observed, and the company did not meet required safety standards. The prosecution highlighted the absence of a robust safety system, while the defense urged the court to consider challenges from pandemic-related financial losses when setting any penalties. Sentencing has been deferred, with Sheriff Jillian Martin-Brown noting the worker was lucky to have survived.
translated_content: חברת קטל פרודוס, אחת החברות המובילות בתעשיית עיבוד הירקות, הודתה כי לא הגנה כראוי על עובדיה לאחר תאונה חמורה במפעל Orkie Farm הסמוך לפרוכי, פייף. רמיגיוש צ'ירק, עובד ניקיון בן 37 מפולין, נפצע קשה בצווארו כאשר כובע המעיל שלו נלכד בגלגלת גדולה של מכונת חיתוך גזר בזמן ניקיון. המכשור לא נותק מהחשמל לחלוטין, וכתוצאה מכך צ'ירק נמשך פנימה ואיבד את ההכרה. האירוע, שקרה בין אוגוסט 2017 ליוני 2018, הוביל לכך שהוא נשאר מחוץ לעבודה למשך שישה חודשים עם כאבים וחוסר תחושה בידו. בדיון בבית המשפט בדנדי, הסבירה נציגת התביעה גייל אדייר כי לא נשמרו נהלי בטיחות כמו כיבוי ובידוד הציוד לפני הניקיון. עמית לעבודה מצא את צ'ירק, חילץ אותו מהמכונה והוא פונה לבית החולים. נציג החברה, בארי סמית', ציין שקטל פרודוס מצטערת מאוד על התאונה ורואה בצ'ירק עובד מוערך. הוא הודה שלמרות קיומם של נהלי בטיחות, לא כולם הוסברו או יושמו במלואם, והחברה לא עמדה בסטנדרטים הנדרשים. התביעה הדגישה את היעדר מערכת בטיחות חזקה, וההגנה ביקשה מהשופטת להביא בחשבון את ההפסדים הכספיים בשל מגפת הקורונה בטווח הקנס. גזר הדין נדחה, והשופטת ג'יליאן מרטין-בראון ציינה שלעובד היה מזל גדול לשרוד.

article_content: In the summer of 2021, Ugo Apuzzo and Floriano Bollettini traveled across Italy as part of their studies at École des Hautes Etudes Commerciales de Paris, searching for the perfect textile material. They spent months meeting with various suppliers, encouraging them to save animal hair that would otherwise be discarded. After five months, their persistence paid off and they collected nearly a ton of animal hair. Italian spinners praised their find, comparing its quality to fine cashmere. The unexpected twist: the source of the hair was dogs.  Known as chiengora, the practice of spinning dog hair into yarn has existed quietly for decades, mostly among hobbyists. Recently, there's been a push to reinvent dog hair as a mainstream, eco-conscious material. The term 'chiengora' merges the French word for dog, 'chien,' with 'gora' from angora rabbits and goats. Ann Cathrin Schönrock, a German entrepreneur in this field, says that just in Germany, about 1,600 tons of dog hair go to waste annually while it could be used as sustainable yarn.  Humans have used dog hair in textiles for thousands of years. Indigenous Salish communities of North America bred dogs for their hair, but the practice waned in the 1800s with the rise of cheaper sheep wool and industrial fabrics.  Environmental concerns about traditional fashion materials, like cotton's water use and wool's impact on land and emissions, have sparked investments in alternate fibers—including mushroom leather and algae-based fabrics. Amidst these innovations, the plentiful supply of dog hair in pet-owning households offers another option. Nearly half of all American homes have a dog, many of which shed regularly and require grooming.  Scientific research backs chiengora’s potential. A North Carolina State University study two decades ago found that dog hair could make profitable and useful yarn. Lithuanian researchers discovered that dog hair offers exceptional warmth, suitable even for people with certain health conditions. Indian academic Surjit Ramamoorthy has closely examined different breeds, finding Lhasa Apso’s long hair especially effective for insulation and softness. Popular long-undercoat breeds like Chow Chows and Samoyeds stand out for quality fiber, and Samoyed yarn can fetch over $400 per kilogram online—more than quality cashmere. Yet, not all breeds are equally suitable; for example, golden retrievers’ hair is shorter and coarser.  Despite its advantages, chiengora faces two big challenges: cultural hesitation and scaling up collection. Some people associate dog hair textiles with fictional stories like Cruella de Vil, but advocates emphasize that collecting dog hair is humane and even healthy for pets. The bigger hurdle is organizing widespread collection—unlike sheep, dogs are dispersed and yields aren't standardized. Owners and groomers must be taught how to collect and sort the ideal undercoat fibers.  Consistency is also an issue, as dog hairs from different breeds and cuts can vary greatly. Surjit is working on industrial methods to soften and blend dog hairs and has developed a blend with synthetic fibers for better feel, though some, such as Schönrock, focus on pure dog hair products. The labor involved is considerable—Surjit often negotiates with pet owners directly for their dogs’ hair.  Apuzzo and Bollettini’s Chiengora Project joined forces with Schönrock’s Yarnsustain and even appeared on German television, but eventually closed in 2023 due to difficulties expanding production. Schönrock remains committed, releasing a book to educate people on ethical collection and identifying the best breeds for chiengora. She believes that with increased knowledge and the right techniques, dog hair could become a premium, sustainable textile.
translated_content: בקיץ 2021 נסעו אוגו אפוצו ופלוריאנו בולטיני ברחבי איטליה כחלק מלימודיהם ב-École des Hautes Etudes Commerciales de Paris בחיפוש אחר חומר טקסטיל מושלם. במשך חודשים הם נפגשו עם ספקים שונים, ועודדו אותם לשמור שיערות בעלי חיים שבדרך כלל היו נזרקות. לאחר חמישה חודשים, מאמציהם נשאו פרי, והם אספו כמעט טון של שיער בעלי חיים. טווי חוטים איטלקיים שיבחו את הגילוי, והשוו את איכותו לקשמיר מובחר. ההפתעה: מקור השיער היה כלבים.  צ'יינגורָה—אמנות טוויית שיער כלבים לחוטים—הייתה קיימת בשקט עשורים, בעיקר אצל חובבים. לאחרונה, קמה תנועה שמנסה להמציא מחדש שיער כלבים כחומר ידידותי לסביבה. המונח משלב את המילה הצרפתית לכלב, 'שיין', עם 'גורה' מאנגורה ארנבים ועיזים. אן קתרין שונרוק, יזמית גרמניה בתחום, אומרת שבגרמניה בלבד נזרקים מדי שנה כ-1,600 טון שיער כלבים שיכולים לשמש כחוט בר-קיימא.  שימוש בשיער כלבים בבדים קיים אלפי שנים. קהילות סליש הילידיות בצפון אמריקה גידלו כלבים עבור שיערם, אבל המסורת דעכה במאה ה-19 עקב בדים תעשייתיים וצמר זול מהצאן.  המודעות לסביבה של תעשיית האופנה, לצד השימוש במים של כותנה והשפעות הצמר, גרמו לחיפושים אחרי סיבים אלטרנטיביים—כולל עור מפטריות ובדים מאצות. בכל זאת, שיער הכלבים בבתי האב מהווה מקור נוסף. כמעט מחצית מהבתים האמריקאיים מחזיקים כלב, שחלקם משירים שיער ודורשים טיפוח.  מחקרים מדעיים תומכים בפוטנציאל של צ'יינגורה. מחקר באוניברסיטת מדינת צפון קרוליינה מצא לפני 20 שנה ששיער כלבים עשוי להיות חוט רווחי ושימושי. חוקרים ליטאים גילו שהוא חם במיוחד, מתאים אפילו לאנשים עם בעיות רפואיות. החוקרן ההודי סורג'יט רמאמורטי בחן גזעים שונים, ומצא שללסה אפסו יש שיער ארוך ומבודד במיוחד. גזעי פרווה תחתונה כמו צ'או צ'או וסמויד בולטים באיכות הסיבים שלהם, וחוט סמויד עשוי להימכר ביותר מ-400 דולר לקילו ברשת—יקר מקשמיר מובחר. יחד עם זאת, לא כל הגזעים מתאימים; לדוגמה, שיער הגולדן רטריבר קצר וגס יחסית.  למרות היתרונות, צ'יינגורה מתמודדת עם שני אתגרים עיקריים: מחסום תרבותי ומורכבות איסוף. יש שחושבים על דמויות כמו קרואלה דה ויל מהסרטים, אבל תומכי התחום מבהירים שהאיסוף אינו מזיק ולמעשה בריא לכלב. הקושי הגדול יותר הוא לארגן איסוף בקנה מידה רחב—בניגוד לכבשים, כלבים מפוזרים והתפוקה לא אחידה. בעלי כלבים ומספרות כלבים צריכים ללמוד איך לאסוף ולמיין שיער תחתון איכותי.  בעיה נוספת היא עקביות: שיער כלבים משתנה מאוד בין גזעים ואף בין תספורות שונות. סורג'יט מפתח תהליכים תעשייתיים לריכוך והשבחת שיער הכלבים, ואפילו יצר תערובת עם סיבים סינתטיים לנוחות, אם כי יש שמעדיפים שיער כלבים טהור בלבד. מדובר בעבודה קשה—לעיתים הוא פונה ישירות לבעלי כלבים ומבקש את שיער כלביהם.  מיזם הצ'יינגורה של אפוצו ובולטיני התאחד עם העסק של שונרוק ואף הופיע בטלוויזיה הגרמנית, אך נסגר בסוף ב-2023 בעקבות קשיים בהתרחבות. שונרוק ממשיכה לפעול לקידום התחום, משיקה ספר שמסביר על איסוף אתי וגזעים מתאימים. היא מאמינה שעם ידע נכון וטכניקות מתקדמות, שיער כלבים יוכל להפוך לטקסטיל מובחר ובר-קיימא.

DCS Card Centre, formerly known as Diners Club Singapore, is back in the spotlight as Member of Parliament Tin Pei Ling takes on a new role to lead strategic partnerships and business development. Ms Tin recently left her position at Grab after seven months amid public scrutiny about a potential conflict of interest.

DCS has a long history in Singapore, starting as the exclusive franchisee of Diners Club International, and introducing the nation’s first charge card in 1973—becoming a pioneer in cashless payments. The company’s market share dropped in the 1990s and 2000s as competitors like Visa and American Express offered more attractive rewards and promotions.

In July 2021, Ezy Net, a Singapore-based electronic payment provider, acquired DCS from Malaysian firm Johan Holdings for S$103.6 million (US$75.4 million). Before this acquisition, DCS and its subsidiary DinersPay DPPL reported combined losses of US$656,000 in 2018, US$5.2 million in 2019, and US$3.04 million in 2020.

The company rebranded as DCS Card Centre in October 2022, announcing a new focus on fintech innovation and future-ready payment solutions. Research by Statista states that Singapore had a 97 percent cashless payment adoption rate in 2022, the highest in Southeast Asia. DCS faces strong competition from other financial institutions, but Ms Tin has stated her aim to drive the company’s market expansion.

CEO Karen Low recently told Tech in Asia the company intends to double its current base of 300,000 cardholders within two years. To support this goal, DCS has expanded its card offerings to include UnionPay, Visa, and Mastercard, with plans to add JCB. It also provides card-acquiring services for Alipay, Singapore Quick Response Code (SGQR), and WeChat Pay, and remains the only issuer of Diners Club cards in Singapore. DCS has further increased its presence through co-branded cards with retailers like Sheng Shiong, Don Don Donki, and vehicle inspection provider VICOM.

מרכז כרטיסי DCS, שבעבר נקרא דיינרס קלאב סינגפור, חזר לכותרות לאחר שחברת הפרלמנט טין פיי לינג מונתה להוביל שותפויות אסטרטגיות ופיתוח עסקי במוסד. טין עזבה לאחרונה את תפקידה ב-Grab לאחר שבעה חודשים של תשומת לב ציבורית עקב חשש לניגוד עניינים.

ל-DCS היסטוריה ארוכה בסינגפור, והוא החל כמחזיק בלעדי של דיינרס קלאב אינטרנשיונל והשיק את כרטיס החיוב הראשון במדינה בשנת 1973, צעד חלוצי בתחום התשלומים ללא מזומן. בשנות ה-90 וה-2000 ירד נתח השוק של החברה, כאשר מתחרים כמו ויזה ואמריקן אקספרס הציעו מבצעים ותגמולים אטרקטיביים יותר.

ביולי 2021 רכשה חברת Ezy Net הסינגפורית את DCS מהחברה המלזית Johan Holdings בסכום של 103.6 מיליון דולר סינגפורי (75.4 מיליון דולר אמריקאי). לפני הרכישה, DCS וחברת הבת DinersPay DPPL דיווחו על הפסדים משותפים של 656 אלף דולר ב-2018, 5.2 מיליון דולר ב-2019 ו-3.04 מיליון דולר ב-2020.

החברה עברה מיתוג מחדש כמרכז כרטיסי DCS באוקטובר 2022, והכריזה על מיקוד בחדשנות פינטק ופתרונות תשלום מתקדמים. לפי Statista, שיעור האימוץ של תשלומים ללא מזומן בסינגפור עמד על 97% בשנת 2022 - הגבוה ביותר בדרום-מזרח אסיה. DCS מתמודדת עם תחרות עזה מצד חברות פיננסיות אחרות, אך טין ציינה כי בכוונתה לקדם את התרחבות השוק של החברה.
