article_content: Britain narrowly missed setting a new record for the warmest Christmas Day, falling just 1.3°C short of the record. Despite this, unseasonably mild conditions led Northern Ireland to break its own maximum temperature record for Christmas Day. Weather experts closely monitored temperatures, with provisional data indicating the British maximum of 15.6°C—set in 1896 and matched in 1920—remained unbeaten. The closest attempt came from Churchfenton, which reported 14.0°C, making 2011 the UK's third warmest Christmas Day on record. A striking sunrise in Barnard Castle, County Durham, and families enjoying walks in Brockwell Park, London, highlighted the unusual warmth. Forecasters suggested this December could approach the highest seasonal temperatures in a decade. With afternoon temperatures dropping, a national record became unlikely. However, Northern Ireland achieved a new maximum of 14.3°C in Murlough, surpassing its 1988 record of 13.0°C. The contrast with last year was dramatic: Katesbridge recorded -17.5°C on Christmas Day 2010, a swing of 30.5°C. Elsewhere, Aberdeen Airport in Scotland recorded 13.8°C, just below the record of 14.8°C from 1896. Met Office forecaster Michael Lawrence noted this Christmas Day was 'very different' from previous years, especially in the north, with temperatures generally between 11 and 12°C. The day also saw severe winds, with gusts up to 136 mph in the Cairngorms, Scotland. The mild weather dashed hopes for a white Christmas, as much of the UK woke to sunshine and clear skies—even Scottish mountains lacked snow. Football fans and outdoor enthusiasts could expect another mild day for Boxing Day. Forecaster Aisling Creevey from MeteoGroup said temperatures would slowly return to seasonal norms after Boxing Day. Though the national maximum temperature was not broken, forecasters stated that the coming days would remain some of the warmest for this period in more than a decade—warmer even than Athens and Barcelona. This contrasts sharply with the previous year’s record cold, such as -18°C in Altnaharra, Scottish Highlands. Chris Bulmer from the Met Office attributed the weather to a milder air mass. After a short cooler spell midweek, forecasters expected the mild conditions to return due to south-westerly winds. This extended a record-breaking year for UK weather, including the warmest spring in 350 years: central England averaged 10.32°C from March to May, surpassing the record from 1893. October 2011 saw exceptional warmth, with Yorkshire reaching 30°C—the hottest October day in more than a century. People flocked to beaches and parks to enjoy the unseasonably warm weather, and the Olympic Park in London recorded highs of 33.3°C in June. One Bristol family made their own white Christmas using a snow machine. Lee and Paul Brailsford spent £10,000 on decorations, including a life-size nativity scene and a £150 snow machine, covering their Brentry garden in artificial snow for their children to enjoy.

מזג האוויר עקבו מקרוב, כאשר נתונים ראשוניים הראו ששיא של 15.6°C שהושג ב-1896 והושווה ב-1920 לא נשבר השנה. הניסיון הקרוב ביותר היה בצ'רצ'פנטון עם 14.0°C, מה שהפך את חג המולד של 2011 לשלישי בחומו אי פעם בבריטניה. זריחה מרהיבה בטירת ברנרד שבמחוז דרהאם ומשפחות שנהנו מטיולים בפארק ברוקוול בלונדון הדגישו את החמימות החריגה. החזאים אמרו שדצמבר הזה עשוי להתקרב לטמפרטורות העונתיות הגבוהות ביותר בעשור האחרון. עם ירידת הטמפרטורות אחר הצהריים, הסיכוי לשבירת שיא ארצי התמעט. עם זאת, צפון אירלנד קבעה שיא חדש – 14.3°C במורלו, מעל השיא מ-1988 שהיה 13.0°C. הניגוד לשנה שעברה היה דרמטי: בקייטסברידג' נמדדו -17.5°C ביום חג המולד 2010, הבדל של 30.5 מעלות. שדה התעופה של אברדין בסקוטלנד רשם 13.8°C, פחות מהשיא של 14.8°C מ-1896. החזאי מייקל לורנס מהמט אופיס אמר שזהו 'יום חג מולד שונה מאוד' מהרגיל, בעיקר בצפון, עם טווח טמפרטורות בין 11 ל-12 מעלות. היום התאפיין גם ברוחות עזות, עם משבים שהגיעו ל-136 קמ"ש בקיירנגורמס, סקוטלנד. החום החריג סיכל את התקווה ל"חג מולד לבן", כאשר המדינה התעוררה לשמש וערפל קל, ואפילו פסגות ההרים בסקוטלנד נותרו ללא שלג. אוהדי הכדורגל והפעילות החוץ ייהנו מיום נוסף של מזג אוויר נעים בבוקסינג דיי. החזאית איילינג קריבי ממטאו-גרופ אמרה שאחרי בוקסינג דיי, הטמפרטורות יחזרו בהדרגה לטווחים הרגילים לעונה. למרות שהשיא הארצי לא נשבר, החזאים אמרו שהימים הקרובים יהיו מהחמים ביותר לתקופה זו ביותר מעשור – חמים אפילו מאתונה וברצלונה. זה שונה מאוד משנה שעברה, שבה נרשם קור קיצוני – לדוג' -18°C באלטנהרה, סקוטלנד. החזאי כריס בולמר מהמט אופיס ייחס את המצב למסות אוויר מתונות. לאחר הפוגה קצרה בהמשך השבוע, החזאים מעריכים שהחום ישוב בזכות רוחות דרום-מערביות. בכך נמשכת שנה שיא במזג האוויר בבריטניה, ובתוכה האביב החם ביותר ב-350 השנים האחרונות: במרכז אנגליה נמדד ממוצע של 10.32°C בין מרץ למאי, שהשווה את השיא מ-1893. אוקטובר 2011 התאפיין בחום יוצא דופן – ביורקשייר נמדדו 30°C, היום החם ביותר באוקטובר מעל למאה שנה. תושבים נהרו לחופים ולפארקים, והפארק האולימפי בלונדון רשם שיא של 33.3°C ביוני. משפחה אחת בבריסטול חגגה חג מולד לבן באמצעות מכונת שלג. האחים לי ופול בריילספורד השקיעו 10,000 ליש"ט בקישוטים, כולל סצינת לידה בגודל מלא ומכונת שלג ב-150 ליש"ט, שכיסתה את גינתם בברנטרי בשלג מלאכותי שילדיהם נהנו ממנו.

article_content: In a creative fundraising effort near Bridgnorth, Shropshire, organizers held an unusual event: launching large items with a massive medieval-style catapult. The main attraction was a 60-foot trebuchet named Dionysus, which flung a red Peugeot car, a church organ, and even a petrol bomb to support Acton Round Church. The event was led by Rollo Gabb, owner of Journey's End Wines, and successfully raised about £1,000 for the church. Gabb, who has been intrigued by catapults for years, saw this as a chance to combine his fascination with supporting a good cause. The car, weighing up to two tonnes, was propelled through the air and landed as a mangled wreck, while the organ was also destroyed on impact. The petrol bomb exploded during flight, adding drama to the event. Dionysus, the 12-tonne trebuchet, is set to be taken apart and shipped to Gabb’s vineyard near Stellenbosch, South Africa, where future fundraisers may feature it launching empty wine barrels. Since 1995, the Gabb family’s Journey’s End Wines has supplied esteemed restaurants, and is now channeling efforts into inventive charitable events. This blend of medieval machinery and modern philanthropy not only raised money for the church but also provided a memorable show, inspiring ideas for creative community fundraisers.
translated_content: במאמץ יצירתי לגיוס תרומות ליד ברידג'נורת', שרופשייר, ארגנו המארגנים אירוע לא שגרתי: שיגור חפצים גדולים באמצעות קטפולטה ענקית בסגנון ימי הביניים. האטרקציה הראשית הייתה טרבושה באורך 60 רגל בשם דיוניסוס, ששיגרה מכונית פג'ו אדומה, עוגב כנסייתי ואפילו בקבוק תבערה, לטובת כנסיית אקטון ראונד. האירוע הובל על ידי רולו גב, בעל יקב Journey's End Wines, והצליח לגייס כ-1,000 ליש"ט למען הכנסייה. גב, שחובב קטפולטות שנים רבות, ראה בכך הזדמנות לשלב את אהבתו עם עשייה למען הקהילה. המכונית, ששקלה כשני טון, הושלכה באוויר והתרסקה לגמרי, וגם העוגב התפרק לחלוטין לאחר הנחיתה. בקבוק התבערה התפוצץ במהלך השיגור והוסיף נופך דרמטי. דיוניסוס, הטרבושה ששוקלת 12 טון, צפויה להתפרק ולהישלח ליקב של גב ליד סטלנבוש בדרום אפריקה, שם יתקיימו בעזרתה אירועי התרמה נוספים – הפעם אולי חביות יין ריקות ישוגרו באוויר. מאז 1995, משפחת גב מנהלת את יקב Journey's End Wines שמספק יינות מובחרים למסעדות יוקרה, וכעת ממנפת את היצירתיות גם לאירועי צדקה מיוחדים. השילוב בין הנדסה ימי-ביניימית והתרמה עכשווית לא רק סייע בגיוס כסף לכנסייה, אלא גם העניק חוויה מיוחדת לצופים – והראה שאפשר לחשוב מחוץ לקופסה כשזה נוגע לגיוס תרומות קהילתי.

article_content: Roger Ross Williams, director of 'Cassandro', discussed the importance of portraying a positive queer story in his biopic about a real-life gay amateur wrestler who challenged the norms of Mexican lucha libre. “It was important to share a positive and inspirational queer story—someone who inspired me,” Williams shared at a panel for the MGM Amazon Studios film at Deadline’s Contenders Film: Los Angeles. Williams recounted that after making a short film about the wrestling star, he told Cassandro, “You’re it! You’re my first scripted film.” He added, “I fell in love with his energy, positivity, and the power of his story. In a macho, male-dominated, and often homophobic world, he reclaimed his power. He turned negativity into strength, becoming a superhero and conquering the world of lucha libre.” Gael García Bernal plays Cassandro. Costume designer María Estela Fernández described him as a 'very generous actor.' She said it was amazing for everyone to see him dressed as an exótico, and that he was clearly enjoying himself. Williams joked, 'He owned the spandex.' Williams also revealed that Cassandro, though still alive, suffered a stroke shortly before filming began and is now paralyzed. Despite this, Cassandro attended the set in a wheelchair and was deeply moved watching Gael portray him. Williams recalled that seeing Cassandro watch the finished film—mimicking the action on screen, especially scenes with his mother and his big match with Santo—was the 'greatest screening of my life.' The panel was hosted at Deadline’s Contenders Film: Los Angeles, with sponsorship from United for Business.
translated_content: רוג'ר רוס וויליאמס, הבמאי של 'קאסנדרו', שיתף בחשיבות שבהצגת סיפור קווירי חיובי בביוגרפיה על מתאבק הומוסקסואל חובב מהחיים האמיתיים, שטלטל את עולם הלוצ'ה ליברה במקסיקו. "היה חשוב לי לספר סיפור קווירי חיובי ומעורר השראה—מישהו שהיווה לי השראה", אמר וויליאמס בפאנל לסרט של MGM Amazon Studios באירוע Contenders Film של דדליין בלוס אנג'לס. וויליאמס סיפר שלאחר שעשה סרט קצר על כוכב ההיאבקות, אמר לקאסנדרו: "אתה זה! אתה הסרט העלילתי הראשון שלי." הוא הוסיף: "התאהבתי באנרגיה, בחיוביות ובעוצמה של הסיפור שלו. בעולם גברי, דומיננטי ולעיתים הומופובי, הוא תבע את הכוח שלו מחדש. הוא הפך את השליליות לעוצמה, הפך לגיבור-על וכבש את עולם הלוצ'ה ליברה." גאל גרסיה ברנאל מגלם את קאסנדרו. מעצבת התלבושות מריה אסטרה פרננדס תיארה אותו כ'שחקן מאוד נדיב'. היא אמרה שחזותו כאקזוטיקו הייתה מדהימה לכולם, ושברנאל נראה ממש נהנה. וויליאמס התבדח: 'הספנדקס היו שלו.' וויליאמס חשף גם כי קאסנדרו, שכיום עדיין חי, עבר שבץ מוחי זמן קצר לפני תחילת הצילומים וכיום משותק. למרות זאת, קאסנדרו הגיע לסט על כיסא גלגלים והתרגש מאוד לראות את גאל מגלם אותו. וויליאמס סיפר שהמעמד שבו קאסנדרו צפה בסרט המוגמר—וחיקה את הפעולות על המסך, במיוחד בסצנות עם אמו ובקרב הגדול מול סנטו—היה 'ההקרנה הכי מרגשת בחיי.' הפאנל נערך באירוע Contenders Film של דדליין בלוס אנג'לס, בחסות United for Business.

During the 1970s and 1980s, Gdansk’s shipyard was a global focal point. The Polish port’s shipyard employed roughly 20,000 workers, constructing container ships and naval vessels mainly for Eastern Europe’s communist countries. It was also the birthplace of the Solidarity movement—led by electrician Lech Walesa—which ignited widespread civil resistance to communism across the region.

Today, over three decades later, the shipyard presents a very different picture. Employment has shrunk to around 2,000 people, and work is irregular. While the shipyard occasionally refurbishes cruise ships and builds a few ferries, large-scale shipbuilding has largely ceased.

Yet one operation keeps part of the shipyard alive: Sunreef Yachts, a French company, has been manufacturing luxury catamarans in Gdansk since 2002. “We are making history too. We started with container ships and continue now with pleasure boats for millionaires worldwide,” says Sunreef’s Rafat Lenartowski.

Poland’s economy grew about 4% last year, and the luxury goods sector remained largely resilient to the global downturn. This has benefited Sunreef’s local employees, many of whom are highly skilled specialists, often from families with deep ties to the shipyard.

"This means a lot to me," says Adam Muczynski, a 32-year-old Sunreef worker whose father was a shipyard electrician during the 1980s. "Everyone talks about the Gdansk shipyard. This factory is crucial to Polish people."

The shipyard’s construction halls have produced over 60 luxury vessels, and there’s hope about the future. “We’re still receiving many offers, especially from emerging markets,” Lenartowski adds.

בשנות ה-70 וה-80, מספנות גדנסק היו מוקד עולמי. המספנה בעיר הנמל הפולנית העסיקה כ-20,000 עובדים, שבנו אוניות מכולה וכלי שיט צבאיים בעיקר למדינות קומוניסטיות במזרח אירופה. זה גם היה המקום בו נולדה תנועת סולידריות בראשות החשמלאי לך ואלנסה, שהציתה התנגדות אזרחית נרחבת לקומוניזם ברחבי האזור.

היום, יותר משלושים שנה מאוחר יותר, המספנה נראית שונה מאוד. מספר העובדים הצטמצם לכ-2,000, והעבודה לא קבועה. לעיתים משופצים כאן אניות נופש או נבנים מעבורות, אך בניית אוניות גדולות כמעט והפסיקה.

ובכל זאת, פעילות אחת שומרת על המספנה: חברת Sunreef Yachts הצרפתית בונה יאכטות קטמרן יוקרתיות בגדנסק מאז 2002. "אנחנו עושים היסטוריה גם כן. פעם בנינו אוניות מכולה, והיום אנחנו ממשיכים עם סירות נופש לעשירים מכל העולם", אומר רפאט לנארטובסקי מחברת סנריף.

הכלכלה הפולנית צמחה בכ-4% בשנה שעברה, ותעשיית מוצרי היוקרה כמעט שלא נפגעה מהמשבר הכלכלי העולמי. זה היטיב עם העובדים המקומיים של סנריף, שרבים מהם בעלי מיומנות גבוהה ולעיתים קרובות ממשפחות ותיקות במספנה.

"זה חשוב לי מאוד," אומר אדם מוצ'ינסקי, בן 32, עובד סנריף, שאביו היה חשמלאי במספנה בשנות ה-80. "כולם מדברים על המספנה של גדנסק. המפעל הזה חשוב מאוד לפולנים."

במספנה יוצרו למעלה מ-60 כלי שיט יוקרתיים, ויש תקווה לעתיד. "אנחנו עדיין מקבלים הרבה הצעות, במיוחד מהשווקים המתפתחים," מוסיף לנארטובסקי.

article_content: Marcus Volke, who killed his wife Mayang Prasetyo before taking his own life, was laid to rest in his hometown of Ballarat, Victoria. Family and friends gathered at the Doveton Park Funeral Centre to remember the 28-year-old, with music from Queen, Pink Floyd, and Metallica played during the service. Volke worked as a male escort under the name 'Heath'. Mayang Prasetyo, originally from Indonesia, was a transgender woman and sex worker. On October 4, police discovered Mayang’s remains at the couple’s new apartment in Teneriffe, Brisbane, a case now treated as a murder-suicide. Instead of flowers, Volke’s family requested donations be made to the mental health organization beyondblue. During the funeral, Volke’s uncle described him as caring, loyal, and gentle, sharing memories from his childhood. Previously, a candlelight vigil honored Mayang Prasetyo in Brisbane’s New Farm Park. Friends described her as kind, generous, ambitious, and someone who loved travel, fashion, and being with friends. The couple had met in 2009 while working at Melbourne’s Pleasure Dome brothel and later continued as private escorts. After Mayang’s death, several people offered to adopt her dogs. Police investigations revealed that Volke fled the scene before taking his own life and noted that the smell from the apartment led to the discovery. Social media saw an outpouring of grief and support for both families. Mayang is remembered not for her tragic death, but for the positive impact she had on those around her. Her story resonated with many people who recognized the value of her life beyond her profession or gender identity.
translated_content: מרקוס וולקה, שרצח את אשתו מאיאנג פראסטיו ואז שם קץ לחייו, הובא למנוחות בעיר הולדתו בלאראט שבוויקטוריה. בני משפחה וחברים התכנסו במרכז ההלוויות דובטון פארק כדי להיפרד ממרקוס בן ה-28, כשבמהלך הטקס הושמעו שירים של קווין, פינק פלויד ומטאליקה. וולקה עבד כליווי גברי בשם 'הית'. מאיאנג פראסטיו, במקור מאינדונזיה, הייתה אישה טרנסג'נדרית ועבדה כמלווה. ב-4 באוקטובר נמצאו שרידיה בדירת בני הזוג בטרנטיף, בריסביין. המקרה מטופל כרצח והתאבדות. בני משפחתו של וולקה ביקשו מהמוזמנים לתרום לארגון לבריאות הנפש 'ביונדבלו' במקום להביא פרחים. בהלוויה תיאר דודו של וולקה אותו כאדם אכפתי, נאמן ועדין, ושיתף זיכרונות מילדותו. לפני כן התקיים משמר נרות לזכרה של מאיאנג פראסטיו בפארק ניו פארם בבריסביין. חבריה תיארו אותה כאדם נדיב, שאפתני, אוהב לטייל, חובבת אופנה ואחת שנהנתה להיות מוקפת בחברים. השניים הכירו בשנת 2009 בעת שעבדו במועדון הליווי 'פלז'ר דום' במלבורן, ובהמשך עבדו בליווי פרטי. לאחר מותה של מאיאנג, הציעו רבים לאמץ את כלביה. המשטרה חקרה ומצאה שוולקה נמלט מהדירה בטרם התאבד, והריח החריג היה זה שהוביל לגילוי המקרה. ברשתות החברתיות הופיע גל של תמיכה וניחומים עבור שתי המשפחות. מאיאנג נזכרת לא בשל מותה הטרגי, אלא בזכות ההשפעה החיובית שהייתה לה על סביבתה. סיפורה נגע ברבים שהכירו בערכה מעבר למקצועה או זהותה המגדרית.

article_content: Manchester, New Hampshire (CNN) -- New Hampshire Republicans approach the presidential debate differently than typical voters nationwide. The state's mix of fiscal conservatism and social tolerance presents a unique challenge for the seven GOP candidates at St. Anselm College. Answers that are popular in Iowa may not resonate as well in New Hampshire, often called the Granite State. While discussions of faith are common in other early primary states and important to many Republican voters, religion plays a less central role in New Hampshire, where social conservatives have limited influence. Only about a quarter of Granite Staters attend church on a typical Sunday, well below the national average. New Hampshire is also one of the few states where same-sex marriage is legal. In 2009, a Democratic legislature and governor replaced civil unions with same-sex marriage, which angered many local Republicans. Despite a shift to the right in both houses of the state legislature during the 2010 elections, repealing the same-sex marriage law has not become a major GOP priority. A University of New Hampshire poll from February found that 37% of Republicans strongly support repeal, while only 5% of all voters consider ending same-sex marriage to be extremely important. As a result, questions about divisive social issues may attract more attention in places like Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, than in Hampton Beach, New Hampshire. Other issues are more vital locally. New Hampshire's reputation as a conservative Republican stronghold is rooted in decades of small-government advocacy, notably from former Governor Meldrim Thomson. His populist motto, "Ax the Tax," has kept sales and income taxes politically toxic here for many years. A new wave of populism arrived in November, with Tea Party-backed candidates winning numerous legislative seats and eventually leading the party by electing allies as House speaker and state party chairman. This new climate has brought libertarian and fiscal conservative issues to the forefront. Previous efforts to weaken unions failed, but now labor has fewer Republican allies. A right-to-work bill, making most union membership voluntary, could soon be passed over Governor John Lynch's veto. Many activists prioritize limiting government power, often championing the 10th Amendment as a shield against federal overreach. They reject 'compassionate conservatism,' viewing it as expanding bureaucracy. Eminent domain is another government authority distrusted by these conservatives. A controversial power line plan involving state seizure of rural land already faces strong opposition, and the votes of these new activists could block it. Questions about these topics may seem unusual elsewhere, but not in New Hampshire. The answers carry weight as Republicans and independents start evaluating candidates. To avoid missteps, candidates must recognize that although the Granite State is evolving, it remains distinct. Treating its voters the same as those in Iowa would be a mistake—just like mixing up ethanol and maple syrup.
translated_content: מנצ'סטר, ניו המפשייר (CNN) -- רפובליקנים בניו המפשייר מתייחסים לעימות הנשיאותי בצורה שונה מהבוחרים הרגילים ברחבי המדינה. השילוב של שמרנות פיסקלית וסובלנות חברתית מציב אתגר ייחודי לשבעת המועמדים הרפובליקנים במכללת סנט אנסלם. תשובות שזוכות להצלחה באייווה לא בהכרח יעבדו באותה מידה במדינת הגרניט. בעוד שנושאי דת נפוצים במדינות בחירות מוקדמות אחרות וחשובים לרבים מהבוחרים הרפובליקנים, לדת תפקיד פחות מרכזי בניו המפשייר, שם לשמרנים החברתיים השפעה מוגבלת. רק כרבע מתושבי המדינה הולכים לכנסייה ביום ראשון טיפוסי, הרבה פחות מהממוצע הארצי. בנוסף, ניו המפשייר היא אחת המדינות הבודדות שבהן נישואי אותו מין חוקיים. בשנת 2009, ממשל ודמוקרטים החליפו את האיחודים האזרחיים בנישואי אותו מין, דבר שקומם רפובליקנים מקומיים רבים. למרות המעבר ימינה בשני בתי המחוקקים בבחירות 2010, ביטול חוק נישואי אותו מין לא הפך לעדיפות מרכזית עבור הרפובליקנים. סקר מאוניברסיטת ניו המפשייר מפברואר מצא כי 37% מהרפובליקנים תומכים נחרצות בביטול החוק, ואילו רק 5% מכלל הבוחרים רואים בכך עניין חשוב מאוד. כתוצאה מכך, שאלות בסוגיות חברתיות נפיצות כנראה יעניינו יותר תושבים במירטל ביץ', דרום קרוליינה, מאשר בחוף המפטון שבניו המפשייר. נושאים אחרים חשובים יותר מקומית. המוניטין של ניו המפשייר כמעוז שמרני מושתת על דורות של מדיניות ממשלה קטנה, במיוחד בשל המושל לשעבר מלדרים תומסון. הסיסמה הפופוליסטית שלו, 'Ax the Tax', השאירה את מסי המכירה וההכנסה מחוץ לחוק המקומי במשך שנים רבות. גל חדש של פופוליזם הגיע בנובמבר, כשמועמדי Tea Party זכו במושבים רבים בבית המחוקקים והובילו את המפלגה לבחירת בני ברית לתפקיד יושבי ראש בית הנבחרים והמפלגה. המציאות הפוליטית החדשה הזו שמה במרכז הבמה נושאים ליברטריאנים ושמרניים פיסקלית. מאמצים קודמים להחלשת האיגודים המקצועיים נכשלו, אך כיום יש לעבודה פחות בעלי ברית רפובליקנים. חוק 'זכות לעבוד', שיהפוך את רוב החברות באיגוד לוולונטרית, עשוי לעבור על אף הווטו של המושל ג'ון לינץ'. רבים מהפעילים מדגישים את הגבלת כוח הממשלה, מרבים לחגוג את התיקון ה-10 כחומה בפני התערבות פדרלית. הם דוחים 'שמרנות רחומה', ורואים בכך הרחבת בירוקרטיה. גם סמכות הפקעה זוכה לחוסר אמון מצד השמרנים החדשים. תוכנית קווי מתח שנויה במחלוקת בה הממשל ישתלט על אדמות כפריות, כבר נתקלה בהתנגדות רבה, והקולות של הפעילים החדשים עשויים למנוע אותה. שאלות על הנושאים הללו עשויות להיות מוזרות במקומות אחרים, אך לא כאן. לתשובות תהיה השפעה משמעותית כאשר בוחרי הרפובליקנים והעצמאים יתחילו לשקול מועמדים. כדי להימנע מטעויות, על המועמדים להכיר בכך שלמרות שגרניט סטייט משתנה, היא עדיין ייחודית. להתייחס לבוחרים כאן כמו לבוחרי אייווה זו טעות—כמו לבלבל בין אתנול לסירופ מייפל.

article_content: A new survey suggests that most internet users and technology experts believe cash and credit cards will become obsolete within the next decade as mobile payments gain popularity. According to the Pew Internet & American Life Project, 65% of respondents think the 'mobile wallet' will become the primary method for day-to-day purchases by 2020. Mobile payments, such as paying for coffee with apps or using tools like Google Wallet and Square, are already gaining traction. A December report from comScore found that 38% of smartphone owners had made some type of purchase via their phones. This aligns with a previous Pew study, which revealed that a third of smartphone users had used their phones for banking tasks, and about 46% had paid for an app through their devices. The new survey also found that 65% of respondents agreed that by 2020, most people will rely on smart devices for purchases, significantly reducing the need for cash or credit cards, especially in developed countries. Susan Crawford, a Harvard University professor and former technology policy adviser to President Barack Obama, noted that monetary systems are fundamentally based on trust and routine. She argued that advancing to more abstract forms of payment, like digital wallets, is a natural progression. However, one-third of respondents disagreed with the idea of an 'all-digital, all-the-time' payment system, citing security concerns. Peter J. McCann, a senior engineer at FutureWei Technologies, described current systems as insecure, emphasizing the need for improvement. Supporters of mobile payments argue that security is comparable to current credit card technology. Mung-Ki Woo, head of mobile for MasterCard Worldwide, said that mobile payment technology is 'basically the same' as that used for credit cards. The Pew report notes that the rapid increase in smartphone ownership, convenience, and security make mobile payment systems an appealing replacement for traditional payment methods. The survey, conducted in collaboration with Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center, gathered responses from 1,021 internet experts and users. As a non-random survey, it does not provide a margin of error.
translated_content: סקר חדש מעלה שרוב משתמשי האינטרנט והמומחים לטכנולוגיה סבורים שמזומן וכרטיסי אשראי יהפכו למיושנים בעשור הקרוב, ככל שתשלומים ניידים יהפכו לפופולריים יותר. לפי פרויקט Pew Internet & American Life, 65% מהמשיבים מאמינים ש'ארנק נייד' יהפוך לאמצעי המרכזי לרכישות יומיומיות עד 2020. תשלומים ניידים כמו תשלום על קפה באמצעות אפליקציות או שימוש בכלים כמו Google Wallet ו-Square כבר תופסים תאוצה. בדוח דצמבר של comScore נמצא ש-38% מבעלי הסמארטפונים ביצעו רכישה כלשהי במכשיר שלהם. ממצא זה תואם למחקר קודם של Pew, שגילה ששליש מבעלי הסמארטפונים השתמשו בטלפון לפעולות בנקאיות, וכ-46% ביצעו תשלום על אפליקציה דרך המכשיר. הסקר החדש גם מצא כי 65% מהמשיבים מסכימים שעד 2020, רוב האנשים יסתמכו על מכשירים חכמים לרכישות, מה שיקטין משמעותית את הצורך במזומן או כרטיסי אשראי, במיוחד בעולם המפותח. פרופ' סוזן קרופורד מאוניברסיטת הרווארד ולשעבר יועצת למדיניות טכנולוגיה לנשיא אובמה, ציינה שמערכות כספיות מבוססות על אמון ודפוסי התנהגות. היא טענה שהמעבר לאמצעי תשלום מופשטים יותר כמו ארנקים דיגיטליים הוא התפתחות טבעית. אולם שליש מהמשיבים לא מסכימים עם הרעיון של מערכת תשלום דיגיטלית בלבד, citing חששות אבטחה כסיבה העיקרית לכך. פיטר ג' מקאן, מהנדס בכיר ב-FutureWei Technologies, תיאר את המערכות הנוכחיות כלא בטוחות והדגיש את הצורך בשיפור. תומכי תשלומים ניידים טוענים שהאבטחה דומה לטכנולוגיית כרטיסי האשראי. מונג-קי וו, ראש תחום מובייל ב-MasterCard Worldwide, אמר שטכנולוגיית תשלומים ניידים היא 'בעצם אותה טכנולוגיה' כמו כרטיסי אשראי. דוח Pew מציין כי העלייה המהירה בבעלות על סמארטפונים, הנוחות ורמת האבטחה הופכים את המערכות האלו לאופציה בולטת להחלפת שיטות תשלום מסורתיות. הסקר, שנעשה בשותפות עם Imagining the Internet Center של אוניברסיטת אילון, כלל 1,021 מומחי אינטרנט ומשתמשים. מאחר שמדובר בסקר לא אקראי, אין לו מרווח טעות.

article_content: MailOnline has launched its Fantasy Football season, encouraging fans to assemble their £100 million squads. One notable new face in the Premier League this year is Muhamed Besic, Everton's recent midfield acquisition. Besic has swiftly impressed supporters with his determined style and ability to distribute play, based on his strong pre-season outings. The 21-year-old Bosnia and Herzegovina international joined Everton from Hungarian club Ferencvaros for £4 million. Known for his defensive toughness and passing ability, Besic enhances Roberto Martinez's midfield setup and is expected to supply key passes to forwards like Romelu Lukaku. He has already begun settling in at Goodison Park, having been named on the bench for Everton's match against Leicester City. While fans appreciate his tenacity, his aggressive play might result in bookings—a factor for fantasy football managers to consider. Born in Berlin in September 1992, Besic has previously played for Hamburg (2010–2012, three appearances) and Ferencvaros (2012–2014, 47 appearances, one goal). He featured in the 2014 World Cup for Bosnia and Herzegovina, with an impressive 91% pass completion, almost 91% successful tackles, and over two interceptions per game. For fantasy players, Besic represents good value at £5.9 million, making him a more affordable pick than midfielders like Wilfried Zaha, Joe Allen, or Emanuele Giaccherini. His potential for regular appearances under Martinez and his balanced skill set could result in steady point accumulation. While Besic tends to operate deeper in midfield, his reliability and Everton’s preference for a settled lineup mean he’s likely to earn consistent points. His vision and passing may also contribute to assists and bonus points. Everton manager Roberto Martinez praises Besic for his mix of technical ability and physical strength, and notes how quickly he's adapted to the club. Martinez believes Besic’s strong mentality, evident in his World Cup form, makes him an excellent fit for the Premier League and predicts he will be a significant contributor this season.

article_content: FIFA has named Portuguese official Luis Godinho as the referee for the upcoming international friendly between Nigeria and Saudi Arabia. The match will be played at the Estadio Municipal de Portimão in Portugal on October 13 at 5pm. According to a statement by Ademola Olajire, Director of Communications for the Nigeria Football Federation, Godinho will be supported by assistant referees Bruno Jesus and Tiago Costa, with Miguel Noguera serving as the fourth official. The Video Assistant Referee (VAR) duties will be led by Helder Carvalho, assisted by Bruno Vieira. This will be only the second-ever meeting between Nigeria’s Super Eagles and Saudi Arabia’s Green Falcons. Their first encounter took place on May 25, 2010, in a pre-World Cup friendly in Austria, ending in a goalless draw. Nigeria will also face Mozambique’s Mambas in another friendly at the same venue on October 16 at 4pm.

article_content: Dr. Kim Seok-Kwun, a surgeon at Dong-A University Hospital in Busan, is recognized as a pioneer for transgender surgery in South Korea, often called the 'father of South Korean transgender people.' He has performed around 320 gender-affirming surgeries over the last 28 years, the most by any one doctor in the country. South Korea is known for its conservative attitudes toward gender and sexuality, with significant resistance from both religious and cultural segments of society. Dr. Kim, a devout Protestant, initially struggled with the ethical implications of his work but decided to prioritize the well-being of his patients, many of whom view the surgery as a matter of life or death. He requires patients to provide diagnoses from at least two psychiatrists, live as their identified gender for at least a year, and typically have parental consent. One of his most famous patients is Harisu, a renowned transgender entertainer in South Korea, who attributes her new life and happiness to Dr. Kim's surgery. Dr. Kim began performing these surgeries in the 1980s, after various people seeking help approached him despite his initial lack of experience. Over the years, Dr. Kim has seen the profile of his patients change. While early patients were older and often faced family opposition, more patients today are in their 20s and sometimes receive family support. Legal and social challenges for transgender people persist. South Korean law requires certain conditions for legal gender change, and conservative attitudes remain strong. Despite limited legal advancement, there have been incremental changes in societal attitudes, reflected in media and cases of legal gender recognition. Dr. Kim continues his work despite criticism from conservative religious leaders and remains committed to supporting his patients.

article_content: Indian cricket star Virat Kohli reached a historic milestone by hitting his 50th ODI century, surpassing Sachin Tendulkar's previous record of 49 ODI centuries. Kohli achieved this during his innings of 117 against New Zealand in the World Cup semifinal, securing India a place in the final for the first time since 2011. Former Indian batsman Gundappa Viswanath, in an interview with PTI, praised Kohli’s consistency—noting his frequent scores in the 70s and 80s in addition to his centuries—and remarked that few contemporary players can aspire to reach such heights. Rohit Sharma, for instance, has over 30 ODI centuries, but is still a considerable distance behind. Kohli’s prowess is not limited to ODIs; he also has 29 Test centuries and one T20I hundred, totaling 80 international hundreds. During the same semifinal, Kohli became the first batter to score more than 700 runs in a single World Cup edition, with at least one match left to play. Viswanath emphasized that he does not compare Kohli and Tendulkar directly, describing them as different cricketers and legends, with Kohli often referring to Tendulkar as his mentor. While Tendulkar remains the only batsman with 100 international centuries (51 in Tests, 49 in ODIs), Viswanath commented that whether Kohli can reach this tally depends on the number of future Test matches he plays. Viswanath, a participant in the 1975 and 1979 World Cups, also praised KL Rahul for his effective wicketkeeping and sharp DRS (Decision Review System) judgments, which have prevented India from making wrong referrals multiple times during the tournament. He additionally highlighted that, although MS Dhoni was well regarded for his DRS abilities as captain, Rahul’s accuracy in assisting captain Rohit Sharma (who is often fielding in other positions) has been a significant advantage. To rejuvenate interest in the ODI format, which faces competition from T20 cricket, Viswanath proposed holding more regular multi-nation tournaments—such as bi-annual competitions similar to the Champions Trophy. The ICC Champions Trophy is scheduled to return in 2025, with Pakistan set to host. With the World Cup final between India and Australia approaching in Ahmedabad, hotel prices and airfares have risen significantly, creating challenges for traveling fans. Separately, OpenAI has removed its cofounder and CEO Sam Altman due to internal disagreements, while the Indian government approved IT hardware manufacturing proposals from 27 companies, anticipating substantial investment in the coming years.

article_content: Dr. Steve Mann, a University of Toronto professor and MIT alum, has dedicated decades to developing wearable augmented-reality devices to help those with impaired vision. While visiting Paris with his family in 2012, he entered a McDonald's on the Champs Elysee wearing his EyeTap glasses—a groundbreaking computerized device securely affixed to his head. After showing a doctor's note about his EyeTap to a questioning staff member, Dr. Mann and his family proceeded to order food. However, while they were eating, another employee attempted to forcibly remove the device. Two more staff joined in, tearing up his note and other documents and pushing him out of the restaurant. The EyeTap, designed to project video and augmented data directly onto the retina, inadvertently recorded the incident because damage during the struggle caused it to save images it otherwise would not store. Dr. Mann tried several times to contact McDonald's regarding the event but received no reply. He is asking only for the device to be replaced. Dr. Mann's EyeTap, invented in 1999, predates devices like Google Glass by many years.

Generative artificial intelligence is struggling to find a viable way to make money, according to Naveen Rao, head of generative-AI strategy at Databricks. After Databricks acquired his startup MosaicML for $1.3 billion, Rao sees parallels between today's generative AI landscape and Napster, the popular early-2000s music-sharing platform that was ultimately shut down by a flurry of copyright lawsuits. As Napster faded, Apple’s iTunes rose to dominate music streaming by creating a legal framework for digital music sales.

Rao believes generative AI faces a similar challenge. These AI systems, which generate text or art, rely on ingesting large datasets — often including copyrighted content — to train their models. The launch of OpenAI’s ChatGPT has fueled rapid growth in AI model development, but it’s also generated widespread concerns about using copyrighted material in training data, raising risks for intellectual property infringement and potential lawsuits against companies.

Legal action has already begun. Last month, 17 prominent authors, such as Jodi Picoult and George R.R. Martin, filed a federal lawsuit against OpenAI, accusing it of 'systematic theft on a mass scale' by using their works to train its AI models. Rao finds these claims reminiscent of the lawsuits that led to Napster's downfall, such as Metallica's case in 2000. He stresses the importance of respecting copyrighted works and developing tools to ensure compliance.

With a background in verification engineering and a doctorate in neuroscience, Rao has long focused on building solutions for these challenges. He previously researched neuromorphic computing at Qualcomm and sold his first startup, Nervana, to Intel for over $350 million. At MosaicML, Rao created a platform enabling companies to build custom large language models (LLMs) and securely train them on their proprietary data using transparent, open-source tools. Rao’s core argument is that empowering organizations to train AI on their own data reduces legal exposure and enables more sustainable business models for AI services.

Differentiation is another key factor motivating companies to build their own LLMs. MosaicML’s infrastructure is designed to help companies create customized models in ways that platforms like OpenAI’s do not. 'We build tools that help companies set their AI apart and leverage their unique data,' Rao explained to Insider.

Rao sees this technology as democratizing generative AI, a mission he has continued at Databricks. In April, Databricks launched Dolly, an open-source-trained LLM that allows companies to develop their own models. Rao concludes that broad access to AI tools is essential: 'Technology will always have the potential for misuse, but the best way to counteract that is by giving more people the same advanced tools and empowering them to use AI for good.'

בינה מלאכותית גנרטיבית מתקשה למצוא מודל רווחי, כך אומר נאווין ראו, ראש תחום האסטרטגיה של בינה מלאכותית גנרטיבית ב-Databricks. אחרי ש-Databricks רכשה את הסטארט-אפ שלו MosaicML ב-1.3 מיליארד דולר, ראו רואה דמיון למצב היום עם בינה מלאכותית ולסיפור של נאפסטר – פלטפורמת שיתוף מוזיקה פופולרית מתחילת שנות האלפיים שנסגרה בעקבות תביעות זכויות יוצרים. בזמן שנאפסטר נעלמה, אפל השיקה את iTunes והשתלטה על תחום הסטרימינג החוקי.

ראו סבור שתחום הבינה המלאכותית הגנרטיבית מתמודד עם אתגר דומה: מערכות בינה מלאכותית כאלה, המייצרות טקסט או אומנות, משתמשות במאגרי מידע עצומים – לעיתים עם חומרים מוגנים בזכויות יוצרים – כדי לאמן את המודלים שלהן. ההשקה של ChatGPT של OpenAI האיצה את התחרות, אך גם העלתה חששות לפריצת זכויות יוצרים וסיכונים משפטיים לחברות.

תביעות כבר החלו. רק בחודש שעבר, 17 סופרים בכירים כמו ג'ודי פיקו וג'ורג' ר"ר מרטין תבעו את OpenAI בטענה ל"גניבה שיטתית בהיקף המוני" כשיצירותיהם שימשו לאימון המודלים. ראו רואה בכך דמיון לתביעות שפגעו בנאפסטר, כמו זו של מטאליקה ב-2000. הוא מדגיש את חשיבות כיבוד זכויות יוצרים ויצירת כלים לאכיפה.

עם רקע בהנדסת אימות ודוקטורט במדעי המוח, ראו פועל שנים למצוא פתרונות. הוא חקר מחשוב נוירומורפי ב-Qualcomm ומכר את הסטארט-אפ Nervana ל-Intel ביותר מ-350 מיליון דולר. ב-MosaicML יצר פלטפורמה שמאפשרת לחברות לבנות מודלי שפה גדולים משלהן ולאמן אותם על נתוניהן בצורה פתוחה ומאובטחת. ראו טוען כי לאפשר לארגונים לאמן מודלים על בסיס הנתונים שלהם מפחית סיכונים משפטיים ומאפשר רווחיות.

סיבה נוספת שחברות רוצות מודלים משלהן היא הצורך בבידול. MosaicML מספקת תשתית שמאפשרת לבנות מודלים מותאמים אישית – בשונה מפלטפורמות כמו OpenAI. "אנחנו מספקים כלים שעוזרים לחברות לבדל את הבינה המלאכותית שלהן ולמנף נתונים ייחודיים," אמר ראו ל-Insider.

ראו רואה בכך דמוקרטיזציה של הבינה המלאכותית הגנרטיבית – חזון שהוא ממשיך לקדם ב-Databricks, שבה השיקו באפריל את Dolly – מודל קוד פתוח שמאפשר לחברות לפתח מודלים משלהן. ראו מסכם: "לטכנולוגיה תמיד יהיה פוטנציאל לשימוש לרעה, והדרך למנוע זאת היא להנגיש את הכלים ליותר אנשים – ולאפשר להם לעשות שימוש נכון בטכנולוגיה."

San Francisco is hosting a pivotal court case examining whether California's Proposition 8, the ban on same-sex marriage, stands up to constitutional scrutiny. Central to the proceedings are two couples, Kristin Perry and Sandra Stier of Berkeley and Jeffrey Zarrillo and Paul Katami from Los Angeles, representing same-sex couples unable to legally marry despite years together and raising families.

Chief Judge Vaughn R. Walker presides over the trial, which is viewed as potentially influencing marriage rights nationwide. The U.S. Supreme Court has temporarily halted plans for live video of the trial while it reviews the matter, underscoring broad public interest.

Arguing against Proposition 8, the plaintiffs claim it violates the U.S. Constitution by denying a basic right to marry, referencing historic Supreme Court cases on civil rights and equality. Their case is led by Ted Olson and David Boies, attorneys famed for their work in high-profile legal battles.

Despite being listed as defendants, Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger and Attorney General Jerry Brown are not defending Proposition 8; Brown supports the plaintiffs and Schwarzenegger has remained neutral.

Supporters of Proposition 8, such as Andrew Pugno from Protect Marriage, argue that marriage should remain defined as between a man and a woman for social stability and the welfare of children, noting that 52% of California voters supported the ban in 2008.

After the 2008 vote, California’s highest court upheld the measure in 2009 but allowed approximately 18,000 same-sex marriages performed before its passage to remain valid. The case, backed in part by celebrity activists like Rob Reiner, is under intense national scrutiny.

The plaintiffs’ legal team asserts that marriage is a fundamental right for all, regardless of sexual orientation. The result of this trial is expected to set a major precedent, possibly shaping American legal and social life for generations.

article_content: Three watercolour paintings by Professor Alan Dunlop, illustrating the aftermath of the 2018 fire at Glasgow School of Art's famed Mackintosh building, have been shortlisted for the 2023 Architecture Drawing Prize. Professor Dunlop, a GSA graduate and architect, created these works as a response to the destruction. His paintings are among 250 hand-drawn entries vying for the prize, part of the World Architecture Festival, which starts next week in Singapore. Final results will be announced in January, with displays planned for Singapore and London. Professor Dunlop, an ardent supporter of hand-drawing in architecture, emphasizes its role in creative thinking and problem-solving. He often urges his students to sketch regularly. In addition to his artistic endeavors, Dunlop has frequently criticized the school’s administration, particularly following two catastrophic fires and subsequent reconstruction delays. The Mackintosh building remains under restoration, facing setbacks due to both the pandemic and an ongoing fire investigation. Protective measures are in place as drying and repairs continue—a process expected to take around two years. Fortunately, significant portions of the building’s brick and stone survived and will be either restored or replaced as reconstruction moves forward. The nearby Reid Building, which opened in 2014 and now accommodates the architecture school, also suffered heat damage during the fire but is currently being repaired. School leaders, such as director Penny Macbeth, have acknowledged the complexity and challenges of the rebuild and have congratulated Professor Dunlop for his recognition, hoping it will help draw positive attention and support for the ongoing project.

article_content: Police in Belfast, Northern Ireland, were monitoring for further violence on Wednesday after a third consecutive night of unrest left one officer injured, officials reported. About 150 nationalist youths fired shots and threw petrol bombs and a pipe bomb at officers, even shining high-powered laser pens at them. The Police Service of Northern Ireland has initiated an investigation to identify those involved in Tuesday night’s violence. Burning barricades were set up in the Ardoyne area—a hotspot for recent clashes. Police stated that one vehicle was hijacked and set on fire. Officers deployed water cannons to disperse the protesters, and by 2 a.m. local time (9 p.m. ET Tuesday), the situation had calmed. One officer suffered minor injuries, though earlier reports indicated there might have been multiple injuries. Disturbances also broke out in other areas of Belfast. The latest unrest began after authorities allowed a Protestant parade to pass through a mainly Catholic neighborhood on July 12. Known as The Twelfth, this holiday observes King William III’s 1689 victory over James II and has long been a source of tension. Police had to remove demonstrators who held a sit-down protest to block this year’s march, after which rioting erupted again and more than 50 officers were reported injured. The previous night, 27 officers were hurt, including three who were shot at close range by a masked individual with a shotgun. In the House of Commons on Wednesday, British Prime Minister David Cameron condemned the 'completely unacceptable behavior' of the protesters and commended police for their bravery and restraint. Cameron said that more than 80 officers had been injured during the incidents, facing attacks involving petrol bombs, pipe bombs, bricks, and gunfire. He noted the police responded with baton rounds and water cannons when necessary. Cameron added that since Northern Ireland’s police force is now under local control, everyone is expected to cooperate with them. Reporting by journalist Peter Taggart in Belfast.

article_content: Marijuana is the most commonly used illegal drug globally, but addiction to legal painkillers results in the highest number of drug-related deaths, according to recent research. Scientists found that cannabis use surpasses that of cocaine and heroin in the first comprehensive global study of drug use. However, researchers from the University of Washington discovered that opioid painkillers such as Vicodin, OxyContin, and codeine were responsible for over half of the estimated 78,000 drug-related deaths worldwide in 2010. The study, published in The Lancet, did not include data on ecstasy and hallucinogens. It also found that men in their 20s are most likely to abuse drugs, with the highest rates in Australia, the UK, Russia, and the U.S. The research further showed that countries with strict anti-drug policies have higher rates of drug-related deaths than those focusing on harm reduction strategies, such as methadone clinics and needle exchange programs. Theo Vos, from the University of Washington's Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation and senior author, emphasized that although concrete data is limited, modeling indicates widespread drug problems. Professor Vos added that drug abuse patterns often reflect local production—cocaine in North America, amphetamines and opioids in Asia and Australia—with the lowest rates in Asia and Africa. The research highlighted that prescription drug abuse has become a significant issue in the U.S. only over the past decade. Michael Lysnkey, of the National Addiction Centre at King's College London, who co-authored an accompanying commentary, warned health officials that rising prescription drug abuse requires urgent attention. He also noted that drug use trends could shift unexpectedly in the future. A related study found that mental health and drug abuse problems—including depression, schizophrenia, and cocaine addiction—cause more deaths worldwide than AIDS, tuberculosis, diabetes, or road accidents. In some developing countries, such as India, efforts to combat AIDS have also helped reduce drug abuse by supporting people to overcome addiction, according to Vikram Patel of the Centre for Global Mental Health at the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine. Patel suggested that drug policies should be similar to those used for tobacco control, proposing that decriminalization could transform public health strategies and free up resources for addiction treatment. The study's results coincide with the U.S. government's announcement that it will not challenge Colorado and Washington's legalization of marijuana. Instead, federal authorities plan to focus on preventing underage access and keeping profits out of criminal hands. Additionally, 20 other states permit marijuana for medical use, although it remains illegal under federal law.

A year ago, Ayoze Perez was playing in Spain’s second division for his hometown club Tenerife, cheered by 10,000 fans including friends and family. He was thriving in familiar surroundings. Today, the 21-year-old starts regularly for Newcastle United in the Premier League, performing before 52,000 fans at St James’ Park, far from the Canary Islands.

Perez’s impressive transition has brought new acclaim: he scored a memorable back-heel at West Brom—his personal favorite—and has attracted praise from manager Alan Pardew and club legend Alan Shearer. While he misses Tenerife’s warm winters and local traditions, he’s enthusiastically embraced Newcastle’s culture: Friday rugby games with his brother Samuel and sampling fish and chips.

Despite the colder climate, Perez’s goal-scoring form remains strong. After 16 goals for Tenerife last season, he has netted three in as many starts for Newcastle, earning significant local coverage. 

‘I’ve settled in much quicker than I imagined,’ Perez says. He’s scored decisive goals against Tottenham and Liverpool and a goal-of-the-season contender at West Brom. He appreciates Newcastle’s culture and is prepared for winter with coats and jumpers. 

Manager Alan Pardew describes Perez as 'a bright, low maintenance player,’ and ‘a fearless predator’ on the field. While expecting a season of adjustment, Pardew has relied on Perez, especially as other strikers struggled with injuries and form, contributing to six straight wins.

Perez is surprised at how quickly he has adapted but believes his confidence is crucial for success. Aware he must improve physically, he enjoys training and is eager to contribute to Newcastle’s rise.

Reflecting on recent changes, Perez notes that just two months ago he was with the under-21 team. Scoring Premier League goals—especially his header at Tottenham and winner against Liverpool—are dreams realized and memories he will always cherish.

Perez’s story with Newcastle is just beginning, and he looks ahead with excitement.

article_content: The Dover Police Department in Delaware has released a dashcam video that showcases the human side of law enforcement. In the video, Master Corporal Jeff Davis is seen driving in his police vehicle and lip-syncing to Taylor Swift's hit song 'Shake It Off.' The clip quickly went viral, being shared nearly 2,000 times within 24 hours on the department's Facebook page and attracting positive feedback worldwide. According to Dover Police Corporal Mark Hoffman, the purpose of the video is to change public perception of police officers by highlighting their relatable, lighter side. 'We're trying to humanize police officers. People often see us as robots in uniforms, so we wanted to show a more personable side of our force,' Hoffman said. The recording is part of a social media outreach initiative called 'Dash Cam Confessionals,' launched in celebration of the department reaching 10,000 Facebook followers. Davis, a 19-year veteran, was enthusiastic about participating, partly because his 10-year-old daughter is a Taylor Swift fan and he is familiar with the song. Although the video appears to show Davis pausing for passing vehicles, it was actually filmed in a secluded parking lot over two takes. 'It was a fun and positive project, especially with all the negative publicity police have received lately,' Davis said. Judging by the enthusiastic response, he believes that people appreciate seeing police from a new perspective.

article_content: A Brazilian court has issued an arrest warrant for a Google executive, accusing him of violating the country's election laws by not removing YouTube videos allegedly slandering a mayoral candidate. The warrant, issued by a judge in Mato Grosso do Sul, charges Fabio Jose Silva Coelho, the president of Google Brazil, with disobedience after failing to take down videos about Alcides Bernal—who is running for mayor in Campo Grande. The court also ordered Embratel, a Brazilian internet provider, to block YouTube in Campo Grande for 24 hours. Google has stated in court documents that it is not responsible for the content of the videos and has asked for the case to be dismissed. According to Brazilian law, disobeying a judge's order can lead to up to six months in prison or a fine. Earlier this month, another Google executive faced a similar order in Paraiba over allegedly slanderous content but was cleared when the court agreed that Google only provides a platform. Facebook also faced a temporary removal order for a political page in August, but that decision was suspended by the judge two days later.

article_content: Nigeria’s Minister of Finance and Coordinating Minister of the Economy, Wale Edun, has underscored the Federal Government's push to adopt Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) as a significant opportunity for private sector participation. At the unveiling of the 2023 Nigerian Banking Sector Report by Afrinvest in Lagos, Edun—represented by Dr. Armstrong Takang, Managing Director of the Ministry Of Finance Incorporated—explained that wider CNG adoption could lower production costs for both households and businesses, but noted that more investment is needed. Edun stated, 'You may have noticed the campaign to substitute Premium Motor Spirit (PMS) with CNG. This move is still in its early stages, but CNG costs can be as low as half, or even a quarter, compared to PMS. As a gas-producing nation, and since gas is cleaner than PMS, Nigeria can benefit greatly by pursuing this path, reducing transportation and industrial fuel costs. The government is planning further actions to stimulate demand in the CNG value chain. Investments are needed in conversion kits, refueling stations, infrastructure, and other related areas, and this opens doors for private sector collaboration.' The Federal Government’s targets of attaining an 18% tax-to-GDP ratio and a 25% revenue-to-GDP ratio by 2026 remain unchanged. On the broader economic outlook, Edun commented, 'We anticipate that ongoing reforms, when successfully implemented, will lead to significant improvements in key revenue and debt indicators by 2025.' Ike Chioke, Group Managing Director of Afrinvest Group, also emphasized the importance of public-private collaboration for Nigeria’s progress. He referenced predictions in Afrinvest’s previous sector report, which foreshadowed the subsidy removal and devaluation of the Naira—developments that have now affected the entire population. Chioke noted that while recent steps by the government indicate a shift in economic perspective, much more work remains. He called for coordinated action across government and the private sector, particularly regarding fiscal and monetary policy, the oil and gas industry, financing strategies, and ensuring transparency about budget sources and supplementary funding.

article_content: At the University of Wisconsin's Center for Dairy Research, cheese tasters carefully evaluate pizzas and cheeses as part of the center’s research initiatives. When the center advertised openings for new cheese tasters—a sought-after position in Wisconsin—over 250 people applied for just five part-time roles. Those chosen undergo detailed training to assess cheeses made by graduate students, local pizza makers, and Wisconsin’s renowned cheese producers. Sensory coordinator Brandon Prochaska emphasizes the importance of objective and repeatable tasting. Human input is essential, as researchers need real feedback about flavor, texture, stretching, and baking. Traditionally, tasters were students, but the recent decision to accept community members sparked considerable attention, especially after this year’s job posting for a 'Descriptive Sensory Panelist' went viral thanks to coverage by CNN, NBC, and Business Insider. Prochaska suggests the position’s popularity comes from both the universal love of cheese and the idea of getting paid to taste it. Some applicants even showcased their experience by listing pizzas they've sampled. Applicants were evaluated on their ability to discern flavors and textures, such as differentiating acid from bitter or recognizing which cheese was saltiest or oldest. One successful candidate, Kelly Kluck—already certified in wine tasting—expressed excitement at turning a hobby into a $15-an-hour job. The center’s panel consists of about 20-25 people, meeting weekly—including on holidays—to help ensure research is sound and repeatable. Training covers a vast lexicon of tasting terms from 'buttery' and 'milky' to 'goaty' and 'wet dog.' Panelists follow detailed protocols for every stage: chewing, nose pinching, and spitting, mirroring the techniques of professional wine tasting. Panelists use tools like buttery popcorn and flavor wheels to train their palates before assessing butteriness and texture. During training, Prochaska might describe mozzarella as 'vinegar-y' or 'citrus-y,' while panelist Kelly Kluck refined that as 'lemongrass-y,' demonstrating the nuance involved. Pizza evaluations differ from standard pizzas: research versions have a uniform crust, only cheese, and measured sauce. Tasters visually assess browning, measure cheese stretch, and taste at specific temperatures—all while recording data on iPads. Panelists, like Carolyn Haswell and Denise Dipert, note the process is more scientific than expected but appreciate contributing to student research. Projects include developing a standard for measuring cheese curd’s 'squeakiness,' requiring consistent protocols like temperature and chew count. Combining fun and science, the panel attracts a variety of enthusiasts, such as job seeker Carrie Cook and retired finance professional Jim DiUlio. Both value the chance to help improve Wisconsin’s signature cheese products.

article_content: JAKARTA, Indonesia — Anwar Usman, Chief Justice of Indonesia’s Constitutional Court, has been removed from his position after an ethics council ruled on Tuesday that he committed a serious code of ethics violation. Usman was found guilty of making last-minute changes to election candidacy rules, which allowed President Joko Widodo’s eldest son, Gibran Rakabuming Raka, to qualify as a vice presidential candidate in the upcoming election. Jimly Asshiddiqie, head of the court’s Honorary Council (ethics council), said Usman violated fundamental principles such as impartiality, integrity, competence, equality, independence, appropriateness, and decency. This comes shortly after the Constitutional Court, by a 5-4 majority, introduced an exception to the minimum age of 40 for presidential and vice presidential candidates, enabling Raka, 36 and current mayor of Surakarta, to run. Various organizations and rights activists challenged this October 16 decision, arguing Usman should have recused himself because Raka is his nephew by marriage and thus represented a conflict of interest. The three-member ethics panel removed Usman as chief justice but decided he could remain as a justice under specific conditions: he must not participate in election dispute cases until 2028, cannot be nominated for chief justice during this term, but could potentially return as chief after 2028 if reappointed and age requirements are met. Panel member Bintan R. Saragih dissented, advocating for Usman's permanent dismissal, which she argued was required by law for serious violations. Most complaints sought to annul the controversial ruling, but Asshiddiqie clarified that the ethics council has no authority to overturn court decisions. Usman recused himself from three earlier petitions challenging the age rule, but then participated in a later successful petition that allowed regional leaders under 40 to seek national office; he voted with the majority. After this, defense minister and presidential hopeful Prabowo Subianto chose Raka as his vice-presidential running mate. Critics have denounced the court’s ruling as nepotistic, fearing it could erode democratic norms. The court formed the ethics council in response to public outcry, assigning it to investigate the nine justices, especially those supporting the amendment. Dewa Gede Palguna, former justice and legal expert, said these sanctions won’t alter the ruling but could help rebuild public trust. “The Constitutional Court’s ruling is final and absolutely valid,” he told Kompas TV. The court is also reviewing proposals to limit the age exception further, specifying that only candidates under 40 who have served two terms as provincial governors would qualify. The General Election Commission will close candidate registration at midnight on Wednesday. Indonesia, the world's third-largest democracy, will hold both legislative and presidential elections in February 2024.
translated_content: ג'קרטה, אינדונזיה — אנואר אוסמן, נשיא בית המשפט החוקתי של אינדונזיה, הודח מתפקידו לאחר שמועצת האתיקה קבעה ביום שלישי כי ביצע הפרה חמורה של כללי האתיקה. אוסמן נמצא אשם בשינוי ברגע האחרון של הכללים לכניסת מועמדים לבחירות, מה שאפשר לבנו הבכור של הנשיא ג'וקו ווידודו, גיבראן רקאבומינג ראקה, להגיש מועמדות לתפקיד סגן הנשיא בבחירות הקרובות. ג'ימלי אסהדיקיה, ראש מועצת הכבוד של בית המשפט (מועצת האתיקה), אמר כי אוסמן הפר עקרונות בסיסיים כמו הוגנות, יושרה, מקצועיות, שוויון, עצמאות, התאמה וענווה. זאת לאחר שבית המשפט החוקתי, ברוב של 5 נגד 4, אישר חריג לדרישת הגיל המינימלית של 40 למועמדי נשיאות וסגן נשיאות, מה שאפשר לראקה, בן 36 וכיום ראש עיריית סורקארטה, להתמודד. ארגונים ופעילי זכויות אדם ערערו על ההחלטה מ-16 באוקטובר בטענה שאוסמן היה צריך לפסול את עצמו בשל ניגוד עניינים – ראקה הוא אחיינו מצד נישואין. ועדת האתיקה הדיחה את אוסמן מתפקיד הנשיא, אך אפשרה לו להמשיך לכהן כשופט בתנאים: הוא לא ישתתף בתיקי בחירות עד 2028, ולא יוכל להתמודד שוב לתפקיד הנשיא בתקופה זו, אך יוכל להיבחר שוב אחרי 2028 אם יעמוד בתנאים. חברת הפאנל בינטן ר. סאראגיה הוציאה דעה שונה, וטענה שיש להדיח את אוסמן לצמיתות, כפי שמורה החוק להפרות חמורות. רוב התלונות ביקשו לבטל את פסיקת בית המשפט, אך אסהדיקיה הבהיר למועצת האתיקה כי אין לה סמכות לבטל פסקי דין. אוסמן פסל את עצמו משלוש עתירות בענייני גיל, אך השתתף בדיון בעתירה המאוחרת שהביאה לאישור החריגה, והצביע עם הרוב. לאחר מכן בחר שר ההגנה והמועמד לנשיאות פראבוו סוביונטו את ראקה כמועמד לסגן נשיא. מבקרים גינו את פסיקת בית המשפט כהעדפת מקורבים ופגיעה בדמוקרטיה. בתגובה לביקורת הציבורית ייסד בית המשפט ועדת אתיקה לבחינת תשעת השופטים, במיוחד התומכים בתיקון. דווה גד פאלאגונה, שופט ויועץ משפטי לשעבר, אמר כי הסנקציות נגד אוסמן לא ישנו את תוקף הפסיקה אך עשויות לסייע בהחזרת אמון הציבור. "פסק הדין של בית המשפט החוקתי הוא סופי ותקף לחלוטין", אמר ל-Kompas TV. כעת בית המשפט בוחן הצעות להגביל עוד יותר את חריגת הגיל, כך שרק מתחת לגיל 40 ששימשו פעמיים כמושלים מחוזיים יוכלו להגיש מועמדות. ועדת הבחירות הכללית תסגור את ההרשמה למועמדים בחצות רביעי. אינדונזיה, הדמוקרטיה השלישית בגודלה בעולם, תקיים בחירות לפרלמנט ולנשיאות בפברואר 2024.

article_content: South Africa captain Jean de Villiers is hopeful he will be fit for the Rugby World Cup in England this September after undergoing reconstructive surgery on his left knee on Thursday. De Villiers, 33, dislocated his kneecap during the 12-6 defeat to Wales in Cardiff on Saturday. Initial estimates suggested he could be sidelined for at least eight months. Team doctor Craig Roberts stated that the procedure went well, but it is difficult at this stage to determine an exact timeline for De Villiers' return. The use of an artificial graft is expected to accelerate his rehabilitation and hopefully increase his chances of a successful recovery. De Villiers stated his goal is to be ready for the World Cup. 'My focus will now be on the arrival of our third child in the coming days,' he added. 'After that, I will concentrate on recovering as quickly as possible so I can begin rehabilitation. I will do everything in my power to make it to England.'

article_content: Pro-Palestinian rallies took place near the US and German embassies in Lebanon as demonstrators voiced their outrage at Israel’s military actions in Gaza and the support provided by the US and Germany. On Wednesday, protesters in a northern suburb of Beirut waved Palestinian and Lebanese party flags, throwing rocks, water bottles, and firecrackers at security barricades near the US embassy. Security forces responded with tear gas and water cannons, dispersing the crowd. Among the protesters was a 20-year-old Palestinian man from Nahr el-Bared refugee camp, who expressed his anger at American support for Israel. Lebanon and Israel, still technically at war and lacking diplomatic relations, saw thousands gather at the US embassy, urging an end to hostilities as the possibility of an Israeli ground invasion of Gaza looms. Protesters, arriving from all over Lebanon by bus, car, and scooter, carried flags representing Palestinian factions as well as Lebanese parties such as Hezbollah, which had called for 'a day of unprecedented anger.' Many demonstrators condemned what they see as unwavering US backing of Israel and alleged war crimes in Gaza. The US provides $3.8 billion annually in military aid to Israel and has consistently supported the country across various administrations. Tensions among the protesters intensified following a devastating explosion at Gaza’s al-Ahli Arab Hospital, which reportedly killed around 500 people. US President Joe Biden, during a meeting with Israel’s Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, suggested the blast was caused by 'the other team.' Following Hamas's October 7 attack on southern Israel, which left approximately 1,400 dead, Israeli bombing has killed more than 3,300 people in Gaza, about a third of them children. Protesters expressed anger not only over recent events, like the hospital explosion, but also due to ongoing issues. Ahmad, a 43-year-old resident of Burj el-Barajneh refugee camp, stressed the continued hardships Palestinians have faced, urging an end to civilian deaths. Many spoke of international double standards, where attacks on Palestinians go unaddressed. This sense of injustice is compounded by feelings that the global community ignores Palestinian suffering and by instances of dehumanizing language used by some Israeli officials. Protesters sat on barricades near the US embassy in Awkar, occasionally throwing objects at security forces, who responded with further crowd-control measures. Lebanon hosts about 210,000 Palestinian refugees, many confined to camps with restricted rights regarding property, education, and employment. The Lebanese left has historically supported the Palestinian cause, but current political parties offer rhetorical support rather than legislative changes to improve refugees’ lives. At the demonstrations, Lebanese political party flags flew alongside Palestinian ones, but not all attendees were part of any faction. Some Lebanese, including Maronites, joined to protest the bombing of a Christian hospital and US foreign policy. Others, like shopkeeper Eliane, agreed with the protest's aims but objected to the disruptive methods and property damage caused. Additional demonstrations occurred near the German embassy and in Beirut's southern suburb of Haret Hreik. In Dekwaneh, a protest near the German embassy featured no political flags, with some participants attending to avoid association with groups like Hezbollah. Attendees emphasized the importance of opposing civilian killings and called for an end to Israel’s occupation and alleged apartheid policies, echoing statements by organizations like Amnesty International. Zainab, a 26-year-old student from Gaza, and Najla el-Hassan, a mother, voiced personal distress and helplessness at the ongoing violence. Lebanese police stood by as protesters vented their frustration at their inability to change the situation, with officers noting the outpouring was a typical emotional response.

מתעלמת מסבל הפלסטינים ומהתבטאויות משפילות של כמה גורמים ישראלים. מפגינים ישבו על המחסומים ליד שגרירות ארה״ב בעוקר, לפעמים יידו חפצים לעבר כוחות הביטחון, שענו באמצעים לפיזור הפגנות. בלבנון חיים כ-210,000 פליטים פלסטינים, שרבים מהם גרים במחנות ולרוב מוגבלים בזכויותיהם בנוגע לרכוש, חינוך ותעסוקה. השמאל הלבנוני תמך בפלסטינים באופן מסורתי, אך כיום התמיכה מצד מפלגות פוליטיות היא לרוב רטורית ולא מגובה בשינויים חקיקתיים לטובת הפליטים. בהפגנות נופפו דגלי מפלגות לבנוניות לצד דגלי פלסטין, אך חלק מהנוכחים לא השתייכו לפלג כלשהו. לבנונים, כולל נוצרים מרונים, באו למחות על הפגזת בית החולים הנוצרי ועל מדיניות החוץ האמריקאית. אחרים, כמו איליין, בעלת מכולת, הסכימו עם מטרות ההפגנה אך הסתייגו משיטות שגרמו נזק לרכוש. הפגנות נוספות התקיימו ליד שגרירות גרמניה ובפרבר הדרומי של ביירות, חארת ח'רייק. בדקוונה שבצפון ביירות התקיימה הפגנה בלי דגלי מפלגות, מתוך רצון להתרחק משיוך לחיזבאללה. משתתפים הדגישו את הצורך להתנגד להרג אזרחים ודרשו לסיים את הכיבוש ולהוקיע את מה שהוגדר כאפרטהייד, בהתאם לעמדות ארגונים כמו article_content: Jack Harper is quickly establishing himself as a name to watch in football. The 18-year-old Scot has emerged as a promising talent within Real Madrid’s youth team and may have an impact on the senior side in the future. During Real Madrid’s youth 2-0 victory over Basle on Tuesday, Harper made a strong impression: he scored a goal, struck the bar, hit the post, and forced the opposition goalkeeper into two impressive saves. A central figure throughout the match, Harper demonstrated skill and flair reminiscent of top players in the club’s history. While comparisons to stars like Cristiano Ronaldo are premature, his development is clearly on the right track. Born in February 1996, Harper has lived most of his life in Spain since his family, originally from Barrhead, East Renfrewshire, relocated there nearly 18 years ago. Spotted by Real Madrid scouts playing for local Malaga club Los Boliches, he joined the Real Madrid Academy at 13 and signed a long-term contract two years ago. Harper is a versatile forward, often operating as a No. 10, known for his creativity, ability to cut inside from the wing, and eye for goal. His poise and understanding of the game set him apart from peers, and he has received guidance from notable figures, including Iker Casillas. Harper has also been pictured with Portuguese legend Luis Figo at the club’s training ground. Internationally, Harper represents Scotland at the youth level. He has attracted the attention of Scottish national team coaches, with SFA Performance Director Mark Wotte visiting Madrid to follow his progress. article_content: Ahead of the upcoming friendlies against Saudi Arabia and Mozambique, Super Eagles head coach Jose Peseiro has brought in Sadiq Umar, Chidozie Awaziem, and Tyronne Ebuehi as last-minute additions. These changes were made following injuries to Taiwo Awoniyi, Jamilu Collins, and Ola Aina. Nigeria is set to play Saudi Arabia’s Green Falcons in Portimão, Portugal, on October 13, and Mozambique in the same city on October 16. The squad is scheduled to arrive in Faro, Portugal, on October 10. Collins and Aina, initially included in Peseiro's squad despite fitness doubts, have been confirmed unavailable for the international break per an announcement on the team’s X account, leading to Awaziem and Ebuehi’s late inclusion. Taiwo Awoniyi will miss about a month of action due to a groin injury suffered during Nottingham Forest’s match against Crystal Palace in the Premier League. Real Sociedad’s Sadiq Umar was called up as his replacement. Though Umar hasn’t found the net yet this season, he remains in the spotlight with transfer rumors linking him to Manchester United. Umar’s last season was disrupted by injuries, but he had a standout spell at Almería, scoring 43 goals and providing 13 assists in 84 games. Concerns arose regarding the fitness of Bright Osayi-Samuel and Jordan Torunarigha (KAA Gent), but Torunarigha's recent appearance for Gent against KRC Genk has allayed some concerns ahead of the Saudi Arabia game.

article_content: FA chairman Greg Dyke will not return the £16,000 watch he received as a gift from FIFA during the 2014 World Cup, choosing instead to donate it to charity. Although Dyke must pay £3,000 in tax on the watch whether he keeps it or returns it, he has decided to auction the watch, with the proceeds going to Breast Cancer Care. 'I am not going to send it back to the FIFA ethics committee as they have requested,' Dyke told ITV. He added, 'I've now been told that I've got to pay £3,000 VAT on this watch regardless of whether I send it back or not. So I've decided instead to pay the VAT and give the watch to this year's FA charity.' FIFA executive committee member Michel D'Hooghe recently described the £16,000 watches given to officials at the summer's World Cup by the Brazilian federation as the most 'poisonous present' he has ever received. Last month, FIFA's ethics committee asked for all the watches to be returned.

Terror suspect Abu Qatada is making what government lawyers describe as a last-ditch attempt to avoid deportation from the UK to Jordan, according to arguments heard at a tribunal today. Qatada, referred to by a judge as Osama bin Laden's right-hand man in Europe, is scheduled to face retrial in Jordan on terrorism charges.

UK Home Secretary Theresa May has received assurances from Jordanian authorities that, if deported, Qatada will receive a fair trial and that no evidence obtained through torture will be used against him, said Robin Tam QC, representing the Home Secretary. The government asserts that the statements of Qatada's former co-defendants, Al-Hamasher and Abu Hawsher—which are alleged to have been obtained by torture—will no longer be admissible in Jordanian courts.

Presiding over the Special Immigration Appeals Commission (Siac), Mr Justice Mitting noted, 'The evidence seems extremely thin,' as he began a review of the case. Qatada, also known as Omar Mahmoud Mohammed Othman, has managed to resist deportation for over a decade, consistently appealing decisions against him in the UK.

Mr Tam dismissed claims from Qatada’s legal team that former co-defendants would face mistreatment if summoned to testify, calling such assertions 'last-ditch arguments.' He also rejected the idea that Qatada would be taken into administrative detention in Jordan, reiterating that Jordanian law prohibits the use of prior statements from the co-defendants and guarantees their fresh, unpressured testimony if required at retrial.

The Home Secretary plans to present new information and diplomatic assurances from Jordan, supported by testimony from Anthony Layden, the former British ambassador to Libya and expert in diplomatic negotiations. Layden is expected to describe the steps Jordanian authorities have taken to guarantee a fair retrial for Qatada. A Jordanian legal advisor to the British Embassy in Amman is also expected to provide evidence.

However, Danny Friedman, representing Qatada, argued that serious issues remain regarding the evidence used to convict Qatada in absentia in Jordan and assured that further appeals are not just attempts to delay the process. Even if the current appeal fails, Qatada could pursue further appeals, potentially extending proceedings for months if not years, especially in the European Court of Human Rights.

Government figures indicate that efforts to deport Qatada over the last decade have cost nearly £1 million in legal fees, with total costs of his detention, surveillance, and legal aid estimated at over £3 million. Qatada has been held in detention for seven years, reportedly the longest administrative detention in recent UK history. He was most recently denied bail due to concerns he might abscond during the Olympic Games, when security resources were stretched.

While judges acknowledge the possibility of further appeals, they note that any challenge would need to be based on points of law and that it is not certain the European Court in Strasbourg would accept the case. Qatada was convicted in Jordan in his absence on charges tied to 1998 terror attacks and is accused of appearing in hate sermons linked to the September 11 bombers. The current appeal will examine whether the assurances secured by the Home Secretary from Jordan are sufficient to guarantee a fair retrial and allow for Qatada’s deportation to proceed.

החשוד בטרור אבו קטאדה מנסה, לדברי עורכי הדין של הממשלה, לבצע ניסיון אחרון להימנע מגירוש מבריטניה לירדן, כך נטען היום בדיון בבית הדין. קטאדה, שכונה על ידי שופט 'יד ימינו של אוסמה בן לאדן באירופה', אמור לעמוד למשפט חוזר בנסיבות אישומי טרור בירדן.

שרת הפנים הבריטית תרזה מיי קיבלה מהשלטונות הירדניים ערבויות לכך שאם יגורש, קטאדה יקבל משפט הוגן ולא תשמשנה ראיות שהושגו בעינויים נגדו, כך לדברי רובין טאם QC, בא כוח הממשלה. הממשלה קובעת כי הצהרות שהושגו מעמיתיו לשעבר של קטאדה, אל-חמאשר ואבו חואשר, שעל פי החשד נגבו בעינויים, לא יהיו קבילות עוד בבתי המשפט בירדן.

יושב ראש ועדת הערעורים המיוחדת (Siac), השופט מיטינג, העיר: 'הראיות נראות דלות מאוד', כשהחל בסקירת המקרה. קטאדה, שמוכר גם בשם עומאר מחמוד מוחמד עות'מאן, הצליח בעשור האחרון להמשיך ולהיאבק בגירושו בערעורים מתמשכים.

טאם דחה את טענות צוות ההגנה של קטאדה שלפיהן עמיתיו לשעבר עלולים להיחשף להתעללות או ללחץ אם יידרשו להעיד במשפט חוזר, וכינה זאת 'טענות של הרגע האחרון'. הוא גם שלל את האפשרות שקטאדה יילקח למעצר מנהלי בירדן, והדגיש כי על פי החוק הירדני, לא ניתן לעשות שימוש בהצהרות קודמות של העדים והם יקבלו הזדמנות להגיש עדות חופשית ונטולת לחץ במשפט החוזר.

שרת הפנים צפויה להציג מידע חדש וערבויות דיפלומטיות מירדן, בתמיכה בעדויות של אנתוני ליידן, שגריר בריטניה לשעבר בלוב ומומחה לערבויות דיפלומטיות. ליידן יתאר אילו צעדים ננקטו על ידי הרשויות הירדניות להבטחת משפט הוגן לקטאדה. גם יועץ משפטי ירדני לשגרירות הבריטית בעמאן אמור להעיד.

יחד עם זאת, דני פרידמן, עורך דינו של קטאדה, טען שעדיין קיימות בעיות חמורות בנוגע לראיות ששימשו להרשעתו שלא בפניו, והבהיר שערעורים נוספים אינם נועדו רק לדחות את התהליך. גם אם הערעור הנוכחי יידחה, קטאדה עדיין עשוי להמשיך לערער, מה שעלול למשוך את ההליכים חודשים ואף שנים, במיוחד בבית הדין האירופי לזכויות אדם.

על פי נתוני הממשלה, ניסיונות גירושו של קטאדה בעשור האחרון עלו קרוב למיליון ליש״ט בהוצאות משפט, וסך כל העלויות כולל מעצר, פיקוח וסיוע משפטי מוערך ביותר מ-3 מיליון ליש״ט. קטאדה שוהה במעצר כבר שבע שנים, ככל הנראה הזמן הארוך ביותר למעצר מנהלי בתולדות בריטניה המודרנית. הוא סורב לשחרור בערבות בשל חשש לבריחה בעת האולימפיאדה בלונדון, כשהרשויות היו במתח אבטחה מוגבר.
