article_content: Marcus Schrenker, a financial advisor accused of deceiving his clients, was located in Quincy, Florida, after officials say he tried to end his own life. Schrenker was discovered at a campsite with injuries suggestive of a suicide attempt and was quickly transported to a Tallahassee hospital for treatment. Authorities, led by the U.S. Marshals Service, had been tracking Schrenker since he disappeared Sunday. Found inside a tent, he had apparently harmed himself and was airlifted for medical care. Officials are withholding details about how they traced him to the campsite, as the investigation is ongoing. Earlier on Tuesday, Indiana authorities charged Schrenker with illegal activities as an investment advisor, suspecting him of defrauding investors through three companies he controlled. Investigators say Schrenker tried to stage his own death by parachuting out of a small plane, which later crashed in Florida, nearly hitting nearby homes. On Sunday, Schrenker took off solo in a Piper PA-46 from Anderson, Indiana, heading toward Destin, Florida. During his flight, he radioed that his windshield had shattered and he was bleeding, but police suspect he then set the plane on autopilot and secretly parachuted away. The empty plane crashed near East Milton, Florida, with no blood found onboard, contradicting his distress call. Shortly after the crash, Schrenker appeared in Childersburg, Alabama, claiming to have had a canoeing accident. Police, unaware of the plane incident, identified him with his pilot’s license and took him to a hotel. He registered under a fake name and vanished before authorities could return the next day. Investigators suspect Schrenker fled the hotel on a red Yamaha motorcycle he had secretly stored under a different name. The storage unit was left with wet clothes, but the bike was gone. Schrenker’s elaborate escape plan also included using a brown pickup truck and trailer to hide the motorcycle. Military jets were dispatched to intercept Schrenker’s abandoned aircraft, witnessing the plane’s empty cockpit moments before it crashed. Officials describe Schrenker as dangerous, noting his disregard for human life by letting the plane crash unmanned. Schrenker’s friends expressed confusion over his actions, unable to understand why he would abandon a plane mid-flight. One friend, Tom Britt, received an email from Schrenker saying he was reading news about his disappearance, felt overwhelmed, and hinted at suicidal thoughts. Meanwhile, a judge in Indiana froze Schrenker’s assets and those of his companies, all under investigation for fraudulent financial activities. Public records name him president of Heritage Wealth Management, Heritage Insurance Services, and Icon Wealth Management—all subjects of the ongoing probe.

article_content: The Universal Basic Education Commission (UBEC) reported on Monday that the number of primary school teachers in Nigeria dropped by 29% after the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic. The commission emphasized that funding for education should not fall solely on the government, noting Nigeria currently has 45 million children enrolled in the basic education system. UBEC's Executive Secretary, Dr. Hamid Boboyyi, shared these points at a 'One-day Meeting on Promoting Partnership with the Organised Private Sector' held in Abuja. Dr. Boboyyi highlighted that, despite annual education allocations exceeding N100 billion, government resources alone are insufficient to sustain the sector. He called on private sector organizations to recognize the importance of early childhood education, explaining, 'Federal Government resources alone cannot run the system. With over 45 million children in basic education, we need more classrooms, learning materials, and support.' He added that state allocations, which can reach a maximum of around N3 billion, are also inadequate for the system's vast needs. Dr. Boboyyi noted the aim of the meeting was to foster a functional partnership with the private sector to enhance education delivery. He also expressed concern over the 29% drop in Nigeria's basic education teaching workforce after the COVID-19 pandemic, attributing the decline to financial challenges impacting teacher motivation and retention. 'If we cannot pay and properly motivate our teachers, it will be difficult to deliver the high-quality education we all desire,' he stated. Mrs. Adegoke Adekanla, Head of the Oando Foundation, commended UBEC’s commitment to advancing basic education. Represented by Ede Okechukwu, she emphasized that basic education is the foundation of all learning and development, calling it a fundamental right and the cornerstone of a just, prosperous society. She stressed that access to quality basic education is a moral imperative that shapes Nigeria's future. The commission reiterated the call for a collaborative approach among all stakeholders to secure sustainable funding and effective delivery of basic education in Nigeria.

"אם לא נוכל לשלם ולתגמל את המורים שלנו כראוי, יהיה קשה לספק חינוך איכותי כפי שכולנו חולמים," אמר. ראש קרן Oando, גב' אדגוקה אדקנלה, שיבחה את מחויבות UBEC לקידום החינוך הבסיסי. בהצהרתה על ידי נציג הקרן, אדה אוקצ'וקוו, היא הדגישה שחינוך בסיסי הוא הבסיס לכל למידה והתפתחות ומהווה זכות יסוד ואבן הייסוד לחברה צודקת ומשגשגת. היא ציינה כי גישה לחינוך בסיסי איכותי היא חובה מוסרית המעצבת את עתיד ניגריה. הנציבות חזרה על קריאתה לפעולה משותפת של כל בעלי העניין להבטחת מימון בר-קיימא ולמערכת חינוך בסיסי יעילה בניגריה.

A 132-year-old Winchester rifle was discovered propped against a juniper tree in Nevada's remote Great Basin National Park. Archaeologists found the .44-40 calibre Model 1873 Winchester during survey work on a rocky outcrop; its wooden stock was weathered and partially buried, and its metal barrel rusted from exposure. Manufactured in 1882, this rifle—nicknamed 'the gun that won the West'—is one of the most popular and historically significant firearms in U.S. history.

Experts are unsure exactly how long the rifle has rested undisturbed but believe it could have stood there for over a century. At the time of its manufacture, the Great Basin area was known for mining and farming, and such rifles were commonly used for protection and hunting.

In 1882, Winchester produced over 25,000 Model 1873 rifles, with prices dropping from about $50 to $25—a sign of their growing availability. The Model 1873, using a lever-action breech, allowed users to fire multiple shots before reloading. Typical rifles measured nearly 50 inches in length and weighed about 9.5 pounds. Between 1873 and 1916, Winchester produced 720,610 Model 1873s, earning it the nickname 'everyman's rifle.'

Nichole Andler, chief of interpretation at Great Basin National Park, explained, 'It looked like someone propped it up there, sat down to have their lunch, and walked off without it. It probably has a very interesting story, but it's one that could have happened to almost anyone living in the Great Basin Desert.'

The rifle was found unloaded and will be available for public viewing before being sent to conservation specialists. Preservation efforts will focus on stabilizing the wood and metal, ensuring the rifle remains as found. The Winchester Model 1873 holds a place in American history, frequently appearing in classic Hollywood Westerns such as 'Stagecoach' and 'Winchester '73.'

ניקול אנדלר, ראש תחום ההסברה בפארק הלאומי גרייט בייסין, סיפרה: 'נראה כאילו מישהו השעין את הרובה, התיישב לאכול צהריים, ואז קם והלך מבלי לקחת אותו. בטח יש לו סיפור מעניין, אבל זה סיפור שיכול היה לקרות לכל אחד שחי במדבר הגרייט בייסין.'

Suzanne Somers, most famous for starring in 'Three’s Company' and 'Step by Step', died peacefully at her home early on October 15, with her husband Alan, son Bruce, and family at her side. For over 23 years, she bravely battled breast cancer. Her loved ones had gathered to celebrate her 77th birthday on October 16, but instead paid tribute to her remarkable legacy.

Beyond acting, Suzanne was recognized as an entrepreneur and for her involvement in political discourse, openly expressing her views and affection for her country. Tributes flooded social media, highlighting her kindness, humor, generosity, and encouragement. Friends and colleagues shared stories of her nurturing nature and the positive impact she made on people’s lives. 

Her talents stretched beyond sitcoms; she competed on 'Dancing with the Stars' with Tony Dovolani and left a lasting impression as both an entertainer and a friend.

Rugby is recognized for its tough gameplay and limited protective equipment, with mouthguards being among the few forms of safety gear most players use. To further promote player welfare, World Rugby, the sport’s global governing organization, plans to roll out smart mouthguards utilizing sensor technology to monitor impacts and head acceleration during games. This system relays immediate information to sideline medical teams, enabling fast decisions about whether a player needs to be evaluated after a significant hit.

The decision follows findings from ice hockey research suggesting that smart mouthguards not only shield against dental injury but also decrease concussion risk by 20%. The devices, created by Prevent Biometrics, a company based in the United States, will have their first official use at the upcoming professional women’s WXV international rugby tournament. World Rugby is investing approximately €2 million (about $2.12 million) to help clubs, leagues, and rugby unions adopt this innovative safety technology.

Dr. Eanna Falvey, chief medical officer for World Rugby, expressed strong support for the initiative, highlighting the importance of reducing head impacts at every level of the sport and emphasizing that integrating smart mouthguards into regular gameplay advances player safety in meaningful ways.

Across the UK, restaurant, hotel, and B&B owners are seeing a significant rise in customers using TripAdvisor as a means of leverage. Some diners and guests threaten to leave negative reviews on the site unless they receive perks such as improved service, complimentary items, or free upgrades. Business owners describe an increase in 'gastronomic blackmail', where individuals demand a free bottle of wine, dessert, or discounts under the threat of unfavorable feedback. Some even falsely claim to work for TripAdvisor and threaten to post multiple negative reviews unless they are granted free services.

Martin Couchman, deputy chief executive of the British Hospitality Association, stated that he is currently in discussions with TripAdvisor to address this issue. He noted, 'Although it's hard to quantify exactly how widespread the problem is, there is a clear trend of a minority leveraging reviews for personal gain. These threats can occur during a visit, or worryingly, sometimes individuals who have not even visited the establishment post false negative reviews seeking compensation.'

Couchman advises businesses not to respond or offer incentives to reviewers they suspect are acting maliciously, but to report such cases to TripAdvisor, which actively works to prevent and remove inaccurate or harmful reviews. He encourages businesses experiencing ongoing problems to contact the British Hospitality Association for guidance.

Craig Savage, owner of the Double Barrel Real Steakhouse and Grill in Rotherham, South Yorkshire, reports that approximately 30 out of 1,000 weekly meals at his restaurant are affected by customers making threats in hope of a free meal. He explains that some individuals introduce themselves as senior TripAdvisor reviewers and then raise complaints shortly afterward, seeking compensation. Savage notes that while genuine customer dissatisfaction is addressed sincerely, he has observed a pattern of exploitation among some reviewers who appear primarily interested in receiving something for free.

A particular concern for Savage and his partner, Sarah Bird, is the increasing number of malicious online reviews from individuals who may not have even visited their restaurant. He recalls instances where people commented on issues that were factually incorrect, indicating deceitful motives.

TripAdvisor has reiterated its commitment to tackling such problems, with a spokesperson emphasizing that allegations of blackmail or threatening behavior are taken seriously. Business owners are encouraged to report threats immediately using TripAdvisor's Management Centre, which allows proactive measures to prevent suspicious reviews from ever appearing on the platform.

As digital devices become more affordable and global internet access expands, Sir Tim Berners-Lee—the world wide web’s creator—believes we must reconsider how we use technology. Following an event hosted by Sapient Nitro, Berners-Lee told CNN Smart Business that sensitive personal data, particularly health records, should be tightly protected and only accessible to authorized medical personnel, with robust accountability and tracking of data usage.

He also advocated for greater transparency within large businesses, encouraging openness both internally and externally while recognizing that some information should remain private. Critiquing banking security, Berners-Lee noted that practices like asking for passwords by phone are unsafe, and recommended that banks direct customers to use the contact numbers listed on their cards.

Looking ahead, Berners-Lee predicted advances where screens surpass human visual capabilities and audio systems feel indistinguishable from live performances. He foresees increased access to public and enterprise data, with a shift from reliance on traditional websites to more dynamic data interactions for commerce.

Berners-Lee concluded by calling for an Internet bill of rights to give users clear insight and control over how their data is managed online.

article_content: Patricia Krentcil, widely known as 'Tanning Mom', was accused of endangering her daughter by allegedly taking her into a tanning booth. The criminal charges were eventually dropped. Krentcil, 44, a mother of five from Nutley, New Jersey, told NBC News that she now plans to travel somewhere warm to sunbathe, joking that no one can arrest her for tanning anymore. Krentcil has been developing a tanning lotion line called Real Tan Mom Healthy Glow in hopes of earning money to pay off her legal fees. She also mentioned plans to write a book and pursue comedy. Last April, Krentcil was arrested and charged with child endangerment after her five-year-old daughter Anna, who is fair-skinned and red-haired, told a school nurse she had 'gone tanning with mommy' after staff noticed burns on her skin. Krentcil insists Anna was never in a tanning booth, emphasizing that the tanning room is separate from the booth. A jury ultimately did not indict Krentcil, and the charges were dropped. She appeared on various media outlets, including 'This Morning', to defend herself, stating that her love of tanning began when she was 23. She admitted she no longer tans, reflecting that the habit was unwise. Krentcil denied ever bringing Anna into the tanning booth, stating there is security camera evidence and witnesses who can support her version of events. She described the legal ordeal as a 'living hell' and expressed frustration with the continued public scrutiny. After a break from tanning, Krentcil revealed a lighter complexion in a recent magazine feature, though she admitted to feeling uncomfortable with the change. Krentcil has garnered further attention for her outspoken public persona, including a recent incident at a New York drag show where she was reportedly asked to leave after a disruptive appearance. Photos from Krentcil's twenties show a marked difference in her appearance, serving as evidence of the impact of her tanning habits on her skin.

article_content: During the Hamas attacks on Israeli border communities near Gaza on October 7, retired Israeli Major-General Noam Tibon demonstrated remarkable courage when he rescued his son, journalist Amir Tibon, and Amir’s family from their kibbutz in Nahal Oz. As gunfire drew nearer to their shelter, Amir contacted his father, who immediately assured, 'Trust me, I will come.' Noam, a counter-terrorism specialist, left Tel Aviv with his wife, armed only with a handgun, and drove south through active conflict zones. Along the way, Noam and his wife helped survivors fleeing the music festival massacre and assisted wounded Israeli soldiers. When they encountered a firefight, Noam and another soldier joined Israeli troops, helping engage the militants. Afterward, Noam’s wife transported wounded soldiers to a hospital. The Tibon family, including Amir’s wife Miri and daughters Galia and Carmel, waited in silence in their safe room, uncertain if help would arrive. After ten tense hours, Noam reached their kibbutz, knocked on the window, and called out, 'Amir, it's father, you can open.' The family, overwhelmed with relief, knew they were safe. Many on social media likened Noam’s actions to Liam Neeson’s character Bryan Mills from the film 'Taken', praising his determination and skill. Noam’s declaration, 'This is my profession, nobody can stop me,' drew comparisons to iconic lines from the movie. A former Credit Suisse banker, Andreas Bachmann, pleaded guilty to fraud charges in a U.S. federal court in Alexandria, Virginia. Bachmann is among eight former Credit Suisse bankers indicted for assisting wealthy Americans in evading taxes. He faces up to 46 months in prison, with sentencing scheduled for August. As part of his plea agreement, Bachmann is expected to cooperate with the ongoing Justice Department investigation into Credit Suisse. This cooperation may further scrutinize Credit Suisse CEO Brady Dougan’s claims that such tax evasion was the work of a few rogue bankers, and not condoned by the bank.

Bachmann was arrested on a 2011 warrant and released on $200,000 bond. Both his attorney and Credit Suisse declined immediate comment. The case highlights the difficulty of prosecuting Swiss bankers, as Switzerland does not treat tax evasion as a crime and will not extradite its citizens for such charges.

A Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations report found that Credit Suisse held up to $12 billion in assets for 22,000 U.S. clients—up to 95% of which was concealed from the IRS. Lawmakers recently criticized the Justice Department for not pursuing Credit Suisse and other banks involved in aiding tax evasion more aggressively.

The indictment alleges that Bachmann and his colleagues helped clients transfer funds to offshore tax havens using shell companies and other entities to hide assets. According to the indictment, Bachmann met with clients to advise on moving their assets when the U.S. began pressuring Swiss banks.

The Senate report detailed elaborate methods used by Credit Suisse bankers to help clients shield funds, including maintaining a discreet Zurich airport branch, using remote-controlled elevators, holding meetings in sparse rooms, and avoiding paper trails or written statements. One banker allegedly passed a client’s bank statement hidden inside a magazine.

CEO Brady Dougan expressed dismay at the conduct of implicated bankers, stating the bank is cooperating with U.S. authorities as much as Swiss law allows. This approach contrasts with that of UBS, a competing Swiss bank, which previously apologized and accepted corporate responsibility in a similar case.

Credit Suisse is reportedly in talks to settle charges with the Justice Department for around $800 million, a sum Senators Carl Levin and John McCain consider inadequate in light of the allegations.

article_content: An unprecedented demonstration is taking place in Paris this weekend, prompted by the ongoing war between Israel and Hamas and its effects in Europe. For the first time, representatives from all major French political parties, including the far right—but not the far left—will attend. On Sunday afternoon, thousands have responded to a call by the Speakers of both houses of parliament to show support for French 'Republican' values and to reject antisemitism, following a significant rise in antisemitic incidents since October 7. Among the earliest to confirm attendance were Marine Le Pen, three-time presidential candidate, and Jordan Bardella, president of the National Rally (formerly National Front). In contrast, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, leader of France Unbowed (LFI), tweeted that his party would not participate, describing the event as a 'rendezvous for unconditional supporters of the massacre [of Gazans]'. This marks a significant shift in French politics. For decades, the far right—especially under Jean-Marie Le Pen—was excluded from mainstream events due to its perceived 'anti-Republican' positions and controversial views on Jews, while the far left, though often criticized, remained within the political mainstream. Historically, it was unthinkable for the far left to avoid a march against antisemitism while the far right participated; this reversal highlights the transformation in France's political landscape, a trend visible in other European countries as well. Today, France's far right focuses on issues like immigration, insecurity, and Islamism—positions that sometimes align with concerns in the Jewish community. At the same time, the far left frames the Gaza conflict through an anti-colonial lens and has found support among politicized immigrants. Thus, the National Rally—whose founder once called the Holocaust a 'detail of history'—now publicly supports French Jews, while the far left faces criticism for not labeling Hamas a terrorist group. Skepticism remains about the far right's intentions; for example, Jordan Bardella recently refused to explicitly call Jean-Marie Le Pen antisemitic, drawing criticism from political opponents. Meanwhile, divisions within the far left are becoming more apparent, as shown by the suspension of Raquel Garrido, a senior LFI figure, for challenging Mélenchon's stance, including on Hamas. Overall, the National Rally under Marine Le Pen is moving into the political mainstream, while Mélenchon's LFI appears increasingly marginalized. Recent IFOP polls show Le Pen leading the first round of a presidential election with up to 33% support, while Mélenchon's share has dropped from 22% in 2022 to 14%. Serge Klarsfeld, noted Holocaust historian and activist, shared his thoughts in Le Figaro. He welcomed the far right's apparent rejection of antisemitism but expressed regret over the far left's present position on combating antisemitism.

שינוי זה ממחיש את המהפך במפה הפוליטית בצרפת, תהליך שמתרחש גם במדינות אירופה נוספות. כיום הימין הקיצוני מתמקד בנושאים כמו הגירה, ביטחון ואיסלאמיזם — עמדות שמוצאות לעיתים מכנה משותף עם חלקים מהקהילה היהודית. בו-זמנית, השמאל הקיצוני רואה בעימות בעזה עניין אנטי-קולוניאלי והבסיס האלקטורלי שלו בקרב מהגרים פוליטיים הולך וגדל. כך, מפלגת ההתאגדות הלאומית — שמייסדה כינה בעבר את השואה 'פרט היסטורי' — מפגינה היום תמיכה גלויה ביהודי צרפת, בעוד השמאל הקיצוני סופג ביקורת על כך שאינו מכנה את חמאס ארגון טרור. עדיין קיימת ספקנות לגבי כוונות הימין הקיצוני; לדוגמה, ג'ורדן בארדלה סירב לאחרונה להצהיר באופן מפורש כי ז'אן-מארי לה פן אנטישמי, מה שעורר ביקורת מהפוליטיקאים היריבים. במקביל, בשמאל הקיצוני מתעצמות המחלוקות, לדוגמה בהשעייתה של רקל גרידו, בכירה ב-LFI, לאחר שהתנגדה לקו של מלנשון, כולל כלפי חמאס. בסך הכל ההתאגדות הלאומית בראשות מרין לה פן פונה לעבר המרכז הפוליטי, בעוד שמפלגתו של מלנשון הולכת ומתבודדת. סקר IFOP אחרון מלמד שלה פן צפויה לזכות ב-33% מהקולות בסיבוב הראשון של הבחירות לנשיאות, לעומת ירידה של מלנשון מ-22% ב-2022 ל-14%. סרז' קלרפד, היסטוריון ואקטיביסט בולט למען זיכרון השואה, אמר ל'לה פיגארו' כי הוא שמח לראות את הימין הקיצוני מתרחק מאנטישמיות, אולם הביע צער על עמדת השמאל הקיצוני במאבק באנטישמיות כיום.

article_content: NHS South West Essex has been providing nicotine patches to schoolchildren as young as 12 without informing their parents, according to recent reports. Nurses working for the NHS visit schools every two weeks to hold confidential sessions with pupils, during which they have distributed nicotine patches. Some parents, like Danielle Northcott—whose 13-year-old daughter attends Woodlands School in Basildon—believe parents should have been consulted before such products were offered to children. Northcott noted that while the patches might help prevent addiction, she was concerned about not being informed and worried that the patches could become a 'status symbol' among pupils. NHS South West Essex contracts the Vitality health group to run this service. Vitality provides children with advice on weight, wellbeing, and smoking cessation, and also offers nicotine patches at drop-in sessions at local health centers, including Laindon Health Centre, Pitsea Health Clinic, and Basildon Centre. NHS guidelines state that children as young as 12 can access nicotine patches from chemists and GPs, based on services offered by local primary care trusts. Andy White, headteacher of Woodlands School, acknowledged NHS nurses visited the school but said the school itself does not distribute nicotine patches, and any sessions between nurses and students are confidential drop-ins. He emphasized that parents are informed if a pupil is caught smoking on school grounds and further actions are managed by parents. A spokesperson for the North East London NHS Foundation Trust explained that providing confidential support to young smokers is crucial for long-term prevention. NHS stop smoking support is offered locally by GPs, pharmacies, and specialist services to people aged 12 and over, following NHS and NICE guidelines. The spokesperson added that all young people seeking help are assessed for competency to give consent before being provided with NRT. Although young people are encouraged to inform their parents or carers when seeking support, they are not required to do so.

article_content: Virat Kohli scored 95 runs as India chased down a target of 274 to defeat New Zealand by four wickets, handing the Black Caps their first loss at the Cricket World Cup. India, the host nation, reached 274-6 with 12 balls to spare in Dharamsala. New Zealand were bowled out for 273 in 50 overs, with Daryl Mitchell hitting a brisk 130. Kohli came close to matching Sachin Tendulkar’s record of 49 ODI hundreds, but was caught near the boundary while attempting a six to achieve both the record and victory. This was India’s fifth consecutive win, keeping them unbeaten and at the top of the tournament table. New Zealand suffered their first defeat and are in second place. India chose to field first, quickly removing both New Zealand openers but struggled with three dropped catches, giving New Zealand some reprieve. Mitchell built a 159-run partnership with Rachin Ravindra (75), pushing New Zealand to 205-3 in the 37th over and positioning them for a 300-plus total. However, Indian bowlers slowed their progress, with Mohammed Shami taking 5-54 in his first match of the tournament. Captain Rohit Sharma (46) gave India a strong start, while Kohli’s fourth fifty-plus score in five innings helped secure the win. New Zealand previously beat England, the Netherlands, Bangladesh, and Afghanistan, while India had victories over Australia, Afghanistan, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. India’s Hardik Pandya missed the match due to a left ankle injury from the previous game against Bangladesh, with Suryakumar Yadav replacing him. Mohammed Shami was selected in place of Shardul Thakur. New Zealand fielded the same team as in their last match, with Tom Latham captaining in the continued absence of Kane Williamson due to a thumb injury.

article_content: Gillingham Football Club is being investigated by the Football Association (FA) following allegations it treated former player Mark McCammon differently because he is black and refused to cover his medical bills. In August 2012, the club was ordered to pay McCammon £68,000 after he successfully sued for unfair dismissal following his 2011 sacking. McCammon claimed that club staff victimized black players while treating white teammates more favorably. He accused the club of trying to force him out by declining to pay for private medical treatment after a serious injury, instead offering him only NHS care—an approach he said was unusual for a Football League club. McCammon was also fined two weeks' wages after visiting a private consultant. In contrast, McCammon referenced a white teammate who was sent to Dubai for specialist treatment at the club’s expense. Additionally, he alleged he was docked pay for missing training during hazardous snowy conditions, while some white players were told not to report. According to McCammon, he confronted manager Andy Hessenthaler about perceived racial intolerance, resulting in disciplinary proceedings and his eventual dismissal. In his 2012 employment tribunal, McCammon said he endured significant distress and never received an explanation for the differential treatment. Gillingham’s chairman, Paul Scally, who is based in Dubai, described McCammon’s claims as 'malicious and without foundation,' noting that the club had not faced racism allegations in 18 years. The club’s appeal was rejected in September, and it was required to pay compensation. The FA has now charged both Gillingham FC and chairman Scally with violating FA Rule E3 by allegedly committing race victimisation related to McCammon’s dismissal. Both parties have until November 14 to respond.

article_content: Swedish mountaineer and professional skier Fredrik Ericsson died on Friday while attempting to summit K2 in Pakistan, his friend David Schipper told CNN in a telephone interview. The incident took place between 7 a.m. and 8 a.m. as Ericsson was trying to become the first person to ski from the summit to base camp, according to Schipper. Schipper said he learned about the accident, which happened on the world’s second-highest mountain, during a satellite call from fellow climber Fabrizio Zangrilli. Ericsson, who was in his mid-30s, was at a location known as the 'bottleneck,' an area at approximately 8,300 meters (27,231 feet) in elevation, situated between Camp 4 (8,000 meters) and the summit (8,611 meters), Schipper explained. He described the bottleneck as a steep and narrow section with a significant drop below. Ericsson, together with his climbing partners Trey Cook and Gerlinde Kaltenbrunner, began their summit attempt between 1 a.m. and 1:30 a.m. in conditions of low visibility. After several hours of climbing, they reached the bottom of the bottleneck. At that point, Cook chose to return to Camp 4, leaving Kaltenbrunner and Ericsson to continue the ascent. As Ericsson attempted to secure ropes on the snow and ice along the route, he lost his grip and was unable to stop his fall, Schipper said. Ericsson’s body came to rest at about 7,000 meters. Schipper, writing on Ericsson’s website, said his parents requested that it remain in the mountains he loved, citing the exceptional danger involved in recovery.

Robert De Niro openly criticized Apple and the Gotham Film & Media Institute following the Gotham Awards, alleging his acceptance speech had been censored. According to Variety, just before the event, an Apple employee reportedly edited De Niro’s teleprompter script to remove comments critical of Donald Trump and the entertainment industry.

De Niro was at the ceremony to present the Historical Icon and Creator Tribute for 'Killers of the Flower Moon', an Apple-distributed film depicting the murder of Osage people in 1920s Oklahoma. On stage, he noticed parts of his speech were missing and opted to read his original version from his phone instead.

In his full speech, De Niro addressed concerns about historical revisionism, misinformation, and the influence of conspiracy theories. He criticized Florida’s education policies on slavery, cited the entertainment industry’s complicity in harmful narratives, quoted John Wayne’s controversial views on Native Americans, and condemned the dishonesty of Donald Trump, particularly the use of 'Pocahontas' as a slur.

De Niro said he had intended to thank Apple and the Gotham institute but changed his mind upon seeing the edits, stating: 'How dare they do that, actually.'

Event photos featured actors from 'Killers of the Flower Moon', including De Niro, accepting awards recognizing the film’s historical significance.

Variety reported the edits were made last-minute by Apple staff at the request of filmmakers to focus the speech on the movie. The teleprompter company was sent the new script, but De Niro was not notified. A source close to the production denied deliberate censorship, citing miscommunication due to multiple drafts and lack of final script approval from De Niro.

This controversy follows similar allegations involving Apple’s management of content, such as the cancellation of Jon Stewart’s Apple TV+ show amid ‘creative differences’ regarding China and artificial intelligence.

article_content: Up to 1.5 million people are working from home in London during the Olympics, raising concerns among experts about possible negative impacts on the city's economy. Thousands of civil servants who would typically be in their Whitehall offices have opted for 'flexible working' during the Games. Major companies such as Lloyds Banking Group and Royal Bank of Scotland have allowed staff to work remotely, following warnings about potential travel disruptions. Small businesses and sole traders report significant drops in revenue as advice to avoid central London has led to fewer visitors in key areas. Retailers warn that parts of London have become 'ghost towns,' with fewer people shopping, dining out, or using local services as many regular workers stay home. Economists suggest some employees may be less productive while working remotely, particularly due to distractions from Olympic TV coverage. Research from the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development shows that over half of employers have implemented flexible work policies or allowed staff to watch key Olympic events at work. According to the London Chamber of Commerce, approximately 1.5 million of the 5 million people who work in London are expected to work from home at some point during the Games. Government departments have permitted remote work or relocated staff; around 800 Ministry of Justice employees and 400 from the Department for Work and Pensions are working outside central London. In total, over 4,000 civil servants are working from home. A Department for Transport spokesperson said that fewer than 6% of civil servants are working from home, with many others adapting their commute or working hours. HSBC stated that 40% of its 8,500 Canary Wharf-based staff are working from home, following advice from Transport for London and the Olympics Committee to reduce congestion. Other organizations like the Bank of England, BP, British Gas, and GlaxoSmithKline have also adopted flexible working arrangements. Some transport workers, such as the 106 Woolwich Ferry staff, are receiving bonuses of at least £400 for working during the Olympics, with higher overtime rates on busy days. While some analysts are worried remote workers may be less productive, employers are focusing on clear communication of remote work policies. Despite business leaders' concerns, Culture Secretary Jeremy Hunt insisted the Games would ultimately benefit London’s tourism industry, boosting the city’s global profile and drawing more visitors in the long term. Recent figures show footfall in central London down nearly 5%, and some areas experiencing lower economic activity. Mayor Boris Johnson acknowledged the Games' mixed impact on businesses. To manage crowds, Westfield Stratford City shopping centre will restrict access to Olympic ticket holders during peak event days, while operating regular hours for others at different times. The mall, one of Europe's largest, is expected to benefit from its location near the Olympic venues, even as it limits access to help with crowd control.
translated_content: עד 1.5 מיליון אנשים עובדים מהבית בלונדון במהלך האולימפיאדה, מה שמעלה חשש בקרב מומחים להשפעות שליליות אפשריות על כלכלת העיר. אלפי עובדי מדינה שבדרך כלל נמצאים במשרדי ווייטהול בחרו בעבודה גמישה במהלך המשחקים. חברות גדולות כמו לוידס בנקינג גרופ והבנק המלכותי של סקוטלנד אפשרו לעובדים לעבוד מהבית בעקבות אזהרות לגבי שיבושי תחבורה אפשריים. עסקים קטנים ובעלי עסקים עצמאיים מדווחים על ירידה משמעותית בהכנסות בשל המלצות להימנע ממרכז לונדון, מה שהביא לפחות מבקרים באזורים המרכזיים. קמעונאים מזהירים שחלקים מלונדון הפכו ל'עיר רפאים', כאשר פחות אנשים קונים, אוכלים בחוץ או משתמשים בשירותים מקומיים בזמן שרבים מהעובדים הרגילים נשארים בבית. כלכלנים מעריכים כי עובדים מהבית עלולים להיות פחות פרודוקטיביים, במיוחד בשל הסחות דעת משידורי האולימפיאדה בטלוויזיה. סקר של המכון המוסמך למשאבי אנוש ופיתוח מראה שלמעלה ממחצית מהמעסיקים יישמו מדיניות עבודה גמישה או אפשרו לעובדים לצפות באירועים אולימפיים עיקריים במקום העבודה. לפי לשכת המסחר של לונדון, כ-1.5 מיליון מתוך 5 מיליון עובדי העיר צפויים לעבוד מהבית בשלב כלשהו במהלך המשחקים. משרדי ממשלה אפשרו עבודה מהבית או רילוקיישן של עובדים; כ-800 עובדים ממשרד המשפטים ו-400 ממשרד העבודה עובדים מחוץ למרכז לונדון. בסך הכל, יותר מ-4,000 עובדי מדינה עובדים מהבית. דובר משרד התחבורה אמר שפחות מ-6% מעובדי המדינה עובדים מהבית, ורבים אחרים מתאימים את זמני העבודה או את מסלול הנסיעה. HSBC הצהיר כי 40% מתוך 8,500 עובדיו שבקאנרי וורף עובדים מהבית, בהתאם להמלצות תחבורה בלונדון והוועדה האולימפית להפחתת עומס. ארגונים נוספים כמו בנק אנגליה, BP, גז בריטי וגלקסו סמית' קליין, גם הם יישמו הסדרי עבודה גמישים. חלק מהעובדים בתחבורה, כמו 106 עובדי מעבורת וולוויץ', מקבלים בונוסים של לפחות 400 פאונד על עבודתם בתקופת האולימפיאדה, עם תעריפי שעות נוספות גבוהים בימים עמוסים. בעוד שחלק מהאנליסטים חוששים שעבודה מהבית עלולה להיות פחות יעילה, המעסיקים ממקדים מאמצים בתקשורת ברורה של מדיניות עבודה מרחוק. למרות דאגות ראשי עסקים, שר התרבות ג'רמי האנט טוען כי המשחקים יהוו יתרון משמעותי לענף התיירות של לונדון, יחזקו את המעמד העולמי של העיר וימשכו יותר מבקרים בטווח הארוך. נתונים עדכניים מראים ירידה של כמעט 5% בתנועת המבקרים במרכז לונדון, וחלק מהאזורים סובלים מצמצום בפעילות העסקית. ראש העיר בוריס ג'ונסון הודה שמשחקי האולימפיאדה משפיעים בדרכים מגוונות על עסקים. כדי להתמודד עם העומסים, מרכז הקניות ווסטפילד סטרטפורד סיטי יגביל את הכניסה לימי שיא רק לאנשים עם כרטיסים לאולימפיאדה, אך יהיה פתוח כרגיל בארוחות אחרות. המרכז, מהגדולים באירופה, צפוי להרוויח ממיקומו הסמוך לאולימפיאדה, גם תוך הקפדה על ניהול העומס.

article_content: This Christmas brought immense sorrow to the McKinstry family as they faced it without their beloved daughter, Lily-Mae, a ten-year-old from Chelmsford, Essex, who had recently succumbed to a rare brain tumor called DIPG. Amidst their grief, however, the family experienced unexpected comfort when they began receiving surprise packages in the mail. These turned out to be carefully chosen gifts that Lily had secretly ordered for each of them in her final weeks, using her father’s credit card. Lily was known for her vivacious spirit and compassion. After her diagnosis, she underwent several weeks of radiotherapy, showing remarkable bravery despite the worsening of her illness. Her parents, Andrew and Vicki, and her older brother, Ethan, have found solace and joy in receiving the presents she had selected, each one a testament to her thoughtfulness and love. Among the surprises were bandanas in favorite colors, a comical chicken costume for Ethan, and a Build-A-Bear teddy bear, which has become a precious keepsake. The family also discovered that Lily had written thank you cards for everyone she cared about, heightening the emotional impact of her gifts. Lily compiled an ambitious bucket list after learning of her condition. Her wishes included promoting world peace, advocating for improved wheelchair access on the London Underground—a cause she shared with then-mayor Boris Johnson, who responded to her personally—and meeting favorite celebrities such as One Direction. She also enjoyed memorable experiences like a helicopter ride and a horse-drawn carriage journey. A note Lily left behind outlined how she wanted her favorite possessions distributed, reflecting her selflessness and maturity even during her most difficult moments: her iPad to her dad, laptop to her brother, mannequin to her mom, clothes to those in need, and her savings toward her funeral. The McKinstry family is now working to fulfill Lily’s remaining wishes and is raising funds for DIPG research in her memory, with the hope of bringing more awareness to this devastating disease. Lily’s legacy is one of kindness, hope, and advocacy, inspiring others to cherish loved ones and support the fight against childhood brain cancer.

Charles Green, a World War II veteran, bravely defended Britain from Nazi threats as a Royal Marine, joining the force at age 16 by lying about his age. He served on the Shetland and Orkney Islands, safeguarding naval bases and national shores.

Years later, in May 2011, Mr Green's courage was again apparent when two men broke into his Oswestry, Shropshire home. The intruders, Danny Keeble (26) and Peter Marston (24), attempted to coerce him into giving his bank details through threats and violence. Despite suffering serious injuries—including a broken hip and bleeding on the brain, which contributed to his death a month later—Mr Green refused to comply.

Following the attack, he called emergency services and gave police a detailed statement, recorded on an officer’s helmet-mounted camera. This was the first time in the UK that such video evidence from a victim who later died was used in court.

Keeble and Marston were convicted of manslaughter at Stafford Crown Court and each sentenced to 15 years in prison. The helmet-cam footage, along with a 999 emergency call recording, were essential in securing a conviction. Prosecutors stated that Mr Green’s testimony was crucial in clarifying the events and the violence inflicted upon him.

Mr Green's family paid tribute to his integrity and courage, remembering him as a steadfast Marine and a resilient person, both in war and civilian life.

שנים מאוחר יותר, במאי 2011, הפגין גרין שוב את אומץ ליבו כאשר שני גברים פרצו לביתו באוסווסטרי שבשרופשייר. הפורצים, דני קיבל (26) ופיטר מרסטון (24), ניסו לאלץ אותו לתת את פרטי הבנק שלו באמצעים של איומים ואלימות. למרות פציעות קשות – כולל שבר באגן ודימום מוחי, שהובילו למותו כחודש לאחר מכן – גרין סירב להיכנע.

לאחר התקיפה הוא התקשר למוקד החירום ונתן לשוטרים עדות מפורטת, שתועדה במצלמה על קסדת אחד מהם. זה היה המקרה הראשון בבריטניה בו נעשה שימוש בעדות כזו של קרבן שנפטר בהמשך לצורך הרשעה משפטית.

קיבל ומרסטון הורשעו בהריגה בבית המשפט בסטפורד, ונגזר על כל אחד מהם עונש של 15 שנות מאסר. תיעוד הקסדה והקלטת שיחת ה-999 היו קריטיים להרשעה. התביעה הדגישה שעדותו של גרין הייתה חיונית בחשיפת האירועים והאלימות שספג.

משפחתו של גרין חלקה לו כבוד על יושרו ואומץ ליבו, וזכרה אותו כלוחם עיקש ואדם חזק – גם במלחמה וגם בחייו האזרחיים.

article_content: A devastating 27-vehicle pile-up occurred on Interstate 80 near Winnemucca, rural Nevada, after a powerful dust storm created zero-visibility conditions late Monday afternoon. High winds, likely stirring up dust from recently cleared fields, rendered drivers unable to see, resulting in one fatality and multiple injuries. The Nevada Highway Patrol confirmed that 51-year-old Ravi Dyer of Chicago lost his life when his truck rear-ended another commercial vehicle, and two additional trucks collided with his truck, seriously injuring his passenger. In total, 26 people were treated at Humboldt General Hospital, with three in critical condition later transferred to a larger hospital in Reno, 160 miles away. Emergency responders from across sparsely populated Humboldt County were called in to assist. Additional support came from a mine rescue team from Newmont Mining Corp., while the Coach America charter bus company helped transport victims. The incident forced the closure of this major east-west trucking route in both directions for over 19 hours as crews worked to clear the wreckage. Hospital officials described the emergency response as extraordinary, with teams working for hours to extricate victims from vehicles. Images from the scene depicted crumpled cars, overturned SUVs, and damaged semitrailers with spilled cargo. According to Incident Commander Ken Whittaker, officials brought in water trucks to suppress dust, allowing emergency crews to safely reach and assist those involved. Even after more than 12 hours, traffic was still being diverted from the affected section of Interstate 80.

The power of online marketing is huge, but the creativity of internet users can take unexpected turns—as Waitrose learned firsthand. The supermarket sought to boost its image by encouraging people on Twitter to finish the phrase: 'I shop at Waitrose because...'. Instead of receiving the positive reviews it hoped for, Waitrose saw its hashtag #WaitroseReasons filled with witty and mocking posts. Many users poked fun at the store’s reputation for catering to a more affluent crowd. Jokes ranged from comments on class, like wanting to avoid 'being surrounded by poor people,' to quips about Harrods being too far away. 

While some tweets genuinely praised Waitrose, the dominant tone was playful mockery about the supermarket’s high-end image. This viral reaction sparked debate over whether the campaign failed or succeeded in gaining public attention. Waitrose responded by thanking all users for their honest and humorous feedback.

Known for quality products and exclusive lines from chefs like Heston Blumenthal, Waitrose also partners with Prince Charles’s Duchy Originals and has a celebrity customer base, including Abbey Clancy, Fearne Cotton, and Kate Middleton.

Waitrose isn’t alone in facing online backlash. McDonald's, The Daily Telegraph, Bing, Starbucks, and Durex have all had their own social media promotions go awry, with hashtags being hijacked or campaigns seen as in poor taste. These examples highlight how risky online marketing can be for big brands.

article_content: A 2-year-old Chinese girl, Wang Yue, who was struck by two vehicles and ignored by multiple passersby last week, has died, according to a nurse at Guangzhou Military Hospital. Wang Yue passed away at around 12:32 a.m. on Friday, hospital officials confirmed. Su Lei, director of the intensive care unit, expressed deep pain and shame over the tragedy, sentiments shared by many. Security camera footage captured two drivers hitting Wang Yue in Foshan, Guangdong Province. More than a dozen people passed by the injured toddler as she lay bleeding in a busy market, without offering assistance. Eventually, a 58-year-old woman named Chen Xianmei intervened, pulling the child to safety and seeking help. Wang Yue’s mother, Qu Feifei, explained that her daughter was in critical condition after the incident, with little brain activity observed in the hospital. The distressing video prompted widespread public anger, with millions of people discussing the story online and sparking a 'Stop Apathy' campaign on Sina Weibo, China's leading social media platform. Government offices in Guangdong awarded Chen Xianmei a total of 20,000 yuan (about $3,135 USD) in recognition of her good deed. Qu Feifei expressed confusion over the lack of action from bystanders but chose to focus on Chen’s compassion, stating, 'Granny Chen represents the best of human nature.' The story prompted ongoing support for Wang Yue's family from the public, with numerous people offering gifts, money, and condolences.

article_content: MAYVILLE, N.Y. – Author Salman Rushdie may testify against the man accused of stabbing him before a scheduled lecture, according to a prosecutor on Friday. 'He is currently on the prosecution’s witness list for trial,' said Chautauqua County District Attorney Jason Schmidt after a court hearing, where the trial was set for January 8. Hadi Matar, 25, has pleaded not guilty to assault and attempted murder charges. Authorities say the New Jersey resident left the audience and rushed the stage as Rushdie, author of 'The Satanic Verses,' was about to speak in August 2022. Matar allegedly stabbed Rushdie more than a dozen times before bystanders intervened. Rushdie, 76, was blinded in his right eye and suffered damage to his left hand. He has written a memoir about the attack, 'Knife: Meditations After an Attempted Murder,' due out April 16, 2024. Matar has remained in custody since the attack, which took place at the Chautauqua Institution, an arts and intellectual center in rural southwestern New York. District Attorney Schmidt noted that selecting a fair and impartial jury may be the biggest challenge. He estimated the trial would last two weeks or less. Rushdie has lived under the threat of a decades-old fatwa issued by former Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini, who called for his death over allegations of blasphemy in 'The Satanic Verses.'

'הוא נמצא כרגע ברשימת עדי התביעה למשפט,' אמר התובע המחוזי של מחוז שיטוקואה, ג'ייסון שמידט, לאחר דיון שבו נקבע מועד המשפט ל-8 בינואר. האדי מטר, בן 25, כפר באשמת תקיפה וניסיון לרצח. הרשויות טוענות שתושב ניו ג'רזי קם מהקהל והסתער על הבמה בדיוק כשרושדי, מחבר 'פסוקי השטן,' עמד לדבר באוגוסט 2022. מטר דקר לכאורה את רושדי למעלה מתריסר פעמים לפני שהתערבו הנוכחים. רושדי, בן 76, איבד את ראייתו בעין ימין ונפגע ביד שמאל. הוא כתב ספר זיכרונות על התקיפה, 'סכין: הרהורים לאחר ניסיון רצח,' שעתיד לצאת ב-16 באפריל 2024. מטר מוחזק במעצר מאז התקיפה, שהתרחשה במוסד שיטוקואה – מרכז לאמנות ואינטלקטואליות בדרום-מערב הכפרי של מדינת ניו יורק. התובע שמידט ציין כי האתגר הגדול ביותר ככל הנראה יהיה בחירת חבר מושבעים הוגן ובלתי משוחד. הוא העריך כי המשפט יימשך כשבועיים או פחות. רושדי חי תחת איום של פתוא בת עשרות שנים שהוציא המנהיג העליון האיראני לשעבר, האייתולה רוחאללה ח'ומייני, שקרא להרגו בשל האשמות בחילול קודש בספר 'פסוקי השטן.'

article_content: Ukraine’s commander-in-chief, General Valerii Zaluzhnyi, has acknowledged that Ukraine’s ongoing counteroffensive is unlikely to achieve a breakthrough against Russian defenses without significant technological and military assistance. In an op-ed published by The Economist, Zaluzhnyi, nicknamed Ukraine's 'Iron General,' outlined the equipment and advancements Ukraine needs to overcome the current stalemate and defeat Russia. "There will most likely be no deep and beautiful breakthrough," Zaluzhnyi said of the counteroffensive’s progress, emphasizing that air superiority is Ukraine’s most urgent need. "Control of the skies is essential to large-scale ground operations." While Ukraine’s air defense has been bolstered by US missile systems, Russia maintains a substantial advantage in building new attack squadrons, which continues to hinder Ukrainian advances. According to a separate interview with The Economist, pre-offensive planning suggested that Ukrainian forces could advance 30 kilometers per day, but after five months, the counteroffensive has achieved just 17 kilometers of progress. This slow advance has been discouraging for Western officials who had hoped that a significant Ukrainian push would force Russian President Vladimir Putin to reconsider his war strategy. Extensive minefields in eastern Ukraine, as well as Russian artillery and drone attacks, have almost stopped Ukrainian troops. As progress slowed, Zaluzhnyi initially changed some of his command staff, believing leadership adjustments could help. However, he later concluded that technological developments on both sides have led to the current deadlock. "We see everything the enemy is doing, and they see everything we are doing," Zaluzhnyi said, adding that breaking the impasse would require new technology: "something new, like gunpowder, which transformed warfare in the past." After air power, Zaluzhnyi ranked electronic warfare as the next highest priority, especially for jamming communications and navigation systems. He stressed that such capabilities are the "key to victory" in an era where inexpensive yet powerful first-person-view drones are increasingly used to damage sophisticated equipment. Zaluzhnyi warned that Russia currently surpasses Ukraine in developing electronic warfare systems. He also cited the need for improved counter-battery fire, mine-clearing technology, and building up troop reserves. While the United States has been a major financial supporter of Ukraine, it has been hesitant to transfer its most advanced military technologies, citing the risk of being drawn more deeply into the war. "They are not obliged to give us anything, and we are grateful for what we have received, but I am simply stating the facts," Zaluzhnyi said. He concluded that without the development or provision of advanced equipment, the war risks dragging on, a scenario he believes Russian President Putin wants. "It is important to understand that this war cannot be won with outdated weapons and tactics. Relying on old methods will only lead to more delays and, ultimately, defeat."
translated_content: הרמטכ"ל של אוקראינה, הגנרל ולרי זלוז'ני, הודה כי המתקפה הנגדית של אוקראינה ככל הנראה לא תצליח לפרוץ את קווי ההגנה של רוסיה ללא סיוע טכנולוגי וצבאי משמעותי. במאמר דעה שפרסם ב-The Economist, פרט זלוז'ני – המכונה 'הגנרל הברזל של אוקראינה' – את הציוד והחידושים שאוקראינה צריכה כדי לשבור את הקיפאון הנוכחי ולנצח את רוסיה. "ככל הנראה לא תהיה פריצה עמוקה ויפה," אמר זלוז'ני על קצב ההתקדמות, והדגיש כי השליטה באוויר היא הצורך הדחוף ביותר של אוקראינה. "שליטה באוויר חיונית לפעולות קרקעיות רחבות היקף." אמנם מערכות ההגנה האווירית של אוקראינה התחזקו במידה מסוימת הודות לטילים מארה"ב, אבל לרוסיה יש יתרון משמעותי ביכולת לבנות טייסות תקיפה חדשות – דבר שממשיך לעכב את כוחות אוקראינה. בריאיון נפרד לאותו כתב עת, סיפר זלוז'ני שתכנון מוקדם צפה התקדמות יומית של 30 ק"מ, אך אחרי חמישה חודשים הושגו רק 17 ק"מ. ההתקדמות האיטית מאכזבת את המערב, שקיווה לדחיפה שתוביל את נשיא רוסיה פוטין לשקול מחדש את האסטרטגיה שלו. שדות מוקשים נרחבים במזרח אוקראינה, יחד עם אש ארטילריה ומל"טים מצד הרוסים, כמעט והשביתו את הכוחות. בהתחלה זלוז'ני שינה חלק מהפיקוד, אבל הבין שלמעשה יש כאן קיפאון שנובע מהטכנולוגיות של שני הצדדים. "אנחנו רואים הכל, וגם האויב רואה הכל," אמר זלוז'ני, וציין ששבירת הקיפאון דורשת חידוש טכנולוגי – "משהו כמו אבק השריפה ששינה היסטוריה של קרבות." אחרי עליונות אווירית, עדיפות שנייה ניתנת ללוחמה אלקטרונית ולשיבוש מערכות תקשורת וניווט. כך לדבריו, ניתן לנצח בעידן שבו מל"טים זולים אבל עוצמתיים פוגעים בציוד יקר. זלוז'ני מזהיר: לרוסיה יתרון בתחום הלוחמה האלקטרונית. הוא מציין עוד את הצורך באש נגד סוללות, טכנולוגיות לפריצת מוקשים וחיזוק כוחות המילואים. ארה"ב אמנם תומכת באוקראינה כלכלית, אבל מהססת להעביר את הטכנולוגיות הצבאיות המתקדמות ביותר, מחשש להסתבכות ישירה. "הם לא חייבים לנו כלום, ואנחנו מעריכים את מה שקיבלנו, אבל אלה העובדות," הוא מסכם. זלוז'ני מזהיר שללא חידוש או סיוע טכנולוגי מתקדם, המלחמה תמשיך, וזה מה שפוטין רוצה. "המלחמה הזו לא תיגמר בנשק ושיטות מהעבר – זה רק יביא לעיכוב נוסף, ובסוף, להפסד."

Veteran actor and politician Kamal Haasan celebrated his 69th birthday by donating an atmospheric water generator (AWG) to the government children's hospital in Egmore, Chennai. The AWG device extracts water from the air and filters it to provide safe drinking water, producing about 500 litres daily. The system has been installed on the hospital’s terrace. 

The inauguration was attended by Tamil Nadu Health Minister Ma Subramanian and Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Minister P K Sekar Babu. Haasan, acting as founder of the Makkal Neethi Maiam political party, launched the new system and mentioned he has been drinking water from an AWG at his office for two years. 

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M K Stalin, State Youth Welfare and Sports Development Minister Udhayanidhi Stalin, former Chief Minister O Panneerselvam, PMK leader Dr Anbumani Ramadoss, and Naam Tamilar Katchi chief coordinator Seeman offered their congratulations and praised Haasan's charitable actions.

article_content: Exit polls indicate that Poland’s three main opposition parties are poised to secure a majority in the 460-seat Sejm, claiming about 248 seats. The Civic Coalition, led by former prime minister and ex-European Council president Donald Tusk, emerged as the largest opposition force with roughly 31.6% of the vote. At a celebratory rally, Tusk stated, “Poland has won. Democracy has triumphed. We are moving beyond the period of Law and Justice rule.” Although the ruling Law and Justice (PiS) party is projected to take more seats than any other single party, their total—around 200 seats per the Ipsos exit poll—is not enough to form a government independently. Their potential far-right partner, Confederation, secured only 12 seats, which the party admitted was a poor result. Many citizens saw this as Poland’s most consequential election since 1989, with turnout hitting 63%. PiS’s support fell from nearly 44% in 2019, likely due to inflation, accusations of cronyism, and strained EU relations. The party has cultivated loyalty through state-controlled jobs and contracts. Even without the final tally, it’s apparent that voters are seeking a new direction for Poland, including changes in political, social, and cultural areas. Central issues included the country’s constitutional health, legal stances on LGBTQ+ and abortion rights, and alliances—especially support for Ukraine. LGBTQ+ activist Bart Staszewski described the result as a “new beginning,” and environmental activist Dominika Lasota expressed her relief and hope for the future. Law and Justice has faced criticism for weakening checks and balances and exerting control over state institutions, the judiciary, and public media. A shift in government could improve relations with the European Union and unlock billions of euros in frozen EU funds withheld over concerns about democratic backsliding. Piotr Buras of the European Council on Foreign Relations noted that dissatisfaction with PiS had broadened across the electorate. Ukraine’s relationship with Poland was under scrutiny as well, but the Confederation party—who ran on an anti-Ukraine message—performed below expectations with just about 14 seats, a development welcomed by Kyiv. The election was held alongside a controversial referendum addressing migration, retirement age, and other topics. The government’s intent was to mobilize its supporters, but turnout for the referendum was only around 40%, rendering its outcome non-binding. Many in the opposition dismissed the referendum as a political ploy.
translated_content: סקרי יציאה מצביעים על כך ששלוש מפלגות האופוזיציה הגדולות בפולין עומדות להשיג רוב בבית הנבחרים (Sejm) בן 460 המושבים, ולזכות בכ-248 מושבים. קואליציית האזרחית, בראשות ראש הממשלה לשעבר ונשיא המועצה האירופית לשעבר דונלד טוסק, מובילה עם כ-31.6% מהקולות. באירוע ניצחון הכריז טוסק: "פולין ניצחה. הדמוקרטיה ניצחה. אנו פונים לעידן חדש אחרי שלטון 'חוק וצדק'." למרות שמפלגת השלטון 'חוק וצדק' (PiS) קיבלה יותר מושבים מכל מפלגה בנפרד – לפי סקרי היציאה של איפסוס יש לה כ-200 מושבים – זה לא מספיק כדי להקים ממשלה לבד. שותפיהם הפוטנציאליים מ'הקונפדרציה' מהימין הקיצוני קיבלו רק 12 מושבים – תוצאה שהם מגדירים ככישלון. רבים רואים בבחירות אלו את החשובות ביותר מאז 1989, כאשר ההצבעה הגיעה ל-63%. התמיכה ב-'חוק וצדק' ירדה לעומת כ-44% ב-2019, בעיקר בגלל אינפלציה, האשמות בנפוטיזם ומתח עם האיחוד האירופי. המפלגה השלטת ביססה את מעמדה באמצעות משרות ציבוריות וחלוקת חוזים למקורביה. עוד לפני פרסום התוצאות הסופיות, ברור שהבוחרים מעוניינים בשינוי מהותי בפולין בפוליטיקה, בחברה ובתרבות. בראש סדר היום עמדו בריאות המשטר החוקתי, זכויות להט"ב והפלות, ובריתות – במיוחד התמיכה באוקראינה. ברט שטשבסקי, פעיל להט"ב, כינה את התוצאה "התחלה חדשה", ודומיניקה לסוטה, פעילה סביבתית, הביעה רווחה ותקווה לעתיד. חוק וצדק סופגת ביקורת כבדה על החלשת איזונים ובלמים והשתלטות על המוסדות הממשלתיים, מערכת המשפט והתקשורת הציבורית. שלטון האופוזיציה עשוי לשפר את היחסים עם האיחוד האירופי ולפתוח זרם של מיליארדי יורו שהיו מוקפאים בשל חששות דמוקרטיים. פיוטר בוראס מהמועצה האירופית ליחסי חוץ ציין שקהל מאוכזבים מ'חוק וצדק' התרחב הרבה מעבר לבסיס המסורתי של היריבים. גם היחסים עם אוקראינה על הפרק, אך קונפדרציה – שרצה בקמפיין אנטי-אוקראיני – קיבלה רק כ-14 מושבים, הישג חלש שמתקבל בקבלת פנים חיובית בקייב. במקביל לבחירות נערך משאל עם שנוי במחלוקת לגבי הגירה, גיל פרישה ועוד. ממשלת פולין ניסתה להניע כך את בוחריה, אך כ-40% בלבד השתתפו בתהליך – ולכן התוצאות לא מחייבות. מתנגדי הממשלה טוענים שמדובר היה בכלי פוליטי בלבד.

article_content: Diwali, celebrated on November 12 this year, symbolizes the triumph of good over evil—a theme reflected in the festival's vibrant rituals such as lighting diyas and creating rangoli designs. Observed by Hindus, Sikhs, Buddhists, and Jains globally, Diwali spans five days filled with bright lights, incense, festive meals, and sweets. It also serves as an occasion for families to reunite, overcoming distance or differences. The festival's name 'Diwali' originates from the Sanskrit words 'deepa' (light) and 'avali' (row), meaning 'row of lights.' Decorative displays like fireworks and candles are common, but earthen lamps called diyas are especially significant. The tradition of diyas is rooted in the Hindu epic Ramayana, where Prince Rama and his wife Sita's return to Ayodhya was celebrated with rows of lit lamps. While Diwali is tied to various myths across different communities, its unifying message is the victory of good over evil, symbolized by diyas. 'People try to enlighten the dark places, not only in their homes but in their souls,' said Manpreet Arora, senior assistant professor at the Central University of Himachal Pradesh. Arora fondly remembers helping her mother prepare for Diwali as a child, highlighting the festival’s familial significance. Preparations start well before Diwali, with thorough cleaning and decoration. 'Somebody is getting new curtains, somebody is getting their house painted,' Arora remarked. Homes are readied to welcome goddess Lakshmi, who is believed to bring prosperity. The festivities begin with Dhanteras (November 10 this year), when people crowd markets to buy items ranging from diyas to luxury products—especially silver coins, jewelry, and utensils, as these are considered auspicious and bring good luck. The main Diwali celebration takes place on the third day, falling on the new moon. In the evening, people light lamps and worship Goddess Lakshmi. Traditionally, noise from drums and firecrackers is used to drive away Alakshmi, Lakshmi’s negative counterpart. Yet, growing concerns about air pollution have led authorities to encourage celebrating a 'green Diwali,' prompting more people to avoid firecrackers and support local artisans by buying handmade diyas. Another cherished custom is creating rangoli—artistic designs on floors using colored sand, rice flour, or powdered limestone—to welcome Lakshmi. Rangoli patterns may be geometric or symbolically meaningful.

article_content: On Sunday, Apple CEO Tim Cook wished millions in India a joyful Diwali, sharing a celebratory image by photographer Chandan Khanna, taken on the iPhone 15 Pro Max. He posted on X: 'Happy Diwali! May your celebrations be filled with warmth, prosperity, and the joy of being together. Shot on iPhone 15 Pro Max by Chandan Khanna.' The featured image captures children preparing to release lanterns into the night sky, marking the festival of lights. Tim Cook has a tradition of sending Diwali greetings to India, often highlighting photographs by prominent Indian photographers taken on iPhones. The iPhone 15 Pro Max’s main 48MP camera has attracted praise from professional photographers in India, especially for its performance in low-light Diwali photography. Gursimran Basra, a renowned travel photographer, emphasized the benefits of the 48MP high-resolution camera for capturing intricate details, and he praised the Night Mode feature for its ability to produce crisp images even in low light, as long as the phone is kept steady. Basra also acknowledged the iPhone’s impressive portrait mode and the 5x optical zoom, equivalent to a 120mm telephoto lens, enabling detailed lamp photos and beautiful portraits with natural lighting. Filmmaker and travel photographer Siddhartha Joshi suggests using the standard wide lens (1x) for maximum light capture and recommends shooting in Apple RAW for post-processing flexibility. He noted that ambient light sources like diyas, candles, or festive lights can overcome noise in night shots. Joshi also pointed out potential flickering issues when filming video under home lighting during Diwali. Elsewhere, corporate India marked Diwali by distributing gifts, sustainable products, electronics, and silver coins to employees, including blue-collar and third-party workers. Some companies expressed concern that India’s new data protection law could restrict their ability to cross-sell products and services, particularly in sectors such as banking, healthcare, and telecom. On the global stage, Moody's downgraded the US credit outlook from ‘stable’ to ‘negative’ due to increased fiscal deficits and reduced debt affordability, drawing criticism from President Joe Biden’s administration.

article_content: The family of Michael Brown has stated that the officer who shot him, Darren Wilson, will face consequences for his actions, even if he is cleared of wrongdoing. Sheryl Davis, Brown's aunt, told MailOnline that she believes Wilson committed murder and that retribution is inevitable, citing her belief in a higher power’s justice. Davis's comments are among the strongest yet from the Brown family since Wilson's account of the shooting was published in The New York Times. This testimony and alleged forensic evidence have been described by some experts as beneficial to Wilson's defense but have angered Brown’s family and supporters. Wilson shot and killed Brown, 18, on August 9 in Ferguson, a suburb of St. Louis, Missouri. The shooting sparked nearly two weeks of protests and civil unrest. Wilson claims he acted in self-defense, stating he feared for his life during a struggle with Brown inside the officer's patrol car, where FBI analysis found Brown's blood. Wilson’s account is contested by witnesses and Brown's supporters. An ongoing grand jury is considering whether to indict Wilson, with a decision expected soon. Davis said: 'It's murder and they will feel and see the consequences for their actions in a significant way, as promised to those who do wrong.' Wilson’s testimony, provided in secret to the grand jury, included claims that Brown pushed him back into his police SUV and pinned him down, prompting Wilson to draw his gun and shoot, hitting Brown. Some witnesses dispute why Wilson fired additional shots after Brown reportedly put his hands in the air. Witness Dorian Johnson claims Wilson was the aggressor, grabbing Brown by the throat and threatening to shoot. Another unnamed witness reportedly told the grand jury that Brown did not have his hands above his head but rather at his sides, and advanced toward Wilson despite orders to stop, with roughly 20 to 25 feet between them when the final shots were fired. Attorney Benjamin Crump, representing Brown's family, said Wilson's statements should be critically examined and not accepted unquestioningly, emphasizing the importance of transparency. Civil rights leader Al Sharpton compared Wilson’s defense to previous controversial cases and said it should not succeed. Residents fear renewed unrest if Wilson is not indicted. According to The New York Times, forensic evidence appears to support elements of Wilson's version, according to unnamed officials. There is also the possibility of a federal civil rights case. Legal experts, such as Professor Peter Joy of Washington University in St. Louis, note that federal civil rights charges require proof of intentional misconduct, making them more challenging to pursue than standard murder or manslaughter charges.

article_content: Kim Shattuck, who took over as bassist for the Pixies only a short time ago, has already exited the band. She announced her disappointment on social media, while expressing gratitude for the opportunity and sharing plans to return her focus to her original band, The Muffs, and their forthcoming album. Shattuck joined the Pixies in July after founding bassist Kim Deal left during recording sessions for the release 'EP-1.' According to manager Richard Jones, Deal decided to step away because she no longer wanted to travel and tour. Band frontman Black Francis said the group specifically sought another female bassist to maintain the band's sound and dynamic. Though Shattuck toured briefly with the band, her abrupt departure leaves the bass role unfilled for the Pixies' upcoming North American tour, which begins January 15 in Toronto. The band has not yet revealed who will take over on bass. Shattuck remains appreciative of her Pixies experience and is eager to focus on new music with The Muffs.

article_content: 'Thirsty Suitors' is silly, bold, and utterly delightful. If someone pitched a game that blends Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater, Scott Pilgrim vs. The World, Cooking Mama, a dating simulator, and turn-based RPGs, you might laugh in disbelief. But 'Thirsty Suitors' not only fulfills this improbable idea, it fully embraces it and stands out as one of 2023’s most charming releases, even within a crowded field. Developed by Outerloop Games, the experience is one of the most original of the past five years—easily ranking among the best indie games of the year. The developer’s commitment to mixing heartfelt and absurd elements never detracts from the central narrative, which explores heartbreak, selfishness, desire, friendship, family, and the human condition. In fact, it makes it even more engaging. Players take on the role of Jala Jayaratne: a bisexual, unlucky-in-love, 21-year-old second-generation immigrant who returns to her family home in the Pacific Northwest after a tough breakup. But she arrives to even bigger problems—Jala feels lost and struggles with self-care, her relationship with her parents is strained, her sister (who is about to get married) is furious with her, and multiple exes are bracing for her return. There's also a man in a bear suit leading a teen cult in an unfinished theme park—just another day. The narrative kicks off in an unusual way, with Jala taking a 'Thirstsona' dating quiz to define her romantic personality—are you a Heartbreaker, The Star, or a Bohemian? These identities shape Jala’s character across the game’s eight-to-ten-hour adventure, all backed by an excellent soundtrack that could be the year’s best indie music offering. Exploration revolves around a skateboarding mechanic—fun but occasionally rough around the edges—which acts as your main way of moving through the game’s chapters. It feels a bit like 'Saved by the Bell' as you glide past the giant forms of your judgmental parents and sister, eventually passing your five exes along the way. Jala’s internal thoughts are guided by a Narrator who looks like her sister Aruni. This inner voice helps Jala confront her emotions through conversations ranging from supportive to challenging. Jala’s exes form a distinctive, diverse LGBTQIA+ group whose personalities stand out, supported by convincing voice acting that makes them feel real. Jala’s powerlifting, lesbian aunt Chandra supports her on this complicated journey. She has faced her own struggles with the family, which Jala learns about while fighting, cooking, skating, and exploring. Auntie Chandra is a steady presence. 'Thirsty Suitors' impresses because it attempts so much, even if no individual gameplay element stands out. Movement between scenes can be awkward, skateboarding can be inconsistent, quick-time events might feel unfair or laggy, and battles are usually easy—unless the story requires otherwise. These turn-based 'psychodrama' fights focus on taunts—using anger, charm, and surprise to uncover your opponent’s vulnerabilities, essentially turning emotional conversations into game mechanics. You level up and gain new skills, but combat can become repetitive. Expect absurd attacks—from cakes to energy beams and sharp roses. However, the combat primarily serves to advance the narrative, keeping you engaged while exploring the characters’ stories. Cooking is another mini-game; you compete with your assertive Indian mother or bond with your loving Sri Lankan father. Quick-time events turn meal prep into an entertaining performance. The game’s visual flair and humor make it uniquely fun, and the relationship between Jala and her dad Arvind is particularly heartfelt. Arvind, caught between his two daughters and his strong-willed wife, is one of 2023’s most memorable characters, brought to life by Sugith Varughese’s excellent voice work. 'Thirsty Suitors' is a remarkable indie story—filled with strong writing, vivid characters, humor, and relatable moments. While the ending feels abrupt and a sequel seems unlikely, it’s rare to experience a game that leaves such a sense of fulfillment.
translated_content: 'מחזרים צמאים' הוא משחק מטורף, נועז ומאוד מהנה. אם היו מציעים לכם משחק שמערבב בין Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater, Scott Pilgrim vs. The World, Cooking Mama, סימולטור דייטים ו-RPG בתורות, כנראה שלא הייתם מאמינים. אבל 'מחזרים צמאים' מביא את הרעיון המטורף הזה לביצוע מושלם ומצליח להיות אחד מהמשחקים הכי מקסימים של 2023, גם בין המתחרים הרבים. המשחק פותח על ידי Outerloop Games והוא מהחוויות הכי מקוריות של השנים האחרונות—וללא ספק מהאינדי המובילים השנה. השילוב בין סיפור דרמטי להומור לא פוגע בעלילה המרכזית, שמדברת על שברון-לב, אנוכיות, תשוקה, חברות, משפחה ומהות האדם. להיפך—הכול נהיה מרתק יותר. השחקנים נכנסים לדמותה של ג'אלה ג'יארטנה: צעירה ביסקסואלית, חסרת מזל באהבה בת 21, מהגרת דור שני שחוזרת הביתה לאזור הצפון-מערבי אחרי פרידה. אבל מחכות לה צרות גדולות—אין לה כיוון, היא לא שומרת על עצמה, היחסים עם ההורים בשפל, אחותה הכועסת מתחתנת, וכמה אקסים עושים לה קאמבק. יש גם בחור בתחפושת דב שמוביל כת נוער בפארק שעשועים לא גמור—הגיוני לגמרי. הסיפור מתחיל בבחינה מוזרה—'מבחן ת׳ירסטסונה' שמגדיר את הסגנון הרומנטי של ג'אלה: שוברת לבבות, כוכבת או בוהמיינית? המוטיבים האלו מעצבים את הדמות שלה לאורך כל המסע בן 8 עד 10 שעות, עם פסקול אינדי משובח. המשחקיות מתבססת על סקייטבורדינג—כיף, לפעמים מעט גמלוני—שמאפשר לעבור בין פרקי המשחק. זה מרגיש קצת כמו 'להציל את בל' כשרוכבים ליד גרסאות ענק של ההורים והאחות, ובדרך פוגשים 5 אקסים. הקול הפנימי של ג'אלה מודרך על ידי דמות המספרת עם הפנים של האחות ארוני—קול שמעודד אותה או מתגרה בה ברגעים שונים. האקסים מהווים צוות צבעוני ומגוון של דמויות קוויריות; כולם מרגישים אמיתיים בגלל משחק קולי אמין. הדודה שרירית, צ'נדרה, נמצאת שם בשביל ג'אלה. גם לה היו מאבקים משפחתיים, וג'אלה לומדת עליהם תוך כדי קרבות, בישול, סקייטינג וגילויים. דודה צ'נדרה תמיד תומכת. 'מחזרים צמאים' מרשים במיוחד כי הוא מנסה הכל—גם אם כל חלק בפני עצמו לא מושלם. המעברים מגושמים, הסקייטבורדינג לא תמיד עובד חלק, QTE לפעמים מאכזבים, והקרבות לרוב קלים—אלא אם העלילה רוצה אחרת. הקרבות הם בעיקר עניין רגשי—לעצבן, לרגש, להקסים ולחשוף חולשות—כך שהשיחות הקשות בעצם מוגדרות כמכניקת משחק. המתקפות הזויות—עוגות, פרחים חדים ועוד. אבל הקרבות משרתים בעיקר את הסיפור, ומרתקים אותך לדמויות. גם הבישול הוא סוג של קרב משפחתי, מול אמא הודית תובענית או אבא סרי-לנקי חמוד. QTE הופכים את הבישול למופע בידור. הומור וסגנון ויזואלי מגניב יוצרים חוויה ייחודית, והקשר בין ג'אלה לאביה ארבינד נוגע ללב. ארבינד – אב בין שתי בנות לאמא דומיננטית – הוא אחת הדמויות הזכורות של 2023, בזכות הדיבוב של סוגית וארוגסה. 'מחזרים צמאים' הוא סיפור אינדי בולט עם כתיבה חזקה, דמויות מלאות חיים, המון הומור ורגעי הזדהות. הסוף מרגיש פתאומי ואין צפי להמשך, אבל נדיר למצוא משחק שמספק תחושת סיפוק כזו.
