"ואז הם הפסיקו. בשבע או שמונה השנים האחרונות, נראה שהם מתעלמים מכל הלקחים שלמדו," אמר ואטנאבה, שנשאר קשור עם קובעי מדיניות נוכחיים. "תחת שלטון שי, כנראה שסין הזיזה את המיקוד שלה מהכלכלה," אמר לרויטרס. כעת, ייתכן שסין משלמת את המחיר. האינפלציה שם תקועה ומשבר הנדל"ן המעמיק זוהה כאחד הסיכונים הגדולים ביותר לצמיחה הגלובלית במהלך מפגשי קרן המטבע והבנק העולמי במרקש, מרוקו, שנערכו ב-9–15 באוקטובר. בתור הכלכלה השנייה בגודלה בעולם, סין נמצאת במוקד בשל סכנת 'יפניזציה' — מונח המתאר את תקופת הצמיחה האיטית והדפלציה שחוותה יפן אחרי קריסת בועת הנכסים בשנות ה-90. קובעי מדיניות יפנים מביעים דאגה, כיוון שמיתון ממושך אצל שותפת הסחר העיקרית צפוי להכות בכלכלת הייצוא של יפן. "הסיכון לכך שסין תגלוש לדפלציה, או ל'יפניזציה', הולך וצומח במהירות," אמר אסאהי נוגוצ'י, חבר מועצת הבנק של יפן, ביום חמישי. "עדיין לא ברור אם סין צועדת בדרך כמו יפן. אבל נכון להיום מגזר הנדל"ן שלה — עמוד תווך מרכזי — חווה ירידה, האבטלה בקרב צעירים עולה והאינפלציה מתרככת," ציין. בדו"ח התחזית העולמית שלה, קרן המטבע הורידה את תחזית הצמיחה הסינית ל-5% השנה מ-5.2% באפריל, והתריעה שהמשבר בנדל"ן עלול להחמיר ולהשפיע על השווקים הגלובליים. ב-2024 תחזית הצמיחה ירדה ל-4.2%. נתונים שפורסמו ביום שישי הצביעו על כך שהאינפלציה לצרכן בסין בספטמבר לא השתנתה, בניגוד לתחזיות לעלייה של 0.2%, מה שממחיש את הלחץ הדפלציוני – בשעה שמדינות אחרות נאבקות באינפלציה גבוהה. בתקופת הדפלציה של יפן (1998–2013) מחירי הליבה לצרכן ירדו בממוצע ב-0.2% בשנה, בזכות ירידת מחירי הנדל"ן שפגעו בבנקים ובהשקעות. ישנם הבדלים בין המקרה הסיני ליפני. בסין, בעיית החובות מתרכזת בעיקר במגזר הנדל"ן ובחלק מהיזמים והמחוזות, בעוד שביפן נפגעו הבנקים בכל רחבי המדינה, דבר שהוביל למשבר ממושך. נכון לעכשיו, בקרן המטבע הבינלאומית לא רואים סיכון גבוה לכך שסין תגלוש לדפלציה, וצופים שהאינפלציה תתחזק ככל שתעלה שוב הביקוש, מסר קרישנה סריניבסן, מנהל החטיבה לאסיה והפסיפיק בקרן. הוא הדגיש שיש לתמוך בייזמים שנקלעו למצוקה ולתת הכוונה לרשויות המקומיות כדי למנוע התפשטות המשבר. "אנחנו מאמינים שסין מסוגלת להימנע מתקופה ממושכת של צמיחה חלשה כאשר יינקטו המדיניות הנכונה," אמר סריניבסן בנוגע לסיכוי ל'יפניזציה' בסין. "העיקר הוא לטפל במשבר הנדל"ן בזמן כדי שלא יהפוך לבעיה גדולה יותר."

Gen Z workers are breaking workplace taboos around discussing wages and giving feedback to management. According to a September survey by Adobe of 1,011 Gen Z employees in the US (defined as those born between 1997 and 2012), 74% felt comfortable providing feedback to supervisors, and nearly 90% were comfortable giving feedback to their peers. Most respondents also said they had no qualms discussing sensitive topics—about 80% were comfortable talking about their wages, while close to 90% felt comfortable discussing job satisfaction at work.

The survey focused on Gen Z professionals who had been working full-time for up to three years at companies with at least 750 employees. These findings support previous research suggesting Gen Z is more open to changing traditional workplace norms. Tracy Francis, chief marketing officer at McKinsey, told Insider that Gen Z's defining trait might be their comfort with change through established structures, rather than radical revolution.

Additionally, Gen Z employees are more likely than older generations to switch jobs, often landing the largest pay increases when they do, according to Insider. Workplace language is also evolving: a Barclays Bank survey in the UK found that Gen Z is making communication at work more casual, with over a third considering phrases like 'yours truly' and 'yours sincerely' outdated.

However, some managers have raised concerns. Managers interviewed by Insider said Gen Z employees sometimes struggle with focus and motivation. In an April survey by ResumeBuilder.com, almost three-quarters of managers reported finding Gen Z workers the most challenging to manage, and over a quarter said they had dismissed a Gen Z employee within the first month on the job.

article_content: Gareth Bale has made history by being named Welsh Footballer of the Year for a fourth time, surpassing the previous record of three awards shared by Mark Hughes and John Hartson. The Real Madrid forward was recognized once again during the Football Association of Wales’ annual awards ceremony at St David’s Hotel in Cardiff, having now secured the prestigious honor in four of the last five years. Bale’s remarkable year at Real Madrid saw him add the Champions League, UEFA Super Cup, and Copa del Rey trophies to his collection. On the international stage, he delivered standout performances for Wales, notably scoring both goals in the team’s 2-1 victory against Andorra in their opening Euro 2016 qualifier, bringing his tally to ten goals in his last eleven appearances for his country. In addition to the main award, Bale picked up the Vauxhall Fans’ Player of the Year title for the fourth consecutive year. Several other accolades went to familiar faces: Swansea City’s captain Ashley Williams claimed Club Player of the Year for the fourth year running, while Jess Fishlock held onto her title as Women’s Player of the Year for a fourth time. Ben Davies, who moved from Swansea to Tottenham, was named Young Player of the Year. Angharad James earned the Young Women's Player of the Year award, while Cardiff City's Michelle Green was recognized as Club Player of the Year for her long-standing contributions, having debuted for Wales in 2001 and earning 95 caps. Scott Ruscoe, with over 250 appearances for The New Saints, was named Welsh Premier Clubman of the Year. FAW also presented long service awards to former men’s captain Kevin Ratcliffe and Swansea City Ladies secretary Julie Lowe. The FAW extended special recognition to Jarmo Matikainen, marking the end of his tenure as Wales women’s team manager before his return to Finland.

article_content: The Philadelphia Inquirer reports that vintage iPods have become popular again, especially among younger consumers. This trend was first highlighted when Philadelphia-based Urban Outfitters began selling refurbished Apple iPod models on its website, branding them as 'vintage.' Recently, the fashion retailer, known for targeting teens and young adults, started offering discontinued Apple iPods at significantly increased prices. For example, a fourth-generation iPod Classic from 2004 was described as a 'genuine piece of vintage retro tech' and promoted as the 'perfect blend of new millennium design with modern features.' A blue, first-generation iPod Mini from 2004 was also listed, reportedly selling for $199. However, it's worth noting that The Inquirer does not provide concrete evidence that this is a widespread Gen Z trend, suggesting the popularity may be more assumed than confirmed. Although Urban Outfitters is not currently selling iPods, similar refurbished models can be found on Amazon—such as a 160GB iPod Classic in black for $300, or a 30GB iPod Video 5th Gen for $142. Meanwhile, a 7th generation iPod Touch with a 256GB hard drive—a device similar to an iPhone minus the cellular capabilities—is currently listed for $410. As Elle Magazine points out, wired headphones are also gaining popularity: they're not just functional, but are considered a statement of individuality. Wired headphones are seen as a way to resist trends and blend nostalgia with modern technology, such as pairing '90s-inspired beaded phone charms with the latest smartphones. This phenomenon is sometimes referred to as 'newstalgia,' where elements from the past are combined with innovative features. One practical challenge remains: Apple discontinued its wide 30-pin USB cords in 2013, raising the question of how people are charging these old devices.

article_content: The iconic countdown clock at Florida's Kennedy Space Center, considered the world’s second most-watched clock after London’s Big Ben, has been dismantled after more than 45 years of service. For decades, millions worldwide watched the clock as it ticked down to liftoff at the launch site. First used for the Apollo 12 launch in 1969, the clock featured in all subsequent moon missions and every one of the 135 space shuttle launches. Powered by 336 light bulbs, it became a symbol of American space exploration. The clock was recently removed and replaced with a digital version, just in time for the upcoming Orion rocket launch from Cape Canaveral. NASA officials honored the clock’s legacy as a historic landmark for space enthusiasts.

article_content: A recently discovered security weakness in WinRAR has left many users at risk, as attackers are already exploiting this flaw. Google's Threat Analysis Group (TAG) has identified that state-backed hacking groups from various countries have been taking advantage of the vulnerability since early 2023. Although a patch is now available, many users still haven't updated—mainly because WinRAR doesn’t update itself automatically. You have to manually download and install the latest version; both versions 6.23 and 6.24 contain the fix. The vulnerability enables hackers to execute harmful code if a Windows user opens files such as PNG images inside specially crafted ZIP archives. TAG explained that the flaw stems from a logic error in WinRAR that causes extra temporary files to be created when processing manipulated archives, combined with a peculiarity in Windows’ ShellExecute function when opening files with spaces in their extension. Attackers have also used this flaw to target cryptocurrency trading accounts since April 2023. TAG points out that attackers continuing to exploit well-known bugs—even after a patch exists—shows why it’s crucial for users to keep their software updated. These ongoing attacks highlight the need for software to offer easy, user-friendly updates to protect against security risks. WinRAR has faced similar problems before: a major vulnerability discovered in 2019 also put users at risk of losing control over their computers. To stay protected, users should install the latest WinRAR update. Windows 11 users can also use the operating system’s built-in support for RAR and 7-zip files, potentially avoiding these threats.

Bad Bunny has openly condemned a trending TikTok track that mimics his vocals using AI technology. The song, titled NostalgIA, which also imitates Justin Bieber and Daddy Yankee, has attracted hundreds of thousands of listens. Taking to his WhatsApp channel, Bad Bunny warned that anyone supporting the AI-crafted song should exit his chat and is not welcome on future tours. He used strong language to criticize the track. The creator, posting under the alias flowgptmusic, is not confirmed to be related to the FlowGPT AI platform, despite the similar name.

Bad Bunny, whose real name is Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio, is known for songs like "Monaco" and "Fina". He has over 83 million monthly Spotify listeners and is rumored, though unconfirmed, to be dating model Kendall Jenner. BBC Newsbeat reached out to his label for comment, and also contacted Justin Bieber's and Daddy Yankee’s representatives, though neither has publicly spoken about the AI song.

This isn’t the first high-profile case of artists speaking out against AI mimicry. Previously, Drake and The Weeknd’s voices were used in the track "Heart On My Sleeve" by @ghostwriter, which triggered public backlash and led to its removal from major streaming platforms. The use of AI in the music industry continues to spark debate, especially over copyright and the ethics of cloning artists’ voices. While some experts see AI as a valuable creative tool, others call for boundaries. Spotify’s CEO stated the platform won’t ban AI-generated music but will prohibit content that duplicates artists’ voices without consent.

Newsbeat is live weekdays at 12:45 and 17:45.

article_content: A severe accident involving 158 vehicles unfolded on Interstate 55 in St. John the Baptist Parish, just outside New Orleans, due to a thick 'super fog' that severely limited drivers' visibility on Monday morning. Authorities have confirmed that at least seven people lost their lives in the crash, with more casualties possible as recovery efforts continue. Police also report that twenty-five people were hospitalized with injuries from the pile-up. The hazardous fog was created by a combination of dense smoke from nearby marsh fires and damp, cool air, significantly reducing visibility to around 10 feet. As drivers commuted, they were unable to see the vehicles ahead, leading to multiple collisions. According to the National Weather Service, this rare 'super fog' can occur when smoke and moisture combine under certain conditions, and similar weather could return later in the week. Some of the vehicles involved in the crash caught fire, including a tanker truck carrying hazardous materials. Police are taking special precautions to off-load the contents of the damaged tanker safely. Additionally, one vehicle skidded off the road into nearby water, but the driver was rescued unharmed. Sheriff Mike Tregre reported that about 100 people were left stranded after the wreck, and school buses were brought in to help transport them. Eyewitness Clarencia Patterson Reed described ongoing crashes for more than 30 minutes, saying she barely avoided a collision herself before being struck from behind. Her wife, who was with her, was injured and needed help to get out of the car. The major highway was closed for investigation and cleanup, with officials expecting it to remain shut until at least midday Tuesday. Governor John Bel Edwards expressed his condolences to those affected and urged citizens to donate blood to support local hospitals treating the injured. Louisiana has been under strain from recent wildfires, dangerous heat, and exceptional drought, with over 60% of the state experiencing the highest level of drought conditions as tracked by the US Drought Monitor.

article_content: As a child, William Lai often saw typhoons blow the roof off his family home in Wanli, a small coalmining town in northern Taiwan. Lai’s father died in a mining accident when Lai was just two, leaving his mother to raise six children in poverty. He recalls climbing banyan trees instead of playing with toys and wearing hand-me-downs instead of new clothes. 'One of my father's greatest gifts was our poverty,' Lai told TIME in a rare interview before Taiwan’s presidential election. 'It made me work harder and gave me determination.' This work ethic led Lai to Harvard, a career as a nephrologist in Taiwan, and later positions as mayor of Tainan and vice president. Now 64, Lai is the leading candidate to succeed President Tsai Ing-wen in January's election. Both are members of the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), but Tsai cannot run for a third term. On the campaign trail, Lai returned to Wanli, greeted by locals as 'president.' At a local temple, he pledged to improve transportation and senior healthcare, but insisted his top priority is maintaining stability in the Indo-Pacific. Tensions with China loom large. Beijing claims Taiwan as its territory and has threatened to reclaim it by force if needed, making cross-Strait relations central to the upcoming election. President Joe Biden has repeatedly promised to protect Taiwan against Chinese aggression. While opposition candidates argue for more dialogue with China, the ruling DPP, which Beijing labels 'troublemakers,' is skeptical of Chinese intentions. As of late October, polls put Lai ahead with 32%, followed by Hou Yu-ih (KMT) at 22%, Ko Wen-je (TPP) at 20%, and Terry Gou (independent) at 5%. Hou and Ko have since discussed forming a unified opposition ticket. Taiwan’s global importance is significant: It is the world’s 16th largest trading economy and produces 90% of the advanced semiconductor chips powering technology from phones to AI. A Chinese blockade would disrupt trillions in global economic activity. Lai says, 'Taiwan wishes to be friends with China, not enemies,' and would welcome Xi Jinping to visit. Nonetheless, a third DPP presidency would affirm Taiwan's independence stance, challenging Beijing’s vision of reunification. Lai asserts, 'We are already a sovereign, independent country,' even as most countries do not recognize Taiwan diplomatically. The U.S. maintains unofficial ties and supplies arms to Taiwan, despite formally recognizing Beijing since 1979. Any Taiwanese moves toward broader diplomatic or commercial recognition are met by Beijing with military drills, embargoes, and diplomatic freeze-outs. International anxieties have grown following conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East, with some fearing Asia could be next. China’s economic slowdown — marked by high youth unemployment and negative foreign direct investment — adds to tensions, with some suggesting Taiwan is a convenient scapegoat for Beijing. A permanent Ukrainian flag in Foreign Minister Joseph Wu’s office is a reminder of the stakes. Following Russia’s invasion, Taiwan extended mandatory military service to one year and increased defense spending to $19.1 billion, including a purchase of 400 U.S. javelin missiles. Taiwan also launched its first domestically made submarine. Lai emphasizes the need to protect Taiwan's sovereignty in case of invasion. Central to cross-Strait dialogue is the 1992 Consensus, which recognizes 'one China' but allows ambiguity about its government. The DPP refuses to endorse this consensus, viewing it as sacrificing sovereignty. Most Taiwanese now identify as solely Taiwanese; younger generations increasingly support independence and democratic values. Lai’s lead in the polls partly reflects divisions in the pro-China opposition, rather than overwhelming endorsement. Taiwan’s economy is growing slowly and the DPP has recently faced scandal, including several #MeToo incidents. Still, easing Chinese pressure tempts some; Beijing could boost Taiwan’s GDP by lifting bans on tourists or through favorable trade policies. Dialogue and crisis management are key themes in the opposition campaigns. Lai instead seeks to deepen global economic ties, making any disruption more costly for all. Taiwan’s semiconductor industry — led by companies like TSMC, MediaTek, and ASE — remains at the heart of global supply chains. Lai sees technology as both a strength and a responsibility. Taiwan has also signed new trade deals, like the U.S.-Taiwan Initiative on 21st Century Trade and a partnership with the UK, despite Beijing’s criticism. These agreements support regulatory reform and small businesses, aiming to encourage further international cooperation. Taiwanese firms are expanding abroad, while global giants like Nvidia and ASML are investing locally. However, Taiwan’s leadership in supply chains means any conflict would make sanctions against Beijing risky for other nations. Warren Buffett, for example, sold Berkshire Hathaway’s stake in TSMC over geopolitical concerns. As one expert notes, countries might hesitate to act against China if it threatens their semiconductor access. At the DPP’s campaign headquarters, Lai meets with business and civil society leaders, addressing concerns ranging from disability rights to discrimination faced by LGBTQ families. Lai is credited with empathy and direct engagement. But Taiwan’s democracy leaves it exposed to foreign interference, including disinformation and targeted scandals. Recently, a DPP politician dropped out of the race after a personal scandal tied to China, and China has deployed trade sanctions as political tools. Despite these pressures, Taiwan’s unique identity and democratic achievements set it apart from China. Taiwan ranks 10th globally for democracy, while China ranks 156th. While China has cracked down on LGBTQ rights and dissent, Taiwan embraces openness — Lai attended Taipei’s pride parade as the highest-ranking official ever. He insists, 'We will not back down,' determined to preserve Taiwan’s freedoms amid mounting external and internal challenges.
translated_content: בילדותו ראה ויליאם לאי לא פעם כיצד טייפונים עוקרים את גג בית משפחתו בעיירת הכורים הקטנה וואנלי שבצפון טייוואן. אביו של לאי נהרג בתאונת כרייה כשלאי היה בן שנתיים בלבד, והותיר את אמו לגדל שישה ילדים בעוני. הוא זוכר שטיפס על עצי בניאן במקום לשחק בצעצועים ולבש בגדים משומשים. 'אחת המתנות הגדולות שאבי נתן לי הייתה העוני,' אמר לאי בראיון נדיר ל-TIME לפני הבחירות לנשיאות. 'זה גרם לי לעבוד קשה יותר ולהיות נחוש.' את מוסר העבודה הזה לקח לאי להארוורד, לקריירה כרופא כליות בטייוואן, ובהמשך לכהונות כראש עיריית טיינאן וסגן הנשיאה. כיום, בגיל 64, לאי מועמד מוביל להחליף את הנשיאה צאי אינג-ון בבחירות שיתקיימו בינואר. שניהם מהמפלגה הדמוקרטית הפרוגרסיבית (DPP), אך צאי אינה יכולה להתמודד לקדנציה שלישית. במסע הבחירות שב לאי לוואנלי וזכה לברכות תושבים כ'נשיא'. במקדש המקומי הבטיח לשפר את התחבורה והבריאות לקשישים, אך הדגיש כי היציבות באזור היא בעדיפותו העליונה. המתח עם סין מורגש היטב. בייג'ין טוענת שטייוואן שייכת לה ואיימה להחזיר אותה בכוח במידת הצורך, והופכת את ניהול היחסים בין המדינות לסוגיה המרכזית בבחירות. הנשיא ביידן הבטיח לא פעם להגן על טייוואן מפני תוקפנות סינית. בעוד המועמדים מהאופוזיציה תומכים בדיאלוג עם סין, מפלגת DPP שבשלטון, אשר בייג'ין מכנה 'מעוררי צרות,' אינה מתרשמת מכוונותיה של סין. בסוף אוקטובר הובילו הסקרים עם 32% תמיכה בלאי, 22% בהו יו-יי מהמפלגה הלאומנית (KMT), 20% בקו וון-ג'ה מהמפלגה העממית, ו-5% לטרי גואו (עצמאי). הו וקו דנו באיחוד קולותיהם. לטייוואן חשיבות עולמית: זו הכלכלה ה-16 בגודלה והיא מייצרת 90% מהשבבים המתקדמים בעולם, המניעים את תעשיות הטכנולוגיה וה-AI. הסגר סיני על האי עלול להשפיע על טריליונים בפעילות הגלובלית. לאי אומר, 'טייוואן רוצה להיות ידידה של סין, לא אויבת,' ומביע נכונות לארח את שי ג'ינפינג. עם זאת, ניצחון נוסף ל-DPP יחזק את קו העצמאות, בניגוד לחזון הסיני לאיחוד. לאי טוען, 'אנחנו כבר מדינה ריבונית ועצמאית,' למרות שמרבית מדינות העולם לא מכירות בטייוואן רשמית. ארה"ב מקיימת קשרים לא רשמיים ומספקת נשק לטייוואן, למרות הכרה רשמית בבייג'ין מאז 1979. כל ניסיון טייוואני להרחבת הכרה מסחרית או דיפלומטית נתקל בתגובות חריפות מסין: תרגילים צבאיים, אמברגו וקיפאון דיפלומטי. המתיחות גברה אחרי מלחמות באוקראינה ובמזרח התיכון, עם חשש שמוקד המתיחות הבא יהיה באסיה. ההיחלשות הכלכלית של סין - אבטלת צעירים גבוהה והשקעות זרות יורדות - מגבירות את הלחץ, ויש הרואים בטייוואן שעיר נוח לסין. דגל אוקראינה קבוע בלשכת שר החוץ ג'וזף וו מזכיר את גודל הסיכון. לאחר הפלישה הרוסית האריכה טייוואן את השירות הצבאי לשנה והגדילה את תקציב הביטחון ל-19.1 מיליארד דולר, כולל רכישת 400 טילי ג'אוולין אמריקניים. נחשפה הצוללת הראשונה מתוצרת מקומית. לאי מדגיש את החשיבות בהגנה על הריבונות הטייוואנית. בלב השיח עומדת הסכמה מדינית מ-1992, העוסקת במדיניות 'סין אחת' אך בסתירות. מפלגת DPP מסרבת להכיר בהסכמה זו מתוך טענה לפגיעה בריבונות. מרבית הטייוואנים מזהים עצמם כטייוואנים בלבד; צעירים תומכים בעצמאות ודמוקרטיה. יתרונו של לאי בסקרים נובע יותר מפיצול באופוזיציה ופחות מאהדה גורפת ל-DPP. כלכלת טייוואן צומחת באיטיות והמפלגה סובלת משורת שערוריות, כולל פרשיות #MeToo. עם זאת, יש המעדיפים הקלה מהלחצים הסיניים; בייג'ין יכולה להזרים מיליוני תיירים ולהקל על מדיניות סחר ותיירות, מה שישפר את הכלכלה. האופוזיציה שמה דגש על דיאלוג. לאי מעדיף להעמיק את קשרי המסחר הבינלאומיים כדי להכביד על פגיעה אפשרית. תעשיית השבבים של טייוואן - TSMC, MediaTek ו-ASE - בלב שרשראות האספקה הגלובליות. לאי רואה בטכנולוגיה יתרון אך גם אחריות. טייוואן חתמה על הסכמי סחר חדשים, כמו יוזמת הסחר עם ארה"ב והסכם שותפות עם בריטניה, למרות ביקורת בייג'ין. הסכמים אלה תומכים ברפורמות רגולטוריות ובסיוע לעסקים קטנים. חברות טייוואניות מתרחבות לחו"ל, בעוד ענקיות זרות כמו Nvidia ו-ASML משקיעות באי. אולם מעמד ההובלה של טייוואן טומן גם סיכון: עימות יוציא את הסנקציות נגד סין למסוכנות עבור מדינות נזקקות לשבבים. וורן באפט, לדוג', מכר את אחזקותיו ב-TSMC על רקע מתחים גיאופוליטיים. מומחים מזהירים שמדינות יחששו לפגוע בגישה לשבבים. במטה הבחירות, לאי נפגש עם אנשי עסקים ופעילים, דן בזכויות נכים ובבעיות קהילת הלהט"ב. לאי ידוע באמפתיה ובגילוי לבו. אך הדמוקרטיה חושפת את טייוואן להתערבות זרה, דיסאינפורמציה ושיימינג מכוון. לאחרונה פרש פוליטיקאי DPP לנוכח שערורייה הקשורה לסין, וגם הסנקציות הסיניות הפכו לכלי לחץ. למרות הכול, זהות ייחודית והישגים דמוקרטיים מבדילים את טייוואן מסין. טייוואן מדורגת עשירית בעולם בדמוקרטיה, בעוד סין במקום 156. בזמן שסין דיכאה את זכויות הלהט"ב, טייוואן חוגגת פתיחות ולאי הגיע למצעד הגאווה כבכיר ביותר אי-פעם. הוא מדגיש: 'לא נוותר' – נחושים לשמור על חירות טייוואן אל מול אתגרים מבית ומחוץ.

article_content: Sean Stone, actor and son of director Oliver Stone, has expressed support for Iran and sympathy towards those in the Middle East who question the connection of Jewish settlers to the land of Israel. Stone, 28, who converted to Islam in 2012, has questioned the official account of the 9/11 attacks, suggesting they may have been an 'inside job.' He also described the war on terror as a period marked by constant fear-mongering and aggression. In an interview with Russia Today (RT), Stone argued that the portrayal of terrorists, whether from Russia, North Korea, or Muslim countries, is often used as propaganda. He drew comparisons between suicide bombers and the use of drones, criticizing what he sees as double standards in the labeling of terrorism. Stone has called Iran a 'civilized nation' with a 3,000-year history, challenging the narrative of Iran as a major terrorist threat. He claimed that calling Iran a sponsor of terrorism and labeling Hezbollah as a terrorist group are exaggerations. Stone described Hezbollah as 'defenders of Lebanese sovereignty' since the group operates within Lebanon’s borders. Additionally, Stone showed understanding of why some Middle Easterners view Israel as a 'crusader state,' and noted skepticism about European and Russian Jews' ties to the region. He clarified that while he does not advocate attacking or dissolving Israel, he believes this perspective contributes to ongoing antagonism toward the country. Stone's views partly align with those of his father, who has criticized the influence of pro-Israel lobby groups in Washington. The RT interview has also been covered by outlets such as Yahoo News.
translated_content: שון סטון, שחקן ובנו של הבמאי אוליבר סטון, הביע תמיכה באיראן והפגין הזדהות עם תושבי המזרח התיכון שמטילים ספק בקשר של מתיישבים יהודים לאדמת ישראל. סטון, בן 28, שהמיר דתו לאסלאם בשנת 2012, הטיל ספק בגרסה הרשמית לאירועי 11 בספטמבר וטען כי ייתכן שזו הייתה 'עבודה פנימית'. בנוסף, הוא תיאר את המלחמה בטרור כתקופה המאופיינת בתעמולת פחד מתמדת ואגרסיביות. בראיון לערוץ Russia Today (RT), טען סטון כי הצגת טרוריסטים – מרוסיה, צפון קוריאה או מדינות מוסלמיות – משמשת לעיתים תכופות כתעמולה. הוא השווה בין מחבלים מתאבדים לשימוש ברחפנים, וביקר את מה שהוא רואה כסטנדרטים כפולים בהגדרת טרור. סטון כינה את איראן 'אומה מתורבתת' עם היסטוריה של 3,000 שנה, וערער על הנרטיב לפיו איראן היא איום טרור מרכזי. הוא טען שכינוי איראן 'נותנת חסות לטרור' ותיאוג חיזבאללה כארגון טרור הם הגזמות. סטון תיאר את חיזבאללה כ'מגני הריבונות הלבנונית', משום שאנשיה פועלים בגבולות לבנון. בנוסף, סטון הביע הבנה לכך שתושבים במזרח התיכון רואים בישראל 'מדינת צלבנים', והעלה ספקות לגבי הקשר של יהודים אירופים ורוסים לאזור. הוא הבהיר שאיננו תומך בתקיפת ישראל או בביטולה, אך מאמין שגישה זו תורמת לעוינות כלפיה. עמדותיו של סטון תואמות במידה מסוימת את אלה של אביו, אשר ביקר את השפעת הלובי הפרו-ישראלי בוושינגטון. הראיון ב-RT סוקר גם באתרים כמו Yahoo News.

article_content: Chris Van Niekerk, a 35-year-old RAC patrolman from Sherfield-on-Loddon, Hampshire, was jailed for assaulting his colleague and close friend, Neil Child, after discovering Child with his estranged wife, Lindsay. The incident happened on March 16 during a period when Van Niekerk and Lindsay were separated. Van Niekerk reportedly witnessed Child and Lindsay together through a window at the family home late at night and attacked Child in a fit of rage. Child claimed he was only at the house to collect a birthday present, but Lindsay later admitted to having an affair with him. Initially, Winchester Crown Court Judge Keith Cutler did not accept Van Niekerk's account of provocation and sentenced him to 15 months in prison for causing grievous bodily harm. The judge believed there was no evidence of a sexual relationship at the time of the assault. However, during the appeal, Lindsay confessed to her affair with Child, leading three senior judges at the London Court of Appeal – Mr Justice Collins, Lord Justice Moore-Bick, and Judge Nicholas Cooke QC – to reconsider the case. They acknowledged that Lindsay's actions had significantly affected Van Niekerk's behavior. The appeal court noted that the injuries to Child, while serious, were not as severe as originally reported. With Lindsay's confession and the reconsideration of evidence, Van Niekerk's sentence was reduced to six months, suspended for one year, allowing him to leave court a free man. As part of his suspension, Van Niekerk is not allowed to visit Child's home and plans to live with a friend in Basingstoke. Mr Justice Collins remarked on the severe impact the situation had on Van Niekerk and his family, emphasizing the emotional consequences of the case.
translated_content: כריס ואן ניקרק, פטרולן בן 35 מ-RAC מהעיירה שרפילד-און-לדון בהאמפשייר, נשלח למאסר לאחר שתקף את עמיתו וחברו הקרוב, ניל צ'יילד, לאחר שתפס אותו עם אשתו הפרודה לינדסי. האירוע התרחש ב-16 במרץ, כשוואן ניקרק ולינדסי התגוררו בנפרד. על פי הדיווח, ואן ניקרק ראה את צ'יילד ולינדסי יחד דרך חלון בבית המשפחה בשעת לילה מאוחרת, ותקף את צ'יילד מתוך סערת רגשות. צ'יילד טען כי הגיע לבית רק כדי לאסוף מתנת יום הולדת, אך לינדסי הודתה בדיעבד שניהלה עמו רומן. בתחילה, השופט קית' קאטלר מבית המשפט בווינצ'סטר דחה את טענת ההתגרות של ואן ניקרק וגזר עליו 15 חודשי מאסר על גרימת חבלה גופנית חמורה. השופט סבר שאין עדות ליחסים אינטימיים בזמן התקיפה. עם זאת, במהלך הערעור, לינדסי הודתה ברומן עם צ'יילד, מה שגרם לשלושה שופטים בכירים בבית המשפט לערעורים בלונדון – השופט קולינס, הלורד ג'אסטיס מורה-ביק והשופט ניקולס קוק QC – לבחון מחדש את המקרה. הם הבינו שמעשי לינדסי השפיעו משמעותית על התנהגותו של ואן ניקרק. בית המשפט לערעורים ציין כי הפציעות של צ'יילד, על אף שהיו רציניות, לא היו חמורות כפי שסברו תחילה. בשל הודאתה של לינדסי והערכת ראיות מחודשת, עונשו של ואן ניקרק הופחת לשישה חודשי מאסר על תנאי לשנה, והוא שוחרר לביתו. במסגרת עונשו המותנה, ואן ניקרק מנוע מלהתקרב לביתו של צ'יילד ומתכנן להתגורר אצל חבר בבייסינגסטוק. השופט קולינס הדגיש את הנזק הרגשי המשמעותי שעברו ואן ניקרק ומשפחתו בעקבות הפרשה.

President Joe Biden will visit Israel and neighboring Jordan on Wednesday, amid the escalating conflict between Israel and Hamas. U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken confirmed that the trip will reaffirm America’s support for Israel, calling it a critical moment for Israel, the region, and the world. Blinken stated that the President will underscore the United States’ solidarity with Israel and its unwavering commitment to Israel’s security.

White House National Security Council spokesperson John Kirby told reporters that Biden intends to discuss Israel's military strategy and progress with Israeli officials, as well as determine what support Israel requires to continue defending itself. The President will also address the issue of nearly 200 hostages believed to be held by Hamas in the Gaza Strip and coordinate efforts for their release.

After Israel, Biden will travel to Amman, Jordan, to meet with Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas, Jordan’s King Abdullah, and Egypt’s President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi. The leaders will discuss the humanitarian needs of civilians in Gaza. Kirby emphasized that innocent civilians, regardless of nationality or religion, should not become victims of conflict, stating, “The number of appropriate civilian casualties is zero.”

Kirby noted that despite the trip lasting just one day, the agenda is extensive. He reiterated that Israel has the right to defend itself against Hamas and that the United States will continue to support this effort. Kirby also accused Hamas of endangering civilians by using them as shields and obstructing their movement.

This will be Biden’s second trip to a war zone this year, following his unannounced visit to Ukraine in February. Since October 7, attacks by Hamas have resulted in more than 1,400 Israeli deaths and 3,400 injuries, with reports of brutality against civilians. In response, Israel has launched airstrikes on Gaza, causing significant destruction and displacing thousands of Palestinians. article_content: The Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) is under fire after spending over £5 million on tablet computers designed to cut down on paper use in courts. Buying 4,700 tablets at £865 apiece, the CPS intended for prosecutors to handle digital files more efficiently. However, these tablets have faced numerous problems: they’re unable to display video evidence (prompting an extra £102,000 spend on DVD players), are reportedly heavy to hold during lengthy hearings, have batteries that can fail at important moments, and are more difficult for document review than paper folders. Over two years, another £1.5 million went to software support and maintenance, bringing total spending to more than £5.5 million. Shadow Attorney General Emily Thornberry, after raising the issue in Parliament, criticized the move as wasteful amidst recent funding cuts, suggesting that the tablets are not fit for purpose. The CPS defended the decision, arguing that transitioning to digital systems will ultimately save money, increase efficiency, and remove the need for bulky paperwork and printing.

One of the largest art thefts in Los Angeles history began when a housekeeper left the home of an elderly, bedridden couple. According to Los Angeles Police art theft detective Don Hrycyk, "There was a small window of opportunity for the crime to have occurred." Upon the housekeeper's return, empty hooks marked where the paintings once hung. The couple, Anton and Susan Roland of Encino, California, were too incapacitated to be aware the daytime burglary was taking place, authorities said. In total, 12 paintings were stolen, among them a watercolor by Marc Chagall titled "Le Paysans" and a work on paper by Diego Rivera titled "Mexican Peasant."

It took six years before the FBI and Los Angeles investigators received a crucial tip from overseas. This information led them to set up an undercover operation to purchase the stolen paintings from a man at a West Los Angeles hotel. Nine of the paintings, valued at up to $12 million, were recovered during this operation in October, authorities reported. The remaining three paintings are still missing. Detective Hrycyk said, "This is the greatest value we've had in recent history."

Raul Espinoza, age 45, has been charged with receiving stolen property and has pleaded not guilty. He is being held on $5 million bail, according to Los Angeles District Attorney's office spokesman Ricardo Santiago. Espinoza's public defender was not immediately available for comment.

Authorities continue to investigate and believe additional individuals were involved in the theft. FBI assistant director Bill Lewis stated at a press conference that selling such high-value, unique artworks is extremely difficult: "Maybe a person has the ability to commit the crime ... but then to profit from it, it's going to be very difficult. As you can see, it's been six years since the crime occurred, and still the art was not sold. These things are one of a kind, irreplaceable, and have historical and cultural value." Hrycyk also noted, "L.A. is the second largest area for the visual arts in this country, and we need to have the resources to pursue these types of crimes."

Investigators have limited descriptions of the remaining missing paintings, other than that one is by Hungarian artist Endre Szasz, due to the couple's extensive collection. The recovered paintings were found without frames and show some signs of damage, but generally remain in fair condition. Sadly, Anton Roland died four months after the theft, and Susan Roland passed away earlier this year before the recovery, authorities said. As the art insurance company has made a payout to the couple, it now owns the recovered paintings. However, such policies typically allow family members an opportunity to repurchase the artwork and regain title.

A $25,000 reward remains for information leading to the arrest and conviction of the conspirators. "The FBI and the LAPD will not give up on any investigation until we have been able to recover the artifacts and bring the people responsible to justice," said Lewis.

List of recovered paintings:
- "Blue Bottle" by Hans Hofmann (1947), signed and dated, 49 3/4" x 62 1/8" unframed
- "La Femme en Rouge" by Chaim Soutine (circa 1926), signed, oil on canvas, 29 7/8" x 21 3/4" unframed
- "Figur mit Hund" by Emil Nolde (circa 1912), signed, oil on canvas, 31 5/8" x 27 9/16" unframed
- "La Vieille Dame au Chien" by Chaim Soutine (circa 1919), oil on canvas, 36 1/4" x 25 5/8" unframed
- "Le Paysans" by Marc Chagall (circa 1976), signed, watercolor, gouache, and ink on paper, 24" x 18 1/2" framed
- "Fin de Seance" by Lyonel Feininger (circa 1910), signed and dated, oil on canvas, 37 3/8" x 33 3/4" framed
- "Portrait of Alicia Alanova" by Kees Van Dongen (circa 1933), signed, oil on canvas, 25 5/8" x 21 1/2" unframed, with original inner liner
- "Cubist Still Life" by Arshile Gorky (circa 1928-1929), unsigned, oil on canvas, 22 1/8" x 15 1/8" framed
- "Mexican Peasant" by Diego Rivera (circa 1938), signed and dated, water-based media on paper, 14 7/8" x 10 3/8" framed

אחת מהפרשיות הגדולות בתולדות גניבת האמנות בלוס אנג'לס התרחשה כאשר עוזרת הבית יצאה מביתם של בני זוג קשישים מרותקים למיטה. לדבריו של דון הריצ'יק, בלש במשטרת לוס אנג'לס המתמחה בגניבות אמנות: "הייתה חלונית זמן קצרה בה הפשע יכל להתרחש." כששבה העוזרת, נראו קרסים ריקים במקום בו היו תלויות היצירות. אנטון וסוזן רולנד מאנסינו, קליפורניה, היו חולים מדי מכדי להיות מודעים לשוד, כך לפי הרשויות. בסך הכול נגנבו 12 יצירות, ביניהן אקוורל של מארק שאגאל בשם "הפלאחים" ויצירה של דייגו ריברה בשם "איכר מקסיקני".

חולפות שש שנים עד ש-FBI ובלשי לוס אנג'לס קיבלו מידע קריטי מחו"ל, שבעטיו הוקם מבצע סמוי לרכישת היצירות הגנובות מגבר בבית מלון במערב לוס אנג'לס. תשע מהיצירות, בשווי כולל שעד 12 מיליון דולר, אותרו במבצע זה באוקטובר — לדברי הרשויות. שלוש יצירות עדיין חסרות. "זה השווי הגבוה ביותר בעשורים האחרונים," אמר הריצ'יק.

ראול אספינוזה, בן 45, הואשם בקבלת רכוש גנוב והכחיש את האישום. הוא מוחזק בערבות של 5 מיליון דולר, כך לדובר לשכת התובע של מחוז לוס אנג'לס, ריקרדו סנטיאגו. הסנגור הציבורי של אספינוזה לא התפנה לתגובת תקשורת.

החקירה נמשכת והרשויות סבורות שיש מעורבים נוספים. סגן מנהל ה-FBI בלוס אנג'לס, ביל לואיס, אמר במסיבת עיתונאים שמכירת יצירות כאלה היא אתגר רציני: "אולי מישהו מסוגל לבצע את הפשע, אבל להרוויח ממנו זו בעיה. כבר שש שנים מאז המעשה, והאמנות לא נמכרה. אלו פריטים חד-פעמיים, בלתי ניתנים להחלפה, ובעלי ערך תרבותי והיסטורי." הריצ'יק הדגיש: "לוס אנג'לס היא העיר השנייה בגודלה באמנות חזותית בארה"ב — ואנו זקוקים למשאבים ללחימה בפשע כזה."

לצוות החקירה יש מידע מוגבל לגבי שלוש היצירות שטרם נמצאו, אחת מהן מיוחסת לאמן ההונגרי אנדרה סאז, בשל גודל האוסף של בני הזוג. היצירות שנמצאו ללא מסגרות, וניכרו בהן סימני נזק — אך מצב רובן נחשב לסביר. לצערם, אנטון רולנד מת ארבעה חודשים לאחר הגניבה, וסוזן רולנד הלכה לעולמה מוקדם יותר השנה, לפני שחזרה האמנות לאוספם, כך מסרו הרשויות. מאחר וחברת הביטוח שילמה פיצוי, היא מחזיקה בבעלות על היצירות — אבל בדרך כלל בני משפחה רשאים לרכוש אותן מחדש.

פרס בסך 25,000$ מוצע למי שיאתר ויביא להרשעת המעורבים. "ה-FBI והמשטרה לא יוותרו עד שנשיב את החפצים ונתפוס את האחראים," אמר לואיס.

article_content: In 'Pictures at an Exhibition', artist Paul Wyse utilizes the piano's natural curves to create an illusion of depth. Pianos are often prized as valuable pieces of furniture, sometimes being the most expensive item in a home, but rarely are they seen as true works of art. That changes with models like Mark Bradford’s ‘Apollo’ (which sold for $365,000 at Christie’s in 2016), Fazioli’s ‘The Butterfly’, and Ambika Hinduja’s ‘Harmony of Nature’; these grand pianos represent a unique category—art-case pianos—that perfectly blend art and music. Art-case pianos are crafted similarly to regular pianos, but with additional artistic elements such as 24-carat gold gilding, malachite stonework, or hand-carved wood. Historically, they were commissioned by European royalty to convey political power or display wealth. Today, these pianos are made for discerning clients and collectors, often through collaborations between renowned piano makers and artists. In 2020, Edelweiss Pianos and their design team Goldfinch crafted ‘The Solis’ for a Los Angeles client, using aged bronze and a 23.5-carat gold leaf finish to evoke a Californian desert sunset. That same year, Steinway unveiled ‘La Mer’, a white Model M grand piano painted with vivid seascapes. Paul Wyse, a renowned Steinway artist and pianist, explains that a plain piano can appear underwhelming in an elegant space, leading buyers to invest in more distinctive pieces which may gain value and even become museum exhibits. Wyse’s own 'Pictures at an Exhibition' is on display at Steinway Hall, NYC, and is available for $2.7 million. Art-case pianos occupy a niche market, representing less than one percent of Steinway & Sons’ sales, according to Anthony Gilroy, V-P of marketing. Buyers are usually wealthy, and view the purchase as equivalent to acquiring a luxury car or rare gem. Steinway has seen increased demand for bespoke pianos, a trend echoed globally by specialists such as Sonny Stancarone of Sonny’s Luxury Art Case Pianos, who sells to clients from Hong Kong to Hawaii. Stancarone shares that clients include Dubai royalty and Indian expatriate families, as well as art collectors in Hong Kong and India. He notes that finding an appreciative buyer can take considerable time. Art-case pianos are also popular among luxury interior designers. For example, Fazioli’s ‘The Butterfly’ was designed for the lobby of Vancouver’s Butterfly Building, with piano legs reflecting the tower’s unique curves. Vancouver’s Fairmont Pacific Rim features another custom Fazioli creation. The cost of a new Steinway grand piano starts around Rs 1.9 crore, but art-case pianos can be much more expensive, depending on the artwork’s complexity and materials. Artist Erin Johnson points out that altering original antiques can harm their artistic and resale value, so he often declines such projects. In India, Furtados Music, the exclusive Steinway dealer, reports limited demand for art-case pianos but increasing interest in exotic and customized finishes. Chetan Gupte, national manager, notes that most art-case buyers are collectors looking to personalize their luxury spaces. Furtados sells around 6–7 Steinways a year. Steinway’s Spirio system appeals to buyers who may not play piano but appreciate automated high-quality performances. Adding Spirio technology can raise the price of a grand piano by $29,000. Since the 20th century, mass production reduced the prevalence of custom art-case pianos, but renewed interest is now seen among collectors and high net-worth individuals.

לבן מדגם M עם ציורי ים סוחפים. פול וייס, אמן פסנתר שטיינווי ופסנתרן קלאסי ידוע, מסביר שפסנתר פשוט עלול להיראות סתמי בחלל אלגנטי, ולכן לעתים קונים משקיעים בפסנתר ייחודי שיכולים לעלות בערכם ואף להגיע למוזיאון. יצירתו 'תמונות בתערוכה' מוצגת באולם של שטיינווי בניו-יורק ומוצעת למכירה ב-2.7 מיליון דולר. פסנתרי Art-Case מהווים נישה קטנה – פחות מאחוז ממכירות שטיינווי, לדברי אנתוני גילרוי, סגן נשיא שיווק. הקונים לרוב אמידים, ורואים בכך רכישת יוקרה כמו רכב יוקרתי או אבן נדירה. שטיינווי מדווחת על עלייה עולמית בביקוש לפסנתרים בהתאמה אישית, מגמה שניכרת גם אצל סוני סטנקרון מסוני'ס ארט קייס בניו-יורק, article_content: A mother whose baby was baptised at birth due to a grim medical prognosis has seen her daughter make a remarkable recovery. Kellie Burville, 27, from south London, developed a rare pregnancy condition, Neonatal Alloimmune Thrombocytopenia (NAIT), causing her immune system to attack her unborn child's platelets. Doctors informed Kellie and her partner, Callum Campbell, 23, that their baby Logan was at high risk of severe brain damage and offered options including pregnancy termination. Despite the devastating outlook, Kellie, nearly full-term, chose to proceed. After a scan at 36 weeks suggested complications, further checks revealed a brain bleed and Logan's head was found to be twice the normal size due to fluid build-up. Kellie underwent a caesarean section, delivering Logan at 5lb 5oz. Logan was in critical condition after birth, with an extremely low platelet count—far below the normal newborn range. She received a blood transfusion, and doctors prepared the parents for the possibility she would not survive. Despite the initial prognosis, Logan rapidly improved, surprising medical staff. At four days old, she was diagnosed with NAIT thanks to family research and a simple blood test. Supported by Chelsea and Westminster Hospital’s neonatal team, she was allowed home soon after. At four months old, Logan continues to meet all developmental milestones, and her consultant reports she is healthy, with no current need for further intervention. The family's experience highlights the challenges and uncertainties of rare pregnancy complications and underscores the importance of support and advocacy during medical crises. A spokesperson for Chelsea and Westminster Hospital confirmed the family's options were clearly communicated and expressed delight at Logan’s recovery.

article_content: The headquarters of the Nigerian Army's 6 Division in Port Harcourt has announced the recovery of the body of a soldier who died during a boat accident in Bolo, Ogu/Bolo Local Government Area of Rivers State. The incident occurred on Saturday, November 25, 2023, when a gunboat carrying the soldier was struck by a turbulent wave while he was on active duty securing national assets in the Niger Delta waterways. The soldier, whose identity has not been disclosed, was reported missing following the accident. A search and rescue operation led to the recovery of his body and the boat involved. In a statement released by Major Danjuma, Acting Deputy Director of Army Public Relations, the Division expressed its condolences and described the loss as a supreme sacrifice in the defense of the nation. Major General Jamal Abdussalam, General Officer Commanding 6 Division and Commander of Operation Delta Safe, also extended sympathies to the soldier's family, expressing sorrow for the incident and honoring the soldier’s dedication and service to the nation.

article_content: The Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) has announced a 70% chance of an El Nino weather pattern developing in Australia this summer, up from 50% just two weeks ago. El Nino is a climate phenomenon that occurs roughly every five years, characterized by significant warming of the Pacific Ocean’s surface temperatures. In Australia, El Nino typically leads to droughts and extreme heat, especially along the eastern and southern coasts—regions already experiencing dry conditions. The BoM’s latest forecast, published in its fortnightly El Nino Southern Oscillation (ENSO) Wrap-Up, upgraded the alert status from 'watch' to 'alert.' Andrew Watkins, the Bureau’s manager of climate prediction services, noted: 'We’re seeing very warm temperatures in the tropical Pacific Ocean, about one degree above average. Conditions have evolved rapidly in recent weeks, and the central tropical Pacific now shows temperatures consistent with El Nino levels.' El Nino's impacts extend beyond Australia. Pacific Rim countries that depend on agriculture and fishing are particularly vulnerable. Prolonged El Nino phases can seriously harm fishing industries. Its counterpart, La Nina, brings cooler-than-average Pacific Ocean temperatures and increases the chances of cyclones across the Asia-Pacific region. Australia has already experienced two major heatwaves this spring. Sub-surface temperatures in the central to eastern Pacific are now about four degrees warmer than average. October temperatures in Australia were 2.8 degrees above normal and very dry, with similar conditions reported in Malaysia and Indonesia. Meanwhile, South America, particularly along the coasts of Peru and Ecuador, has seen significant flooding during recent El Nino years. Watkins explained that the Bureau relies on several international models from France, England, the United States, Canada, and Japan, as well as its own 'Poama' model, to inform its predictions. According to U.S. agencies, the April–September 2014 period was the warmest on record, putting 2014 in contention to be the hottest year to date. The previous record is jointly held by 2005 and 2010. Watkins cautioned that classifying an El Nino is not straightforward: 'It is not a sudden change, but a gradual progression. However, we are observing clear signs that El Nino conditions could be established by December.' Warmer Pacific waters and cooler seas around northern Australia may reduce the number of tropical cyclones making landfall but also decrease tropical rain depressions, which are vital for drought-affected farmers in Queensland. Watkins noted these farmers have already endured several poor wet seasons, and a third could have serious consequences. The El Nino event of 2009/10 resulted in severe drought across much of eastern Australia.

שנים, ומתאפיינת בהתחממות משמעותית של פני שטח האוקיינוס השקט. באוסטרליה, אל ניניו גורם לרוב לבצורות ולחום קיצוני, במיוחד לאורך החופים המזרחיים והדרומיים – אזורים שכבר כעת נמצאים בתנאים יבשים. בתחזית החדשה שפורסמה בעדכון הדו-שבועי של הלשכה ('ENSO Wrap-Up'), שודרגה רמת הכוננות מ'מעקב' ל'התראה'. אנדרו ווטקינס, מנהל שירות תחזיות האקלים בלשכה, אמר: 'אנחנו רואים טמפרטורות גבוהות במיוחד באוקיינוס השקט הטרופי, בערך מעלה אחת מעל הממוצע. התנאים השתנו במהירות בשבועות האחרונים, וכעת הטמפרטורות במרכז האוקיינוס הטרופי מתאימות לרמות של אל ניניו.' השפעותיו של אל ניניו חורגות מגבולות אוסטרליה. מדינות באזור הפסיפי התלויות בחקלאות ודיג פגיעות במיוחד. תקופות ממושכות של אל ניניו עלולות לפגוע קשות בתעשיות הדיג. מנגד, תופעת לה ניניה מביאה לירידת טמפרטורות באוקיינוס השקט ולהגברת הסיכון לציקלונים באסיה-פסיפיק. אוסטרליה כבר חוותה שני גלי חום משמעותיים השנה באביב. טמפרטורות תת-קרקעיות במרכז ובמזרח האוקיינוס השקט גבוהות כעת בארבע מעלות מהממוצע. אוקטובר היה חם מהרגיל – 2.8 מעלות מעל הנורמה – ויבש מאוד, עם תנאים דומים במלזיה ובאינדונזיה. במקביל, בדרום אמריקה – במיוחד לאורך חופי פרו ואקוודור – נרשמו הצפות קשות בשנות אל ניניו האחרונות. ווטקינס הסביר כי הלשכה נשענת על מספר מודלים בינלאומיים מצרפת, אנגליה, ארה"ב, קנדה ויפן, וכן על המודל שלה ('פואמה'), כדי להפיק את התחזיות. לפי סוכנויות בארה"ב, אפריל–ספטמבר 2014 הייתה התקופה החמה ביותר שנרשמה, מה שמציב את 2014 כמועמדת לשנה החמה ביותר אי פעם. השיא הקודם שייך ל-2005 ו-2010. ווטקינס הדגיש כי לא קל לקבוע מתי אל ניניו מתחיל: 'זו לא שינוי חד, אלא תהליך הדרגתי. עם זאת, אנו רואים סימנים ברורים לכך שהתנאים של אל ניניו עשויים להתבסס עד דצמבר.' טמפרטורות גבוהות באוקיינוס השקט יחד עם מים קרים בצפון אוסטרליה עלולים להוביל לפחות ציקלונים, אך גם לפחות גשמים טרופיים החיוניים לחקלאים שנפגעו מבצורת בקווינסלנד. לדברי ווטקינס, החקלאים כבר סבלו מעונות רטובות חלשות, ועונה שלישית כזו תהיה בעייתית במיוחד. ב-2009/10 הביא אל ניניו לבצורת קשה ברחבי מזרח אוסטרליה.

article_content: A beauty salon in South Kensington, London, has come under fire for charging customers extra for leg waxing based on their dress size. MM Bubbles applies a £5 surcharge for clients who are a UK size 12 or above, and the fee can rise to £10 for those size 18 or higher. Although the regular price for a leg wax is currently £21 as part of a promotion, larger customers pay more. The salon has argued that the additional charge is needed to offset the higher amount of materials required for waxing larger legs. This policy, which some have called a 'fat tax,' has stirred up controversy. In a test by a model wearing size 22-24, she was charged £26—£5 more than the listed price. The salon told her that the extra cost was due to greater product use. Not every customer is bothered by the policy, but there are worries that it might negatively impact people who are self-conscious about their size. Another woman, between sizes 14 and 16, was reportedly charged £10 above the standard rate. Christina Damela, a salon staff member, confirmed these additional charges for larger clients, even as the average UK women's dress size has reached 16.

Raymond Hollingsworth, a 60-year-old self-employed businessman from Fleet, Hampshire, died by suicide after struggling with financial difficulties during the recession. A father of two and known as a keen gardener and runner, Mr. Hollingsworth was found hanging from a bridge over the Basingstoke Canal on November 27 last year. His body was discovered by dog walker Philip Hinsley. An inquest heard that Mr. Hollingsworth had left a signed note inside his passport stating: 'No work, no money, no pension, no future.'

According to his wife Linda, Mr. Hollingsworth did not show signs of depression or unhappiness prior to his death. She revealed that he had managed the family's finances alone and had concealed several business loans and credit card debts, including loans with Barclays, after discovering that his private pension would not pay out as expected. The couple had marked his 60th birthday with family and friends just days before his death, and had spent a normal evening together the night before.

Police and pathologist reports confirmed there was no evidence of foul play, with Coroner Andrew Bradley recording a verdict of suicide. Mental health charity SANE recently reported that the recession had contributed to an increase in suicides, especially among middle-aged men. Figures from the Office for National Statistics show that in 2011, suicides among men aged 45-59 increased by 8.5% since 2007, reaching 22.2 deaths per 100,000 people, with overall UK suicides totaling 6,045 that year.

article_content: Christopher Luxon, head of New Zealand's National Party and a former business executive, is set to become the country’s next prime minister after a clear electoral win on Saturday. This marks the conclusion of six years of Labour Party rule led by Jacinda Ardern and, more recently, Chris Hipkins. The final shape of Luxon’s government is yet to be decided, as vote counting continues, but he was met with enthusiastic applause in Auckland as he appeared alongside his family. He expressed his appreciation to New Zealanders for voting for change and reiterated his pledge to get the nation 'back on track.' Outgoing Prime Minister Chris Hipkins, who succeeded Ardern earlier this year, called Luxon to concede and spoke to his supporters in Wellington. While acknowledging his disappointment, Hipkins encouraged supporters to take pride in Labour’s achievements during their time in power. Ardern, having stepped down in January, had previously secured a landslide electoral victory, but her popularity faded amid dissatisfaction with pandemic restrictions and economic challenges. Her departure allowed Hipkins, the former education minister and COVID-19 response leader, to take over. With most votes counted, the National Party had about 40%, making a coalition with the ACT Party likely under New Zealand’s proportional electoral system. Labour’s support dropped to just over 25%. The Mount Albert seat, a historic Labour stronghold previously held by Ardern, is now highly contested. National’s candidate in Mount Albert, Melissa Lee, reported mixed feelings as final results were awaited, and said many locals expressed concerns about the economy and the cost of living. Conservative pollster David Farrar noted that while Labour might still retain Mount Albert, initial trends represent a major loss for the political left across the country. Luxon, formerly heading Air New Zealand and Unilever Canada, ran on promises to cut taxes for middle earners and be tougher on crime. Hipkins, on the other hand, advocated for expanding free dental care to those under 30 and scrapping sales taxes on fruit and vegetables. The election also brought attention to differing views on Māori representation, with Luxon vowing to dissolve the Māori Health Authority, arguing it divides health services, while Hipkins backed such initiatives as valuable co-governance. Both leaders campaigned nationwide, with Hipkins facing significant challenges from natural disasters soon after taking office. While considered a political newcomer, Luxon was seen as an effective debater, though he drew online criticism for underestimating the weekly cost of groceries in a televised discussion—a comment many felt showed his distance from everyday struggles.

Sir Ben Ainslie and Georgie Thompson expressed their gratitude to Sir Richard Branson after he came to their aid when their yacht experienced mechanical problems during their honeymoon. The couple had been sailing near Branson's Necker Island in the British Virgin Islands shortly after their December wedding when their yacht encountered an issue with its sail furling system. After messaging for assistance, members of the island's watersports team responded, helping to cut the sail and prevent the vessel from being wrecked on a reef. Branson then invited Ainslie and Thompson to stay on Necker Island for a few days. A photo captured Necker Island staff members Marco Bava, George Lambert, and Adam Chubbock posing alongside the couple after the rescue.

Ainslie, a four-time Olympic champion, told Sky Sports News, 'Unfortunately, we had a mechanical failure with the mast furling system, which was a bit much for just the two of us to fix on our own. We were very lucky to be near Necker Island, and the team from the sailing centre were absolutely amazing. Together, we managed to resolve the situation.' He added, 'Then Richard very kindly phoned and invited us over for dinner.'

The newlyweds chose not to let the mishap spoil their honeymoon and accepted Branson's invitation to stay on Necker Island. Branson tweeted about the rescue and wrote on his blog that he had not expected to be rescuing an Olympic sailor. Thompson, relieved to be on land, gladly accepted Branson's offer. 'Dinner became a two-day stay, which was lovely,' she said. 'At the end of our honeymoon, after three weeks on a boat, it was welcome to have a couple of days of luxury without mechanical problems.'

Branson and Ainslie previously faced difficulties at sea together when their 2008 attempt to set an Atlantic crossing record ended after their boat was damaged by wind and waves. Ainslie, the most decorated Olympic sailor in history, has medaled at the last five Olympics and helped Oracle Team USA overturn an 8-1 deficit to win the America's Cup in 2013. The couple married at London's Hampton Court on December 20 and spent time in Antigua before embarking on their yacht trip around the British Virgin Islands.

article_content: South Africa edged past a 14-man New Zealand side 12-11 in a tightly contested Rugby World Cup final, securing the Webb Ellis Cup for a record fourth time. All Blacks captain Sam Cane became the first player to be red-carded in a World Cup final after a high tackle, which left New Zealand playing most of the match one man down. The final, held at Stade de France before 80,065 spectators, saw an unprecedented number of cards: one red and three yellows issued in 80 minutes, reflecting a greater clampdown on foul play. Despite the disadvantage, New Zealand scored the only try of the game through Beauden Barrett and came within a point of South Africa. Handre Pollard's four first-half penalties ultimately proved decisive for the Springboks, adding to their previous titles from 1995, 2007, and 2019. Man of the Match Pieter-Steph du Toit led South Africa’s strong defense in the closing stages, preserving the narrow lead. Siya Kolisi became the second captain, after Richie McCaw, to lift the trophy twice, and dedicated the win to South Africans, highlighting the significance of unity amid national challenges. Shannon Frizell was the first player to be shown a yellow card early in the match for a tackle that resulted in an injury to Springboks hooker Bongi Mbonambi. Kolisi also spent time in the sin bin for a high tackle but was not permanently dismissed. Coach Ian Foster voiced concerns over card consistency, noting similarities in incidents with different rulings. Cane expressed regret over his red card, saying he would have to live with it for life.

article_content: What would you do if you met a future version of yourself? In Charles Yu's debut novel, 'How to Live Safely in a Science Fictional Universe,' the protagonist faces exactly that paradox. When he encounters his future self, a humorous but dark chain of events unfolds—a situation both absurd and profound. Yu's novel has received praise for blending elements of string theory, existential humor reminiscent of 'The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy,' and the introspection of Philip Roth. The book follows a time machine repairman living in Minor Universe 31, an alternate reality, who finds himself stuck in a time loop. Along the way, he develops feelings for his computer operating system, Tammy, and grapples with family dysfunction. Beneath the science fiction tropes, Yu tackles themes of memory, regret, and the complex emotional dynamics within families. 'At its heart, the novel is about marriage and the father-son relationship,' Yu explains. Using the metaphor of a time machine, he explores how families create and live within their own stories, shaped by shared experiences over time. Yu views the novel itself as a kind of technological device—an imaginative time machine navigating both physical and psychological spaces. The protagonist's literal and figurative 'stuckness'—trapped in a box, a time loop, and his own past—mirrors the ways people sometimes struggle to move forward in their lives. While deeply rooted in science fiction, the book is accessible even to those unfamiliar with the genre. Yu enjoyed researching scientific concepts and weaving them into the story, likening the process to exploring a new universe. Despite fleeting moments of inspiration, he found writing the novel challenging, echoing Thomas Mann's sentiment that writing can be more difficult for writers than for others. The main character shares Yu’s name, but the author insists the story is not autobiographical except in its depiction of close family relationships. Yu highlights his fascination with the intricate, sometimes strained connections within families. Yu cites literary figures such as Philip Roth, Nicholson Baker, Richard Powers, and Umberto Eco as influences, noting Eco's work on narrative structure. He also draws inspiration from comic books and video games, seeking to create an environment governed by unique rules and logic. Despite juggling his career as a lawyer and his responsibilities as a husband and father, Yu managed to write in small increments during nights and weekends, occasionally dozing off at his computer. Yu's appearance at Comic-Con introduced his work to many new fans. His publisher supported the event with creative promotional materials, and Yu enjoyed engaging with fellow enthusiasts of fictional worlds. Comic-Con, he reflects, is a celebration of storytelling across genres. Looking ahead, Yu is working on a new novel as well as potential projects inspired by the universe of his debut, possibly in serial or comic book form. Asked about a possible film adaptation, Yu is excited by the prospect and jokes that his brother Kelvin, an actor, would be perfect for the lead—unless Hollywood star Matt Damon is available. Yu offers one final piece of advice: 'If you ever find yourself face to face with a future version of yourself, don't shoot! You may regret it.'
translated_content: מה הייתם עושים אם הייתם פוגשים את עצמכם מהעתיד? ברומן הביכורים של צ'ארלס יו, "איך לחיות בבטחה ביקום מדע-בדיוני", הגיבור מתמודד בדיוק עם הפרדוקס הזה. כשהוא פוגש את עצמו מהעתיד, מתפתחת שרשרת אירועים משעשעת אבל גם עמוקה—סיטואציה אבסורדית ומרגשת. הספר של יו זכה לשבחים על השילוב בין תורת המיתרים, הומור קיומי בסגנון "מדריך הטרמפיסט לגלקסיה" ובחינה עצמית כמו של פיליפ רות'. העלילה עוקבת אחרי טכנאי תיקון מכונות זמן, שחי ביקום משני 31 ונקלע ללולאת זמן. במהלכה הוא מתאהב במערכת ההפעלה שלו, טמי, ומתמודד עם משפחה מעט מורכבת. מעבר לאלמנטים של מדע בדיוני, יו נוגע גם בזיכרון, חרטה ומערכות יחסים משפחתיות מורכבות. "בלב הסיפור יש נישואין וקשר בין אב ובן," אומר יו. דרך מטפורת מכונת הזמן הוא חוקר איך משפחות יוצרות לעצמן סיפורים לאורך הזמן. יו מתאר את הרומן עצמו כמכשיר טכנולוגי—מכונת זמן דמיונית שמבקרת במרחבים פיזיים ופסיכולוגיים. 'התקיעות' של הגיבור—בתוך קופסה, לולאת זמן, ובעבר—משקפת את התחושה של לא פעם קשה לזוז הלאה. למרות שמדובר במדע בדיוני, הספר נגיש גם למי שלא חובבי הז'אנר. יו מספר שנהנה לשלב רעיונות מדעיים בעלילה ואהב את תחושת הגילוי. לצד רגעי השראה, תהליך הכתיבה היה לו מאתגר, כמו שצוטט תומאס מאן: "כתיבה לעיתים אף קשה יותר לסופר מאשר לכל אחד אחר." הגיבור נושא את שמו של יו, אך הוא מבהיר שהסיפור אינו אוטוביוגרפי, חוץ מהדגש על יחסים משפחתיים קרובים. יו מציין שהוא סקרן במיוחד למשפחתיות המורכבת. יו שואב השראה מסופרים כמו פיליפ רות', ניקולסון בייקר, ריצ'רד פאוורס ואומברטו אקו וכן מקומיקס ומשחקי מחשב, ורצה ליצור תחושת עולם עם כללים ולוגיקה מיוחדים. למרות עבודתו כעו"ד ומחויבותיו למשפחה, יו כתב בלילות ובסופי שבוע, לפעמים כשהוא נרדם מול המסך. ההופעה של יו בקומיק-קון הקפיצה את הפופולריות שלו. המו"ל דאג לשיווק יצירתי, ויו נהנה להיפגש עם חובבי סיפורים. קומיק-קון עבורו הוא חגיגה של סיפורים מכל הסוגים. יו עובד על רומן חדש וגם על פרויקטים נוספים שמבוססים על היקום של ספרו הראשון—אולי סדרה או קומיקס. כשנשאל על גרסת סרט, יו מתלהב ומציע שאחיו קלווין, שחקן, מתאים לתפקיד הראשי—אלא אם מאט דיימון פנוי. ועצה אחרונה: "אם תמצאו יום אחד את עצמכם פנים אל פנים עם הגרסה העתידית שלכם—אל תירו! כנראה תצטערו על זה."

article_content: Just days after being rescued from the Idaho wilderness, where an FBI agent ended her abduction by fatally shooting her kidnapper, 16-year-old Hannah Anderson attended a fundraiser close to her home in Lakeside, California. The gathering at Boll Weevil restaurant brought out community support for Hannah and her family during their recovery. While the media was present outside, only Hannah’s father, Brett Anderson, spoke to reporters. He thanked everyone involved—friends, family, law enforcement, and neighbors—for their solidarity, emphasizing that such unity defines Lakeside. Earlier in the month, Hannah disappeared following a cheerleading practice. The next day, the bodies of her mother, Christina, and her 8-year-old brother, Ethan, were found at the burned home of James DiMaggio, a family acquaintance, and both were victims of violence. The search for Hannah intensified once authorities discovered DiMaggio’s car near Cascade, Idaho, and horseback riders reported seeing the pair. The riders noted unusual details, like their new camping gear and Hannah’s pajama-like trousers, prompting them to alert authorities. Brett Anderson later personally thanked these horsemen, attributing his daughter’s rescue to their vigilance. After a long trek, authorities found DiMaggio and Hannah’s campsite near Morehead Lake. In the rescue, an FBI agent shot and killed DiMaggio, bringing the ordeal to an end. Hannah was taken to safety soon after. Brett Anderson relayed that Hannah is recovering and sent appreciation to everyone for their care and support. Friends like Alyssa Haugum described her as resilient, cheerful, and strong—even after her harrowing experience—adding that she always believed Hannah would make it back home.

article_content: A recent study predicts that nearly four million people born outside the UK will be eligible to vote in the forthcoming General Election, a historic high following a decade of significant immigration. This number has grown by approximately 500,000 since the previous election, accounting for about 10% of the electorate. In an unprecedented shift, over half of the voting population in the London seats of East Ham and Brent North are foreign-born. Similarly, at least a quarter of voters in ten other constituencies outside London are from overseas. In 25 seats, this figure rises to a third, and in an additional 50, foreign-born voters make up at least 25%. Manchester University researchers emphasize that this evolving demographic could be crucial in determining outcomes in 20 marginal seats—across constituencies held by Labour, Conservative, and Liberal Democrat MPs. The largest foreign-born voter groups in England and Wales come from India, followed by Pakistan, the Republic of Ireland, and Bangladesh. Up to two million people have obtained British citizenship since 2000, with approximately 200,000 successful applications each year. Compiled for the Migrants’ Rights Network, the study estimates that up to one million Commonwealth citizens without British citizenship are currently eligible to vote—an arrangement not always extended to British residents abroad. A report commissioned in 2008 by then Prime Minister Gordon Brown called for limiting the voting rights of non-citizen Commonwealth nationals in general elections, but neither Labour nor subsequent governments have implemented changes. Organizations such as MigrationWatch UK highlight that these voting policies are unbalanced, as most Commonwealth nations do not give British residents similar rights. The Runnymede Trust found that in 2010, 68% of minority voters supported Labour, compared to 16% for the Conservatives and 14% for the Liberal Democrats. While migrant voters are diverse and do not constitute a single group, trends suggest many gravitate toward parties perceived as supportive on race and immigration issues. The main political parties, however, have largely failed to address this growing segment of the electorate. Some analysts warn that ongoing neglect could have long-term political consequences. EU nationals can vote in local elections but not for Parliament. This week, Ukip leader Nigel Farage argued that they should also be excluded from future EU referendums. Lord Green from MigrationWatch said the UK’s current practice of granting voting rights to some foreign citizens is outdated, calling for a thorough review based on fairness and practicality.

article_content: MTV personality Diem Brown has shared her experiences following a major medical ordeal. Ten days after undergoing an emergency hysterectomy, Brown, 32, has been released from the hospital. Her ordeal began when she collapsed on the set of a new reality show and was flown to a New York City hospital. There, doctors diagnosed her with colon cancer after discovering multiple tumors in her colon, uterus, and stomach lining. Unable to save her uterus during surgery, Brown described feeling a profound sense of loss, explaining that it was tied to her sense of womanhood and hopes for the future. In addition to coming to terms with having a colostomy bag, Brown recalled her medical team explaining how risky her surgery had been. Despite her grief over her changed body and inability to carry children, Brown expressed gratitude for survival. She said, 'I might not have the ability to ever carry a child and I have this bag for the time being – but I'm alive.' Brown underwent a second operation three days later due to an abdominal infection. According to her sister, Brown is waiting to start chemotherapy once sufficiently recovered and remains on medication; glimpses of her positive spirit still shine through during recovery. This isn't Brown's first cancer battle. Diagnosed with ovarian cancer at age 23, she had an ovary, part of her fallopian tube, and lymph nodes removed. After being cancer-free for seven years, she faced a recurrence in 2012, which led to the loss of her remaining ovary. Before the second diagnosis, Brown preserved her fertility by freezing her eggs, hoping to have children in the future. Following her 2012 diagnosis, Brown bravely documented her experiences, including a video showing the reality of chemotherapy-induced hair loss. She explained her intent was to demystify the process for others dealing with similar struggles. Beyond her personal journey, Brown is the founder of MedGift, a registry designed to provide support for patients facing serious illnesses.

article_content: World leaders will gather next week for crucial UN climate talks at COP28 in the United Arab Emirates, amid what is likely the hottest year in human history. The conference is set to be the largest UN climate change event ever, with over 70,000 participants—including Pope Francis, King Charles III, political leaders, activists, and lobbyists. Negotiators are expected to debate key issues such as the future of oil, gas, and coal, alongside financial support from wealthy polluters to poorer nations most vulnerable to climate impacts. The main focus will be on assessing the world's limited progress in curbing global warming—a process that will require an official response during talks from November 30 to December 12. About 140 heads of state and government will address a two-day summit starting December 1. Scientists have warned that the 1.5°C warming limit set by the Paris Agreement is quickly slipping out of reach. Alden Meyer from the think tank E3G described a 'corrosive lack of trust' in global negotiations, worsened by recent geopolitical tensions such as Russia's invasion of Ukraine, financial crises, and the COVID-19 pandemic. Activists have raised concerns about the influence of fossil fuel interests at COP28, given that the summit president, Sultan Al Jaber, is both the UAE climate envoy and CEO of the state-owned oil company ADNOC. However, many hope the conference will prioritize a phase-out of fossil fuels as central to addressing climate change. Mitzi Jonelle Tan from Fridays for Future Philippines noted, 'It's both an opportunity and a challenge to ensure a fossil fuel phaseout is discussed at COP.' The 2015 Paris Agreement aimed to keep global warming well below 2°C over pre-industrial levels, ideally to 1.5°C. While clean energy growth—such as in China, the US, and Europe—has led the IEA to predict fossil fuel demand will peak by 2030, global emissions are still rising. The UN Environment Programme warned this week the world could see up to 2.9°C of warming, even if countries honor their current pledges, and called for faster action from G20 nations. The IPCC advises emissions must decline by 43% this decade to meet the 1.5°C goal, but nearly 1.2°C of warming has already led to extreme heatwaves, wildfires, floods, and storms. This year is expected to be the warmest on record, with proxy data suggesting temperatures are unprecedented in the past 100,000 years. Australia and Tuvalu recently struck a landmark agreement to offer residency to Tuvaluans in case their islands are submerged by rising sea levels, illustrating the high stakes of climate inaction. For decades, UN climate talks largely sidestepped the topic of fossil fuels until COP26 in Glasgow recognized the need to 'phasedown' unfiltered coal power and eliminate inefficient fossil fuel subsidies. Momentum for a fossil fuel phaseout has grown since then, with calls to scale up renewable energy and double energy efficiency by 2030. Still, concerns remain as to whether these measures will be included in legally binding agreements or left as voluntary pledges. Financing remains contentious: while wealthy nations may have finally met their target of $100 billion in annual climate finance for poorer countries, the amount is insufficient and came two years late. An agreement on a 'loss and damage' fund, intended to help climate-vulnerable nations, was recently reached, though many details are still unresolved. A recent US-China climate declaration is viewed as a positive shift, yet uncertainty remains about whether other major developing countries, such as India, will raise their level of climate ambition.
translated_content: מנהיגי העולם יתכנסו בשבוע הבא לשיחות האקלים הקריטיות של האו"ם ב-COP28, שמתקיימות באיחוד האמירויות בשנת השיא החמה ביותר שנרשמה אי פעם. הכנס צפוי להיות אירוע האקלים הגדול ביותר של האו"ם – עם למעלה מ-70,000 משתתפים, בהם האפיפיור פרנסיסקוס, המלך צ'ארלס השלישי, מנהיגים, פעילים ולוביסטים. במרכז הדיונים יעמדו סוגיות כמו עתיד הנפט, הגז והפחם, ותמיכה כלכלית מהמדינות העשירות למדינות פגיעות במיוחד מהתחממות. מוקד מרכזי אחר: דוח מצב על קצב ההתמודדות הגלובלית עם משבר האקלים – תהליך הדורש תגובה רשמית בדיוני COP28 בין 30 בנובמבר ל-12 בדצמבר. כ-140 ראשי מדינות וממשלות ינאמו בפתיחת הפסגה הדו-יומית המתחילה ב-1 בדצמבר. לדברי מדענים, היעד של הגבלת ההתחממות ל-1.5 מעלות, כפי שנקבע בהסכם פריז, הולך ומתרחק. אלדן מאייר ממכון E3G ציין כי קיים "חוסר אמון משחית" בדיונים, שהוחמר עקב משברים גיאופוליטיים – בין השאר בעקבות הפלישה הרוסית לאוקראינה, משברים פיננסיים וקורונה. פעילי סביבה חוששים מהשפעת תעשיית הדלקים הפוסיליים בכנס, במיוחד כשסולטן אל ג'אבר, נשיא COP28, הוא גם שליח האקלים של האמירויות ומנכ"ל ADNOC. עם זאת, יש תקווה שהוועידה תשים את מעבר הדלקים הפוסיליים במרכז. מיטסי ג'ונל טאן מ-Fridays for Future הפיליפינית אמרה: 'זו הזדמנות ואתגר להוביל דיון בנושא הפסקת השימוש בדלקים פוסיליים ב-COP.' הסכם פריז קבע יעד להגביל התחממות ל-2 מעלות ומטה, ורצוי ל-1.5 מעלות מעל עידן קדם-תעשייתי. למרות צמיחה חזקה באנרגיה מתחדשת בסין, ארה"ב ואירופה – ולפי תחזית IEA שיא ביקוש לדלקים פוסיליים יגיע עד 2030 – הפליטות עודן עולות. לדברי תוכנית הסביבה של האו"ם, גם אם ימומשו ההתחייבויות הנוכחיות, העולם בדרך להתחממות של עד 2.9 מעלות וקראה לגי-20 להאיץ צעדים. דו"ח IPCC קובע כי יש להפחית את הפליטות ב-43% בעשור הקרוב לעמוד ביעד 1.5 מעלות, אך כבר יש התחממות של 1.2 מעלות המובילה לגלי חום קיצוניים, שריפות, הצפות וסופות. השנה צפויה להיות החמה בהיסטוריה, ונתונים מעידים כי טמפרטורות כאלו לא נרשמו מזה 100,000 שנים. אוסטרליה וטובאלו הגיעו להסכם היסטורי: מתן תושבות לאזרחי טובאלו אם אייהם יוצפו כתוצאה מעליית פני הים – דוגמה בולטת להשלכות המשבר. שנים רבות שיחות האקלים של האו"ם כמעט לא התייחסו ישירות לדלקים פוסיליים, עד COP26 בגלזגו. אז הוסכם על הפחתה הדרגתית של פחם והתייעלות בסובסידיות. התגברה הקריאה להפסקת דלקים פוסיליים והגדלת שימוש באנרגיה מתחדשת עד 2030, אך טרם ברור אם צעדים אלה יהיו מחייבים או בגדר התחייבויות וולונטריות. המימון למדינות מתפתחות – נושא נפיץ: למרות שהמדינות העשירות עמדו ביעד ה-100 מיליארד דולר למימון אקלים, זה קרה באיחור של שנתיים והסכום לא מספיק. הושג לאחרונה הסכם ראשוני לקרן 'אובדן ונזק', אך פרטים רבים עדיין לא סגורים. הצהרת אקלים משותפת של סין וארה"ב נחשבת לאות חיובי, אך לא ברור אם מדינות כמו הודו יבחרו להעלות את רמת השאיפות בנוגע לאקלים.
